text_en: The vision of Isaiah the Son of Amos , which he saw concerning Juda and Jerusalem in the days of Ozias , Joathan, Achaz , and Ezechias , kings of Juda .
text_la: Visio Isaiæ, filii Amos, quam vidit super Judam et Jerusalem, in diebus Oziæ, Joathan, Achaz, et Ezechiæ, regum Juda.
text_pt: Visão de Isaías, filho de Amós, que ele teve a respeito de Judá e Jerusalém, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz, e Ezequias, reis de Judá.
text_el: ὅρασις ἣν εἶδεν Ησαιας υἱὸς Αμως ἣν εἶδεν κατὰ τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ κατὰ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν βασιλείᾳ Οζιου καὶ Ιωαθαμ καὶ Αχαζ καὶ Εζεκιου οἳ ἐβασίλευσαν τῆς Ιουδαίας

text_en: Hear, O you heavens , and give ear, O earth, for the Lord has spoken. I have brought up children, and exalted them: but they have despised me.
text_la: Audite, cæli, et auribus percipe, terra, quoniam Dominus locutus est. Filios enutrivi, et exaltavi; ipsi autem spreverunt me.
text_pt: Ouvi, ó céus, e dá ouvidos, tu, ó terra; porque o Senhor tem falado: Criei filhos, e engrandeci-os; mas eles se rebelaram contra mim.
text_el: ἄκουε οὐρανέ καὶ ἐνωτίζου γῆ ὅτι κύριος ἐλάλησεν υἱοὺς ἐγέννησα καὶ ὕψωσα αὐτοὶ δέ με ἠθέτησαν

text_en: The ox knows his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel has not known me, and my people has not understood.
text_la: Cognovit bos possessorem suum, et asinus præsepe domini sui; Israël autem me non cognovit, et populus meus non intellexit.
text_pt: O boi conhece o seu possuidor, e o jumento a manjedoura do seu dono; mas Israel não tem conhecimento, o meu povo não entende.
text_el: ἔγνω βοῦς τὸν κτησάμενον καὶ ὄνος τὴν φάτνην τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ δέ με οὐκ ἔγνω καὶ ὁ λαός με οὐ συνῆκεν

text_en: Woe to the sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity , a wicked seed, ungracious children: they have forsaken the Lord , they have blasphemed the Holy One of Israel , they have gone away backwards.
text_la: Væ genti peccatrici, populo gravi iniquitate, semini nequam, filiis sceleratis! dereliquerunt Dominum; blasphemaverunt Sanctum Israël; abalienati sunt retrorsum.
text_pt: Ai, nação pecadora, povo carregado de iniqüidade, descendência de malfeitores, filhos corruptores; deixaram ao Senhor, blasfemaram o Santo de Israel, voltaram para trás.
text_el: οὐαὶ ἔθνος ἁμαρτωλόν λαὸς πλήρης ἁμαρτιῶν σπέρμα πονηρόν υἱοὶ ἄνομοι ἐγκατελίπατε τὸν κύριον καὶ παρωργίσατε τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: For what shall I strike you any more, you that increase transgression ? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart is sad.
text_la: Super quo percutiam vos ultra, addentes prævaricationem? omne caput languidum, et omne cor mœrens.
text_pt: Por que seríeis ainda castigados, se mais vos rebelaríeis? Toda a cabeça está enferma e todo o coração fraco.
text_el: τί ἔτι πληγῆτε προστιθέντες ἀνομίαν πᾶσα κεφαλὴ εἰς πόνον καὶ πᾶσα καρδία εἰς λύπην

text_en: From the sole of the foot unto the top of the head, there is no soundness therein: wounds and bruises and swelling sores: they are not bound up, nor dressed, nor fomented with oil.
text_la: A planta pedis usque ad verticem, non est in eo sanitas; vulnus, et livor, et plaga tumens, non est circumligata, nec curata medicamine, neque fota oleo.
text_pt: Desde a planta do pé até a cabeça não há nele coisa sã, senão feridas, e inchaços, e chagas podres não espremidas, nem ligadas, nem amolecidas com óleo.
text_el: ἀπὸ ποδῶν ἕως κεφαλῆς οὔτε τραῦμα οὔτε μώλωψ οὔτε πληγὴ φλεγμαίνουσα οὐκ ἔστιν μάλαγμα ἐπιθεῖναι οὔτε ἔλαιον οὔτε καταδέσμους

text_en: Your land is desolate, your cities are burnt with fire: your country strangers devour before your face, and it shall be desolate as when wasted by enemies.
text_la: Terra vestra deserta; civitates vestræ succensæ igni : regionem vestram coram vobis alieni devorant, et desolabitur sicut in vastitate hostili.
text_pt: A vossa terra está assolada, as vossas cidades estão abrasadas pelo fogo; a vossa terra os estranhos a devoram em vossa presença; e está como devastada, numa subversão de estranhos.
text_el: ἡ γῆ ὑμῶν ἔρημος αἱ πόλεις ὑμῶν πυρίκαυστοι τὴν χώραν ὑμῶν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ἀλλότριοι κατεσθίουσιν αὐτήν καὶ ἠρήμωται κατεστραμμένη ὑπὸ λαῶν ἀλλοτρίων

text_en: And the daughter of Sion shall be left as a covert in a vineyard, and as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, and as a city that is laid waste.
text_la: Et derelinquetur filia Sion ut umbraculum in vinea, et sicut tugurium in cucumerario, et sicut civitas quæ vastatur.
text_pt: E a filha de Sião é deixada como a cabana na vinha, como a choupana no pepinal, como uma cidade sitiada.
text_el: ἐγκαταλειφθήσεται ἡ θυγάτηρ Σιων ὡς σκηνὴ ἐν ἀμπελῶνι καὶ ὡς ὀπωροφυλάκιον ἐν σικυηράτῳ ὡς πόλις πολιορκουμένη

text_en: Except the Lord of hosts had left us seed, we had been as Sodom , and we should have been like to Gomorrha .
text_la: Nisi Dominus exercituum reliquisset nobis semen, quasi Sodoma fuissemus, et quasi Gomorrha similes essemus.
text_pt: Se o Senhor dos Exércitos não nos tivesse deixado algum remanescente, já como Sodoma seríamos, e semelhantes a Gomorra.
text_el: καὶ εἰ μὴ κύριος σαβαωθ ἐγκατέλιπεν ἡμῖν σπέρμα ὡς Σοδομα ἂν ἐγενήθημεν καὶ ὡς Γομορρα ἂν ὡμοιώθημεν

text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , you rulers of Sodom , give ear to the law of our God , you people of Gomorrha .
text_la: Audite verbum Domini, principes Sodomorum; percipite auribus legem Dei nostri, populus Gomorrhæ.
text_pt: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor, vós poderosos de Sodoma; dai ouvidos à lei do nosso Deus, ó povo de Gomorra.
text_el: ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου ἄρχοντες Σοδομων προσέχετε νόμον θεοῦ λαὸς Γομορρας

text_en: To what purpose do you offer me the multitude of your victims, says the Lord ? I am full, I desire not holocausts of rams, and fat of fatlings, and blood of calves, and lambs, and buck goats.
text_la: Quo mihi multitudinem victimarum vestrarum? dicit Dominus. Plenus sum : holocausta arietum, et adipem pinguium, et sanguinem vitulorum et agnorum et hircorum, nolui.
text_pt: De que me serve a mim a multidão de vossos sacrifícios, diz o Senhor? Já estou farto dos holocaustos de carneiros, e da gordura de animais cevados; nem me agrado de sangue de bezerros, nem de cordeiros, nem de bodes.
text_el: τί μοι πλῆθος τῶν θυσιῶν ὑμῶν λέγει κύριος πλήρης εἰμὶ ὁλοκαυτωμάτων κριῶν καὶ στέαρ ἀρνῶν καὶ αἷμα ταύρων καὶ τράγων οὐ βούλομαι

text_en: When you came to appear before me, who required these things at your hands, that you should walk in my courts ?
text_la: Cum veniretis ante conspectum meum, quis quæsivit hæc de manibus vestris, ut ambularetis in atriis meis?
text_pt: Quando vindes para comparecer perante mim, quem requereu isto de vossas mãos, que viésseis a pisar os meus átrios?
text_el: οὐδ' ἐὰν ἔρχησθε ὀφθῆναί μοι τίς γὰρ ἐξεζήτησεν ταῦτα ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν πατεῖν τὴν αὐλήν μου

text_en: Offer sacrifice no more in vain: incense is an abomination to me. The new moons, and the sabbaths and other festivals I will not abide, your assemblies are wicked .
text_la: Ne offeratis ultra sacrificium frustra : incensum abominatio est mihi. Neomeniam et sabbatum, et festivitates alias, non feram; iniqui sunt cœtus vestri.
text_pt: Não continueis a trazer ofertas vãs; o incenso é para mim abominação, e as luas novas, e os sábados, e a convocação das assembléias; não posso suportar iniqüidade, nem mesmo a reunião solene.
text_el: οὐ προσθήσεσθε ἐὰν φέρητε σεμίδαλιν μάταιον θυμίαμα βδέλυγμά μοί ἐστιν τὰς νουμηνίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ σάββατα καὶ ἡμέραν μεγάλην οὐκ ἀνέχομαι νηστείαν καὶ ἀργίαν

text_en: My soul hates your new moons, and your solemnities : they have become troublesome to me, I am weary of bearing them.
text_la: Calendas vestras, et solemnitates vestras odivit anima mea : facta sunt mihi molesta; laboravi sustinens.
text_pt: As vossas luas novas, e as vossas solenidades, a minha alma as odeia; já me são pesadas; já estou cansado de as sofrer.
text_el: καὶ τὰς νουμηνίας ὑμῶν καὶ τὰς ἑορτὰς ὑμῶν μισεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐγενήθητέ μοι εἰς πλησμονήν οὐκέτι ἀνήσω τὰς ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν

text_en: And when you stretch forth your hands, I will turn away my eyes from you: and when you multiply prayer , I will not hear: for your hands are full of blood.
text_la: Et cum extenderitis manus vestras, avertam oculos meos a vobis, et cum multiplicaveritis orationem, non exaudiam : manus enim vestræ sanguine plenæ sunt.
text_pt: Por isso, quando estendeis as vossas mãos, escondo de vós os meus olhos; e ainda que multipliqueis as vossas orações, não as ouvirei, porque as vossas mãos estão cheias de sangue.
text_el: ὅταν τὰς χεῖρας ἐκτείνητε πρός με ἀποστρέψω τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου ἀφ' ὑμῶν καὶ ἐὰν πληθύνητε τὴν δέησιν οὐκ εἰσακούσομαι ὑμῶν αἱ γὰρ χεῖρες ὑμῶν αἵματος πλήρεις

text_en: Wash yourselves, be clean, take away the evil of your devices from my eyes, cease to do perversely,
text_la: Lavamini, mundi estote; auferte malum cogitationum vestrarum ab oculis meis : quiescite agere perverse,
text_pt: Lavai-vos, purificai-vos, tirai a maldade de vossos atos de diante dos meus olhos; cessai de fazer mal.
text_el: λούσασθε καθαροὶ γένεσθε ἀφέλετε τὰς πονηρίας ἀπὸ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου παύσασθε ἀπὸ τῶν πονηριῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: learn to do well: seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge for the fatherless , defend the widow .
text_la: discite benefacere; quærite judicium, subvenite oppresso, judicate pupillo, defendite viduam.
text_pt: Aprendei a fazer bem; procurai o que é justo; ajudai o oprimido; fazei justiça ao órfão; tratai da causa das viúvas.
text_el: μάθετε καλὸν ποιεῖν ἐκζητήσατε κρίσιν ῥύσασθε ἀδικούμενον κρίνατε ὀρφανῷ καὶ δικαιώσατε χήραν

text_en: And then come, and accuse me, says the Lord : if your sins be as scarlet, they shall be made as white as snow: and if they be red as crimson, they shall be white as wool.
text_la: Et venite, et arguite me, dicit Dominus. Si fuerint peccata vestra ut coccinum, quasi nix dealbabuntur; et si fuerint rubra quasi vermiculus, velut lana alba erunt.
text_pt: Vinde então, e argüi-me, diz o Senhor: ainda que os vossos pecados sejam como a escarlata, eles se tornarão brancos como a neve; ainda que sejam vermelhos como o carmesim, se tornarão como a branca lã.
text_el: καὶ δεῦτε καὶ διελεγχθῶμεν λέγει κύριος καὶ ἐὰν ὦσιν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ὑμῶν ὡς φοινικοῦν ὡς χιόνα λευκανῶ ἐὰν δὲ ὦσιν ὡς κόκκινον ὡς ἔριον λευκανῶ

text_en: If you be willing, and will hearken to me, you shall eat the good things of the land.
text_la: Si volueritis, et audieritis me, bona terræ comeditis.
text_pt: Se quiserdes, e obedecerdes, comereis o bem desta terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν θέλητε καὶ εἰσακούσητέ μου τὰ ἀγαθὰ τῆς γῆς φάγεσθε

text_en: But if you will not, and will provoke me to wrath : the sword shall devour you because the mouth of the Lord has spoken it.
text_la: Quod si nolueritis, et me ad iracundiam provocaveritis, gladius devorabit vos, quia os Domini locutum est.
text_pt: Mas se recusardes, e fordes rebeldes, sereis devorados à espada; porque a boca do Senhor o disse.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ θέλητε μηδὲ εἰσακούσητέ μου μάχαιρα ὑμᾶς κατέδεται τὸ γὰρ στόμα κυρίου ἐλάλησεν ταῦτα

text_en: How is the faithful city, that was full of judgment , become a harlot? justice dwelt in it, but now murderers .
text_la: Quomodo facta est meretrix civitas fidelis, plena judicii? justitia habitavit in ea, nunc autem homicidæ.
text_pt: Como se fez prostituta a cidade fiel! Ela que estava cheia de retidão! A justiça habitava nela, mas agora homicidas.
text_el: πῶς ἐγένετο πόρνη πόλις πιστὴ Σιων πλήρης κρίσεως ἐν ᾗ δικαιοσύνη ἐκοιμήθη ἐν αὐτῇ νῦν δὲ φονευταί

text_en: Your silver is turned into dross: your wine is mingled with water.
text_la: Argentum tuum versum est in scoriam; vinum tuum mistum est aqua.
text_pt: A tua prata tornou-se em escórias, o teu vinho se misturou com água.
text_el: τὸ ἀργύριον ὑμῶν ἀδόκιμον οἱ κάπηλοί σου μίσγουσι τὸν οἶνον ὕδατι

text_en: Your princes are faithless, companions of thieves : they all love bribes , they run after rewards. They judge not for the fatherless : and the widow's cause comes not in to them.
text_la: Principes tui infideles, socii furum. Omnes diligunt munera, sequuntur retributiones. Pupillo non judicant, et causa viduæ non ingreditur ad illos.
text_pt: Os teus príncipes são rebeldes, e companheiros de ladrões; cada um deles ama as peitas, e anda atrás das recompensas; não fazem justiça ao órfão, e não chega perante eles a causa da viúva.
text_el: οἱ ἄρχοντές σου ἀπειθοῦσιν κοινωνοὶ κλεπτῶν ἀγαπῶντες δῶρα διώκοντες ἀνταπόδομα ὀρφανοῖς οὐ κρίνοντες καὶ κρίσιν χηρῶν οὐ προσέχοντες

text_en: Therefore says the Lord the God of hosts , the mighty one of Israel : Ah! I will comfort myself over my adversaries: and I will be revenged of my enemies.
text_la: Propter hoc ait Dominus, Deus exercituum, Fortis Israël : Heu! consolabor super hostibus meis, et vindicabor de inimicis meis.
text_pt: Portanto diz o Senhor, o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Forte de Israel: Ah! tomarei satisfações dos meus adversários, e vingar-me-ei dos meus inimigos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει ὁ δεσπότης κύριος σαβαωθ οὐαὶ οἱ ἰσχύοντες Ισραηλ οὐ παύσεται γάρ μου ὁ θυμὸς ἐν τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις καὶ κρίσιν ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου ποιήσω

text_en: And I will turn my hand to you, and I will clean purge away your dross, and I will take away all your tin.
text_la: Et convertam manum meam ad te, et excoquam ad puram scoriam tuam, et auferam omne stannum tuum.
text_pt: E voltarei contra ti a minha mão, e purificarei inteiramente as tuas escórias; e tirar-te-ei toda a impureza.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάξω τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ πυρώσω σε εἰς καθαρόν τοὺς δὲ ἀπειθοῦντας ἀπολέσω καὶ ἀφελῶ πάντας ἀνόμους ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ πάντας ὑπερηφάνους ταπεινώσω

text_en: And I will restore your judges as they were before, and your counsellors as of old. After this you shall be called the city of the just , a faithful city.
text_la: Et restituam judices tuos ut fuerunt prius, et consiliarios tuos sicut antiquitus; post hæc vocaberis civitas justi, urbs fidelis.
text_pt: E te restituirei os teus juízes, como foram dantes; e os teus conselheiros, como antigamente; e então te chamarão cidade de justiça, cidade fiel.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστήσω τοὺς κριτάς σου ὡς τὸ πρότερον καὶ τοὺς συμβούλους σου ὡς τὸ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα κληθήσῃ πόλις δικαιοσύνης μητρόπολις πιστὴ Σιων

text_en: Sion shall be redeemed in judgment , and they shall bring her back in justice .
text_la: Sion in judicio redimetur, et reducent eam in justitia.
text_pt: Sião será remida com juízo, e os que voltam para ela com justiça.
text_el: μετὰ γὰρ κρίματος σωθήσεται ἡ αἰχμαλωσία αὐτῆς καὶ μετὰ ἐλεημοσύνης

text_en: And he shall destroy the wicked , and the sinners together: and they that have forsaken the Lord , shall be consumed.
text_la: Et conteret scelestos, et peccatores simul; et qui dereliquerunt Dominum consumentur.
text_pt: Mas os transgressores e os pecadores serão juntamente destruídos; e os que deixarem o Senhor serão consumidos.
text_el: καὶ συντριβήσονται οἱ ἄνομοι καὶ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἅμα καὶ οἱ ἐγκαταλείποντες τὸν κύριον συντελεσθήσονται

text_en: For they shall be confounded for the idols , to which they have sacrificed : and you shall be ashamed of the gardens which you have chosen.
text_la: Confundentur enim ab idolis quibus sacrificaverunt, et erubescetis super hortis quos elegeratis,
text_pt: Porque vos envergonhareis pelos carvalhos que cobiçastes, e sereis confundidos pelos jardins que escolhestes.
text_el: διότι αἰσχυνθήσονται ἐπὶ τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν ἃ αὐτοὶ ἠβούλοντο καὶ ἐπῃσχύνθησαν ἐπὶ τοῖς κήποις αὐτῶν ἃ ἐπεθύμησαν

text_en: When you shall be as an oak with the leaves falling off, and as a garden without water.
text_la: cum fueritis velut quercus defluentibus foliis, et velut hortus absque aqua.
text_pt: Porque sereis como o carvalho, ao qual caem as folhas, e como o jardim que não tem água.
text_el: ἔσονται γὰρ ὡς τερέβινθος ἀποβεβληκυῖα τὰ φύλλα καὶ ὡς παράδεισος ὕδωρ μὴ ἔχων

text_en: And your strength shall be as the ashes of tow, and your work as a spark: and both shall burn together, and there shall be none to quench it.
text_la: Et erit fortitudo vestra ut favilla stuppæ, et opus vestrum quasi scintilla, et succendetur utrumque simul, et non erit qui extinguat.
text_pt: E o forte se tornará em estopa, e a sua obra em faísca; e ambos arderão juntamente, e não haverá quem os apague.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτῶν ὡς καλάμη στιππύου καὶ αἱ ἐργασίαι αὐτῶν ὡς σπινθῆρες πυρός καὶ κατακαυθήσονται οἱ ἄνομοι καὶ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἅμα καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ σβέσων

text_en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amos saw, concerning Juda and Jerusalem .
text_la: Verbum quod vidit Isaias, filius Amos, super Juda et Jerusalem.
text_pt: Palavra que viu Isaías, filho de Amós, a respeito de Judá e de Jerusalém.
text_el: ὁ λόγος ὁ γενόμενος παρὰ κυρίου πρὸς Ησαιαν υἱὸν Αμως περὶ τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ περὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And in the last days the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be prepared on the top of mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills, and all nations shall flow unto it.
text_la: Et erit in novissimis diebus : præparatus mons domus Domini in vertice montium, et elevabitur super colles; et fluent ad eum omnes gentes,
text_pt: E acontecerá nos últimos dias que se firmará o monte da casa do Senhor no cume dos montes, e se elevará por cima dos outeiros; e concorrerão a ele todas as nações.
text_el: ὅτι ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις ἐμφανὲς τὸ ὄρος κυρίου καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπ' ἄκρων τῶν ὀρέων καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὑπεράνω τῶν βουνῶν καὶ ἥξουσιν ἐπ' αὐτὸ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: And many people shall go, and say: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , and to the house of the God of Jacob , and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion , and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem .
text_la: et ibunt populi multi, et dicent : Venite, et ascendamus ad montem Domini, et ad domum Dei Jacob; et docebit nos vias suas, et ambulabimus in semitis ejus, quia de Sion exibit lex, et verbum Domini de Jerusalem.
text_pt: E irão muitos povos, e dirão: Vinde, subamos ao monte do Senhor, à casa do Deus de Jacó, para que nos ensine os seus caminhos, e andemos nas suas veredas; porque de Sião sairá a lei, e de Jerusalém a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πορεύσονται ἔθνη πολλὰ καὶ ἐροῦσιν δεῦτε καὶ ἀναβῶμεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος κυρίου καὶ εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ἡμῖν τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πορευσόμεθα ἐν αὐτῇ ἐκ γὰρ Σιων ἐξελεύσεται νόμος καὶ λόγος κυρίου ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And he shall judge the Gentiles , and rebuke many people: and they shall turn their swords into ploughshares, and their spears into sickles: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they be exercised any more to war .
text_la: Et judicabit gentes, et arguet populos multos; et conflabunt gladios suos in vomeres, et lanceas suas in falces. Non levabit gens contra gentem gladium, nec exercebuntur ultra ad prælium.
text_pt: E ele julgará entre as nações, e repreenderá a muitos povos; e estes converterão as suas espadas em enxadões e as suas lanças em foices; uma nação não levantará espada contra outra nação, nem aprenderão mais a guerrear.
text_el: καὶ κρινεῖ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ ἐλέγξει λαὸν πολύν καὶ συγκόψουσιν τὰς μαχαίρας αὐτῶν εἰς ἄροτρα καὶ τὰς ζιβύνας αὐτῶν εἰς δρέπανα καὶ οὐ λήμψεται ἔτι ἔθνος ἐπ' ἔθνος μάχαιραν καὶ οὐ μὴ μάθωσιν ἔτι πολεμεῖν

text_en: O house of Jacob , come and let us walk in the light of the Lord .
text_la: Domus Jacob, venite, et ambulemus in lumine Domini.
text_pt: Vinde, ó casa de Jacó, e andemos na luz do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὁ οἶκος τοῦ Ιακωβ δεῦτε πορευθῶμεν τῷ φωτὶ κυρίου

text_en: For you have cast off your people, the house of Jacob : because they are filled as in times past, and have had soothsayers as the Philistines , and have adhered to strange children.
text_la: Projecisti enim populum tuum, domum Jacob, quia repleti sunt ut olim, et augeres habuerunt ut Philisthiim, et pueris alienis adhæserunt.
text_pt: Mas tu desamparaste o teu povo, a casa de Jacó, porque se encheram dos costumes do oriente e são agoureiros como os filisteus; e associam-se com os filhos dos estrangeiros,
text_el: ἀνῆκεν γὰρ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Ισραηλ ὅτι ἐνεπλήσθη ὡς τὸ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἡ χώρα αὐτῶν κληδονισμῶν ὡς ἡ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ τέκνα πολλὰ ἀλλόφυλα ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς

text_en: Their land is filled with silver and gold: and there is no end of their treasures.
text_la: Repleta est terra argento et auro, et non est finis thesaurorum ejus.
text_pt: E a sua terra está cheia de prata e ouro, e não têm fim os seus tesouros; também a sua terra está cheia de cavalos, e os seus carros não têm fim.
text_el: ἐνεπλήσθη γὰρ ἡ χώρα αὐτῶν ἀργυρίου καὶ χρυσίου καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἀριθμὸς τῶν θησαυρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐνεπλήσθη ἡ γῆ ἵππων καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἀριθμὸς τῶν ἁρμάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: And their land is filled with horses: and their chariots are innumerable. Their land also is full of idols : they have adored the work of their own hands, which their own fingers have made.
text_la: Et repleta est terra ejus equis, et innumerabiles quadrigæ ejus. Et repleta est terra ejus idolis; opus manuum suarum adoraverunt, quod fecerunt digiti eorum.
text_pt: Também a sua terra está cheia de ídolos; inclinam-se perante a obra das suas mãos, diante daquilo que fabricaram os seus dedos.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεπλήσθη ἡ γῆ βδελυγμάτων τῶν ἔργων τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν οἷς ἐποίησαν οἱ δάκτυλοι αὐτῶν

text_en: And man has bowed himself down, and man has been debased: therefore forgive them not.
text_la: Et incurvavit se homo, et humiliatus est vir; ne ergo dimittas eis.
text_pt: E o povo se abate, e os nobres se humilham; portanto não lhes perdoarás.
text_el: καὶ ἔκυψεν ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἐταπεινώθη ἀνήρ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀνήσω αὐτούς

text_en: Enter into the rock, and hide you in the pit from the face of the fear of the Lord , and from the glory of his majesty.
text_la: Ingredere in petram, et abscondere in fossa humo a facie timoris Domini, et a gloria majestatis ejus.
text_pt: Entra nas rochas, e esconde-te no pó, do terror do Senhor e da glória da sua majestade.
text_el: καὶ νῦν εἰσέλθετε εἰς τὰς πέτρας καὶ κρύπτεσθε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ φόβου κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ ὅταν ἀναστῇ θραῦσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: The lofty eyes of man are humbled , and the haughtiness of men shall be made to stoop: and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
text_la: Oculi sublimes hominis humiliati sunt, et incurvabitur altitudo virorum; exaltabitur autem Dominus solus in die illa.
text_pt: Os olhos altivos dos homens serão abatidos, e a sua altivez será humilhada; e só o Senhor será exaltado naquele dia.
text_el: οἱ γὰρ ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου ὑψηλοί ὁ δὲ ἄνθρωπος ταπεινός καὶ ταπεινωθήσεται τὸ ὕψος τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ ὑψωθήσεται κύριος μόνος ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

text_en: Because the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and highminded, and upon every one that is arrogant , and he shall be humbled .
text_la: Quia dies Domini exercituum super omnem superbum, et excelsum, et super omnem arrogantem, et humiliabitur;
text_pt: Porque o dia do Senhor dos Exércitos será contra todo o soberbo e altivo, e contra todo o que se exalta, para que seja abatido;
text_el: ἡμέρα γὰρ κυρίου σαβαωθ ἐπὶ πάντα ὑβριστὴν καὶ ὑπερήφανον καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα ὑψηλὸν καὶ μετέωρον καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται

text_en: And upon all the tall and lofty cedars of Libanus , and upon all the oaks of Basan.
text_la: et super omnes cedros Libani sublimes et erectas, et super omnes quercus Basan,
text_pt: E contra todos os cedros do Líbano, altos e sublimes; e contra todos os carvalhos de Basã;
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν κέδρον τοῦ Λιβάνου τῶν ὑψηλῶν καὶ μετεώρων καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν δένδρον βαλάνου Βασαν

text_en: And upon all the high mountains and upon all the elevated hills.
text_la: et super omnes montes excelsos, et super omnes colles elevatos,
text_pt: E contra todos os montes altos, e contra todos os outeiros elevados;
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα βουνὸν ὑψηλὸν

text_en: And upon every high tower, and every fenced wall.
text_la: et super omnem turrim excelsam, et super omnem murum munitum,
text_pt: E contra toda a torre alta, e contra todo o muro fortificado;
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα πύργον ὑψηλὸν καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν τεῖχος ὑψηλὸν

text_en: And upon all the ships of Tharsis, and upon all that is fair to behold.
text_la: et super omnes naves Tharsis, et super omne quod visu pulchrum est,
text_pt: E contra todos os navios de Társis, e contra todas as pinturas desejáveis.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν πλοῖον θαλάσσης καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν θέαν πλοίων κάλλους

text_en: And the loftiness of men shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be humbled , and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
text_la: et incurvabitur sublimitas hominum, et humiliabitur altitudo virorum, et elevabitur Dominus solus in die illa;
text_pt: E a arrogância do homem será humilhada, e a sua altivez se abaterá, e só o Senhor será exaltado naquele dia.
text_el: καὶ ταπεινωθήσεται πᾶς ἄνθρωπος καὶ πεσεῖται ὕψος ἀνθρώπων καὶ ὑψωθήσεται κύριος μόνος ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

text_en: And idols shall be utterly destroyed.
text_la: et idola penitus conterentur;
text_pt: E todos os ídolos desaparecerão totalmente.
text_el: καὶ τὰ χειροποίητα πάντα κατακρύψουσιν

text_en: And they shall go into the holes of rocks, and into the caves of the earth from the face of the fear of the Lord , and from the glory of his majesty, when he shall rise up to strike the earth.
text_la: et introibunt in speluncas petrarum, et in voragines terræ, a facie formidinis Domini et a gloria majestatis ejus, cum surrexerit percutere terram.
text_pt: Então os homens entrarão nas cavernas das rochas, e nas covas da terra, do terror do Senhor, e da glória da sua majestade, quando ele se levantar para assombrar a terra.
text_el: εἰσενέγκαντες εἰς τὰ σπήλαια καὶ εἰς τὰς σχισμὰς τῶν πετρῶν καὶ εἰς τὰς τρώγλας τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ φόβου κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ ὅταν ἀναστῇ θραῦσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: In that day a man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which he had made for himself to adore , moles and bats.
text_la: In die illa projiciet homo idola argenti sui, et simulacra auri sui, quæ fecerat sibi ut adoraret, talpas et vespertiliones.
text_pt: Naquele dia o homem lançará às toupeiras e aos morcegos os seus ídolos de prata, e os seus ídolos de ouro, que fizeram para diante deles se prostrarem.
text_el: τῇ γὰρ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐκβαλεῖ ἄνθρωπος τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτοῦ τὰ ἀργυρᾶ καὶ τὰ χρυσᾶ ἃ ἐποίησαν προσκυνεῖν τοῖς ματαίοις καὶ ταῖς νυκτερίσιν

text_en: And he shall go into the clefts of rocks, and into the holes of stones from the face of the fear of the Lord , and from the glory of his majesty, when he shall rise up to strike the earth.
text_la: Et ingreditur scissuras petrarum et in cavernas saxorum, a facie formidinis Domini, et a gloria majestatis ejus, cum surrexerit percutere terram.
text_pt: E entrarão nas fendas das rochas, e nas cavernas das penhas, por causa do terror do Senhor, e da glória da sua majestade, quando ele se levantar para abalar terrivelmente a terra.
text_el: τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὰς τρώγλας τῆς στερεᾶς πέτρας καὶ εἰς τὰς σχισμὰς τῶν πετρῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ φόβου κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ ὅταν ἀναστῇ θραῦσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: Cease therefore from the man , whose breath is in his nostrils, for he is reputed high.
text_la: Quiescite ergo ab homine, cujus spiritus in naribus ejus est, quia excelsus reputatus est ipse.
text_pt: Deixai-vos do homem cujo fôlego está nas suas narinas; pois em que se deve ele estimar?

text_en: For behold the sovereign Lord of hosts shall take away from Jerusalem , and from Juda the valiant and the strong, the whole strength of bread, and the whole strength of water.
text_la: Ecce enim Dominator, Dominus exercituum, auferet a Jerusalem et a Juda validum et fortem, omne robur panis, et omne robor aquæ;
text_pt: Porque, eis que o Senhor, o SENHOR dos Exércitos, tirará de Jerusalém e de Judá o sustento e o apoio; a todo o sustento de pão e a todo o sustento de água;
text_el: ἰδοὺ δὴ ὁ δεσπότης κύριος σαβαωθ ἀφελεῖ ἀπὸ τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ ἰσχύοντα καὶ ἰσχύουσαν ἰσχὺν ἄρτου καὶ ἰσχὺν ὕδατος

text_en: The strong man , and the man of war , the judge, and the prophet and the cunning man , and the ancient.
text_la: fortem, et virum bellatorem, judicem, et prophetam, et ariolum, et senem;
text_pt: O poderoso, e o homem de guerra, o juiz, e o profeta, e o adivinho, e o ancião,
text_el: γίγαντα καὶ ἰσχύοντα καὶ ἄνθρωπον πολεμιστὴν καὶ δικαστὴν καὶ προφήτην καὶ στοχαστὴν καὶ πρεσβύτερον

text_en: The captain over fifty, and the honourable in countenance, and the counsellor, and the architect, and the skilful in eloquent speech.
text_la: principem super quinquaginta, et honorabilem vultu et consiliarium, et sapientem de architectis, et prudentem eloquii mystici.
text_pt: O capitão de cinqüenta, e o homem respeitável, e o conselheiro, e o sábio entre os artífices, e o eloqüente orador.
text_el: καὶ πεντηκόνταρχον καὶ θαυμαστὸν σύμβουλον καὶ σοφὸν ἀρχιτέκτονα καὶ συνετὸν ἀκροατήν

text_en: And I will give children to be their princes, and the effeminate shall rule over them.
text_la: Et dabo pueros principes eorum, et effeminati dominabuntur eis;
text_pt: E dar-lhes-ei meninos por príncipes, e crianças governarão sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστήσω νεανίσκους ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐμπαῖκται κυριεύσουσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the people shall rush one upon another, and every man against his neighbour: the child shall make a tumult against the ancient, and the base against the honourable .
text_la: et irruet populus, vir ad virum, et unusquisque ad proximum suum; tumultuabitur puer contra senem, et ignobilis contra nobilem.
text_pt: E o povo será oprimido; um será contra o outro, e cada um contra o seu próximo; o menino se atreverá contra o ancião, e o vil contra o nobre.
text_el: καὶ συμπεσεῖται ὁ λαός ἄνθρωπος πρὸς ἄνθρωπον καὶ ἄνθρωπος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ προσκόψει τὸ παιδίον πρὸς τὸν πρεσβύτην ὁ ἄτιμος πρὸς τὸν ἔντιμον

text_en: For a man shall take hold of his brother, one of the house of his father, saying: You have a garment, be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.
text_la: Apprehendet enim vir fratrem suum, domesticum patris sui : Vestimentum tibi est, princeps esto noster, ruina autem hæc sub manu tua.
text_pt: Quando alguém pegar de seu irmão na casa de seu pai, dizendo: Tu tens roupa, sê nosso governador, e toma sob a tua mão esta ruína;
text_el: ὅτι ἐπιλήμψεται ἄνθρωπος τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ ἢ τοῦ οἰκείου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ λέγων ἱμάτιον ἔχεις ἀρχηγὸς ἡμῶν γενοῦ καὶ τὸ βρῶμα τὸ ἐμὸν ὑπὸ σὲ ἔστω

text_en: In that day he shall answer, saying: I am no healer, and in my house there is no bread, nor clothing: make me not ruler of the people.
text_la: Respondebit in die illa, dicens : Non sum medicus, et in domo mea non est panis neque vestimentum : nolite constituere me principem populi.
text_pt: Naquele dia levantará este a sua voz, dizendo: Não posso ser médico, nem tampouco há em minha casa pão, ou roupa alguma; não me haveis de constituir governador sobre o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ἐρεῖ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ οὐκ ἔσομαί σου ἀρχηγός οὐ γὰρ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου ἄρτος οὐδὲ ἱμάτιον οὐκ ἔσομαι ἀρχηγὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου

text_en: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Juda is fallen: because their tongue, and their devices are against the Lord , to provoke the eyes of his majesty.
text_la: Ruit enim Jerusalem, et Judas concidit, quia lingua eorum et adinventiones eorum contra Dominum, ut provocarent oculos majestatis ejus.
text_pt: Porque Jerusalém está arruinada, e Judá caída; porque a sua língua e as suas obras são contra o Senhor, para provocarem os olhos da sua glória.
text_el: ὅτι ἀνεῖται Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἡ Ιουδαία συμπέπτωκεν καὶ αἱ γλῶσσαι αὐτῶν μετὰ ἀνομίας τὰ πρὸς κύριον ἀπειθοῦντες διότι νῦν ἐταπεινώθη ἡ δόξα αὐτῶν

text_en: The show of their countenance has answered them: and they have proclaimed abroad their sin as Sodom , and they have not hid it: woe to their souls , for evils are rendered to them.
text_la: Agnitio vultus eorum respondit eis; et peccatum suum quasi Sodoma prædicaverunt, nec absconderunt. Væ animæ eorum, quoniam reddita sunt eis mala!
text_pt: O aspecto do seu rosto testifica contra eles; e publicam os seus pecados, como Sodoma; não os dissimulam. Ai da sua alma! Porque fazem mal a si mesmos.
text_el: καὶ ἡ αἰσχύνη τοῦ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἀντέστη αὐτοῖς τὴν δὲ ἁμαρτίαν αὐτῶν ὡς Σοδομων ἀνήγγειλαν καὶ ἐνεφάνισαν οὐαὶ τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτῶν διότι βεβούλευνται βουλὴν πονηρὰν καθ' ἑαυτῶν

text_en: Say to the just man that it is well, for he shall eat the fruit of his doings.
text_la: Dicite justo quoniam bene, quoniam fructum adinventionum suarum comedet.
text_pt: Dizei ao justo que bem lhe irá; porque comerão do fruto das suas obras.
text_el: εἰπόντες δήσωμεν τὸν δίκαιον ὅτι δύσχρηστος ἡμῖν ἐστιν τοίνυν τὰ γενήματα τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν φάγονται

text_en: Woe to the wicked unto evil : for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
text_la: Væ impio in malum! retributio enim manuum ejus fiet ei.
text_pt: Ai do ímpio! Mal lhe irá; porque se lhe fará o que as suas mãos fizeram.
text_el: οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνόμῳ πονηρὰ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ συμβήσεται αὐτῷ

text_en: As for my people, their oppressors have stripped them, and women have ruled over them. O my people, they that call you blessed , the same deceive you, and destroy the way of your steps.
text_la: Populum meum exactores sui spoliaverunt, et mulieres dominatæ sunt eis. Popule meus, qui te beatum dicunt, ipsi te decipiunt, et viam gressuum tuorum dissipant.
text_pt: Os opressores do meu povo são crianças, e mulheres dominam sobre ele; ah, povo meu! Os que te guiam te enganam, e destroem o caminho das tuas veredas.
text_el: λαός μου οἱ πράκτορες ὑμῶν καλαμῶνται ὑμᾶς καὶ οἱ ἀπαιτοῦντες κυριεύουσιν ὑμῶν λαός μου οἱ μακαρίζοντες ὑμᾶς πλανῶσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ τὸν τρίβον τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν ταράσσουσιν

text_en: The Lord stands up to judge , and he stands to judge the people.
text_la: Stat ad judicandum Dominus, et stat ad judicandos populos.
text_pt: O Senhor se levanta para pleitear, e põe-se de pé para julgar os povos.
text_el: ἀλλὰ νῦν καταστήσεται εἰς κρίσιν κύριος καὶ στήσει εἰς κρίσιν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and its princes: for you have devoured the vineyard, and the spoil of the poor is in your house.
text_la: Dominus ad judicium veniet cum senibus populi sui, et principibus ejus; vos enim depasti estis vineam, et rapina pauperis in domo vestra.
text_pt: O Senhor entrará em juízo contra os anciãos do seu povo, e contra os seus príncipes; é que fostes vós que consumistes esta vinha; o espólio do pobre está em vossas casas.
text_el: αὐτὸς κύριος εἰς κρίσιν ἥξει μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ μετὰ τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτοῦ ὑμεῖς δὲ τί ἐνεπυρίσατε τὸν ἀμπελῶνά μου καὶ ἡ ἁρπαγὴ τοῦ πτωχοῦ ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις ὑμῶν

text_en: Why do you consume my people, and grind the faces of the poor ? Says the Lord the God of hosts .
text_la: Quare atteritis populum meum, et facies pauperum commolitis? dicit Dominus Deus exercituum.
text_pt: Que tendes vós, que esmagais o meu povo e moeis as faces dos pobres? Diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos.
text_el: τί ὑμεῖς ἀδικεῖτε τὸν λαόν μου καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον τῶν πτωχῶν καταισχύνετε

text_en: And the Lord said: Because the daughters of Sion are haughty , and have walked with stretched out necks, and wanton glances of their eyes, and made a noise as they walked with their feet and moved in a set pace:
text_la: Et dixit Dominus : Pro eo quod elevatæ sunt filiæ Sion, et ambulaverunt extento collo, et nutibus oculorum ibant, et plaudebant, ambulabant pedibus suis, et composito gradu incedebant;
text_pt: Diz ainda mais o Senhor: Porquanto as filhas de Sião se exaltam, e andam com o pescoço erguido, lançando olhares impudentes; e quando andam, caminham afetadamente, fazendo um tilintar com os seus pés;
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν ὑψώθησαν αἱ θυγατέρες Σιων καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὑψηλῷ τραχήλῳ καὶ ἐν νεύμασιν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ τῇ πορείᾳ τῶν ποδῶν ἅμα σύρουσαι τοὺς χιτῶνας καὶ τοῖς ποσὶν ἅμα παίζουσαι

text_en: The Lord will make bald the crown of the head of the daughters of Sion , and the Lord will discover their hair.
text_la: decalvabit Dominus verticem filiarum Sion, et Dominus crinem earum nudabit.
text_pt: Portanto o Senhor fará tinhoso o alto da cabeça das filhas de Sião, e o Senhor porá a descoberto a sua nudez,
text_el: καὶ ταπεινώσει ὁ θεὸς ἀρχούσας θυγατέρας Σιων καὶ κύριος ἀποκαλύψει τὸ σχῆμα αὐτῶν

text_en: In that day the Lord will take away the ornaments of shoes, and little moons,
text_la: In die illa auferet Dominus ornamentum calceamentum,
text_pt: Naquele dia tirará o Senhor os ornamentos dos pés, e as toucas, e adornos em forma de lua,
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἀφελεῖ κύριος τὴν δόξαν τοῦ ἱματισμοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς κόσμους αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἐμπλόκια καὶ τοὺς κοσύμβους καὶ τοὺς μηνίσκους

text_en: and chains and necklaces, and bracelets, and bonnets,
text_la: et lunulas, et torques, et monilia, et armillas, et mitras,
text_pt: Os pendentes, e os braceletes, as estolas,
text_el: καὶ τὸ κάθεμα καὶ τὸν κόσμον τοῦ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: and bodkins, and ornaments of the legs, and tablets, and sweet balls, and earrings,
text_la: et discriminalia, et periscelidas, et murenulas, et olfactoriola, et inaures,
text_pt: Os gorros, e os ornamentos das pernas, e os cintos e as caixinhas de perfumes, e os brincos,
text_el: καὶ τὴν σύνθεσιν τοῦ κόσμου τῆς δόξης καὶ τοὺς χλιδῶνας καὶ τὰ ψέλια καὶ τὸ ἐμπλόκιον καὶ τὰ περιδέξια καὶ τοὺς δακτυλίους καὶ τὰ ἐνώτια

text_en: and rings , and jewels hanging on the forehead,
text_la: et annulos, et gemmas in fronte pendentes,
text_pt: Os anéis, e as jóias do nariz,
text_el: καὶ τὰ περιπόρφυρα καὶ τὰ μεσοπόρφυρα

text_en: and changes of apparel, and short cloaks, and fine linen, and crisping pins,
text_la: et mutatoria, et palliola, et linteamina, et acus,
text_pt: Os vestidos de festa, e os mantos, e os xales, e as bolsas.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἐπιβλήματα τὰ κατὰ τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ τὰ διαφανῆ λακωνικὰ

text_en: and lookingglasses, and lawns, and headbands, and fine veils.
text_la: et specula, et sindones, et vittas, et theristra.
text_pt: Os espelhos, e o linho finíssimo, e os turbantes, e os véus.
text_el: καὶ τὰ βύσσινα καὶ τὰ ὑακίνθινα καὶ τὰ κόκκινα καὶ τὴν βύσσον σὺν χρυσίῳ καὶ ὑακίνθῳ συγκαθυφασμένα καὶ θέριστρα κατάκλιτα

text_en: And instead of a sweet smell there shall be stench, and instead of a girdle, a cord, and instead of curled hair, baldness, and instead of a stomacher, haircloth .
text_la: Et erit pro suavi odore fœtor, et pro zona funiculus, et pro crispanti crine calvitium, et pro fascia pectorali cilicium.
text_pt: E será que em lugar de perfume haverá mau cheiro; e por cinto uma corda; e em lugar de encrespadura de cabelos, calvície; e em lugar de veste luxuosa, pano de saco; e queimadura em lugar de formosura.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἀντὶ ὀσμῆς ἡδείας κονιορτός καὶ ἀντὶ ζώνης σχοινίῳ ζώσῃ καὶ ἀντὶ τοῦ κόσμου τῆς κεφαλῆς τοῦ χρυσίου φαλάκρωμα ἕξεις διὰ τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ ἀντὶ τοῦ χιτῶνος τοῦ μεσοπορφύρου περιζώσῃ σάκκον

text_en: Your fairest men also shall fall by the sword, and your valiant ones in battle.
text_la: Pulcherrimi quoque viri tui gladio cadent, et fortes tui in prælio.
text_pt: Teus homens cairão à espada e teus poderosos na peleja.
text_el: καὶ ὁ υἱός σου ὁ κάλλιστος ὃν ἀγαπᾷς μαχαίρᾳ πεσεῖται καὶ οἱ ἰσχύοντες ὑμῶν μαχαίρᾳ πεσοῦνται

text_en: And her gates shall lament and mourn, and she shall sit desolate on the ground.
text_la: Et mœrebunt atque lugebunt portæ ejus, et desolata in terra sedebit.
text_pt: E as suas portas gemerão e prantearão; e ela, desolada, se assentará no chão.
text_el: καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται καὶ πενθήσουσιν αἱ θῆκαι τοῦ κόσμου ὑμῶν καὶ καταλειφθήσῃ μόνη καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐδαφισθήσῃ

text_en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man , saying: We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by your name , take away our reproach.
text_la: Et apprehendent septem mulieres virum unum in die illa, dicentes : Panem nostrum comedemus, et vestimentis nostris operiemur : tantummodo invocetur nomen tuum super nos; aufer opprobrium nostrum.
text_pt: E sete mulheres naquele dia lançarão mão de um homem, dizendo: Nós comeremos do nosso pão, e nos vestiremos do que é nosso; tão-somente queremos ser chamadas pelo teu nome; tira o nosso opróbrio.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιλήμψονται ἑπτὰ γυναῖκες ἀνθρώπου ἑνὸς λέγουσαι τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν φαγόμεθα καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια ἡμῶν περιβαλούμεθα πλὴν τὸ ὄνομα τὸ σὸν κεκλήσθω ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἄφελε τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν ἡμῶν

text_en: In that day the bud of the Lord shall be in magnificence and glory , and the fruit of the earth shall be high, and a great joy to them that shall have escaped of Israel .
text_la: In die illa, erit germen Domini in magnificentia et gloria, et fructus terræ sublimis, et exsultatio his qui salvati fuerint de Israël.
text_pt: Naquele dia o renovo do Senhor será cheio de beleza e de glória; e o fruto da terra excelente e formoso para os que escaparem de Israel.
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐπιλάμψει ὁ θεὸς ἐν βουλῇ μετὰ δόξης ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τοῦ ὑψῶσαι καὶ δοξάσαι τὸ καταλειφθὲν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that every one that shall be left in Sion , and that shall remain in Jerusalem , shall be called holy , every one that is written in life in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et erit : omnis qui relictus fuerit in Sion, et residuus in Jerusalem, Sanctus vocabitur, omnis qui scriptus est in vita in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E será que aquele que for deixado em Sião, e ficar em Jerusalém, será chamado santo; todo aquele que estiver inscrito entre os viventes em Jerusalém;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ ὑπολειφθὲν ἐν Σιων καὶ τὸ καταλειφθὲν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἅγιοι κληθήσονται πάντες οἱ γραφέντες εἰς ζωὴν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: If the Lord shall wash away the filth of the daughters of Sion , and shall wash away the blood of Jerusalem out of the midst thereof, by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
text_la: Si abluerit Dominus sordes filiarum Sion, et sanguinem Jerusalem laverit de medio ejus, in spiritu judicii, et spiritu ardoris.
text_pt: Quando o Senhor lavar a imundícia das filhas de Sião, e limpar o sangue de Jerusalém, do meio dela, com o espírito de justiça, e com o espírito de ardor.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκπλυνεῖ κύριος τὸν ῥύπον τῶν υἱῶν καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων Σιων καὶ τὸ αἷμα ἐκκαθαριεῖ ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν ἐν πνεύματι κρίσεως καὶ πνεύματι καύσεως

text_en: And the Lord will create upon every place of mount Sion, and where he is called upon, a cloud by day, and a smoke and the brightness of a flaming fire in the night: for over all the glory shall be a protection.
text_la: Et creabit Dominus super omnem locum montis Sion, et ubi invocatus est, nubem per diem et fumum, et splendorem ignis flammantis in nocte : super omnem enim gloriam protectio.
text_pt: E criará o Senhor sobre todo o lugar do monte de Sião, e sobre as suas assembléias, uma nuvem de dia e uma fumaça, e um resplendor de fogo flamejante de noite; porque sobre toda a glória haverá proteção.
text_el: καὶ ἥξει καὶ ἔσται πᾶς τόπος τοῦ ὄρους Σιων καὶ πάντα τὰ περικύκλῳ αὐτῆς σκιάσει νεφέλη ἡμέρας καὶ ὡς καπνοῦ καὶ ὡς φωτὸς πυρὸς καιομένου νυκτός πάσῃ τῇ δόξῃ σκεπασθήσεται

text_en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a security and covert from the whirlwind, and from rain.
text_la: Et tabernaculum erit in umbraculum, diei ab æstu, et in securitatem et absconsionem a turbine et a pluvia.
text_pt: E haverá um tabernáculo para sombra contra o calor do dia; e para refúgio e esconderijo contra a tempestade e a chuva.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται εἰς σκιὰν ἀπὸ καύματος καὶ ἐν σκέπῃ καὶ ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ ἀπὸ σκληρότητος καὶ ὑετοῦ

text_en: I will sing to my beloved the canticle of my cousin concerning his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a hill in a fruitful place.
text_la: Cantabo dilecto meo canticum patruelis mei vineæ suæ. Vinea facta est dilecto meo in cornu filio olei.
text_pt: Agora cantarei ao meu amado o cântico do meu querido a respeito da sua vinha. O meu amado tem uma vinha num outeiro fértil.
text_el: ᾄσω δὴ τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ ᾆσμα τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ τῷ ἀμπελῶνί μου ἀμπελὼν ἐγενήθη τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ ἐν κέρατι ἐν τόπῳ πίονι

text_en: And he fenced it in, and picked the stones out of it, and planted it with the choicest vines, and built a tower in the midst thereof, and set up a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
text_la: Et sepivit eam, et lapides elegit ex illa, et plantavit eam electam; et ædificavit turrim in medio ejus, et torcular exstruxit in ea; et exspectavit ut faceret uvas, et fecit labruscas.
text_pt: E cercou-a, e limpando-a das pedras, plantou-a de excelentes vides; e edificou no meio dela uma torre, e também construiu nela um lagar; e esperava que desse uvas boas, porém deu uvas bravas.
text_el: καὶ φραγμὸν περιέθηκα καὶ ἐχαράκωσα καὶ ἐφύτευσα ἄμπελον σωρηχ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησα πύργον ἐν μέσῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ προλήνιον ὤρυξα ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἔμεινα τοῦ ποιῆσαι σταφυλήν ἐποίησεν δὲ ἀκάνθας

text_en: And now, O you inhabitants of Jerusalem , and you men of Juda , judge between me and my vineyard.
text_la: Nunc ergo, habitatores Jerusalem et viri Juda, judicate inter me et vineam meam.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó moradores de Jerusalém, e homens de Judá, julgai, vos peço, entre mim e a minha vinha.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἄνθρωπος τοῦ Ιουδα καὶ οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν Ιερουσαλημ κρίνατε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ἀμπελῶνός μου

text_en: What is there that I ought to do more to my vineyard, that I have not done to it? Was it that I looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it has brought forth wild grapes?
text_la: Quid est quod debui ultra facere vineæ meæ, et non feci ei? an quod exspectavi ut faceret uvas, et fecit labruscas?
text_pt: Que mais se podia fazer à minha vinha, que eu lhe não tenha feito? Por que, esperando eu que desse uvas boas, veio a dar uvas bravas?
text_el: τί ποιήσω ἔτι τῷ ἀμπελῶνί μου καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησα αὐτῷ διότι ἔμεινα τοῦ ποιῆσαι σταφυλήν ἐποίησεν δὲ ἀκάνθας

text_en: And now I will show you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be wasted: I will break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down.
text_la: Et nunc ostendam vobis quid ego faciam vineæ meæ : auferam sepem ejus, et erit in direptionem; diruam maceriam ejus, et erit in conculcationem.
text_pt: Agora, pois, vos farei saber o que eu hei de fazer à minha vinha: tirarei a sua sebe, para que sirva de pasto; derrubarei a sua parede, para que seja pisada;
text_el: νῦν δὲ ἀναγγελῶ ὑμῖν τί ποιήσω τῷ ἀμπελῶνί μου ἀφελῶ τὸν φραγμὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται εἰς διαρπαγήν καὶ καθελῶ τὸν τοῖχον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται εἰς καταπάτημα

text_en: And I will make it desolate: it shall not be pruned, and it shall not be digged: but briers and thorns shall come up: and I will command the clouds to rain no rain upon it.
text_la: Et ponam eam desertam; non putabitur et non fodietur : et ascendent vepres et spinæ, et nubibus mandabo ne pluant super eam imbrem.
text_pt: E a tornarei em deserto; não será podada nem cavada; porém crescerão nela sarças e espinheiros; e às nuvens darei ordem que não derramem chuva sobre ela.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήσω τὸν ἀμπελῶνά μου καὶ οὐ μὴ τμηθῇ οὐδὲ μὴ σκαφῇ καὶ ἀναβήσεται εἰς αὐτὸν ὡς εἰς χέρσον ἄκανθα καὶ ταῖς νεφέλαις ἐντελοῦμαι τοῦ μὴ βρέξαι εἰς αὐτὸν ὑετόν

text_en: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel : and the man of Juda , his pleasant plant: and I looked that he should do judgment, and behold iniquity : and do justice , and behold a cry.
text_la: Vinea enim Domini exercituum domus Israël est; et vir Juda germen ejus delectabile : et exspectavi ut faceret judicium, et ecce iniquitas; et justitiam, et ecce clamor.
text_pt: Porque a vinha do Senhor dos Exércitos é a casa de Israel, e os homens de Judá são a planta das suas delícias; e esperou que exercesse juízo, e eis aqui opressão; justiça, e eis aqui clamor.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ ἀμπελὼν κυρίου σαβαωθ οἶκος τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐστίν καὶ ἄνθρωπος τοῦ Ιουδα νεόφυτον ἠγαπημένον ἔμεινα τοῦ ποιῆσαι κρίσιν ἐποίησεν δὲ ἀνομίαν καὶ οὐ δικαιοσύνην ἀλλὰ κραυγήν

text_en: Woe to you that join house to house and lay field to field, even to the end of the place: shall you alone dwell in the midst of the earth?
text_la: Væ qui conjungitis domum ad domum, et agrum agro copulatis usque ad terminum loci! Numquid habitabitis vos soli in medio terræ?
text_pt: Ai dos que ajuntam casa a casa, reúnem campo a campo, até que não haja mais lugar, e fiquem como únicos moradores no meio da terra!
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ συνάπτοντες οἰκίαν πρὸς οἰκίαν καὶ ἀγρὸν πρὸς ἀγρὸν ἐγγίζοντες ἵνα τοῦ πλησίον ἀφέλωνταί τι μὴ οἰκήσετε μόνοι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: These things are in my ears, says the Lord of hosts : Unless many great and fair houses shall become desolate, without an inhabitant.
text_la: In auribus meis sunt hæc, dicit Dominus exercituum; nisi domus multæ desertæ fuerint, grandes et pulchræ, absque habitatore.
text_pt: A meus ouvidos disse o Senhor dos Exércitos: Em verdade que muitas casas ficarão desertas, e até as grandes e excelentes sem moradores.
text_el: ἠκούσθη γὰρ εἰς τὰ ὦτα κυρίου σαβαωθ ταῦτα ἐὰν γὰρ γένωνται οἰκίαι πολλαί εἰς ἔρημον ἔσονται μεγάλαι καὶ καλαί καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν αὐταῖς

text_en: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one little measure, and thirty bushels of seed shall yield three bushels.
text_la: Decem enim jugera vinearum facient lagunculam unam, et triginta modii sementis facient modios tres.
text_pt: E dez jeiras de vinha não darão mais do que um bato; e um ômer de semente não dará mais do que um efa.
text_el: οὗ γὰρ ἐργῶνται δέκα ζεύγη βοῶν ποιήσει κεράμιον ἕν καὶ ὁ σπείρων ἀρτάβας ἓξ ποιήσει μέτρα τρία

text_en: Woe to you that rise up early in the morning to follow drunkenness , and to drink in the evening, to be inflamed with wine.
text_la: Væ qui consurgitis mane ad ebrietatem sectandam, et potandum usque ad vesperam, ut vino æstuetis!
text_pt: Ai dos que se levantam pela manhã, e seguem a bebedice; e continuam até à noite, até que o vinho os esquente!
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ ἐγειρόμενοι τὸ πρωὶ καὶ τὸ σικερα διώκοντες οἱ μένοντες τὸ ὀψέ ὁ γὰρ οἶνος αὐτοὺς συγκαύσει

text_en: The harp, and the lyre, and, the timbrel and the pipe, and wine are in your feasts: and the work of the Lord you regard not, nor do you consider the works of his hands.
text_la: Cithara, et lyra, et tympanum, et tibia, et vinum in conviviis vestris; et opus Domini non respicitis, nec opera manuum ejus consideratis.
text_pt: E harpas e alaúdes, tamboris e gaitas, e vinho há nos seus banquetes; e não olham para a obra do Senhor, nem consideram as obras das suas mãos.
text_el: μετὰ γὰρ κιθάρας καὶ ψαλτηρίου καὶ τυμπάνων καὶ αὐλῶν τὸν οἶνον πίνουσιν τὰ δὲ ἔργα κυρίου οὐκ ἐμβλέπουσιν καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ οὐ κατανοοῦσιν

text_en: Therefore is my people led away captive , because they had not knowledge , and their nobles have perished with famine, and their multitude were dried up with thirst.
text_la: Propterea captivus ductus est populus meus, quia non habuit scientiam, et nobiles ejus interierunt fame, et multitudo ejus siti exaruit.
text_pt: Portanto o meu povo será levado cativo, por falta de entendimento; e os seus nobres terão fome, e a sua multidão se secará de sede.
text_el: τοίνυν αἰχμάλωτος ὁ λαός μου ἐγενήθη διὰ τὸ μὴ εἰδέναι αὐτοὺς τὸν κύριον καὶ πλῆθος ἐγενήθη νεκρῶν διὰ λιμὸν καὶ δίψαν ὕδατος

text_en: Therefore has hell enlarged her soul , and opened her mouth without any bounds, and their strong ones, and their people, and their high and glorious ones shall go down into it.
text_la: Propterea dilatavit infernus animam suam, et aperuit os suum absque ullo termino; et descendent fortes ejus, et populus ejus, et sublimes gloriosique ejus, ad eum.
text_pt: Portanto o inferno grandemente se alargou, e se abriu a sua boca desmesuradamente; e para lá descerão o seu esplendor, e a sua multidão, e a sua pompa, e os que entre eles se alegram.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλάτυνεν ὁ ᾅδης τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ διήνοιξεν τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ τοῦ μὴ διαλιπεῖν καὶ καταβήσονται οἱ ἔνδοξοι καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι καὶ οἱ πλούσιοι καὶ οἱ λοιμοὶ αὐτῆς

text_en: And man shall be brought down, and man shall be humbled , and the eyes of the lofty shall be brought low.
text_la: Et incurvabitur homo, et humiliabitur vir, et oculi sublimium deprimentur.
text_pt: Então o plebeu se abaterá, e o nobre se humilhará; e os olhos dos altivos se humilharão.
text_el: καὶ ταπεινωθήσεται ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἀτιμασθήσεται ἀνήρ καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ οἱ μετέωροι ταπεινωθήσονται

text_en: And the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and the holy God shall be sanctified in justice .
text_la: Et exaltabitur Dominus exercituum in judicio; et Deus sanctus sanctificabitur in justitia.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor dos Exércitos será exaltado em juízo; e Deus, o Santo, será santificado em justiça.
text_el: καὶ ὑψωθήσεται κύριος σαβαωθ ἐν κρίματι καὶ ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἅγιος δοξασθήσεται ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ

text_en: And the lambs shall feed according to their order, and strangers shall eat the deserts turned into fruitfulness.
text_la: Et pascentur agni juxta ordinem suum, et deserta in ubertatem versa advenæ comedent.
text_pt: Então os cordeiros pastarão como de costume, e os estranhos comerão dos lugares devastados pelos gordos.
text_el: καὶ βοσκηθήσονται οἱ διηρπασμένοι ὡς ταῦροι καὶ τὰς ἐρήμους τῶν ἀπειλημμένων ἄρνες φάγονται

text_en: Woe to you that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as the rope of a cart.
text_la: Væ qui trahitis iniquitatem in funiculis vanitatis, et quasi vinculum plaustri peccatum!
text_pt: Ai dos que puxam a iniqüidade com cordas de vaidade, e o pecado com tirantes de carro!
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ ἐπισπώμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας ὡς σχοινίῳ μακρῷ καὶ ὡς ζυγοῦ ἱμάντι δαμάλεως τὰς ἀνομίας

text_en: That say: Let him make haste, and let his work come quickly, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel come, that we may know it.
text_la: qui dicitis : Festinet, et cito veniat opus ejus, ut videamus; et appropiet, et veniat consilium sancti Israël, et sciemus illud!
text_pt: E dizem: Avie-se, e acabe a sua obra, para que a vejamos; e aproxime-se e venha o conselho do Santo de Israel, para que o conheçamos.
text_el: οἱ λέγοντες τὸ τάχος ἐγγισάτω ἃ ποιήσει ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ ἐλθάτω ἡ βουλὴ τοῦ ἁγίου Ισραηλ ἵνα γνῶμεν

text_en: Woe to you that call evil good , and good evil : that put darkness for light, and light for darkness: that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter.
text_la: Væ qui dicitis malum bonum, et bonum malum; ponentes tenebras lucem, et lucem tenebras; ponentes amarum in dulce, et dulce in amarum!
text_pt: Ai dos que ao mal chamam bem, e ao bem mal; que fazem das trevas luz, e da luz trevas; e fazem do amargo doce, e do doce amargo!
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ λέγοντες τὸ πονηρὸν καλὸν καὶ τὸ καλὸν πονηρόν οἱ τιθέντες τὸ σκότος φῶς καὶ τὸ φῶς σκότος οἱ τιθέντες τὸ πικρὸν γλυκὺ καὶ τὸ γλυκὺ πικρόν

text_en: Woe to you that are wise in your own eyes, and prudent in your own conceits.
text_la: Væ qui sapientes estis in oculis vestris, et coram vobismetipsis prudentes.
text_pt: Ai dos que são sábios a seus próprios olhos, e prudentes diante de si mesmos!
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ συνετοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐνώπιον ἑαυτῶν ἐπιστήμονες

text_en: Woe to you that are mighty to drink wine, and stout men at drunkenness .
text_la: Væ qui potentes estis ad bibendum vinum, et viri fortes ad miscendam ebrietatem!
text_pt: Ai dos que são poderosos para beber vinho, e homens de poder para misturar bebida forte;
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ ἰσχύοντες ὑμῶν οἱ τὸν οἶνον πίνοντες καὶ οἱ δυνάσται οἱ κεραννύντες τὸ σικερα

text_en: That justify the wicked for gifts, and take away the justice of the just from him.
text_la: qui justificatis impium pro muneribus, et justitiam justi aufertis ab eo!
text_pt: Dos que justificam ao ímpio por suborno, e aos justos negam a justiça!
text_el: οἱ δικαιοῦντες τὸν ἀσεβῆ ἕνεκεν δώρων καὶ τὸ δίκαιον τοῦ δικαίου αἴροντες

text_en: Therefore as the tongue of the fire devours the stubble, and the heat of the flame consumes it: so shall their root be as ashes, and their bud shall go up as dust: for they have cast away the law of the Lord of hosts , and have blasphemed the word of the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Propter hoc, sicut devorat stipulam lingua ignis, et calor flammæ exurit, sic radix eorum quasi favilla erit, et germen eorum ut pulvis ascendet; abjecerunt enim legem Domini exercituum, et eloquium sancti Israël blasphemaverunt.
text_pt: Por isso, como a língua de fogo consome a palha, e o restolho se desfaz pela chama, assim será a sua raiz como podridão, e a sua flor se esvaecerá como pó; porquanto rejeitaram a lei do Senhor dos Exércitos, e desprezaram a palavra do Santo de Israel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ὃν τρόπον καυθήσεται καλάμη ὑπὸ ἄνθρακος πυρὸς καὶ συγκαυθήσεται ὑπὸ φλογὸς ἀνειμένης ἡ ῥίζα αὐτῶν ὡς χνοῦς ἔσται καὶ τὸ ἄνθος αὐτῶν ὡς κονιορτὸς ἀναβήσεται οὐ γὰρ ἠθέλησαν τὸν νόμον κυρίου σαβαωθ ἀλλὰ τὸ λόγιον τοῦ ἁγίου Ισραηλ παρώξυναν

text_en: Therefore is the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, and he has stretched out his hand upon them, and struck them: and the mountains were troubles, and their carcasses became as dung in the midst of the streets. For after this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text_la: Ideo iratus est furor Domini in populum suum, et extendit manum suam super eum, et percussit eum : et conturbati sunt montes, et facta sunt morticina eorum quasi stercus in medio platearum. In his omnibus non est adversus furor ejus, sed adhuc manus ejus extenta.
text_pt: Por isso se acendeu a ira do Senhor contra o seu povo, e estendeu a sua mão contra ele, e o feriu, de modo que as montanhas tremeram, e os seus cadáveres se fizeram como lixo no meio das ruas; com tudo isto não tornou atrás a sua ira, mas a sua mão ainda está estendida.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ κύριος σαβαωθ ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέβαλεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτούς καὶ παρωξύνθη τὰ ὄρη καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ θνησιμαῖα αὐτῶν ὡς κοπρία ἐν μέσῳ ὁδοῦ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις οὐκ ἀπεστράφη ὁ θυμός ἀλλ' ἔτι ἡ χεὶρ ὑψηλή

text_en: And he will lift up a sign to the nations afar off, and will whistle to them from the ends of the earth: and behold they shall come with speed swiftly.
text_la: Et elevabit signum in nationibus procul, et sibilabit ad eum de finibus terræ : et ecce festinus velociter veniet.
text_pt: E ele arvorará o estandarte para as nações de longe, e lhes assobiará para que venham desde a extremidade da terra; e eis que virão apressurada e ligeiramente.
text_el: τοιγαροῦν ἀρεῖ σύσσημον ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ συριεῖ αὐτοῖς ἀπ' ἄκρου τῆς γῆς καὶ ἰδοὺ ταχὺ κούφως ἔρχονται

text_en: There is none that shall faint, nor labour among them: they shall not slumber nor sleep, neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken.
text_la: Non est deficiens neque laborans in eo; non dormitabit, neque dormiet; neque solvetur cingulum renum ejus, nec rumpetur corrigia calceamenti ejus.
text_pt: Não haverá entre eles cansado, nem quem tropece; ninguém tosquenejará nem dormirá; não se lhe desatará o cinto dos seus lombos, nem se lhe quebrará a correia dos seus sapatos.
text_el: οὐ πεινάσουσιν οὐδὲ κοπιάσουσιν οὐδὲ νυστάξουσιν οὐδὲ κοιμηθήσονται οὐδὲ λύσουσιν τὰς ζώνας αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτῶν οὐδὲ μὴ ῥαγῶσιν οἱ ἱμάντες τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: Their arrows are sharp, and all their bows are bent. The hoofs of their horses shall be like the flint, and their wheels like the violence of a tempest.
text_la: Sagittæ ejus acutæ, et omnes arcus ejus extenti. Ungulæ equorum ejus ut silex, et rotæ ejus quasi impetus tempestatis.
text_pt: As suas flechas serão agudas, e todos os seus arcos retesados; os cascos dos seus cavalos são reputados como pederneiras, e as rodas dos seus carros como redemoinho.
text_el: ὧν τὰ βέλη ὀξεῖά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ τόξα αὐτῶν ἐντεταμένα οἱ πόδες τῶν ἵππων αὐτῶν ὡς στερεὰ πέτρα ἐλογίσθησαν οἱ τροχοὶ τῶν ἁρμάτων αὐτῶν ὡς καταιγίς

text_en: Their roaring like that of a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea they shall roar, and take hold of the prey, and they shall keep fast hold of it, and there shall be none to deliver it.
text_la: Rugitus ejus ut leonis; rugiet ut catuli leonum : et frendet, et tenebit prædam, et amplexabitur, et non erit qui eruat.
text_pt: O seu rugido será como o do leão; rugirão como filhos de leão; sim, rugirão e arrebatarão a presa, e a levarão, e não haverá quem a livre.
text_el: ὁρμῶσιν ὡς λέοντες καὶ παρέστηκαν ὡς σκύμνος λέοντος καὶ ἐπιλήμψεται καὶ βοήσει ὡς θηρίου καὶ ἐκβαλεῖ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ῥυόμενος αὐτούς

text_en: And they shall make a noise against them that day, like the roaring of the sea; we shall look towards the land, and behold darkness of tribulation, and the light is darkened with the mist thereof.
text_la: Et sonabit super eum in die illa sicut sonitus maris : aspiciemus in terram, et ecce tenebræ tribulationis, et lux obtenebrata est in caligine ejus.
text_pt: E bramarão contra eles naquele dia, como o bramido do mar; então olharão para a terra, e eis que só verão trevas e ânsia, e a luz se escurecerá nos céus.
text_el: καὶ βοήσει δι' αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὡς φωνὴ θαλάσσης κυμαινούσης καὶ ἐμβλέψονται εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ ἰδοὺ σκότος σκληρὸν ἐν τῇ ἀπορίᾳ αὐτῶν

text_en: In the year that King Ozias died, I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne high and elevated: and his train filled the temple .
text_la: In anno quo mortuus est rex Ozias, vidi Dominum sedentem super solium excelsum et elevatum; et ea quæ sub ipso erant replebant templum.
text_pt: No ano em que morreu o rei Uzias, eu vi também ao Senhor assentado sobre um alto e sublime trono; e a cauda do seu manto enchia o templo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ οὗ ἀπέθανεν Οζιας ὁ βασιλεύς εἶδον τὸν κύριον καθήμενον ἐπὶ θρόνου ὑψηλοῦ καὶ ἐπηρμένου καὶ πλήρης ὁ οἶκος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ

text_en: Upon it stood the seraphims : the one had six wings, and the other had six wings: with two they covered his face, and with two they covered his feet, and with two they flew.
text_la: Seraphim stabant super illud : sex alæ uni, et sex alæ alteri; duabus velabant faciem ejus, et duabus velabant pedes ejus, et duabus volabant.
text_pt: Serafins estavam por cima dele; cada um tinha seis asas; com duas cobriam os seus rostos, e com duas cobriam os seus pés, e com duas voavam.
text_el: καὶ σεραφιν εἱστήκεισαν κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ ἓξ πτέρυγες τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ ἓξ πτέρυγες τῷ ἑνί καὶ ταῖς μὲν δυσὶν κατεκάλυπτον τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ ταῖς δυσὶν κατεκάλυπτον τοὺς πόδας καὶ ταῖς δυσὶν ἐπέταντο

text_en: And they cried one to another, and said: Holy, holy, holy, the Lord God of hosts , all the earth is full of his glory ,
text_la: Et clamabant alter ad alterum, et dicebant : Sanctus, sanctus, sanctus Dominus, Deus exercituum; plena est omnis terra gloria ejus.
text_pt: E clamavam uns aos outros, dizendo: Santo, Santo, Santo é o Senhor dos Exércitos; toda a terra está cheia da sua glória.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέκραγον ἕτερος πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον καὶ ἔλεγον ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος κύριος σαβαωθ πλήρης πᾶσα ἡ γῆ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ

text_en: and the lintels of the doors were moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
text_la: Et commota sunt superliminaria cardinum a voce clamantis, et domus repleta est fumo.
text_pt: E os umbrais das portas se moveram à voz do que clamava, e a casa se encheu de fumaça.
text_el: καὶ ἐπήρθη τὸ ὑπέρθυρον ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς ἧς ἐκέκραγον καὶ ὁ οἶκος ἐπλήσθη καπνοῦ

text_en: And I said: Woe is me, because I have held my peace; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people that has unclean lips, and I have seen with my eyes the King the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et dixi : Væ mihi, quia tacui, quia vir pollutus labiis ego sum, et in medio populi polluta labia habentis ego habito, et regem Dominum exercituum vidi oculis meis.
text_pt: Então disse eu: Ai de mim! Pois estou perdido; porque sou um homem de lábios impuros, e habito no meio de um povo de impuros lábios; os meus olhos viram o Rei, o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ὦ τάλας ἐγώ ὅτι κατανένυγμαι ὅτι ἄνθρωπος ὢν καὶ ἀκάθαρτα χείλη ἔχων ἐν μέσῳ λαοῦ ἀκάθαρτα χείλη ἔχοντος ἐγὼ οἰκῶ καὶ τὸν βασιλέα κύριον σαβαωθ εἶδον τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς μου

text_en: And one of the seraphims flew to me, and in his hand was a live coal, which he had taken with the tongs off the altar .
text_la: Et volavit ad me unus de seraphim, et in manu ejus calculus, quem forcipe tulerat de altari,
text_pt: Porém um dos serafins voou para mim, trazendo na sua mão uma brasa viva, que tirara do altar com uma tenaz;
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστάλη πρός με ἓν τῶν σεραφιν καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ εἶχεν ἄνθρακα ὃν τῇ λαβίδι ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: And he touched my mouth, and said: Behold this has touched your lips, and your iniquities shall be taken away, and your sin shall be cleansed .
text_la: et tetigit os meum, et dixit : Ecce tetigit hoc labia tua, et auferetur iniquitas tua, et peccatum tuum mundabitur.
text_pt: E com a brasa tocou a minha boca, e disse: Eis que isto tocou os teus lábios; e a tua iniqüidade foi tirada, e expiado o teu pecado.
text_el: καὶ ἥψατο τοῦ στόματός μου καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἥψατο τοῦτο τῶν χειλέων σου καὶ ἀφελεῖ τὰς ἀνομίας σου καὶ τὰς ἁμαρτίας σου περικαθαριεῖ

text_en: And I heard the voice of the Lord , saying: Whom shall I send? And who shall go for us? And I said: Lo, here am I, send me.
text_la: Et audivi vocem Domini dicentis : Quem mittam? et quis ibit nobis? Et dixi : Ecce ego, mitte me.
text_pt: Depois disto ouvi a voz do Senhor, que dizia: A quem enviarei, e quem há de ir por nós? Então disse eu: Eis-me aqui, envia-me a mim.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσα τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου λέγοντος τίνα ἀποστείλω καὶ τίς πορεύσεται πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ εἶπα ἰδού εἰμι ἐγώ ἀπόστειλόν με

text_en: And he said: Go, and you shall say to this people: Hearing, hear, and understand not: and see the vision , and know it not.
text_la: Et dixit : Vade, et dices populo huic : Audite audientes, et nolite intelligere; et videte visionem, et nolite cognoscere.
text_pt: Então disse ele: Vai, e dize a este povo: Ouvis, de fato, e não entendeis, e vedes, em verdade, mas não percebeis.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πορεύθητι καὶ εἰπὸν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἀκοῇ ἀκούσετε καὶ οὐ μὴ συνῆτε καὶ βλέποντες βλέψετε καὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδητε

text_en: Blind the heart of this people, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes: lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and be converted and I heal them.
text_la: Excæca cor populi hujus, et aures ejus aggrava, et oculos ejus claude : ne forte videat oculis suis, et auribus suis audiat, et corde suo intelligat, et convertatur, et sanem eum.
text_pt: Engorda o coração deste povo, e faze-lhe pesados os ouvidos, e fecha-lhe os olhos; para que ele não veja com os seus olhos, e não ouça com os seus ouvidos, nem entenda com o seu coração, nem se converta e seja sarado.
text_el: ἐπαχύνθη γὰρ ἡ καρδία τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν αὐτῶν βαρέως ἤκουσαν καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν ἐκάμμυσαν μήποτε ἴδωσιν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν ἀκούσωσιν καὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ συνῶσιν καὶ ἐπιστρέψωσιν καὶ ἰάσομαι αὐτούς

text_en: And I said: How long, O Lord ? And he said: Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man , and the land shall be left desolate.
text_la: Et dixi : Usquequo, Domine? Et dixit : Donec desolentur civitates absque habitatore, et domus sine homine, et terra relinquetur deserta.
text_pt: Então disse eu: Até quando Senhor? E respondeu: Até que sejam desoladas as cidades e fiquem sem habitantes, e as casas sem moradores, e a terra seja de todo assolada.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα ἕως πότε κύριε καὶ εἶπεν ἕως ἂν ἐρημωθῶσιν πόλεις παρὰ τὸ μὴ κατοικεῖσθαι καὶ οἶκοι παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἡ γῆ καταλειφθήσεται ἔρημος

text_en: And the Lord shall remove men far away, and she shall be multiplied that was left in the midst of the earth.
text_la: Et longe faciet Dominus homines, et multiplicabitur quæ derelicta fuerat in medio terræ.
text_pt: E o Senhor afaste dela os homens, e no meio da terra seja grande o desamparo.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα μακρυνεῖ ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ οἱ καταλειφθέντες πληθυνθήσονται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And there shall be still a tithing therein, and she shall turn, and shall be made a show as a turpentine tree, and as an oak that spreads its branches: that which shall stand therein, shall be a holy seed.
text_la: Et adhuc in ea decimatio, et convertetur, et erit in ostensionem sicut terebinthus, et sicut quercus quæ expandit ramos suos; semen sanctum erit id quod steterit in ea.
text_pt: Porém ainda a décima parte ficará nela, e tornará a ser pastada; e como o carvalho, e como a azinheira, que depois de se desfolharem, ainda ficam firmes, assim a santa semente será a firmeza dela.
text_el: καὶ ἔτι ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἔστιν τὸ ἐπιδέκατον καὶ πάλιν ἔσται εἰς προνομὴν ὡς τερέβινθος καὶ ὡς βάλανος ὅταν ἐκπέσῃ ἀπὸ τῆς θήκης αὐτῆς

text_en: And it came to pass in the days of Achaz the son of Joathan, the son of Ozias , king of Juda , that Rasin king of Syria and Phacee the son of Romelia king of Israel , came up to Jerusalem , to fight against it: but they could not prevail over it.
text_la: Et factum est in diebus Achaz, filii Joathan, filii Oziæ, regis Juda, ascendit Rasin, rex Syriæ, et Phacee, filius Romeliæ, rex Israël, in Jerusalem, ad præliandum contra eam : et non potuerunt
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, nos dias de Acaz, filho de Jotão, filho de Uzias, rei de Judá, que Rezim, rei da Síria, e Peca, filho de Remalias, rei de Israel, subiram a Jerusalém, para pelejarem contra ela, mas nada puderam contra ela.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Αχαζ τοῦ Ιωαθαμ τοῦ υἱοῦ Οζιου βασιλέως Ιουδα ἀνέβη Ραασσων βασιλεὺς Αραμ καὶ Φακεε υἱὸς Ρομελιου βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ πολεμῆσαι αὐτὴν καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν πολιορκῆσαι αὐτήν

text_en: And they told the house of David , saying: Syria has rested upon Ephraim, and his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the woods are moved with the wind.
text_la: debellare eam. Et nuntiaverunt domui David, dicentes : Requievit Syria super Ephraim. Et commotum est cor ejus, et cor populi ejus, sicut moventur ligna silvarum a facie venti.
text_pt: E deram aviso à casa de Davi, dizendo: A Síria fez aliança com Efraim. Então se moveu o seu coração, e o coração do seu povo, como se movem as árvores do bosque com o vento.
text_el: καὶ ἀνηγγέλη εἰς τὸν οἶκον Δαυιδ λέγοντες συνεφώνησεν Αραμ πρὸς τὸν Εφραιμ καὶ ἐξέστη ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ὃν τρόπον ὅταν ἐν δρυμῷ ξύλον ὑπὸ πνεύματος σαλευθῇ

text_en: And the Lord said to Isaiah : Go forth to meet Achaz , you and Jasub your son that is left, to the conduit of the upper pool in the way of the fuller's field.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Isaiam : Egredere in occursum Achaz, tu et qui derelictus est Jasub, filius tuus, ad extremum aquæductus piscinæ superioris in via agri Fullonis;
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Isaías: Agora, tu e teu filho Sear-Jasube, saí ao encontro de Acaz, ao fim do canal do tanque superior, no caminho do campo do lavandeiro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ησαιαν ἔξελθε εἰς συνάντησιν Αχαζ σὺ καὶ ὁ καταλειφθεὶς Ιασουβ ὁ υἱός σου πρὸς τὴν κολυμβήθραν τῆς ἄνω ὁδοῦ τοῦ ἀγροῦ τοῦ γναφέως

text_en: And you shall say to him: See that you be quiet: fear not, and let not your heart be afraid of the two tails of these firebrands, smoking with the wrath of the fury of Rasin king of Syria , and of the son of Romelia.
text_la: et dices ad eum : Vide ut sileas; noli timere, et cor tuum ne formidet a duabus caudis titionum fumigantium istorum, in ira furoris Rasin, regis Syriæ, et filii Romeliæ;
text_pt: E dize-lhe: Acautela-te, e aquieta-te; não temas, nem se desanime o teu coração por causa destes dois pedaços de tições fumegantes; por causa do ardor da ira de Rezim, e da Síria, e do filho de Remalias.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτῷ φύλαξαι τοῦ ἡσυχάσαι καὶ μὴ φοβοῦ μηδὲ ἡ ψυχή σου ἀσθενείτω ἀπὸ τῶν δύο ξύλων τῶν δαλῶν τῶν καπνιζομένων τούτων ὅταν γὰρ ὀργὴ τοῦ θυμοῦ μου γένηται πάλιν ἰάσομαι

text_en: Because Syria has taken counsel against you, unto the evil of Ephraim and the son of Romelia, saying:
text_la: eo quod consilium inierit contra te Syria in malum, Ephraim, et filius Romeliæ, dicentes :
text_pt: Porquanto a Síria teve contra ti maligno conselho, com Efraim, e com o filho de Remalias, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ Αραμ καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ Ρομελιου ὅτι ἐβουλεύσαντο βουλὴν πονηρὰν περὶ σοῦ λέγοντες

text_en: Let us go up to Juda , and rouse it up, and draw it away to us, and make the son of Tabeel king in the midst thereof.
text_la: Ascendamus ad Judam, et suscitemus eum, et avellamus eum ad nos, et ponamus regem in medio ejus filium Tabeel.
text_pt: Vamos subir contra Judá, e molestemo-lo e repartamo-lo entre nós, e façamos reinar no meio dele o filho de Tabeal.
text_el: ἀναβησόμεθα εἰς τὴν Ιουδαίαν καὶ συλλαλήσαντες αὐτοῖς ἀποστρέψομεν αὐτοὺς πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ βασιλεύσομεν αὐτῆς τὸν υἱὸν Ταβεηλ

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : It shall not stand, and this shall not be.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Non stabit, et non erit istud;
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Isto não subsistirá, nem tampouco acontecerá.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ οὐ μὴ ἐμμείνῃ ἡ βουλὴ αὕτη οὐδὲ ἔσται

text_en: But the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rasin: and within threescore and five years, Ephraim shall cease to be a people:
text_la: sed caput Syriæ Damascus, et caput Damasci Rasin; et adhuc sexaginta et quinque anni, et desinet Ephraim esse populus;
text_pt: Porém a cabeça da Síria será Damasco, e a cabeça de Damasco Rezim; e dentro de sessenta e cinco anos Efraim será destruído, e deixará de ser povo.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἡ κεφαλὴ Αραμ Δαμασκός ἀλλ' ἔτι ἑξήκοντα καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν ἐκλείψει ἡ βασιλεία Εφραιμ ἀπὸ λαοῦ

text_en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is the son of Romelia. If you will not believe , you shall not continue.
text_la: et caput Ephraim Samaria, et caput Samariæ filius Romeliæ. Si non credideritis, non permanebitis.
text_pt: Entretanto a cabeça de Efraim será Samaria, e a cabeça de Samaria o filho de Remalias; se não o crerdes, certamente não haveis de permanecer.
text_el: καὶ ἡ κεφαλὴ Εφραιμ Σομορων καὶ ἡ κεφαλὴ Σομορων υἱὸς τοῦ Ρομελιου καὶ ἐὰν μὴ πιστεύσητε οὐδὲ μὴ συνῆτε

text_en: And the Lord spoke again to Achaz , saying:
text_la: Et adjecit Dominus loqui ad Achaz, dicens:
text_pt: E continuou o Senhor a falar com Acaz, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο κύριος λαλῆσαι τῷ Αχαζ λέγων

text_en: Ask you a sign of the Lord your God , either unto the depth of hell, or unto the height above.
text_la: Pete tibi signum a Domino Deo tuo, in profundum inferni, sive in excelsum supra.
text_pt: Pede para ti ao Senhor teu Deus um sinal; pede-o, ou em baixo nas profundezas, ou em cima nas alturas.
text_el: αἴτησαι σεαυτῷ σημεῖον παρὰ κυρίου θεοῦ σου εἰς βάθος ἢ εἰς ὕψος

text_en: And Achaz said: I will not ask, and I will not tempt the Lord .
text_la: Et dixit Achaz : Non petam, et non tentabo Dominum.
text_pt: Acaz, porém, disse: Não pedirei, nem tentarei ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αχαζ οὐ μὴ αἰτήσω οὐδ' οὐ μὴ πειράσω κύριον

text_en: And he said: Hear therefore, O house of David : Is it a small thing for you to be grievous to men , that you are grievous to my God also?
text_la: Et dixit : Audite ergo, domus David. Numquid parum vobis est molestos esse hominibus, quia molesti estis et Deo meo?
text_pt: Então ele disse: Ouvi agora, ó casa de Davi: Pouco vos é afadigardes os homens, senão que também afadigareis ao meu Deus?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀκούσατε δή οἶκος Δαυιδ μὴ μικρὸν ὑμῖν ἀγῶνα παρέχειν ἀνθρώποις καὶ πῶς κυρίῳ παρέχετε ἀγῶνα

text_en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign. Behold a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son and his name shall be called Emmanuel .
text_la: Propter hoc dabit Dominus ipse vobis signum : ecce virgo concipiet, et pariet filium, et vocabitur nomen ejus Emmanuel.
text_pt: Portanto o mesmo Senhor vos dará um sinal: Eis que a virgem conceberá, e dará à luz um filho, e chamará o seu nome Emanuel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο δώσει κύριος αὐτὸς ὑμῖν σημεῖον ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει καὶ τέξεται υἱόν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Εμμανουηλ

text_en: He shall eat butter and honey, that he may know to refuse the evil , and to choose the good .
text_la: Butyrum et mel comedet, ut sciat reprobare malum, et eligere bonum.
text_pt: Manteiga e mel comerá, quando ele souber rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem.
text_el: βούτυρον καὶ μέλι φάγεται πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι αὐτὸν ἢ προελέσθαι πονηρὰ ἐκλέξεται τὸ ἀγαθόν

text_en: For before the child know to refuse the evil and to choose the good , the land which you abhor shall be forsaken of the face of her two kings.
text_la: Quia antequam sciat puer reprobare malum et eligere bonum, derelinquetur terra quam tu detestaris a facie duorum regum suorum.
text_pt: Na verdade, antes que este menino saiba rejeitar o mal e escolher o bem, a terra, de que te enfadas, será desamparada dos seus dois reis.
text_el: διότι πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι τὸ παιδίον ἀγαθὸν ἢ κακὸν ἀπειθεῖ πονηρίᾳ τοῦ ἐκλέξασθαι τὸ ἀγαθόν καὶ καταλειφθήσεται ἡ γῆ ἣν σὺ φοβῇ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν δύο βασιλέων

text_en: The Lord shall bring upon you, and upon your people, and upon the house of your father, days that have not come since the time of the separation of Ephraim from Juda with the king of the Assyrians .
text_la: Adducet Dominus super te, et super populum tuum, et super domum patris tui, dies qui non venerunt a diebus separationis Ephraim a Juda, cum rege Assyriorum.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor fará vir sobre ti, e sobre o teu povo, e sobre a casa de teu pai, pelo rei da Assíria, dias tais, quais nunca vieram, desde o dia em que Efraim se separou de Judá.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἐπάξει ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου ἡμέρας αἳ οὔπω ἥκασιν ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἀφεῖλεν Εφραιμ ἀπὸ Ιουδα τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly, that is in the uttermost parts of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .
text_la: Et erit in die illa : sibilabit Dominus muscæ quæ est in extremo fluminum Ægypti, et api quæ est in terra Assur;
text_pt: Porque há de acontecer que naquele dia assobiará o Senhor às moscas, que há no extremo dos rios do Egito, e às abelhas que estão na terra da Assíria;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ συριεῖ κύριος μυίαις ὃ κυριεύει μέρους ποταμοῦ Αἰγύπτου καὶ τῇ μελίσσῃ ἥ ἐστιν ἐν χώρᾳ Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: And they shall come, and shall all of them rest in the torrents of the valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all places set with shrubs, and in all hollow places.
text_la: et venient, et requiescent omnes in torrentibus vallium, et in cavernis petrarum, et in omnibus frutetis, et in universis foraminibus.
text_pt: E todas elas virão, e pousarão nos vales desertos e nas fendas das rochas, e em todos os espinheiros e em todos os arbustos.
text_el: καὶ ἐλεύσονται πάντες καὶ ἀναπαύσονται ἐν ταῖς φάραγξι τῆς χώρας καὶ ἐν ταῖς τρώγλαις τῶν πετρῶν καὶ εἰς τὰ σπήλαια καὶ εἰς πᾶσαν ῥαγάδα καὶ ἐν παντὶ ξύλῳ

text_en: In that day the Lord shall shave with a razor that is hired by them that are beyond the river, by the king of the Assyrians , the head and the hairs of the feet, and the whole beard .
text_la: In die illa radet Dominus in novacula conducta in his qui trans flumen sunt, in rege Assyriorum, caput et pilos pedum, et barbam universam.
text_pt: Naquele mesmo dia rapará o Senhor com uma navalha alugada, que está além do rio, isto é, com o rei da Assíria, a cabeça e os cabelos dos pés; e até a barba totalmente tirará.
