text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ξυρήσει κύριος τῷ ξυρῷ τῷ μεγάλῳ καὶ μεμεθυσμένῳ ὅ ἐστιν πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων τὴν κεφαλὴν καὶ τὰς τρίχας τῶν ποδῶν καὶ τὸν πώγωνα ἀφελεῖ

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : nutriet homo vaccam boum, et duas oves,
text_pt: E sucederá naquele dia que um homem criará uma novilha e duas ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ θρέψει ἄνθρωπος δάμαλιν βοῶν καὶ δύο πρόβατα

text_en: And for the abundance of milk he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that shall be left in the midst of the land.
text_la: et præ ubertate lactis comedet butyrum; butyrum enim et mel manducabit omnis qui relictus fuerit in medio terræ.
text_pt: E acontecerá que por causa da abundância do leite que elas hão de dar, comerá manteiga; e manteiga e mel comerá todo aquele que restar no meio da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἀπὸ τοῦ πλεῖστον ποιεῖν γάλα βούτυρον καὶ μέλι φάγεται πᾶς ὁ καταλειφθεὶς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place where there were a thousand vines, at a thousand pieces of silver, shall become thorns and briers.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : omnis locus ubi fuerint mille vites, mille argenteis, in spinas et in vepres erunt.
text_pt: Sucederá também naquele dia que todo o lugar, em que houver mil vides, do valor de mil siclos de prata, será para as sarças e para os espinheiros.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ πᾶς τόπος οὗ ἐὰν ὦσιν χίλιαι ἄμπελοι χιλίων σίκλων εἰς χέρσον ἔσονται καὶ εἰς ἄκανθαν

text_en: With arrows and with bows they shall go in thither: for briers and thorns shall be in all the land.
text_la: Cum sagittis et arcu ingredientur illuc : vepres enim et spinæ erunt in universa terra.
text_pt: Com arco e flecha se entrará ali, porque toda a terra será sarças e espinheiros.
text_el: μετὰ βέλους καὶ τοξεύματος εἰσελεύσονται ἐκεῖ ὅτι χέρσος καὶ ἄκανθα ἔσται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: And as for the hills that shall be raked with a rake, the fear of thorns and briers shall not come thither, but they shall be for the ox to feed on, and the lesser cattle to tread upon.
text_la: Et omnes montes qui in sarculo sarrientur, non veniet illuc terror spinarum et veprium : et erit in pascua bovis, et in conculcationem pecoris.
text_pt: E quanto a todos os montes, que costumavam cavar com enxadas, para ali não irás por causa do temor das sarças e dos espinheiros; porém servirão para se mandarem para lá os bois e para serem pisados pelas ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ὄρος ἀροτριώμενον ἀροτριαθήσεται καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐπέλθῃ ἐκεῖ φόβος ἔσται γὰρ ἀπὸ τῆς χέρσου καὶ ἀκάνθης εἰς βόσκημα προβάτου καὶ εἰς καταπάτημα βοός

text_en: And the Lord said to me: Take you a great book, and write in it with a man's pen. Take away the spoils with speed, quickly take the prey.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Sume tibi librum grandem, et scribe in eo stylo hominis : Velociter spolia detrahe, cito prædare.
text_pt: Disse-me também o SENHOR: Toma um grande rolo, e escreve nele com caneta de homem: Apressando-se ao despojo, apressurou-se à presa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρός με λαβὲ σεαυτῷ τόμον καινοῦ μεγάλου καὶ γράψον εἰς αὐτὸν γραφίδι ἀνθρώπου τοῦ ὀξέως προνομὴν ποιῆσαι σκύλων πάρεστιν γάρ

text_en: And I took unto me faithful witnesses , Urias the priest , and Zacharias the son of Barachias.
text_la: Et adhibui mihi testes fideles, Uriam sacerdotem, et Zachariam, filium Barachiæ:
text_pt: Então tomei comigo fiéis testemunhas, a Urias sacerdote, e a Zacarias, filho de Jeberequias,
text_el: καὶ μάρτυράς μοι ποίησον πιστοὺς ἀνθρώπους τὸν Ουριαν καὶ τὸν Ζαχαριαν υἱὸν Βαραχιου

text_en: And I went to the prophetess , and she conceived, and bore a son. And the Lord said to me: Call his name , Hasten to take away the spoils: Make have to take away the prey.
text_la: et accessi ad prophetissam, et concepit, et peperit filium. Et dixit Dominus ad me : Voca nomen ejus : Accelera spolia detrahere; Festina prædari:
text_pt: E fui ter com a profetisa, e ela concebeu, e deu à luz um filho; e o Senhor me disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Maer-Salal-Has-Baz.
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθον πρὸς τὴν προφῆτιν καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβεν καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱόν καὶ εἶπεν κύριός μοι κάλεσον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ταχέως σκύλευσον ὀξέως προνόμευσον

text_en: For before the child know to call his father and his mother, the strength of Damascus , and the spoils of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of the Assyrians .
text_la: quia antequam sciat puer vocare patrem suum et matrem suam, auferetur fortitudo Damasci, et spolia Samariæ, coram rege Assyriorum.
text_pt: Porque antes que o menino saiba dizer meu pai, ou minha mãe, se levarão as riquezas de Damasco, e os despojos de Samaria, diante do rei da Assíria.
text_el: διότι πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι τὸ παιδίον καλεῖν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα λήμψεται δύναμιν Δαμασκοῦ καὶ τὰ σκῦλα Σαμαρείας ἔναντι βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: And the Lord spoke to me again, saying:
text_la: Et adjecit Dominus loqui ad me adhuc, dicens:
text_pt: E continuou o Senhor a falar ainda comigo, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο κύριος λαλῆσαί μοι ἔτι

text_en: Forasmuch as this people has cast away the waters of Siloe , that go with silence, and has rather taken Rasin, and the son of Romelia:
text_la: Pro eo quod abjecit populus iste aquas Siloë, quæ vadunt cum silentio, et assumpsit magis Rasin, et filium Romeliæ :
text_pt: Porquanto este povo desprezou as águas de Siloé que correm brandamente, e alegrou-se com Rezim e com o filho de Remalias,
text_el: διὰ τὸ μὴ βούλεσθαι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ Σιλωαμ τὸ πορευόμενον ἡσυχῇ ἀλλὰ βούλεσθαι ἔχειν τὸν Ραασσων καὶ τὸν υἱὸν Ρομελιου βασιλέα ἐφ' ὑμῶν

text_en: Therefore behold the Lord will bring upon them the waters of the river strong and many, the king of the Assyrians , and all his glory : and he shall come up over all his channels, and shall overflow all his banks.
text_la: propter hoc ecce Dominus adducet super eos aquas fluminis fortes et multas, regem Assyriorum, et omnem gloriam ejus, et ascendet super omnes rivos ejus, et fluet super universas ripas ejus;
text_pt: Portanto eis que o Senhor fará subir sobre eles as águas do rio, fortes e impetuosas, isto é, o rei da Assíria, com toda a sua glória; e subirá sobre todos os seus leitos, e transbordará por todas as suas ribanceiras.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἀνάγει κύριος ἐφ' ὑμᾶς τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ ποταμοῦ τὸ ἰσχυρὸν καὶ τὸ πολύ τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἀσσυρίων καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναβήσεται ἐπὶ πᾶσαν φάραγγα ὑμῶν καὶ περιπατήσει ἐπὶ πᾶν τεῖχος ὑμῶν

text_en: And shall pass through Juda , overflowing, and going over shall reach even to the neck. And the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of your, land, O Emmanuel .
text_la: et ibit per Judam, inundans, et transiens : usque ad collum veniet. Et erit extensio alarum ejus implens latitudinem terræ tuæ, o Emmanuel!
text_pt: E passará a Judá, inundando-o, e irá passando por ele e chegará até ao pescoço; e a extensão de suas asas encherá a largura da tua terra, ó Emanuel.
text_el: καὶ ἀφελεῖ ἀπὸ τῆς Ιουδαίας ἄνθρωπον ὃς δυνήσεται κεφαλὴν ἆραι ἢ δυνατὸν συντελέσασθαί τι καὶ ἔσται ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτοῦ ὥστε πληρῶσαι τὸ πλάτος τῆς χώρας σου μεθ' ἡμῶν ὁ θεός

text_en: Gather yourselves together, O you people, and be overcome, and give ear, all you lands afar off: strengthen yourselves, and be overcome, gird yourselves, and be overcome.
text_la: Congregamini, populi, et vincimini; et audite, universæ procul terræ : confortamini, et vincimini; accingite vos, et vincimini.
text_pt: Ajuntai-vos, ó povos, e sereis quebrantados; dai ouvidos, todos os que sois de terras longínquas; cingi-vos e sereis feitos em pedaços, cingi-vos e sereis feitos em pedaços.
text_el: γνῶτε ἔθνη καὶ ἡττᾶσθε ἐπακούσατε ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ἰσχυκότες ἡττᾶσθε ἐὰν γὰρ πάλιν ἰσχύσητε πάλιν ἡττηθήσεσθε

text_en: Take counsel together, and it shall be defeated: speak a word, and it shall not be done: because God is with us.
text_la: Inite consilium, et dissipabitur; loquimini verbum, et non fiet : quia nobiscum Deus.
text_pt: Tomai juntamente conselho, e ele será frustrado; dizei uma palavra, e ela não subsistirá, porque Deus é conosco.
text_el: καὶ ἣν ἂν βουλεύσησθε βουλήν διασκεδάσει κύριος καὶ λόγον ὃν ἐὰν λαλήσητε οὐ μὴ ἐμμείνῃ ὑμῖν ὅτι μεθ' ἡμῶν κύριος ὁ θεός

text_en: For thus says the Lord to me: As he has taught me, with a strong arm, that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying:
text_la: Hæc enim ait Dominus ad me : Sicut in manu forti erudivit me, ne irem in via populi hujus, dicens :
text_pt: Porque assim o Senhor me disse com mão forte, e me ensinou que não andasse pelo caminho deste povo, dizendo:
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος τῇ ἰσχυρᾷ χειρὶ ἀπειθοῦσιν τῇ πορείᾳ τῆς ὁδοῦ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου λέγοντες

text_en: Say not: A conspiracy: for all that this people speaks, is a conspiracy: neither fear their fear , nor be afraid .
text_la: Non dicatis : Conjuratio; omnia enim quæ loquitur populus iste, conjuratio est : et timorem ejus ne timeatis, neque paveatis.
text_pt: Não chameis conjuração, a tudo quanto este povo chama conjuração; e não temais o que ele teme, nem tampouco vos assombreis.
text_el: μήποτε εἴπητε σκληρόν πᾶν γάρ ὃ ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ λαὸς οὗτος σκληρόν ἐστιν τὸν δὲ φόβον αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ φοβηθῆτε οὐδὲ μὴ ταραχθῆτε

text_en: Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself: and let him be your fear , and let him be your dread.
text_la: Dominum exercituum ipsum sanctificate; ipse pavor vester, et ipse terror vester :
text_pt: Ao Senhor dos Exércitos, a ele santificai; e seja ele o vosso temor e seja ele o vosso assombro.
text_el: κύριον αὐτὸν ἁγιάσατε καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται σου φόβος

text_en: And he shall be a sanctification to you. But for a stone of stumbling, and for a rock of offence to the two houses of Israel , for a snare and a ruin to the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
text_la: et erit vobis in sanctificationem; in lapidem autem offensionis, et in petram scandali, duabus domibus Israël; in laqueum et in ruinam habitantibus Jerusalem.
text_pt: Então ele vos será por santuário; mas servirá de pedra de tropeço, e rocha de escândalo, às duas casas de Israel; por armadilha e laço aos moradores de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἐπ' αὐτῷ πεποιθὼς ᾖς ἔσται σοι εἰς ἁγίασμα καὶ οὐχ ὡς λίθου προσκόμματι συναντήσεσθε αὐτῷ οὐδὲ ὡς πέτρας πτώματι ὁ δὲ οἶκος Ιακωβ ἐν παγίδι καὶ ἐν κοιλάσματι ἐγκαθήμενοι ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And very many of them shall stumble and fall, and shall be broken in pieces, and shall be snared, and taken.
text_la: Et offendent ex eis plurimi, et cadent, et conterentur, et irretientur, et capientur.
text_pt: E muitos entre eles tropeçarão, e cairão, e serão quebrantados, e enlaçados, e presos.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀδυνατήσουσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς πολλοὶ καὶ πεσοῦνται καὶ συντριβήσονται καὶ ἐγγιοῦσιν καὶ ἁλώσονται ἄνθρωποι ἐν ἀσφαλείᾳ ὄντες

text_en: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples .
text_la: Liga testimonium, signa legem in discipulis meis.
text_pt: Liga o testemunho, sela a lei entre os meus discípulos.
text_el: τότε φανεροὶ ἔσονται οἱ σφραγιζόμενοι τὸν νόμον τοῦ μὴ μαθεῖν

text_en: And I will wait for the Lord , who has hid his face from the house of Jacob , and I will look for him.
text_la: Et exspectabo Dominum qui abscondit faciem suam a domo Jacob, et præstolabor eum.
text_pt: E esperarei ao Senhor, que esconde o seu rosto da casa de Jacó, e a ele aguardarei.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ μενῶ τὸν θεὸν τὸν ἀποστρέψαντα τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου Ιακωβ καὶ πεποιθὼς ἔσομαι ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_en: Behold I and my children, whom the Lord has given me for a sign, and for a wonder in Israel from the Lord of hosts , who dwells in mount Sion.
text_la: Ecce ego et pueri mei quos dedit mihi Dominus in signum, et in portentum Israël a Domino exercituum, qui habitat in monte Sion :
text_pt: Eis-me aqui, com os filhos que me deu o Senhor, por sinais e por maravilhas em Israel, da parte do Senhor dos Exércitos, que habita no monte de Sião.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἅ μοι ἔδωκεν ὁ θεός καὶ ἔσται εἰς σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ παρὰ κυρίου σαβαωθ ὃς κατοικεῖ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σιων

text_en: And when they shall say to you: Seek of pythons, and of diviners , who mutter in their enchantments: should not the people seek of their God , for the living or the dead?
text_la: et cum dixerint ad vos : Quærite a pythonibus et a divinis qui strident in incantationibus suis : numquid non populus a Deo suo requiret, pro vivis a mortuis?
text_pt: Quando, pois, vos disserem: Consultai os que têm espíritos familiares e os adivinhos, que chilreiam e murmuram: Porventura não consultará o povo a seu Deus? A favor dos vivos consultar-se-á aos mortos?
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν εἴπωσιν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ζητήσατε τοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς φωνοῦντας καὶ τοὺς ἐγγαστριμύθους τοὺς κενολογοῦντας οἳ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας φωνοῦσιν οὐκ ἔθνος πρὸς θεὸν αὐτοῦ τί ἐκζητοῦσιν περὶ τῶν ζώντων τοὺς νεκρούς

text_en: To the law rather, and to the testimony. And if they speak not according to this word, they shall not have the morning light.
text_la: ad legem magis et ad testimonium. Quod si non dixerint juxta verbum hoc, non erit eis matutina lux.
text_pt: À lei e ao testemunho! Se eles não falarem segundo esta palavra, é porque não há luz neles.
text_el: νόμον γὰρ εἰς βοήθειαν ἔδωκεν ἵνα εἴπωσιν οὐχ ὡς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο περὶ οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν δῶρα δοῦναι περὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they shall pass by it, they shall fall, and be hungry: and when they shall be hungry, they will be angry , and curse their king, and their God , and look upwards.
text_la: Et transibit per eam, corruet, et esuriet; et cum esurierit, irascetur. Et maledicet regi suo, et Deo suo, et suscipiet sursum,
text_pt: E passarão pela terra duramente oprimidos e famintos; e será que, tendo fome, e enfurecendo-se, então amaldiçoarão ao seu rei e ao seu Deus, olhando para cima.
text_el: καὶ ἥξει ἐφ' ὑμᾶς σκληρὰ λιμός καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν πεινάσητε λυπηθήσεσθε καὶ κακῶς ἐρεῖτε τὸν ἄρχοντα καὶ τὰ παταχρα καὶ ἀναβλέψονται εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἄνω

text_en: And they shall look to the earth, and behold trouble and darkness, weakness and distress, and a mist following them, and they cannot fly away from their distress.
text_la: et ad terram intuebitur; et ecce tribulatio et tenebræ, dissolutio et angustia, et caligo persequens, et non poterit avolare de angustia sua.
text_pt: E, olhando para a terra, eis que haverá angústia e escuridão, e sombras de ansiedade, e serão empurrados para as trevas.
text_el: καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν κάτω ἐμβλέψονται καὶ ἰδοὺ θλῖψις καὶ στενοχωρία καὶ σκότος ἀπορία στενὴ καὶ σκότος ὥστε μὴ βλέπειν

text_en: At the first time the land of Zabulon , and the land of Nephtali was lightly touched: and at the last the way of the sea beyond the Jordan of the Galilee of the Gentiles was heavily loaded.
text_la: Primo tempore alleviata est terra Zabulon et terra Nephthali : et novissimo aggravata est via maris trans Jordanem Galilææ gentium.
text_pt: Mas a terra, que foi angustiada, não será entenebrecida; envileceu nos primeiros tempos, a terra de Zebulom, e a terra de Naftali; mas nos últimos tempos a enobreceu junto ao caminho do mar, além do Jordão, na Galiléia das nações.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπορηθήσεται ὁ ἐν στενοχωρίᾳ ὢν ἕως καιροῦ τοῦτο πρῶτον ποίει ταχὺ ποίει χώρα Ζαβουλων ἡ γῆ Νεφθαλιμ ὁδὸν θαλάσσης καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ οἱ τὴν παραλίαν κατοικοῦντες καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου Γαλιλαία τῶν ἐθνῶν τὰ μέρη τῆς Ιουδαίας

text_en: The people that walked in darkness, have seen a great light: to them that dwelt in the region of the shadow of death, light is risen.
text_la: Populus qui ambulabat in tenebris, vidit lucem magnam; habitantibus in regione umbræ mortis, lux orta est eis.
text_pt: O povo que andava em trevas, viu uma grande luz, e sobre os que habitavam na região da sombra da morte resplandeceu a luz.
text_el: ὁ λαὸς ὁ πορευόμενος ἐν σκότει ἴδετε φῶς μέγα οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν χώρᾳ καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου φῶς λάμψει ἐφ' ὑμᾶς

text_en: You have multiplied the nation, and have not increased the joy . They shall rejoice before you, as they that rejoice in the harvest, as conquerors rejoice after taking a prey, when they divide the spoils.
text_la: Multiplicasti gentem, et non magnificasti lætitiam. Lætabuntur coram te, sicut qui lætantur in messe; sicut exsultant victores capta præda, quando dividunt spolia.
text_pt: Tu multiplicaste a nação, a alegria lhe aumentaste; todos se alegrarão perante ti, como se alegram na ceifa, e como exultam quando se repartem os despojos.
text_el: τὸ πλεῖστον τοῦ λαοῦ ὃ κατήγαγες ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ σου καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται ἐνώπιόν σου ὡς οἱ εὐφραινόμενοι ἐν ἀμήτῳ καὶ ὃν τρόπον οἱ διαιρούμενοι σκῦλα

text_en: For the yoke of their burden, and the rod of their shoulder, and the sceptre of their oppressor you have overcome, as in the day of Madian .
text_la: Jugum enim oneris ejus, et virgam humeri ejus, et sceptrum exactoris ejus superasti, sicut in die Madian.
text_pt: Porque tu quebraste o jugo da sua carga, e o bordão do seu ombro, e a vara do seu opressor, como no dia dos midianitas.
text_el: διότι ἀφῄρηται ὁ ζυγὸς ὁ ἐπ' αὐτῶν κείμενος καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος ἡ ἐπὶ τοῦ τραχήλου αὐτῶν τὴν γὰρ ῥάβδον τῶν ἀπαιτούντων διεσκέδασεν κύριος ὡς τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἐπὶ Μαδιαμ

text_en: For every violent taking of spoils, with tumult, and garment mingled with blood, shall be burnt, and be fuel for the fire.
text_la: Quia omnis violentia prædatio cum tumultu, et vestimentum mistum sanguine, erit in combustionem, et cibus ignis.
text_pt: Porque todo calçado que levava o guerreiro no tumulto da batalha, e todo o manto revolvido em sangue, serão queimados, servindo de combustível ao fogo.
text_el: ὅτι πᾶσαν στολὴν ἐπισυνηγμένην δόλῳ καὶ ἱμάτιον μετὰ καταλλαγῆς ἀποτείσουσιν καὶ θελήσουσιν εἰ ἐγενήθησαν πυρίκαυστοι

text_en: For a CHILD IS BORN to us, and a son is given to us, and the government is upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, God the Mighty, the Father of the world to come, the Prince of Peace.
text_la: Parvulus enim natus est nobis, et filius datus est nobis, et factus est principatus super humerum ejus : et vocabitur nomen ejus, Admirabilis, Consiliarius, Deus, Fortis, Pater futuri sæculi, Princeps pacis.
text_pt: Porque um menino nos nasceu, um filho se nos deu, e o principado está sobre os seus ombros, e se chamará o seu nome: Maravilhoso, Conselheiro, Deus Forte, Pai da Eternidade, Príncipe da Paz.
text_el: ὅτι παιδίον ἐγεννήθη ἡμῖν υἱὸς καὶ ἐδόθη ἡμῖν οὗ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐγενήθη ἐπὶ τοῦ ὤμου αὐτοῦ καὶ καλεῖται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ μεγάλης βουλῆς ἄγγελος ἐγὼ γὰρ ἄξω εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας εἰρήνην καὶ ὑγίειαν αὐτῷ

text_en: His empire shall be multiplied, and there shall be no end of peace: he shall sit upon the throne of David , and upon his kingdom ; to establish it and strengthen it with judgment and with justice , from henceforth and for ever: the zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.
text_la: Multiplicabitur ejus imperium, et pacis non erit finis; super solium David, et super regnum ejus sedebit, ut confirmet illud et corroboret in judicio et justitia, amodo et usque in sempiternum : zelus Domini exercituum faciet hoc.
text_pt: Do aumento deste principado e da paz não haverá fim, sobre o trono de Davi e no seu reino, para o firmar e o fortificar com juízo e com justiça, desde agora e para sempre; o zelo do Senhor dos Exércitos fará isto.
text_el: μεγάλη ἡ ἀρχὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς εἰρήνης αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ὅριον ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον Δαυιδ καὶ τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ κατορθῶσαι αὐτὴν καὶ ἀντιλαβέσθαι αὐτῆς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἐν κρίματι ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον ὁ ζῆλος κυρίου σαβαωθ ποιήσει ταῦτα

text_en: The Lord sent a word into Jacob , and it has lighted upon Israel .
text_la: Verbum misit Dominus in Jacob, et cecidit in Israël.
text_pt: O Senhor enviou uma palavra a Jacó, e ela caiu em Israel.
text_el: θάνατον ἀπέστειλεν κύριος ἐπὶ Ιακωβ καὶ ἦλθεν ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And all the people of Ephraim shall know , and the inhabitants of Samaria that say in the pride and haughtiness of their heart:
text_la: Et sciet omnis populus Ephraim, et habitantes Samariam, in superbia et magnitudine cordis dicentes :
text_pt: E todo este povo o saberá, Efraim e os moradores de Samaria, que em soberba e altivez de coração, dizem:
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τοῦ Εφραιμ καὶ οἱ ἐγκαθήμενοι ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ ἐφ' ὕβρει καὶ ὑψηλῇ καρδίᾳ λέγοντες

text_en: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with square stones: they have cut down the sycamores, but we will change them for cedars .
text_la: Lateres ceciderunt, sed quadris lapidibus ædificabimus; sycomoros succiderunt, sed cedros immutabimus.
text_pt: Os tijolos caíram, mas com cantaria tornaremos a edificar; cortaram-se os sicômoros, mas em cedros as mudaremos.
text_el: πλίνθοι πεπτώκασιν ἀλλὰ δεῦτε λαξεύσωμεν λίθους καὶ ἐκκόψωμεν συκαμίνους καὶ κέδρους καὶ οἰκοδομήσωμεν ἑαυτοῖς πύργον

text_en: And the Lord shall set up the enemies of Rasin over him, and shall bring on his enemies in a crowd:
text_la: Et elevabit Dominus hostes Rasin super eum, et inimicos ejus in tumultum vertet.
text_pt: Portanto o Senhor suscitará, contra ele, os adversários de Rezim, e juntará os seus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ ῥάξει ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ἐπανιστανομένους ἐπ' ὄρος Σιων ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν διασκεδάσει

text_en: The Syrians from the east, and, the Philistines from the west: and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his indignation is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text_la: Syriam ab oriente, et Philisthiim ab occidente; et devorabunt Israël toto ore. In omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, sed adhuc manus ejus extenta.
text_pt: Pela frente virão os sírios, e por detrás os filisteus, e devorarão a Israel à boca escancarada; e nem com tudo isto cessou a sua ira, mas ainda está estendida a sua mão.
text_el: Συρίαν ἀφ' ἡλίου ἀνατολῶν καὶ τοὺς Ἕλληνας ἀφ' ἡλίου δυσμῶν τοὺς κατεσθίοντας τὸν Ισραηλ ὅλῳ τῷ στόματι ἐπὶ τούτοις πᾶσιν οὐκ ἀπεστράφη ὁ θυμός ἀλλ' ἔτι ἡ χεὶρ ὑψηλή

text_en: And the people are not returned to him who has struck them, and have not sought after the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et populus non est reversus ad percutientem se, et Dominum exercituum non inquisierunt.
text_pt: Todavia este povo não se voltou para quem o feria, nem buscou ao Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λαὸς οὐκ ἀπεστράφη ἕως ἐπλήγη καὶ τὸν κύριον οὐκ ἐξεζήτησαν

text_en: And the Lord shall destroy out of Israel the head and the tail, him that bends down, and him that holds back, in one day.
text_la: Et disperdet Dominus ab Israël caput et caudam, incurvantem et refrenantem, die una.
text_pt: Assim o Senhor cortará de Israel a cabeça e a cauda, o ramo e o junco, num mesmo dia
text_el: καὶ ἀφεῖλεν κύριος ἀπὸ Ισραηλ κεφαλὴν καὶ οὐράν μέγαν καὶ μικρὸν ἐν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ

text_en: The aged and honourable , he is the head: and the prophet that teaches lies , he is the tail.
text_la: Longævus et honorabilis, ipse est caput; et propheta docens mendacium, ipse est cauda.
text_pt: (O ancião e o homem de respeito é a cabeça; e o profeta que ensina a falsidade é a cauda).
text_el: πρεσβύτην καὶ τοὺς τὰ πρόσωπα θαυμάζοντας αὕτη ἡ ἀρχή καὶ προφήτην διδάσκοντα ἄνομα οὗτος ἡ οὐρά

text_en: And they that call this people blessed , shall cause them to err : and they that are called blessed , shall be thrown down, headlong.
text_la: Et erunt qui beatificant populum istum, seducentes; et qui beatificantur, præcipitati.
text_pt: Porque os guias deste povo são enganadores, e os que por eles são guiados são destruídos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ μακαρίζοντες τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον πλανῶντες καὶ πλανῶσιν ὅπως καταπίωσιν αὐτούς

text_en: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men: neither shall he have mercy on their fatherless , and widows : for every one is a hypocrite and wicked , and every mouth has spoken folly. For all this his indignation is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text_la: Propter hoc super adolescentulis ejus non lætabitur Dominus, et pupillorum ejus et viduarum non miserebitur : quia omnis hypocrita est et nequam, et universum os locutum est stultitiam; in omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, sed adhuc manus ejus extenta.
text_pt: Por isso o Senhor não se regozija nos seus jovens, e não se compadecerá dos seus órfãos e das suas viúvas, porque todos eles são hipócritas e malfazejos, e toda a boca profere doidices; e nem com tudo isto cessou a sua ira, mas ainda está estendida a sua mão.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοὺς νεανίσκους αὐτῶν οὐκ εὐφρανθήσεται ὁ θεὸς καὶ τοὺς ὀρφανοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς χήρας αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐλεήσει ὅτι πάντες ἄνομοι καὶ πονηροί καὶ πᾶν στόμα λαλεῖ ἄδικα ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τούτοις οὐκ ἀπεστράφη ὁ θυμός ἀλλ' ἔτι ἡ χεὶρ ὑψηλή

text_en: For wickedness is kindled as a fire, it shall devour the brier and the thorn: and shall kindle in the thicket of the forest, and it shall be wrapped up in smoke ascending on high.
text_la: Succensa est enim quasi ignis impietas : veprem et spinam vorabit, et succendetur in densitate saltus, et convolvetur superbia fumi.
text_pt: Porque a impiedade lavra como um fogo, ela devora as sarças e os espinheiros; e ela se ateará no emaranhado da floresta; e subirão em espessas nuvens de fumaça.
text_el: καὶ καυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ἡ ἀνομία καὶ ὡς ἄγρωστις ξηρὰ βρωθήσεται ὑπὸ πυρός καὶ καυθήσεται ἐν τοῖς δάσεσι τοῦ δρυμοῦ καὶ συγκαταφάγεται τὰ κύκλῳ τῶν βουνῶν πάντα

text_en: By the wrath of the Lord of hosts the land is troubled, and the people shall be as fuel for the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
text_la: In ira Domini exercituum conturbata est terra, et erit populus quasi esca ignis; vir fratri suo non parcet.
text_pt: Por causa da ira do Senhor dos Exércitos a terra se escurecerá, e será o povo como combustível para o fogo; ninguém poupará ao seu irmão.
text_el: διὰ θυμὸν ὀργῆς κυρίου συγκέκαυται ἡ γῆ ὅλη καὶ ἔσται ὁ λαὸς ὡς ὑπὸ πυρὸς κατακεκαυμένος ἄνθρωπος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐλεήσει

text_en: And he shall turn to the right hand, and shall be hungry: and shall eat on the left hand, and shall not be filled: every one shall eat the flesh of his own arm: Manasses Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasses , and they together shall be against Juda .
text_la: Et declinabit ad dexteram, et esuriet; et comedet ad sinistram, et non saturabitur; unusquisque carnem brachii sui vorabit : Manasses Ephraim, et Ephraim Manassen; simul ipsi contra Judam.
text_pt: Se colher à direita, ainda terá fome, e se comer à esquerda, ainda não se fartará; cada um comerá a carne de seu braço.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἐκκλινεῖ εἰς τὰ δεξιά ὅτι πεινάσει καὶ φάγεται ἐκ τῶν ἀριστερῶν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐμπλησθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἔσθων τὰς σάρκας τοῦ βραχίονος αὐτοῦ

text_en: After all these things his indignation is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text_la: In omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, sed adhuc manus ejus extenta.
text_pt: Manassés a Efraim, e Efraim a Manassés, e ambos serão contra Judá. Com tudo isto não cessou a sua ira, mas ainda está estendida a sua mão.
text_el: φάγεται γὰρ Μανασση τοῦ Εφραιμ καὶ Εφραιμ τοῦ Μανασση ὅτι ἅμα πολιορκήσουσιν τὸν Ιουδαν ἐπὶ τούτοις πᾶσιν οὐκ ἀπεστράφη ὁ θυμός ἀλλ' ἔτι ἡ χεὶρ ὑψηλή

text_en: Woe to them that make wicked laws: and when they write, write injustice :
text_la: Væ qui condunt leges iniquas, et scribentes injustitiam scripserunt,
text_pt: Ai dos que decretam leis injustas, e dos escrivães que prescrevem opressão.
text_el: οὐαὶ τοῖς γράφουσιν πονηρίαν γράφοντες γὰρ πονηρίαν γράφουσιν

text_en: To oppress the poor in judgment, and do violence to the cause of the humble of my people: that widows might be their prey, and that they might rob the fatherless .
text_la: ut opprimerent in judicio pauperes, et vim facerent causæ humilium populi mei; ut essent viduæ præda eorum, et pupillos diriperent.
text_pt: Para desviarem os pobres do seu direito, e para arrebatarem o direito dos aflitos do meu povo; para despojarem as viúvas e roubarem os órfãos!
text_el: ἐκκλίνοντες κρίσιν πτωχῶν ἁρπάζοντες κρίμα πενήτων τοῦ λαοῦ μου ὥστε εἶναι αὐτοῖς χήραν εἰς ἁρπαγὴν καὶ ὀρφανὸν εἰς προνομήν

text_en: What will you do in the day of visitation, and of the calamity which comes from afar? To whom will you flee for help? And where will you leave your glory ?
text_la: Quid facietis in die visitationis, et calamitatis de longe venientis? ad cujus confugietis auxilium? et ubi derelinquetis gloriam vestram,
text_pt: Mas que fareis vós no dia da visitação, e na desolação, que há de vir de longe? A quem recorrereis para obter socorro, e onde deixareis a vossa glória,
text_el: καὶ τί ποιήσουσιν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἐπισκοπῆς ἡ γὰρ θλῖψις ὑμῖν πόρρωθεν ἥξει καὶ πρὸς τίνα καταφεύξεσθε τοῦ βοηθηθῆναι καὶ ποῦ καταλείψετε τὴν δόξαν ὑμῶν

text_en: That you be not bowed down under the bond, and fall with the slain? In all these things his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
text_la: ne incurvemini sub vinculo, et cum interfectis cadatis? Super omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, sed adhuc manus ejus extenta.
text_pt: Sem que cada um se abata entre os presos, e caia entre mortos? Com tudo isto a sua ira não cessou, mas ainda está estendida a sua mão.
text_el: τοῦ μὴ ἐμπεσεῖν εἰς ἐπαγωγήν ἐπὶ πᾶσι τούτοις οὐκ ἀπεστράφη ὁ θυμός ἀλλ' ἔτι ἡ χεὶρ ὑψηλή

text_en: Woe to the Assyrian , he is the rod and the staff of my anger , and my indignation is in their hands.
text_la: Væ Assur! virga furoris mei et baculus ipse est; in manu eorum indignatio mea.
text_pt: Ai da Assíria, a vara da minha ira, porque a minha indignação é como bordão nas suas mãos.
text_el: οὐαὶ Ἀσσυρίοις ἡ ῥάβδος τοῦ θυμοῦ μου καὶ ὀργῆς ἐστιν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: I will send him to a deceitful nation, and I will give him a charge against the people of my wrath , to take away the spoils, and to lay hold on the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
text_la: Ad gentem fallacem mittam eum, et contra populum furoris mei mandabo illi, ut auferat spolia, et diripiat prædam, et ponat illum in conculcationem quasi lutum platearum.
text_pt: Enviá-la-ei contra uma nação hipócrita, e contra o povo do meu furor lhe darei ordem, para que lhe roube a presa, e lhe tome o despojo, e o ponha para ser pisado aos pés, como a lama das ruas.
text_el: τὴν ὀργήν μου εἰς ἔθνος ἄνομον ἀποστελῶ καὶ τῷ ἐμῷ λαῷ συντάξω ποιῆσαι σκῦλα καὶ προνομὴν καὶ καταπατεῖν τὰς πόλεις καὶ θεῖναι αὐτὰς εἰς κονιορτόν

text_en: But he shall not take it so, and his heart shall not think so: but his heart shall be set to destroy, and to cut off nations not a few.
text_la: Ipse autem non sic arbitrabitur, et cor ejus non ita existimabit; sed ad conterendum erit cor ejus, et ad internecionem gentium non paucarum.
text_pt: Ainda que ele não cuide assim, nem o seu coração assim o imagine; antes no seu coração intenta destruir e desarraigar não poucas nações.
text_el: αὐτὸς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως ἐνεθυμήθη καὶ τῇ ψυχῇ οὐχ οὕτως λελόγισται ἀλλὰ ἀπαλλάξει ὁ νοῦς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἔθνη ἐξολεθρεῦσαι οὐκ ὀλίγα

text_en: For he shall say:
text_la: Dicet enim :
text_pt: Porque diz: Não são meus príncipes todos eles reis?
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν εἴπωσιν αὐτῷ σὺ μόνος εἶ ἄρχων

text_en: Are not my princes as so many kings? Is not Calano as Charcamis: and Emath as Arphad? Is not Samaria as Damascus ?
text_la: Numquid non principes mei simul reges sunt? numquid non ut Charcamis, sic Calano? et ut Arphad, sic Emath? numquid non ut Damascus, sic Samaria?
text_pt: Não é Calno como Carquemis? Não é Hamate como Arpade? E Samaria como Damasco?
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖ οὐκ ἔλαβον τὴν χώραν τὴν ἐπάνω Βαβυλῶνος καὶ Χαλαννη οὗ ὁ πύργος ᾠκοδομήθη καὶ ἔλαβον Ἀραβίαν καὶ Δαμασκὸν καὶ Σαμάρειαν

text_en: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idol , so also their idols of Jerusalem , and of Samaria .
text_la: Quomodo invenit manus mea regna idoli, sic et simulacra eorum de Jerusalem et de Samaria.
text_pt: Como a minha mão alcançou os reinos dos ídolos, cujas imagens esculpidas eram melhores do que as de Jerusalém e do que as de Samaria,
text_el: ὃν τρόπον ταύτας ἔλαβον ἐν τῇ χειρί μου καὶ πάσας τὰς ἀρχὰς λήμψομαι ὀλολύξατε τὰ γλυπτὰ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ

text_en: Shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols , so do to Jerusalem and her idols ?
text_la: Numquid non sicut feci Samariæ et idolis ejus, sic faciam Jerusalem et simulacris ejus?
text_pt: Porventura como fiz a Samaria e aos seus ídolos, não o faria igualmente a Jerusalém e aos seus ídolos?
text_el: ὃν τρόπον γὰρ ἐποίησα Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ τοῖς χειροποιήτοις αὐτῆς οὕτως ποιήσω καὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῆς

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that when the Lord shall have performed all his works in mount Sion, and in Jerusalem , I will visit the fruit of the proud heart of the king of Assyria , and the glory of the haughtiness of his eyes.
text_la: Et erit, cum impleverit Dominus cuncta opera sua in monte Sion et in Jerusalem, visitabo super fructum magnifici cordis regis Assur, et super gloriam altitudinis oculorum ejus.
text_pt: Por isso acontecerá que, havendo o Senhor acabado toda a sua obra no monte Sião e em Jerusalém, então castigarei o fruto da arrogante grandeza do coração do rei da Assíria e a pompa da altivez dos seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν συντελέσῃ κύριος πάντα ποιῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σιων καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐπάξει ἐπὶ τὸν νοῦν τὸν μέγαν τὸν ἄρχοντα τῶν Ἀσσυρίων καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ὕψος τῆς δόξης τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: For he has said: By the strength of my own hand I have done it, and by my own wisdom I have understood: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have taken the spoils of the princes, and as a mighty man has pulled down them that sat on high.
text_la: Dixit enim : In fortitudine manus meæ feci, et in sapientia mea intellexi; et abstuli terminos populorum, et principes eorum deprædatus sum, et detraxi quasi potens in sublimi residentes.
text_pt: Porquanto disse: Com a força da minha mão o fiz, e com a minha sabedoria, porque sou prudente; e removi os limites dos povos, e roubei os seus tesouros, e como valente abati aos habitantes.
text_el: εἶπεν γάρ τῇ ἰσχύι ποιήσω καὶ τῇ σοφίᾳ τῆς συνέσεως ἀφελῶ ὅρια ἐθνῶν καὶ τὴν ἰσχὺν αὐτῶν προνομεύσω καὶ σείσω πόλεις κατοικουμένας

text_en: And my hand has found the strength of the people as a nest; and as eggs are gathered, that are left, so have I gathered all the earth: and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or made the least noise.
text_la: Et invenit quasi nidum manus mea fortitudinem populorum; et sicut colliguntur ova quæ derelicta sunt, sic universam terram ego congregavi; et non fuit qui moveret pennam, et aperiret os, et ganniret.
text_pt: E achou a minha mão as riquezas dos povos como a um ninho, e como se ajuntam os ovos abandonados, assim eu ajuntei a toda a terra, e não houve quem movesse a asa, ou abrisse a boca, ou murmurasse.
text_el: καὶ τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅλην καταλήμψομαι τῇ χειρὶ ὡς νοσσιὰν καὶ ὡς καταλελειμμένα ᾠὰ ἀρῶ καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς διαφεύξεταί με ἢ ἀντείπῃ μοι

text_en: Shall the axe boast itself against him that cuts with it? Or shall the saw exalt itself against him by whom it is drawn? As if a rod should lift itself up against him that lifts it up, and a staff exalt itself, which is but wood.
text_la: Numquid gloriabitur securis contra eum qui secat in ea? aut exaltabitur serra contra eum a quo trahitur? Quomodo si elevetur virga contra elevantem se, et exaltetur baculus, qui utique lignum est.
text_pt: Porventura gloriar-se-á o machado contra o que corta com ele, ou presumirá a serra contra o que puxa por ela, como se o bordão movesse aos que o levantam, ou a vara levantasse como não sendo pau?
text_el: μὴ δοξασθήσεται ἀξίνη ἄνευ τοῦ κόπτοντος ἐν αὐτῇ ἢ ὑψωθήσεται πρίων ἄνευ τοῦ ἕλκοντος αὐτόν ὡσαύτως ἐάν τις ἄρῃ ῥάβδον ἢ ξύλον

text_en: Therefore the sovereign Lord, the Lord of hosts , shall send leanness among his fat ones: and under his glory shall be kindled a burning, as it were the burning of a fire.
text_la: Propter hoc mittet Dominator, Dominus exercituum, in pinguibus ejus tenuitatem; et subtus gloriam ejus succensa ardebit quasi combustio ignis.
text_pt: Por isso o Senhor, o Senhor dos Exércitos, fará definhar os que entre eles são gordos, e debaixo da sua glória ateará um incêndio, como incêndio de fogo.
text_el: καὶ οὐχ οὕτως ἀλλὰ ἀποστελεῖ κύριος σαβαωθ εἰς τὴν σὴν τιμὴν ἀτιμίαν καὶ εἰς τὴν σὴν δόξαν πῦρ καιόμενον καυθήσεται

text_en: And the light of Israel shall be as a fire, and the Holy One thereof as a flame: and his thorns and his briers shall be set on fire, and shall be devoured in one day.
text_la: Et erit lumen Israël in igne, et Sanctus ejus in flamma; et succendetur, et devorabitur spina ejus et vepres in die una.
text_pt: Porque a Luz de Israel virá a ser como fogo e o seu Santo por labareda, que abrase e consuma os seus espinheiros e as suas sarças num só dia.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ φῶς τοῦ Ισραηλ εἰς πῦρ καὶ ἁγιάσει αὐτὸν ἐν πυρὶ καιομένῳ καὶ φάγεται ὡσεὶ χόρτον τὴν ὕλην τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

text_en: And the glory of his forest, and of his beautiful hill, shall be consumed from the soul even to the flesh, and he shall run away through fear .
text_la: Et gloria saltus ejus, et carmeli ejus, ab anima usque ad carnem consumetur; et erit terrore profugus.
text_pt: Também consumirá a glória da sua floresta, e do seu campo fértil, desde a alma até à carne, e será como quando desmaia o porta-bandeira.
text_el: ἀποσβεσθήσεται τὰ ὄρη καὶ οἱ βουνοὶ καὶ οἱ δρυμοί καὶ καταφάγεται ἀπὸ ψυχῆς ἕως σαρκῶν καὶ ἔσται ὁ φεύγων ὡς ὁ φεύγων ἀπὸ φλογὸς καιομένης

text_en: And they that remain of the trees of his forest shall be so few, that they shall easily be numbered, and a child shall write them down.
text_la: Et reliquiæ ligni saltus ejus præ paucitate numerabuntur, et puer scribet eos.
text_pt: E o resto das árvores da sua floresta será tão pouco em número, que um menino poderá contá-las.
text_el: καὶ οἱ καταλειφθέντες ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἔσονται ἀριθμός καὶ παιδίον γράψει αὐτούς

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel , and they that shall escape of the house of Jacob , shall lean no more upon him that strikes them: but they shall lean upon the Lord the Holy One of Israel , in truth .
text_la: Et erit in die illa : non adjiciet residuum Israël, et hi qui fugerint de domo Jacob, inniti super eo qui percutit eos; sed innitetur super Dominum, Sanctum Israël, in veritate.
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia que os restantes de Israel, e os que tiverem escapado da casa de Jacó, nunca mais se estribarão sobre aquele que os feriu; antes estribar-se-ão verdadeiramente sobre o Senhor, o Santo de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ οὐκέτι προστεθήσεται τὸ καταλειφθὲν Ισραηλ καὶ οἱ σωθέντες τοῦ Ιακωβ οὐκέτι μὴ πεποιθότες ὦσιν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀδικήσαντας αὐτούς ἀλλὰ ἔσονται πεποιθότες ἐπὶ τὸν θεὸν τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ

text_en: The remnant shall be converted , the remnant, I say, of Jacob , to the mighty God .
text_la: Reliquiæ convertentur; reliquiæ, inquam, Jacob ad Deum fortem.
text_pt: Os restantes se converterão ao Deus forte, sim, os restantes de Jacó.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ καταλειφθὲν τοῦ Ιακωβ ἐπὶ θεὸν ἰσχύοντα

text_en: For if your people, O Israel , shall be as the sand of the sea, a remnant of them shall be converted , the consumption abridged shall overflow with justice .
text_la: Si enim fuerit populus tuus, Israël, quasi arena maris, reliquiæ convertentur ex eo; consummatio abbreviata inundabit justitiam.
text_pt: Porque ainda que o teu povo, ó Israel, seja como a areia do mar, só um remanescente dele se converterá; uma destruição está determinada, transbordando em justiça.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν γένηται ὁ λαὸς Ισραηλ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης τὸ κατάλειμμα αὐτῶν σωθήσεται λόγον γὰρ συντελῶν καὶ συντέμνων ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ

text_en: For the Lord God of hosts shall make a consumption, and an abridgment in the midst of all the land.
text_la: Consummationem enim et abbreviationem Dominus Deus exercituum faciet in medio omnis terræ.
text_pt: Porque determinada já a destruição, o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos a executará no meio de toda esta terra.
text_el: ὅτι λόγον συντετμημένον ποιήσει ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῇ οἰκουμένῃ ὅλῃ

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord the God of hosts : O my people that dwell in Sion , be not afraid of the Assyrian : he shall strike you with his rod, and he shall lift up his staff over you in the way of Egypt .
text_la: Propter hoc, hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : Noli timere, populus meus, habitator Sion, ab Assur : in virga percutiet te, et baculum suum levabit super te, in via Ægypti.
text_pt: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos: Povo meu, que habitas em Sião, não temas à Assíria, quando te ferir com a vara, e contra ti levantar o seu bordão à maneira dos egípcios.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ μὴ φοβοῦ ὁ λαός μου οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Σιων ἀπὸ Ἀσσυρίων ὅτι ἐν ῥάβδῳ πατάξει σε πληγὴν γὰρ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ σὲ τοῦ ἰδεῖν ὁδὸν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: For yet a little and a very little while, and my indignation shall cease, and my wrath shall be upon their wickedness .
text_la: Adhuc enim paululum modicumque, et consummabitur indignatio et furor meus super scelus eorum.
text_pt: Porque daqui a bem pouco se cumprirá a minha indignação e a minha ira, para a consumir.
text_el: ἔτι γὰρ μικρὸν καὶ παύσεται ἡ ὀργή ὁ δὲ θυμός μου ἐπὶ τὴν βουλὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Lord of hosts shall raise up a scourge against him, according to the slaughter of Madian in the rock of Oreb, and his rod over the sea, and he shall lift it up in the way of Egypt .
text_la: Et suscitabit super eum Dominus exercituum flagellum, juxta plagam Madian in petra Oreb : et virgam suam super mare, et levabit eam in via Ægypti.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor dos Exércitos suscitará contra ela um flagelo, como na matança de Midiã junto à rocha de Orebe; e a sua vara estará sobre o mar, e ele a levantará como sucedeu aos egípcios.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεγερεῖ ὁ θεὸς ἐπ' αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὴν πληγὴν τὴν Μαδιαμ ἐν τόπῳ θλίψεως καὶ ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ τῇ ὁδῷ τῇ κατὰ θάλασσαν εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν τὴν κατ' Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall putrefy at the presence of the oil.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : auferetur onus ejus de humero tuo et jugum ejus de collo tuo, et computrescet jugum a facie olei.
text_pt: E acontecerá, naquele dia, que a sua carga será tirada do teu ombro, e o seu jugo do teu pescoço; e o jugo será despedaçado por causa da unção.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀφαιρεθήσεται ὁ φόβος αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ὁ ζυγὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὤμου σου καὶ καταφθαρήσεται ὁ ζυγὸς ἀπὸ τῶν ὤμων ὑμῶν

text_en: He shall come into Aiath, he shall pass into Magron: at Machmas he shall lay up his carriages.
text_la: Veniet in Ajath, transibit in Magron, apud Machmas commendabit vasa sua.
text_pt: Já vem chegando a Aiate, já vai passando por Migrom, e em Micmás deixa a sua bagagem.
text_el: ἥξει γὰρ εἰς τὴν πόλιν Αγγαι καὶ παρελεύσεται εἰς Μαγεδω καὶ ἐν Μαχμας θήσει τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ

text_en: They have passed in haste, Gaba is our lodging: Rama was astonished, Gabaath of Saul fled away.
text_la: Transierunt cursim, Gaba sedes nostra; obstupuit Rama, Gabaath Saulis fugit.
text_pt: Já passaram o desfiladeiro, já se alojam em Geba; já Ramá treme, e Gibeá de Saul vai fugindo.
text_el: καὶ παρελεύσεται φάραγγα καὶ ἥξει εἰς Αγγαι φόβος λήμψεται Ραμα πόλιν Σαουλ φεύξεται

text_en: Lift up your voice, O daughter of Gallim, attend, O Laisa, poor Anathoth .
text_la: Hinni voce tua, filia Gallim, attende Laisa, paupercula Anathoth.
text_pt: Clama alto com a tua voz, ó filha de Galim! Ouve, ó Laís! Ó tu pobre Anatote!
text_el: ἡ θυγάτηρ Γαλλιμ ἐπακούσεται Λαισα ἐπακούσεται Αναθωθ

text_en: Medemena is removed: you inhabitants of Gabim, take courage .
text_la: Migravit Medemena; habitatores Gabim, confortamini.
text_pt: Madmena já se foi; os moradores de Gebim vão fugindo em bandos.
text_el: ἐξέστη Μαδεβηνα καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Γιββιρ παρακαλεῖτε

text_en: It is yet day enough, to remain in Nobe: he shall shake his hand against the mountain of the daughter of Sion , the hill of Jerusalem .
text_la: Adhuc dies est ut in Nobe stetur; agitabit manum suam super montem filiæ Sion, collem Jerusalem.
text_pt: Ainda um dia parará em Nobe; acenará com a sua mão contra o monte da filha de Sião, o outeiro de Jerusalém.
text_el: σήμερον ἐν ὁδῷ τοῦ μεῖναι τῇ χειρὶ παρακαλεῖτε τὸ ὄρος τὴν θυγατέρα Σιων καὶ οἱ βουνοὶ οἱ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Behold the sovereign Lord of hosts shall break the earthen vessel with terror, and the tall of stature shall be cut down, and the lofty shall be humbled .
text_la: Ecce Dominator, Dominus exercituum, confringet lagunculam in terrore; et excelsi statura succidentur, et sublimes humiliabuntur.
text_pt: Mas eis que o Senhor, o Senhor dos Exércitos, cortará os ramos com violência, e os de alta estatura serão cortados, e os altivos serão abatidos.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὁ δεσπότης κύριος σαβαωθ συνταράσσει τοὺς ἐνδόξους μετὰ ἰσχύος καὶ οἱ ὑψηλοὶ τῇ ὕβρει συντριβήσονται καὶ οἱ ὑψηλοὶ ταπεινωθήσονται

text_en: And the thickets of the forest shall be cut down with iron, and Libanus with its high ones shall fall.
text_la: Et subvertentur condensa saltus ferro; et Libanus cum excelsis cadet.
text_pt: E cortará com ferro a espessura da floresta, e o Líbano cairá à mão de um poderoso.
text_el: καὶ πεσοῦνται οἱ ὑψηλοὶ μαχαίρᾳ ὁ δὲ Λίβανος σὺν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς πεσεῖται

text_en: And there shall come forth a rod out of the root of Jesse, and a flower shall rise up out of his root.
text_la: Et egredietur virga de radice Jesse, et flos de radice ejus ascendet.
text_pt: Porque brotará um rebento do tronco de Jessé, e das suas raízes um renovo frutificará.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ῥάβδος ἐκ τῆς ῥίζης Ιεσσαι καὶ ἄνθος ἐκ τῆς ῥίζης ἀναβήσεται

text_en: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him: the spirit of wisdom, and of understanding, the spirit of counsel, and of fortitude , the spirit of knowledge , and of godliness .
text_la: Et requiescet super eum spiritus Domini : spiritus sapientiæ et intellectus, spiritus consilii et fortitudinis, spiritus scientiæ et pietatis;
text_pt: E repousará sobre ele o Espírito do Senhor, o espírito de sabedoria e de entendimento, o espírito de conselho e de fortaleza, o espírito de conhecimento e de temor do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀναπαύσεται ἐπ' αὐτὸν πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ συνέσεως πνεῦμα βουλῆς καὶ ἰσχύος πνεῦμα γνώσεως καὶ εὐσεβείας

text_en: And he shall be filled with the spirit of the fear of the Lord , He shall not judge according to the sight of the eyes, nor reprove according to the hearing of the ears.
text_la: et replebit eum spiritus timoris Domini. Non secundum visionem oculorum judicabit, neque secundum auditum aurium arguet;
text_pt: E deleitar-se-á no temor do Senhor; e não julgará segundo a vista dos seus olhos, nem repreenderá segundo o ouvir dos seus ouvidos.
text_el: ἐμπλήσει αὐτὸν πνεῦμα φόβου θεοῦ οὐ κατὰ τὴν δόξαν κρινεῖ οὐδὲ κατὰ τὴν λαλιὰν ἐλέγξει

text_en: But he shall judge the poor with justice , and shall reprove with equity the meek of the earth: and he shall strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips he shall slay the wicked .
text_la: sed judicabit in justitia pauperes, et arguet in æquitate pro mansuetis terræ; et percutiet terram virga oris sui, et spiritu labiorum suorum interficiet impium.
text_pt: Mas julgará com justiça aos pobres, e repreenderá com eqüidade aos mansos da terra; e ferirá a terra com a vara de sua boca, e com o sopro dos seus lábios matará ao ímpio,
text_el: ἀλλὰ κρινεῖ ταπεινῷ κρίσιν καὶ ἐλέγξει τοὺς ταπεινοὺς τῆς γῆς καὶ πατάξει γῆν τῷ λόγῳ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν πνεύματι διὰ χειλέων ἀνελεῖ ἀσεβῆ

text_en: And justice shall be the girdle of his loins: and faith the girdle of his reins.
text_la: Et erit justitia cingulum lumborum ejus, et fides cinctorium renum ejus.
text_pt: E a justiça será o cinto dos seus lombos, e a fidelidade o cinto dos seus rins.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται δικαιοσύνῃ ἐζωσμένος τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ εἰλημένος τὰς πλευράς

text_en: The wolf shall dwell with the lamb : and the leopard shall lie down with the kid: the calf and the lion, and the sheep shall abide together, and a little child shall lead them.
text_la: Habitabit lupus cum agno, et pardus cum hædo accubabit; vitulus, et leo, et ovis, simul morabuntur, et puer parvulus minabit eos.
text_pt: E morará o lobo com o cordeiro, e o leopardo com o cabrito se deitará, e o bezerro, e o filho de leão e o animal cevado andarão juntos, e um menino pequeno os guiará.
text_el: καὶ συμβοσκηθήσεται λύκος μετὰ ἀρνός καὶ πάρδαλις συναναπαύσεται ἐρίφῳ καὶ μοσχάριον καὶ ταῦρος καὶ λέων ἅμα βοσκηθήσονται καὶ παιδίον μικρὸν ἄξει αὐτούς

text_en: The calf and the bear shall feed: their young ones shall rest together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
text_la: Vitulus et ursus pascentur, simul requiescent catuli eorum; et leo quasi bos comedet paleas.
text_pt: A vaca e a ursa pastarão juntas, seus filhos se deitarão juntos, e o leão comerá palha como o boi.
text_el: καὶ βοῦς καὶ ἄρκος ἅμα βοσκηθήσονται καὶ ἅμα τὰ παιδία αὐτῶν ἔσονται καὶ λέων καὶ βοῦς ἅμα φάγονται ἄχυρα

text_en: And the sucking child shall play on other hole of the asp: and the weaned child shall thrust his hand into the den of the basilisk.
text_la: Et delectabitur infans ab ubere super foramine aspidis; et in caverna reguli qui ablactatus fuerit manum suam mittet.
text_pt: E brincará a criança de peito sobre a toca da áspide, e a desmamada colocará a sua mão na cova do basilisco.
text_el: καὶ παιδίον νήπιον ἐπὶ τρώγλην ἀσπίδων καὶ ἐπὶ κοίτην ἐκγόνων ἀσπίδων τὴν χεῖρα ἐπιβαλεῖ

text_en: They shall not hurt, nor shall they kill in all my holy mountain, for the earth is filled with the knowledge of the Lord , as the covering waters of the sea.
text_la: Non nocebunt, et non occident in universo monte sancto meo, quia repleta est terra scientia Domini, sicut aquæ maris operientes.
text_pt: Não se fará mal nem dano algum em todo o meu santo monte, porque a terra se encherá do conhecimento do Senhor, como as águas cobrem o mar.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ κακοποιήσωσιν οὐδὲ μὴ δύνωνται ἀπολέσαι οὐδένα ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ ἅγιόν μου ὅτι ἐνεπλήσθη ἡ σύμπασα τοῦ γνῶναι τὸν κύριον ὡς ὕδωρ πολὺ κατακαλύψαι θαλάσσας

text_en: In that day the root of Jesse, who stands for an ensign of the people, him the Gentiles shall beseech, and his sepulchre shall be glorious .
text_la: In die illa radix Jesse, qui stat in signum populorum, ipsum gentes deprecabuntur, et erit sepulchrum ejus gloriosum.
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia que a raiz de Jessé, a qual estará posta por estandarte dos povos, será buscada pelos gentios; e o lugar do seu repouso será glorioso.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ιεσσαι καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἀνάπαυσις αὐτοῦ τιμή

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand the second time to possess the remnant of his people, which shall be left from the Assyrians , and from Egypt , and from Phetros, and from Ethiopia , and from Elam, and from Sennaar, and from Emath, and from the islands of the sea.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : adjiciet Dominus secundo manum suam ad possidendum residuum populi sui, quod relinquetur ab Assyriis, et ab Ægypto, et a Phetros, et ab Æthiopia, et ab Ælam, et a Sennaar, et ab Emath, et ab insulis maris.
text_pt: E há de ser que naquele dia o Senhor tornará a pôr a sua mão para adquirir outra vez o remanescente do seu povo, que for deixado, da Assíria, e do Egito, e de Patros, e da Etiópia, e de Elã, e de Sinar, e de Hamate, e das ilhas do mar.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ προσθήσει κύριος τοῦ δεῖξαι τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ τοῦ ζηλῶσαι τὸ καταλειφθὲν ὑπόλοιπον τοῦ λαοῦ ὃ ἂν καταλειφθῇ ἀπὸ τῶν Ἀσσυρίων καὶ ἀπὸ Αἰγύπτου καὶ Βαβυλωνίας καὶ Αἰθιοπίας καὶ ἀπὸ Αιλαμιτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ ἡλίου ἀνατολῶν καὶ ἐξ Ἀραβίας

text_en: And he shall set up a standard unto the nations , and shall assemble the fugitives of Israel , and shall gather together the dispersed of Juda from the four quarters of the earth.
text_la: Et levabit signum in nationes, et congregabit profugos Israël, et dispersos Juda colliget a quatuor plagis terræ.
text_pt: E levantará um estandarte entre as nações, e ajuntará os desterrados de Israel, e os dispersos de Judá congregará desde os quatro confins da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀρεῖ σημεῖον εἰς τὰ ἔθνη καὶ συνάξει τοὺς ἀπολομένους Ισραηλ καὶ τοὺς διεσπαρμένους τοῦ Ιουδα συνάξει ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων πτερύγων τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the envy of Ephraim shall be taken away, and the enemies of Juda shall perish: Ephraim shall not envy Juda , and Juda shall not fight against Ephraim.
text_la: Et auferetur zelus Ephraim, et hostes Juda peribunt; Ephraim non æmulabitur Judam, et Judas non pugnabit contra Ephraim.
text_pt: E afastar-se-á a inveja de Efraim, e os adversários de Judá serão desarraigados; Efraim não invejará a Judá, e Judá não oprimirá a Efraim.
text_el: καὶ ἀφαιρεθήσεται ὁ ζῆλος Εφραιμ καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ Ιουδα ἀπολοῦνται Εφραιμ οὐ ζηλώσει Ιουδαν καὶ Ιουδας οὐ θλίψει Εφραιμ

text_en: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines by the sea, they together shall spoil the children of the east: Edom , till Moab shall be under the rule of their hand, and the children of Ammon shall be obedient .
text_la: Et volabunt in humeros Philisthiim per mare, simul prædabuntur filios orientis; Idumæa et Moab præceptum manus eorum, et filii Ammon obedientes erunt.
text_pt: Antes voarão sobre os ombros dos filisteus ao ocidente; juntos despojarão aos do oriente; em Edom e Moabe porão as suas mãos, e os filhos de Amom lhes obedecerão.
text_el: καὶ πετασθήσονται ἐν πλοίοις ἀλλοφύλων θάλασσαν ἅμα προνομεύσουσιν καὶ τοὺς ἀφ' ἡλίου ἀνατολῶν καὶ Ιδουμαίαν καὶ ἐπὶ Μωαβ πρῶτον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιβαλοῦσιν οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Αμμων πρῶτοι ὑπακούσονται

text_en: And the Lord shall lay waste the tongue of the sea of Egypt , and shall lift up his hand over the river in the strength of his spirit : and he shall strike it in the seven streams, so that men may pass through it in their shoes.
text_la: Et desolabit Dominus linguam maris Ægypti, et levabit manum suam super flumen in fortitudine spiritus sui; et percutiet eum in septem rivis, ita ut transeant per eum calceati.
text_pt: E o Senhor destruirá totalmente a língua do mar do Egito, e moverá a sua mão contra o rio com a força do seu vento e, ferindo-o, dividi-lo-á em sete correntes e fará que por ele passem com sapatos secos.
text_el: καὶ ἐρημώσει κύριος τὴν θάλασσαν Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐπιβαλεῖ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμὸν πνεύματι βιαίῳ καὶ πατάξει ἑπτὰ φάραγγας ὥστε διαπορεύεσθαι αὐτὸν ἐν ὑποδήμασιν

text_en: And there shall be a highway for the remnant of my people, which shall be left from the Assyrians : as there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et erit via residuo populo meo qui relinquetur ab Assyriis, sicut fuit Israëli in die illa qua ascendit de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E haverá caminho plano para o remanescente do seu povo, que for deixado da Assíria, como sucedeu a Israel no dia em que subiu da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται δίοδος τῷ καταλειφθέντι μου λαῷ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἔσται τῷ Ισραηλ ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα ὅτε ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And you shall say in that day: I will give thanks to you, O Lord , for you were angry with me: your wrath is turned away, and you have comforted me.
text_la: Et dices in die illa : Confitebor tibi, Domine, quoniam iratus es mihi; conversus est furor tuus, et consolatus es me.
text_pt: E dirás naquele dia: Graças te dou, ó SENHOR, porque, ainda que te iraste contra mim, a tua ira se retirou, e tu me consolas.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ εὐλογήσω σε κύριε διότι ὠργίσθης μοι καὶ ἀπέστρεψας τὸν θυμόν σου καὶ ἠλέησάς με

text_en: Behold, God is my saviour, I will deal confidently, and will not fear : because the Lord is my strength, and my praise, and he has become my salvation .
text_la: Ecce Deus salvator meus; fiducialiter agam, et non timebo : quia fortitudo mea et laus mea Dominus, et factus est mihi in salutem.
text_pt: Eis que Deus é a minha salvação; nele confiarei, e não temerei, porque o SENHOR DEUS é a minha força e o meu cântico, e se tornou a minha salvação.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὁ θεός μου σωτήρ μου κύριος πεποιθὼς ἔσομαι ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ σωθήσομαι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ οὐ φοβηθήσομαι διότι ἡ δόξα μου καὶ ἡ αἴνεσίς μου κύριος καὶ ἐγένετό μοι εἰς σωτηρίαν

text_en: You shall draw waters with joy out of the saviour's fountains:
text_la: Haurietis aquas in gaudio de fontibus salvatoris.
text_pt: E vós com alegria tirareis águas das fontes da salvação.
text_el: καὶ ἀντλήσετε ὕδωρ μετ' εὐφροσύνης ἐκ τῶν πηγῶν τοῦ σωτηρίου

text_en: And you shall say in that day: Praise the Lord , and call upon his name : make his works known among the people: remember that his name is high.
text_la: Et dicetis in die illa : Confitemini Domino et invocate nomen ejus; notas facite in populis adinventiones ejus; mementote quoniam excelsum est nomen ejus.
text_pt: E direis naquele dia: Dai graças ao Senhor, invocai o seu nome, fazei notório os seus feitos entre os povos, contai quão excelso é o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὑμνεῖτε κύριον βοᾶτε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὰ ἔνδοξα αὐτοῦ μιμνῄσκεσθε ὅτι ὑψώθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sing to the Lord , for he has done great things: show this forth in all the earth.
text_la: Cantate Domino, quoniam magnifice fecit; annuntiate hoc in universa terra.
text_pt: Cantai ao Senhor, porque fez coisas grandiosas; saiba-se isto em toda a terra.
text_el: ὑμνήσατε τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ὅτι ὑψηλὰ ἐποίησεν ἀναγγείλατε ταῦτα ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: Rejoice, and praise, O habitation of Sion : for great is he that is in the midst of you, the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Exsulta et lauda, habitatio Sion, quia magnus in medio tui Sanctus Israël.
text_pt: Exulta e jubila, ó habitante de Sião, porque grande é o Santo de Israel no meio de ti.
text_el: ἀγαλλιᾶσθε καὶ εὐφραίνεσθε οἱ κατοικοῦντες Σιων ὅτι ὑψώθη ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: The burden of Babylon which Isaiah the son of Amos saw.
text_la: Onus Babylonis, quod vidit Isaias, filius Amos.
text_pt: Peso de babilônia, que viu Isaías, filho de Amós.
text_el: ὅρασις ἣν εἶδεν Ησαιας υἱὸς Αμως κατὰ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: Upon the dark mountain lift up a banner, exalt the voice, lift up the hand, and let the rulers go into the gates.
text_la: Super montem caliginosum levate signum : exaltate vocem, levate manum, et ingrediantur portas duces.
text_pt: Alçai uma bandeira sobre o monte elevado, levantai a voz para eles; acenai-lhes com a mão, para que entrem pelas portas dos nobres.
text_el: ἐπ' ὄρους πεδινοῦ ἄρατε σημεῖον ὑψώσατε τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῖς μὴ φοβεῖσθε παρακαλεῖτε τῇ χειρί ἀνοίξατε οἱ ἄρχοντες

text_en: I have commanded my sanctified ones, and have called my strong ones in my wrath , them that rejoice in my glory .
text_la: Ego mandavi sanctificatis meis, et vocavi fortes meos in ira mea, exsultantes in gloria mea.
text_pt: Eu dei ordens aos meus santificados; sim, já chamei os meus poderosos para executarem a minha ira, os que exultam com a minha majestade.
text_el: ἐγὼ συντάσσω καὶ ἐγὼ ἄγω αὐτούς ἡγιασμένοι εἰσίν καὶ ἐγὼ ἄγω αὐτούς γίγαντες ἔρχονται πληρῶσαι τὸν θυμόν μου χαίροντες ἅμα καὶ ὑβρίζοντες

text_en: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, as it were of many people, the noise of the sound of kings, of nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts has given charge to the troops of war .
text_la: Vox multitudinis in montibus, quasi populorum frequentium; vox sonitus regum, gentium congregatarum. Dominus exercituum præcepit militiæ belli,
text_pt: Já se ouve a gritaria da multidão sobre os montes, como a de muito povo; o som do rebuliço de reinos e de nações congregados. O Senhor dos Exércitos passa em revista o exército de guerra.
text_el: φωνὴ ἐθνῶν πολλῶν ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ὁμοία ἐθνῶν πολλῶν φωνὴ βασιλέων καὶ ἐθνῶν συνηγμένων κύριος σαβαωθ ἐντέταλται ἔθνει ὁπλομάχῳ

text_en: To them that come from a country afar off, from the end of heaven : the Lord and the instruments of his wrath , to destroy the whole land.
text_la: venientibus de terra procul, a summitate cæli; Dominus, et vasa furoris ejus, ut disperdat omnem terram.
text_pt: Já vem de uma terra remota, desde a extremidade do céu, o Senhor, e os instrumentos da sua indignação, para destruir toda aquela terra.
text_el: ἔρχεσθαι ἐκ γῆς πόρρωθεν ἀπ' ἄκρου θεμελίου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κύριος καὶ οἱ ὁπλομάχοι αὐτοῦ τοῦ καταφθεῖραι τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅλην

text_en: Howl, for the day of the Lord is near: it shall come as a destruction from the Lord .
text_la: Ululate, quia prope est dies Domini; quasi vastitas a Domino veniet.
text_pt: Clamai, pois, o dia do Senhor está perto; vem do Todo-Poderoso como assolação.
text_el: ὀλολύζετε ἐγγὺς γὰρ ἡ ἡμέρα κυρίου καὶ συντριβὴ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἥξει

text_en: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every heart of man shall melt,
text_la: Propter hoc omnes manus dissolventur, et omne cor hominis contabescet,
text_pt: Portanto, todas as mãos se debilitarão, e o coração de todos os homens se desanimará.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πᾶσα χεὶρ ἐκλυθήσεται καὶ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ἀνθρώπου δειλιάσει

text_en: and shall be broken. Gripings and pains, shall take hold of them, they shall be in pain as a woman in labour. Every one shall be amazed at his neighbour, their countenances shall be as faces burnt.
text_la: et conteretur. Torsiones et dolores tenebunt; quasi parturiens dolebunt : unusquisque ad proximum suum stupebit, facies combustæ vultus eorum.
text_pt: E assombrar-se-ão, e apoderar-se-ão deles dores e ais, e se angustiarão, como a mulher com dores de parto; cada um se espantará do seu próximo; os seus rostos serão rostos flamejantes.
text_el: καὶ ταραχθήσονται οἱ πρέσβεις καὶ ὠδῖνες αὐτοὺς ἕξουσιν ὡς γυναικὸς τικτούσης καὶ συμφοράσουσιν ἕτερος πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον καὶ ἐκστήσονται καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ὡς φλὸξ μεταβαλοῦσιν

text_en: Behold, the day of the Lord shall come, a cruel day, and full of indignation, and of wrath , and fury, to lay the land desolate, and to destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
text_la: Ecce dies Domini veniet, crudelis, et indignationis plenus, et iræ, furorisque, ad ponendam terram in solitudinem, et peccatores ejus conterendos de ea.
text_pt: Eis que vem o dia do Senhor, horrendo, com furor e ira ardente, para pôr a terra em assolação, e dela destruir os pecadores.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἡμέρα κυρίου ἀνίατος ἔρχεται θυμοῦ καὶ ὀργῆς θεῖναι τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅλην ἔρημον καὶ τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς ἀπολέσαι ἐξ αὐτῆς

text_en: For the stars of heaven , and their brightness shall not display their light: the sun shall be darkened in his rising, and the moon shall not shine with her light.
text_la: Quoniam stellæ cæli, et splendor earum, non expandent lumen suum; obtenebratus est sol in ortu suo, et luna non splendebit in lumine suo.
text_pt: Porque as estrelas dos céus e as suas constelações não darão a sua luz; o sol se escurecerá ao nascer, e a lua não resplandecerá com a sua luz.
text_el: οἱ γὰρ ἀστέρες τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὁ Ὠρίων καὶ πᾶς ὁ κόσμος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸ φῶς οὐ δώσουσιν καὶ σκοτισθήσεται τοῦ ἡλίου ἀνατέλλοντος καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φῶς αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will visit the evils of the world, and against the wicked for their iniquity : and I will make the pride of infidels to cease, and will bring down the arrogancy of the mighty.
text_la: Et visitabo super orbis mala, et contra impios iniquitatem eorum; et quiescere faciam superbiam infidelium, et arrogantiam fortium humiliabo.
text_pt: E visitarei sobre o mundo a maldade, e sobre os ímpios a sua iniqüidade; e farei cessar a arrogância dos atrevidos, e abaterei a soberba dos tiranos.
text_el: καὶ ἐντελοῦμαι τῇ οἰκουμένῃ ὅλῃ κακὰ καὶ τοῖς ἀσεβέσιν τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπολῶ ὕβριν ἀνόμων καὶ ὕβριν ὑπερηφάνων ταπεινώσω

text_en: A man shall be more precious than gold, yea a man than the finest of gold.
text_la: Pretiosior erit vir auro, et homo mundo obrizo.
text_pt: Farei que o homem seja mais precioso do que o ouro puro, e mais raro do que o ouro fino de Ofir.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ καταλελειμμένοι ἔντιμοι μᾶλλον ἢ τὸ χρυσίον τὸ ἄπυρον καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος μᾶλλον ἔντιμος ἔσται ἢ ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐκ Σουφιρ

text_en: For this I will trouble the heaven : and the earth shall be moved out of her place, for the indignation of the Lord of hosts , and for the day of his fierce wrath .
text_la: Super hoc cælum turbabo; et movebitur terra de loco suo, propter indignationem Domini exercituum, et propter diem iræ furoris ejus.
text_pt: Por isso farei estremecer os céus; e a terra se moverá do seu lugar, por causa do furor do Senhor dos Exércitos, e por causa do dia da sua ardente ira.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ οὐρανὸς θυμωθήσεται καὶ ἡ γῆ σεισθήσεται ἐκ τῶν θεμελίων αὐτῆς διὰ θυμὸν ὀργῆς κυρίου σαβαωθ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἂν ἐπέλθῃ ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they shall be as a doe fleeing away, and as a sheep: and there shall be none to gather them together: every man shall turn to his own people, and every one shall flee to his own land.
text_la: Et erit quasi damula fugiens, et quasi ovis, et non erit qui congreget. Unusquisque ad populum suum convertetur, et singuli ad terram suam fugient.
text_pt: E cada um será como a corça que foge, e como a ovelha que ninguém recolhe; cada um voltará para o seu povo, e cada um fugirá para a sua terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ καταλελειμμένοι ὡς δορκάδιον φεῦγον καὶ ὡς πρόβατον πλανώμενον καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ συνάγων ὥστε ἄνθρωπον εἰς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀποστραφῆναι καὶ ἄνθρωπον εἰς τὴν χώραν αὐτοῦ διῶξαι

text_en: Every one that shall be found, shall be slain : and every one that shall come to their aid, shall fall by the sword.
text_la: Omnis qui inventus fuerit occidetur, et omnis qui supervenerit cadet in gladio;
text_pt: Todo o que for achado será transpassado; e todo o que se unir a ele cairá à espada.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἂν ἁλῷ ἡττηθήσεται καὶ οἵτινες συνηγμένοι εἰσίν μαχαίρᾳ πεσοῦνται

text_en: Their inhabitants shall be dashed in pieces before their eyes: their houses shall be pillaged, and their wives shall be ravished.
text_la: infantes eorum allidentur in oculis eorum, diripientur domus eorum, et uxores eorum violabuntur.
text_pt: E suas crianças serão despedaçadas perante os seus olhos; as suas casas serão saqueadas, e as suas mulheres violadas.
text_el: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ῥάξουσιν καὶ τὰς οἰκίας αὐτῶν προνομεύσουσιν καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν ἕξουσιν

text_en: Behold I will stir up the Medes against them, who shall not seek silver, nor desire gold:
text_la: Ecce ego suscitabo super eos Medos, qui argentum non quærant, nec aurum velint;
text_pt: Eis que eu despertarei contra eles os medos, que não farão caso da prata, nem tampouco desejarão ouro.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐπεγείρω ὑμῖν τοὺς Μήδους οἳ οὐ λογίζονται ἀργύριον οὐδὲ χρυσίου χρείαν ἔχουσιν

text_en: But with their arrows they shall kill the children, and shall have no pity upon the sucklings of the womb, and their eye shall not spare their sons.
text_la: sed sagittis parvulos interficient, et lactantibus uteris non miserebuntur, et super filios non parcet oculus eorum.
text_pt: E os seus arcos despedaçarão os jovens, e não se compadecerão do fruto do ventre; os seus olhos não pouparão aos filhos.
text_el: τοξεύματα νεανίσκων συντρίψουσιν καὶ τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ ἐλεήσωσιν οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς τέκνοις οὐ φείσονται οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: And that Babylon , glorious among kingdoms, the famous pride of the Chaldeans , shall be even as the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrha .
text_la: Et erit Babylon illa gloriosa in regnis, inclyta superbia Chaldæorum, sicut subvertit Dominus Sodomam et Gomorrham.
text_pt: E babilônia, o ornamento dos reinos, a glória e a soberba dos caldeus, será como Sodoma e Gomorra, quando Deus as transtornou.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Βαβυλών ἣ καλεῖται ἔνδοξος ὑπὸ βασιλέως Χαλδαίων ὃν τρόπον κατέστρεψεν ὁ θεὸς Σοδομα καὶ Γομορρα

text_en: It shall no more be inhabited for ever, and it shall not be founded unto generation and generation : neither shall the Arabian pitch his tents there, nor shall shepherds rest there.
text_la: Non habitabitur usque in finem, et non fundabitur usque ad generationem et generationem; nec ponet ibi tentoria Arabs, nec pastores requiescent ibi.
text_pt: Nunca mais será habitada, nem nela morará alguém de geração em geração; nem o árabe armará ali a sua tenda, nem tampouco os pastores ali farão deitar os seus rebanhos.
text_el: οὐ κατοικηθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον οὐδὲ μὴ εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς αὐτὴν διὰ πολλῶν γενεῶν οὐδὲ μὴ διέλθωσιν αὐτὴν Ἄραβες οὐδὲ ποιμένες οὐ μὴ ἀναπαύσωνται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: But wild beasts shall rest there, and their houses shall be filled with serpents, and ostriches shall dwell there, and the hairy ones shall dance there:
text_la: Sed requiescent ibi bestiæ, et replebuntur domus eorum draconibus, et habitabunt ibi struthiones, et pilosi saltabunt ibi;
text_pt: Mas as feras do deserto repousarão ali, e as suas casas se encherão de horríveis animais; e ali habitarão os avestruzes, e os sátiros pularão ali.
text_el: καὶ ἀναπαύσονται ἐκεῖ θηρία καὶ ἐμπλησθήσονται αἱ οἰκίαι ἤχου καὶ ἀναπαύσονται ἐκεῖ σειρῆνες καὶ δαιμόνια ἐκεῖ ὀρχήσονται

text_en: And owls shall answer one another there, in the houses thereof, and sirens in the temples of pleasure.
text_la: et respondebunt ibi ululæ in ædibus ejus, et sirenes in delubris voluptatis.
text_pt: E os animais selvagens das ilhas uivarão em suas casas vazias, como também os chacais nos seus palácios de prazer; pois bem perto já vem chegando o seu tempo, e os seus dias não se prolongarão.
text_el: καὶ ὀνοκένταυροι ἐκεῖ κατοικήσουσιν καὶ νοσσοποιήσουσιν ἐχῖνοι ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις αὐτῶν ταχὺ ἔρχεται καὶ οὐ χρονιεῖ

text_en: Her time is near at hand, and her days shall not be prolonged. For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob , and will yet choose out of Israel , and will make them rest upon their own ground: and the stranger shall be joined with them, and shall adhere to the house of Jacob .
text_la: Prope est ut veniat tempus ejus, et dies ejus non elongabuntur. Miserebitur enim Dominus Jacob, et eliget adhuc de Israël, et requiescere eos faciet super humum suam; adjungetur advena ad eos, et adhærebit domui Jacob.
text_pt: Porque o SENHOR se compadecerá de Jacó, e ainda escolherá a Israel e os porá na sua própria terra; e ajuntar-se-ão com eles os estrangeiros, e se achegarão à casa de Jacó.
text_el: καὶ ἐλεήσει κύριος τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ ἐκλέξεται ἔτι τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἀναπαύσονται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ γιώρας προστεθήσεται πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ προστεθήσεται πρὸς τὸν οἶκον Ιακωβ

text_en: And the people shall take them, and bring them into their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall make them captives that had taken them, and shall subdue their oppressors.
text_la: Et tenebunt eos populi, et adducent eos in locum suum; et possidebit eos domus Israël super terram Domini in servos et ancillas : et erunt capientes eos qui se ceperant, et subjicient exactores suos.
text_pt: E os povos os receberão, e os levarão aos seus lugares, e a casa de Israel os possuirá por servos, e por servas, na terra do Senhor; e cativarão aqueles que os cativaram, e dominarão sobre os seus opressores.
text_el: καὶ λήμψονται αὐτοὺς ἔθνη καὶ εἰσάξουσιν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῶν καὶ κατακληρονομήσουσιν καὶ πληθυνθήσονται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς δούλους καὶ δούλας καὶ ἔσονται αἰχμάλωτοι οἱ αἰχμαλωτεύσαντες αὐτούς καὶ κυριευθήσονται οἱ κυριεύσαντες αὐτῶν

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that when God shall give you rest from your labour, and from your vexation, and from the hard bondage , wherewith you served before,
text_la: Et erit in die illa : cum requiem dederit tibi Deus a labore tuo, et a concussione tua, et a servitute dura qua ante servisti,
text_pt: E acontecerá que no dia em que o Senhor vier a dar-te descanso do teu sofrimento, e do teu pavor, e da dura servidão com que te fizeram servir,
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀναπαύσει σε ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῆς ὀδύνης καὶ τοῦ θυμοῦ σου καὶ τῆς δουλείας σου τῆς σκληρᾶς ἧς ἐδούλευσας αὐτοῖς

text_en: you shall take up this parable against the king of Babylon , and shall say: How is the oppressor come to nothing, the tribute has ceased?
text_la: sumes parabolam istam contra regem Babylonis, et dices : Quomodo cessavit exactor; quievit tributum?
text_pt: Então proferirás este provérbio contra o rei de babilônia, e dirás: Como já cessou o opressor, como já cessou a cidade dourada!
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τὸν θρῆνον τοῦτον ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἐρεῖς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ πῶς ἀναπέπαυται ὁ ἀπαιτῶν καὶ ἀναπέπαυται ὁ ἐπισπουδαστής

text_en: The Lord has broken the staff of the wicked , the rod of the rulers,
text_la: Contrivit Dominus baculum impiorum, virgam dominantium,
text_pt: Já quebrantou o Senhor o bastão dos ímpios e o cetro dos dominadores.
text_el: συνέτριψεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν ζυγὸν τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν τὸν ζυγὸν τῶν ἀρχόντων

text_en: that struck the people in wrath with an incurable wound, that brought nations under in fury , that persecuted in a cruel manner.
text_la: cædentem populos in indignatione plaga insanabili, subjicientem in furore gentes, persequentem crudeliter.
text_pt: Aquele que feria aos povos com furor, com golpes incessantes, e que com ira dominava sobre as nações agora é perseguido, sem que alguém o possa impedir.
text_el: πατάξας ἔθνος θυμῷ πληγῇ ἀνιάτῳ παίων ἔθνος πληγὴν θυμοῦ ἣ οὐκ ἐφείσατο

text_en: The whole earth is quiet and still, it is glad and has rejoiced.
text_la: Conquievit et siluit omnis terra, gavisa est et exsultavit;
text_pt: Já descansa, já está sossegada toda a terra; rompem cantando.
text_el: ἀνεπαύσατο πεποιθώς πᾶσα ἡ γῆ βοᾷ μετ' εὐφροσύνης

text_en: The fir trees also have rejoiced over you, and the cedars of Libanus , saying: Since you have slept, there has none come up to cut us down.
text_la: abietes quoque lætatæ sunt super te, et cedri Libani : ex quo dormisti, non ascendet qui succidat nos.
text_pt: Até as faias se alegram sobre ti, e os cedros do Líbano, dizendo: Desde que tu caíste ninguém sobe contra nós para nos cortar.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ξύλα τοῦ Λιβάνου εὐφράνθησαν ἐπὶ σοὶ καὶ ἡ κέδρος τοῦ Λιβάνου ἀφ' οὗ σὺ κεκοίμησαι οὐκ ἀνέβη ὁ κόπτων ἡμᾶς

text_en: Hell below was in an uproar to meet you at your coming, it stirred up the giants for you. All the princes of the earth are risen up from their thrones, all the princes of nations .
text_la: Infernus subter conturbatus est in occursum adventus tui; suscitavit tibi gigantes. Omnes principes terræ surrexerunt de soliis suis, omnes principes nationum.
text_pt: O inferno desde o profundo se turbou por ti, para te sair ao encontro na tua vinda; despertou por ti os mortos, e todos os chefes da terra, e fez levantar dos seus tronos a todos os reis das nações.
text_el: ὁ ᾅδης κάτωθεν ἐπικράνθη συναντήσας σοι συνηγέρθησάν σοι πάντες οἱ γίγαντες οἱ ἄρξαντες τῆς γῆς οἱ ἐγείραντες ἐκ τῶν θρόνων αὐτῶν πάντας βασιλεῖς ἐθνῶν

text_en: All shall answer, and say to you: You also are wounded as well as we, you have become like unto us.
text_la: Universi respondebunt, et dicent tibi : Et tu vulneratus es sicut et nos; nostri similis effectus es.
text_pt: Estes todos responderão, e te dirão: Tu também adoeceste como nós, e foste semelhante a nós.
text_el: πάντες ἀποκριθήσονται καὶ ἐροῦσίν σοι καὶ σὺ ἑάλως ὥσπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐν ἡμῖν δὲ κατελογίσθης

text_en: Your pride is brought down to hell, your carcass is fallen down: under you shall the moth be strewed, and worms shall be your covering.
text_la: Detracta est ad inferos superbia tua, concidit cadaver tuum; subter te sternetur tinea, et operimentum tuum erunt vermes.
text_pt: Já foi derrubada na sepultura a tua soberba com o som das tuas violas; os vermes debaixo de ti se estenderão, e os bichos te cobrirão.
text_el: κατέβη δὲ εἰς ᾅδου ἡ δόξα σου ἡ πολλή σου εὐφροσύνη ὑποκάτω σου στρώσουσιν σῆψιν καὶ τὸ κατακάλυμμά σου σκώληξ

text_en: How are you fallen from heaven , O Lucifer , who rose in the morning? How are you fallen to the earth, that wounded the nations ?
text_la: Quomodo cecidisti de cælo, Lucifer, qui mane oriebaris? corruisti in terram, qui vulnerabas gentes?
text_pt: Como caíste desde o céu, ó Lúcifer, filho da alva! Como foste cortado por terra, tu que debilitavas as nações!
text_el: πῶς ἐξέπεσεν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὁ ἑωσφόρος ὁ πρωὶ ἀνατέλλων συνετρίβη εἰς τὴν γῆν ὁ ἀποστέλλων πρὸς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: And you said in your heart: I will ascend into heaven , I will exalt my throne above the stars of God , I will sit in the mountain of the covenant, in the sides of the north.
text_la: Qui dicebas in corde tuo : In cælum conscendam, super astra Dei exaltabo solium meum; sedebo in monte testamenti, in lateribus aquilonis;
text_pt: E tu dizias no teu coração: Eu subirei ao céu, acima das estrelas de Deus exaltarei o meu trono, e no monte da congregação me assentarei, aos lados do norte.
text_el: σὺ δὲ εἶπας ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ σου εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀναβήσομαι ἐπάνω τῶν ἄστρων τοῦ οὐρανοῦ θήσω τὸν θρόνον μου καθιῶ ἐν ὄρει ὑψηλῷ ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη τὰ ὑψηλὰ τὰ πρὸς βορρᾶν

text_en: I will ascend above the height of the clouds, I will be like the most High .
text_la: ascendam super altitudinem nubium, similis ero Altissimo?
text_pt: Subirei sobre as alturas das nuvens, e serei semelhante ao Altíssimo.
text_el: ἀναβήσομαι ἐπάνω τῶν νεφελῶν ἔσομαι ὅμοιος τῷ ὑψίστῳ

text_en: But yet you shall be brought down to hell, into the depth of the pit.
text_la: Verumtamen ad infernum detraheris, in profundum laci.
text_pt: E contudo levado serás ao inferno, ao mais profundo do abismo.
text_el: νῦν δὲ εἰς ᾅδου καταβήσῃ καὶ εἰς τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς

text_en: They that shall see you, shall turn toward you, and behold you. Is this the man that troubled the earth, that shook kingdoms,
text_la: Qui te viderint, ad te inclinabuntur, teque prospicient : Numquid iste est vir qui conturbavit terram, qui concussit regna,
text_pt: Os que te virem te contemplarão, considerar-te-ão, e dirão: É este o homem que fazia estremecer a terra e que fazia tremer os reinos?
text_el: οἱ ἰδόντες σε θαυμάσουσιν ἐπὶ σοὶ καὶ ἐροῦσιν οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ παροξύνων τὴν γῆν σείων βασιλεῖς

text_en: that made the world a wilderness , and destroyed the cities thereof, that opened not the prison to his prisoners?
text_la: qui posuit orbem desertum, et urbes ejus destruxit, vinctis ejus non aperuit carcerem?
text_pt: Que punha o mundo como o deserto, e assolava as suas cidades? Que não abria a casa de seus cativos?
text_el: ὁ θεὶς τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅλην ἔρημον καὶ τὰς πόλεις καθεῖλεν τοὺς ἐν ἐπαγωγῇ οὐκ ἔλυσεν

text_en: All the kings of the nations have all of them slept in glory , every one in his own house.
text_la: Omnes reges gentium universi dormierunt in gloria, vir in domo sua;
text_pt: Todos os reis das nações, todos eles, jazem com honra, cada um na sua morada.
text_el: πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐκοιμήθησαν ἐν τιμῇ ἄνθρωπος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: But you are cast out of your grave, as an unprofitable branch defiled, and wrapped up among them that were slain by the sword, and have gone down to the bottom of the pit, as a rotten carcass.
text_la: tu autem projectus es de sepulchro tuo, quasi stirps inutilis pollutus, et obvolutus cum his qui interfecti sunt gladio, et descenderunt ad fundamenta laci, quasi cadaver putridum.
text_pt: Porém tu és lançado da tua sepultura, como um renovo abominável, como as vestes dos que foram mortos atravessados à espada, como os que descem ao covil de pedras, como um cadáver pisado.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ῥιφήσῃ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν ὡς νεκρὸς ἐβδελυγμένος μετὰ πολλῶν τεθνηκότων ἐκκεκεντημένων μαχαίραις καταβαινόντων εἰς ᾅδου ὃν τρόπον ἱμάτιον ἐν αἵματι πεφυρμένον οὐκ ἔσται καθαρόν
