text_en: You shall not keep company with them, even in burial: for you have destroyed your land, you have slain your people: the seed of the wicked shall not be named for ever.
text_la: Non habebis consortium, neque cum eis in sepultura; tu enim terram tuam disperdidisti, tu populum tuum occidisti : non vocabitur in æternum semen pessimorum.
text_pt: Com eles não te reunirás na sepultura; porque destruíste a tua terra e mataste o teu povo; a descendência dos malignos não será jamais nomeada.
text_el: οὕτως οὐδὲ σὺ ἔσῃ καθαρός διότι τὴν γῆν μου ἀπώλεσας καὶ τὸν λαόν μου ἀπέκτεινας οὐ μὴ μείνῃς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον σπέρμα πονηρόν

text_en: Prepare his children for slaughter for the iniquity of their fathers: they shall not rise up, nor inherit the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
text_la: Præparate filios ejus occisioni, in iniquitate patrum suorum : non consurgent, nec hæreditabunt terram, neque implebunt faciem orbis civitatum.
text_pt: Preparai a matança para os seus filhos por causa da maldade de seus pais, para que não se levantem, e nem possuam a terra, e encham a face do mundo de cidades.
text_el: ἑτοίμασον τὰ τέκνα σου σφαγῆναι ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις τοῦ πατρός σου ἵνα μὴ ἀναστῶσιν καὶ τὴν γῆν κληρονομήσωσιν καὶ ἐμπλήσωσι τὴν γῆν πόλεων

text_en: And I will rise up against them, says the Lord of hosts : and I will destroy the name of Babylon , and the remains, and the bud, and the offspring, says the Lord .
text_la: Et consurgam super eos, dicit Dominus exercituum; et perdam Babylonis nomen, et reliquias, et germen, et progeniem, dicit Dominus;
text_pt: Porque me levantarei contra eles, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, e extirparei de babilônia o nome, e os sobreviventes, o filho e o neto, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ ἐπαναστήσομαι αὐτοῖς λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ καὶ ἀπολῶ αὐτῶν ὄνομα καὶ κατάλειμμα καὶ σπέρμα τάδε λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will make it a possession for the ericius and pools of waters, and I will sweep it and wear it out with a besom, says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: et ponam eam in possessionem ericii, et in paludes aquarum, et scopabo eam in scopa terens, dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: E farei dela uma possessão de ouriços e a lagoas de águas; e varrê-la-ei com vassoura de perdição, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ θήσω τὴν Βαβυλωνίαν ἔρημον ὥστε κατοικεῖν ἐχίνους καὶ ἔσται εἰς οὐδέν καὶ θήσω αὐτὴν πηλοῦ βάραθρον εἰς ἀπώλειαν

text_en: The Lord of hosts has sworn , saying: Surely as I have thought, so shall it be: and as I have purposed,
text_la: Juravit Dominus exercituum, dicens : Si non, ut putavi, ita erit; et quomodo mente tractavi,
text_pt: O Senhor dos Exércitos jurou, dizendo: Como pensei, assim sucederá, e como determinei, assim se efetuará.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ ὃν τρόπον εἴρηκα οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ὃν τρόπον βεβούλευμαι οὕτως μενεῖ

text_en: so shall it fall out: That I will destroy the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: and his yoke shall be taken away from them, and his burden shall be taken off their shoulder.
text_la: sic eveniet : ut conteram Assyrium in terra mea, et in montibus meis conculcem eum; et auferetur ab eis jugum ejus, et onus illius ab humero eorum tolletur.
text_pt: Quebrantarei a Assíria na minha terra, e nas minhas montanhas a pisarei, para que o seu jugo se aparte deles e a sua carga se desvie dos seus ombros.
text_el: τοῦ ἀπολέσαι τοὺς Ἀσσυρίους ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς τῆς ἐμῆς καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ὀρέων μου καὶ ἔσονται εἰς καταπάτημα καὶ ἀφαιρεθήσεται ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὁ ζυγὸς αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ κῦδος αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ὤμων ἀφαιρεθήσεται

text_en: This is the counsel, that I have purposed upon all the earth, and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all nations .
text_la: Hoc consilium quod cogitavi super omnem terram; et hæc est manus extenta super universas gentes.
text_pt: Este é o propósito que foi determinado sobre toda a terra; e esta é a mão que está estendida sobre todas as nações.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ βουλή ἣν βεβούλευται κύριος ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅλην καὶ αὕτη ἡ χεὶρ ἡ ὑψηλὴ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς οἰκουμένης

text_en: For the Lord of hosts has decreed, and who can disannul it? And his hand is stretched out: and who shall turn it away?
text_la: Dominus enim exercituum decrevit; et quis poterit infirmare? et manus ejus extenta; et quis avertet eam?
text_pt: Porque o Senhor dos Exércitos o determinou; quem o invalidará? E a sua mão está estendida; quem pois a fará voltar atrás?
text_el: ἃ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἅγιος βεβούλευται τίς διασκεδάσει καὶ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν ὑψηλὴν τίς ἀποστρέψει

text_en: In the year that King Achaz died, was this burden:
text_la: In anno quo mortuus est rex Achaz, factum est onus istud:
text_pt: No ano em que morreu o rei Acaz, foi dada esta sentença.
text_el: τοῦ ἔτους οὗ ἀπέθανεν Αχαζ ὁ βασιλεύς ἐγενήθη τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: Rejoice not, whole Philistia , that the rod of him that struck you is broken in pieces: for out of the root of the serpent shall come forth a basilisk, and his seed shall swallow the bird.
text_la: Ne lætaris, Philisthæa omnis tu, quoniam comminuta est virga percussoris tui; de radice enim colubri egredietur regulus, et semen ejus absorbens volucrem.
text_pt: Não te alegres, tu, toda a Filístia, por estar quebrada a vara que te feria; porque da raiz da cobra sairá um basilisco, e o seu fruto será uma serpente ardente, voadora.
text_el: μὴ εὐφρανθείητε πάντες οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι συνετρίβη γὰρ ὁ ζυγὸς τοῦ παίοντος ὑμᾶς ἐκ γὰρ σπέρματος ὄφεων ἐξελεύσεται ἔκγονα ἀσπίδων καὶ τὰ ἔκγονα αὐτῶν ἐξελεύσονται ὄφεις πετόμενοι

text_en: And the firstborn of the poor shall be fed, and the poor shall rest with confidence: and I will make your root perish with famine, and I will kill your remnant.
text_la: Et pascentur primogeniti pauperum, et pauperes fiducialiter requiescent; et interire faciam in fame radicem tuam, et reliquias tuas interficiam.
text_pt: E os primogênitos dos pobres serão apascentados, e os necessitados se deitarão seguros; porém farei morrer de fome a tua raiz, e ele matará os teus sobreviventes.
text_el: καὶ βοσκηθήσονται πτωχοὶ δι' αὐτοῦ πτωχοὶ δὲ ἄνδρες ἐπ' εἰρήνης ἀναπαύσονται ἀνελεῖ δὲ λιμῷ τὸ σπέρμα σου καὶ τὸ κατάλειμμά σου ἀνελεῖ

text_en: Howl, O gate; cry, O city: all Philistia is thrown down: for a smoke shall come from the north, and there is none that shall escape his troop.
text_la: Ulula, porta; clama civitas; prostrata est Philisthæa omnis; ab aquilone enim fumus veniet, et non est qui effugiet agmen ejus.
text_pt: Dá uivos, ó porta, grita, ó cidade; tu, ó Filístia, estás toda derretida; porque do norte vem uma fumaça, e não haverá quem fique sozinho nas suas convocações.
text_el: ὀλολύζετε πύλαι πόλεων κεκραγέτωσαν πόλεις τεταραγμέναι οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι πάντες ὅτι καπνὸς ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἔρχεται καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν τοῦ εἶναι

text_en: And what shall be answered to the messengers of the nations ? That the Lord has founded Sion , and the poor of his people shall hope in him.
text_la: Et quid respondebitur nuntiis gentis? Quia Dominus fundavit Sion, et in ipso sperabunt pauperes populi ejus.
text_pt: Que se responderá, pois, aos mensageiros da nação? Que o Senhor fundou a Sião, para que os opressos do seu povo nela encontrem refúgio.
text_el: καὶ τί ἀποκριθήσονται βασιλεῖς ἐθνῶν ὅτι κύριος ἐθεμελίωσεν Σιων καὶ δι' αὐτοῦ σωθήσονται οἱ ταπεινοὶ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: The burden of Moab . Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, it is silent: because the wall of Moab is destroyed in the night, it is silent.
text_la: Onus Moab. Quia nocte vastata est Ar Moab, conticuit; quia nocte vastatus est murus Moab, conticuit.
text_pt: Peso de Moabe. Certamente numa noite foi destruída Ar de Moabe, e foi desfeita; certamente numa noite foi destruída Quir de Moabe e foi desfeita.
text_el: τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ κατὰ τῆς Μωαβίτιδος νυκτὸς ἀπολεῖται ἡ Μωαβῖτις νυκτὸς γὰρ ἀπολεῖται τὸ τεῖχος τῆς Μωαβίτιδος

text_en: The house has gone up, and Dibon to the high places to mourn over Nabo , and over Medaba, Moab has howled: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard shall be shaven.
text_la: Ascendit domus, et Dibon ad excelsa, in planctum super Nabo; et super Medaba, Moab ululavit; in cunctis capitibus ejus calvitium, et omnis barba radetur.
text_pt: Vai subindo a Bajite, e a Dibom, aos lugares altos, para chorar; por Nebo e por Medeba clamará Moabe; todas as cabeças ficarão calvas, e toda a barba será rapada.
text_el: λυπεῖσθε ἐφ' ἑαυτοῖς ἀπολεῖται γὰρ καὶ Δηβων οὗ ὁ βωμὸς ὑμῶν ἐκεῖ ἀναβήσεσθε κλαίειν ἐπὶ Ναβαυ τῆς Μωαβίτιδος ὀλολύζετε ἐπὶ πάσης κεφαλῆς φαλάκρωμα πάντες βραχίονες κατατετμημένοι

text_en: In their streets they are girded with sackcloth : on the tops of their houses, and in their streets all shall howl and come down weeping.
text_la: In triviis ejus accincti sunt sacco; super tecta ejus et in plateis ejus omnis ululatus descendit in fletum.
text_pt: Cingiram-se de sacos nas suas ruas; nos seus terraços e nas suas praças todos andam gritando, e choram abundantemente.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις αὐτῆς περιζώσασθε σάκκους καὶ κόπτεσθε ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων αὐτῆς καὶ ἐν ταῖς ῥύμαις αὐτῆς πάντες ὀλολύζετε μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ

text_en: Hesebon shall cry, and Eleale, their voice is heard even to Jasa. For this shall the well appointed men of Moab howl, his soul shall howl to itself.
text_la: Clamabit Hesebon et Eleale, usque Jasa audita est vox eorum; super hoc expediti Moab ululabunt, anima ejus ululabit sibi.
text_pt: Assim Hesbom como Eleale, andam gritando; até Jaaz se ouve a sua voz; por isso os armados de Moabe clamam; a sua alma lhes será penosa.
text_el: ὅτι κέκραγεν Εσεβων καὶ Ελεαλη ἕως Ιασσα ἠκούσθη ἡ φωνὴ αὐτῶν διὰ τοῦτο ἡ ὀσφὺς τῆς Μωαβίτιδος βοᾷ ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῆς γνώσεται

text_en: My heart shall cry to Moab , the bars thereof shall flee unto Segor a heifer of three years old: for by the ascent of Luith they shall go up weeping: and in the way of Oronaim they shall lift up a cry of destruction.
text_la: Cor meum ad Moab clamabit; vectes ejus usque ad Segor, vitulam conternantem; per ascensum enim Luith flens ascendet, et in via Oronaim clamorem contritionis levabunt.
text_pt: O meu coração clama por causa de Moabe; os seus fugitivos foram até Zoar, como uma novilha de três anos; porque vão chorando pela subida de Luíte, porque no caminho de Horonaim levantam um lastimoso pranto.
text_el: ἡ καρδία τῆς Μωαβίτιδος βοᾷ ἐν αὐτῇ ἕως Σηγωρ δάμαλις γάρ ἐστιν τριετής ἐπὶ δὲ τῆς ἀναβάσεως τῆς Λουιθ πρὸς σὲ κλαίοντες ἀναβήσονται τῇ ὁδῷ Αρωνιιμ βοᾷ σύντριμμα καὶ σεισμός

text_en: For the waters of Nemrim shall be desolate, for the grass is withered away, the spring is faded, all the greenness is perished.
text_la: Aquæ enim Nemrim desertæ erunt, quia aruit herba, defecit germen, viror omnis interiit.
text_pt: Porque as águas de Ninrim serão pura assolação; porque já secou o feno, acabou a erva, e não há verdura alguma.
text_el: τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς Νεμριμ ἔρημον ἔσται καὶ ὁ χόρτος αὐτῆς ἐκλείψει χόρτος γὰρ χλωρὸς οὐκ ἔσται

text_en: According to the greatness of their work, is their visitation also: they shall lead them to the torrent of the willows.
text_la: Secundum magnitudinem operis, et visitatio eorum : ad torrentem Salicum ducent eos.
text_pt: Por isso a abundância que ajuntaram, e o que guardaram, ao ribeiro dos salgueiros o levarão.
text_el: μὴ καὶ οὕτως μέλλει σωθῆναι ἐπάξω γὰρ ἐπὶ τὴν φάραγγα Ἄραβας καὶ λήμψονται αὐτήν

text_en: For the cry has gone round about the border of Moab : the howling thereof unto Gallim, and unto the well of Elim the cry thereof.
text_la: Quoniam circuivit clamor terminum Moab; usque ad Gallim ululatus ejus, et usque ad puteum Elim clamor ejus.
text_pt: Porque o pranto rodeará aos limites de Moabe; até Eglaim chegará o seu clamor, e ainda até Beer-Elim chegará o seu lamento.
text_el: συνῆψεν γὰρ ἡ βοὴ τὸ ὅριον τῆς Μωαβίτιδος τῆς Αγαλλιμ καὶ ὀλολυγμὸς αὐτῆς ἕως τοῦ φρέατος τοῦ Αιλιμ

text_en: For the waters of Dibon are filled with blood: for I will bring more upon Dibon : the lion upon them that shall flee of Moab , and upon the remnant of the land.
text_la: Quia aquæ Dibon repletæ sunt sanguine; ponam enim super Dibon additamenta; his qui fugerint de Moab leonem, et reliquiis terræ.
text_pt: Porquanto as águas de Dimom estão cheias de sangue, porque ainda acrescentarei mais a Dimom; leões contra aqueles que escaparem de Moabe e contra o restante da terra.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ὕδωρ τὸ Ρεμμων πλησθήσεται αἵματος ἐπάξω γὰρ ἐπὶ Ρεμμων Ἄραβας καὶ ἀρῶ τὸ σπέρμα Μωαβ καὶ Αριηλ καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον Αδαμα

text_en: Send forth, O Lord , the lamb , the ruler of the earth, from Petra of the desert , to the mount of the daughter of Sion .
text_la: Emitte agnum, Domine, dominatorem terræ, de petra deserti ad montem filiæ Sion.
text_pt: Enviai o cordeiro ao governador da terra, desde Sela, no deserto, até ao monte da filha de Sião.
text_el: ἀποστελῶ ὡς ἑρπετὰ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν μὴ πέτρα ἔρημός ἐστιν τὸ ὄρος Σιων

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that as a bird fleeing away, and as young ones flying out of the nest, so shall the daughters of Moab be in the passage of Arnon.
text_la: Et erit : sicut avis fugiens, et pulli de nido avolantes, sic erunt filiæ Moab in transcensu Arnon.
text_pt: De outro modo sucederá que serão as filhas de Moabe junto aos vaus de Arnom como o pássaro vagueante, lançado fora do ninho.
text_el: ἔσῃ γὰρ ὡς πετεινοῦ ἀνιπταμένου νεοσσὸς ἀφῃρημένος θύγατερ Μωαβ ἔπειτα δέ Αρνων

text_en: Take counsel, gather a council: make your shadow as the night in the midday: hide them that flee, and betray not them that wander about.
text_la: Ini consilium, coge concilium; pone quasi noctem umbram tuam in meridie; absconde fugientes, et vagos ne prodas.
text_pt: Toma conselho, executa juízo, põe a tua sombra no pino do meio-dia como a noite; esconde os desterrados, e não descubras os fugitivos.
text_el: πλείονα βουλεύου ποιεῖτε σκέπην πένθους αὐτῇ διὰ παντός ἐν μεσημβρινῇ σκοτίᾳ φεύγουσιν ἐξέστησαν μὴ ἀπαχθῇς

text_en: My fugitives shall dwell with you: O Moab , be a covert to them from the face of the destroyer: for the dust is at an end, the wretch is consumed: he has failed, that trod the earth under foot.
text_la: Habitabunt apud te profugi mei; Moab, esto latibulum eorum a facie vastatoris : finitus est enim pulvis, consummatus est miser, defecit qui conculcabat terram.
text_pt: Habitem contigo os meus desterrados, ó Moabe; serve-lhes de refúgio perante a face do destruidor; porque o homem violento terá fim; a destruição é desfeita, e os opressores são consumidos sobre a terra.
text_el: παροικήσουσίν σοι οἱ φυγάδες Μωαβ ἔσονται σκέπη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ προσώπου διώκοντος ὅτι ἤρθη ἡ συμμαχία σου καὶ ὁ ἄρχων ἀπώλετο ὁ καταπατῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And a throne shall be prepared in mercy, and one shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David , judging and seeking judgment and quickly rendering that which is just .
text_la: Et præparabitur in misericordia solium, et sedebit super illud in veritate in tabernaculo David, judicans et quærens judicium, et velociter reddens quod justum est.
text_pt: Porque o trono se firmará em benignidade, e sobre ele no tabernáculo de Davi se assentará em verdade um que julgue, e busque o juízo, e se apresse a fazer justiça.
text_el: καὶ διορθωθήσεται μετ' ἐλέους θρόνος καὶ καθίεται ἐπ' αὐτοῦ μετὰ ἀληθείας ἐν σκηνῇ Δαυιδ κρίνων καὶ ἐκζητῶν κρίμα καὶ σπεύδων δικαιοσύνην

text_en: We have heard of the pride of Moab , he is exceeding proud : his pride and his arrogancy , and his indignation is more than his strength.
text_la: Audivimus superbiam Moab : superbus est valde; superbia ejus, et arrogantia ejus, et indignatio ejus plus quam fortitudo ejus.
text_pt: Ouvimos da soberba de Moabe, que é soberbíssimo; da sua altivez, da sua soberba, e do seu furor; porém, as suas mentiras não serão firmes.
text_el: ἠκούσαμεν τὴν ὕβριν Μωαβ ὑβριστὴς σφόδρα τὴν ὑπερηφανίαν ἐξῆρας οὐχ οὕτως ἡ μαντεία σου

text_en: Therefore shall Moab howl to Moab , every one shall howl: to them that rejoice upon the brick walls, tell their stripes.
text_la: Idcirco ululabit Moab ad Moab; universus ululabit : his qui lætantur super muros cocti lateris, loquimini plagas suas.
text_pt: Portanto Moabe clamará por Moabe; todos clamarão; gemereis pelos fundamentos de Quir-Haresete, pois certamente já estão abatidos.
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως ὀλολύξει Μωαβ ἐν γὰρ τῇ Μωαβίτιδι πάντες ὀλολύξουσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Δεσεθ μελετήσεις καὶ οὐκ ἐντραπήσῃ

text_en: For the suburbs of Hesebon are desolate, and the lords of the nations have destroyed the vineyard of Sabama: the branches thereof have reached even to Jazer: they have wandered in the wilderness , the branches thereof are left, they have gone over the sea.
text_la: Quoniam suburbana Hesebon deserta sunt, et vineam Sabama domini gentium exciderunt : flagella ejus usque ad Jazer pervenerunt, erraverunt in deserto; propagines ejus relictæ sunt, transierunt mare.
text_pt: Porque os campos de Hesbom enfraqueceram, e a vinha de Sibma; os senhores dos gentios quebraram as suas melhores plantas que haviam chegado a Jazer e vagueiam no deserto; os seus rebentos se estenderam e passaram além do mar.
text_el: τὰ πεδία Εσεβων πενθήσει ἄμπελος Σεβαμα καταπίνοντες τὰ ἔθνη καταπατήσατε τὰς ἀμπέλους αὐτῆς ἕως Ιαζηρ οὐ μὴ συνάψητε πλανήθητε τὴν ἔρημον οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι ἐγκατελείφθησαν διέβησαν γὰρ τὴν ἔρημον

text_en: Therefore I will lament with the weeping of Jazer the vineyard of Sabama: I will water you with my tears, O Hesebon , and Eleale: for the voice of the treaders has rushed in upon your vintage, and upon your harvest.
text_la: Super hoc plorabo in fletu Jazer vineam Sabama; inebriabo de lacrima mea, Hesebon et Eleale, quoniam super vindemiam tuam et super messem tuam vox calcantium irruit.
text_pt: Por isso prantearei, com o pranto de Jazer, a vinha de Sibma; regar-te-ei com as minhas lágrimas, ó Hesbom e Eleale; porque o júbilo dos teus frutos de verão e da tua sega desapareceu.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο κλαύσομαι ὡς τὸν κλαυθμὸν Ιαζηρ ἄμπελον Σεβαμα τὰ δένδρα σου κατέβαλεν Εσεβων καὶ Ελεαλη ὅτι ἐπὶ τῷ θερισμῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ τρυγήτῳ σου καταπατήσω καὶ πάντα πεσοῦνται

text_en: And gladness and joy shall be taken away from Carmel , and there shall be no rejoicing nor shouting in the vineyards. He shall not tread out wine in the press that was wont to tread it out: the voice of the treaders I have taken away.
text_la: Et auferetur lætitia et exsultatio de Carmelo, et in vineis non exsultabit neque jubilabit. Vinum in torculari non calcabit qui calcare consueverat; vocem calcantium abstuli.
text_pt: E fugiu a alegria e o regozijo do campo fértil, e nas vinhas não se canta, nem há júbilo algum; já não se pisarão as uvas nos lagares. Eu fiz cessar o júbilo.
text_el: καὶ ἀρθήσεται εὐφροσύνη καὶ ἀγαλλίαμα ἐκ τῶν ἀμπελώνων σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀμπελῶσίν σου οὐ μὴ εὐφρανθήσονται καὶ οὐ μὴ πατήσουσιν οἶνον εἰς τὰ ὑπολήνια πέπαυται γάρ

text_en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like a harp for Moab , and my inward parts for the brick wall.
text_la: Super hoc venter meus ad Moab quasi cithara sonabit, et viscera mea ad murum cocti lateris.
text_pt: Por isso o meu íntimo vibra por Moabe como harpa, e o meu interior por Quir-Heres.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἡ κοιλία μου ἐπὶ Μωαβ ὡς κιθάρα ἠχήσει καὶ τὰ ἐντός μου ὡσεὶ τεῖχος ὃ ἐνεκαίνισας

text_en: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is wearied on his high places, that he shall go in to his sanctuaries to pray , and shall not prevail.
text_la: Et erit : cum apparuerit quod laboravit Moab super excelsis suis, ingredietur ad sancta sua ut obsecret, et non valebit.
text_pt: E será que, quando virem Moabe cansado nos altos, então entrará no seu santuário a orar, porém não prevalecerá.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται εἰς τὸ ἐντραπῆναί σε ὅτι ἐκοπίασεν Μωαβ ἐπὶ τοῖς βωμοῖς καὶ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὰ χειροποίητα αὐτῆς ὥστε προσεύξασθαι καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνηται ἐξελέσθαι αὐτόν

text_en: This is the word, that the Lord spoke to Moab from that time:
text_la: Hoc verbum quod locutus est Dominus ad Moab ex tunc.
text_pt: Esta é a palavra que o Senhor falou contra Moabe desde aquele tempo.
text_el: τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐπὶ Μωαβ ὁπότε καὶ ἐλάλησεν

text_en: And now the Lord has spoken, saying: In three years, as the years of a hireling, the glory of Moab shall be taken away for all the multitude of the people, and it shall be left small and feeble, not many.
text_la: Et nunc locutus est Dominus, dicens : In tribus annis, quasi anni mercenarii, auferetur gloria Moab super omni populo multo, et relinquetur parvus et modicus, nequaquam multus.
text_pt: Porém agora falou o Senhor, dizendo: Dentro de três anos (tais como os anos de jornaleiros), será envilecida a glória de Moabe, com toda a sua grande multidão; e o restante será pouco, pequeno e impotente.
text_el: καὶ νῦν λέγω ἐν τρισὶν ἔτεσιν ἐτῶν μισθωτοῦ ἀτιμασθήσεται ἡ δόξα Μωαβ ἐν παντὶ τῷ πλούτῳ τῷ πολλῷ καὶ καταλειφθήσεται ὀλιγοστὸς καὶ οὐκ ἔντιμος

text_en: The burden of Damascus . Behold Damascus shall cease to be a city, and shall be as a ruinous heap of stones.
text_la: Onus Damasci. Ecce Damascus desinet esse civitas, et erit sicut acervus lapidum in ruina.
text_pt: Peso de Damasco. Eis que Damasco será tirada, e já não será cidade, antes será um montão de ruínas.
text_el: τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ κατὰ Δαμασκοῦ ἰδοὺ Δαμασκὸς ἀρθήσεται ἀπὸ πόλεων καὶ ἔσται εἰς πτῶσιν

text_en: The cities of Aroer shall be left for flocks, and they shall rest there, and there shall be none to make them afraid .
text_la: Derelictæ civitates Aroër gregibus erunt, et requiescent ibi, et non erit qui exterreat.
text_pt: As cidades de Aroer serão abandonadas; hão de ser para os rebanhos que se deitarão sem que alguém os espante.
text_el: καταλελειμμένη εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα εἰς κοίτην ποιμνίων καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ διώκων

text_en: And aid shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus : and the remnant of Syria shall be as the glory of the children of Israel : says the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et cessabit adjutorium ab Ephraim, et regnum a Damasco; et reliquiæ Syriæ sicut gloria filiorum Israël erunt, dicit Dominus exercituum.
text_pt: E a fortaleza de Efraim cessará, como também o reino de Damasco e o restante da Síria; serão como a glória dos filhos de Israel, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσται ὀχυρὰ τοῦ καταφυγεῖν Εφραιμ καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσται βασιλεία ἐν Δαμασκῷ καὶ τὸ λοιπὸν τῶν Σύρων ἀπολεῖται οὐ γὰρ σὺ βελτίων εἶ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ τῆς δόξης αὐτῶν τάδε λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall grow lean.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : attenuabitur gloria Jacob, et pinguedo carnis ejus marcescet.
text_pt: E naquele dia será diminuída a glória de Jacó, e a gordura da sua carne ficará emagrecida.
text_el: ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔκλειψις τῆς δόξης Ιακωβ καὶ τὰ πίονα τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ σεισθήσεται

text_en: And it shall be as when one gathers in the harvest that which remains, and his arm shall gather the ears of corn: and it shall be as he that seeks ears in the vale of Raphaim.
text_la: Et erit sicut congregans in messe quod restiterit, et brachium ejus spicas leget; et erit sicut quærens spicas in valle Raphaim.
text_pt: Porque será como o segador que colhe a cana do trigo e com o seu braço sega as espigas; e será também como o que colhe espigas no vale de Refaim.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον ἐάν τις συναγάγῃ ἀμητὸν ἑστηκότα καὶ σπέρμα σταχύων ἐν τῷ βραχίονι αὐτοῦ ἀμήσῃ καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον ἐάν τις συναγάγῃ στάχυν ἐν φάραγγι στερεᾷ

text_en: And the fruit thereof that shall be left upon it, shall be as one cluster of grapes, and as the shaking of the olive tree, two or three berries in the top of a bough, or four or five upon the top of the tree, says the Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: Et relinquetur in eo sicut racemus et sicut excussio oleæ duarum vel trium olivarum in summitate rami, sive quatuor aut quinque in cacuminibus ejus fructus ejus, dicit Dominus Deus Israël.
text_pt: Porém ainda ficarão nele alguns rabiscos, como no sacudir da oliveira: duas ou três azeitonas na mais alta ponta dos ramos, e quatro ou cinco nos seus ramos mais frutíferos, diz o Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ καταλειφθῇ ἐν αὐτῇ καλάμη ἢ ὡς ῥῶγες ἐλαίας δύο ἢ τρεῖς ἐπ' ἄκρου μετεώρου ἢ τέσσαρες ἢ πέντε ἐπὶ τῶν κλάδων αὐτῶν καταλειφθῇ τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: In that day man shall bow down himself to his Maker , and his eyes shall look to the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: In die illa inclinabitur homo ad factorem suum, et oculi ejus ad Sanctum Israël respicient;
text_pt: Naquele dia atentará o homem para o seu Criador, e os seus olhos olharão para o Santo de Israel.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ πεποιθὼς ἔσται ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτόν οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐμβλέψονται

text_en: And he shall not look to the altars which his hands made; and he shall not have respect to the things that his fingers wrought, such as groves and temples .
text_la: et non inclinabitur ad altaria quæ fecerunt manus ejus; et quæ operati sunt digiti ejus non respiciet lucos et delubra.
text_pt: E não atentará para os altares, obra das suas mãos, nem olhará para o que fizeram seus dedos, nem para os bosques, nem para as imagens.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ πεποιθότες ὦσιν ἐπὶ τοῖς βωμοῖς οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν ἃ ἐποίησαν οἱ δάκτυλοι αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ὄψονται τὰ δένδρα αὐτῶν οὐδὲ τὰ βδελύγματα αὐτῶν

text_en: In that day his strong cities shall be forsaken, as the ploughs, and the corn that were left before the face of the children of Israel , and you shall be desolate.
text_la: In die illa erunt civitates fortitudinis ejus derelictæ sicut aratra, et segetes quæ derelictæ sunt a facie filiorum Israël; et eris deserta.
text_pt: Naquele dia as suas cidades fortificadas serão como lugares abandonados, no bosque ou sobre o cume das montanhas, os quais foram abandonados ante os filhos de Israel; e haverá assolação.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσονται αἱ πόλεις σου ἐγκαταλελειμμέναι ὃν τρόπον ἐγκατέλιπον οἱ Αμορραῖοι καὶ οἱ Ευαῖοι ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ἔσονται ἔρημοι

text_en: Because you have forgotten God your saviour, and have not remembered your strong helper: therefore shall you plant good plants, and shall sow strange seed.
text_la: Quia oblitus es Dei salvatoris tui, et fortis adjutoris tui non es recordata : propterea plantabis plantationem fidelem, et germen alienum seminabis;
text_pt: Porque te esqueceste do Deus da tua salvação, e não te lembraste da rocha da tua fortaleza, portanto farás plantações formosas, e assentarás nelas sarmentos estranhos.
text_el: διότι κατέλιπες τὸν θεὸν τὸν σωτῆρά σου καὶ κυρίου τοῦ βοηθοῦ σου οὐκ ἐμνήσθης διὰ τοῦτο φυτεύσεις φύτευμα ἄπιστον καὶ σπέρμα ἄπιστον

text_en: In the day of your planting shall be the wild grape, and in the morning your seed shall flourish: the harvest is taken away in the day of inheritance, and shall grieve you much.
text_la: in die plantationis tuæ labrusca, et mane semen tuum florebit; ablata est messis in die hæreditatis, et dolebit graviter.
text_pt: E no dia em que as plantares as farás crescer, e pela manhã farás que a tua semente brote; mas a colheita voará no dia da angústia e das dores insofríveis.
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἂν φυτεύσῃς πλανηθήσῃ τὸ δὲ πρωί ἐὰν σπείρῃς ἀνθήσει εἰς ἀμητὸν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ κληρώσῃ καὶ ὡς πατὴρ ἀνθρώπου κληρώσῃ τοῖς υἱοῖς σου

text_en: Woe to the multitude of many people, like the multitude of the roaring sea: and the tumult of crowds, like the noise of many waters.
text_la: Væ multitudini populorum multorum, ut multitudo maris sonantis; et tumultus turbarum, sicut sonitus aquarum multarum.
text_pt: Ai do bramido dos grandes povos que bramam como bramam os mares, e do rugido das nações que rugem como rugem as impetuosas águas.
text_el: οὐαὶ πλῆθος ἐθνῶν πολλῶν ὡς θάλασσα κυμαίνουσα οὕτως ταραχθήσεσθε καὶ νῶτος ἐθνῶν πολλῶν ὡς ὕδωρ ἠχήσει

text_en: Nations shall make a noise like the noise of waters overflowing, but he shall rebuke him, and he shall flee far off: and he shall be carried away as the dust of the mountains before the wind, and as a whirlwind before a tempest.
text_la: Sonabunt populi sicut sonitus aquarum inundantium, et increpabit eum, et fugiet procul; et rapietur sicut pulvis montium a facie venti, et sicut turbo coram tempestate.
text_pt: Rugirão as nações, como rugem as muitas águas, mas Deus as repreenderá e elas fugirão para longe; e serão afugentadas como a pragana dos montes diante do vento, e como o que rola levado pelo tufão.
text_el: ὡς ὕδωρ πολὺ ἔθνη πολλά ὡς ὕδατος πολλοῦ βίᾳ καταφερομένου καὶ ἀποσκορακιεῖ αὐτὸν καὶ πόρρω αὐτὸν διώξεται ὡς χνοῦν ἀχύρου λικμώντων ἀπέναντι ἀνέμου καὶ ὡς κονιορτὸν τροχοῦ καταιγὶς φέρουσα

text_en: In the time of the evening, behold there shall be trouble: the morning shall come, and he shall not be: this is the portion of them that have wasted us, and the lot of them that spoiled us.
text_la: In tempore vespere, et ecce turbatio; in matutino, et non subsistet. Hæc est pars eorum qui vastaverunt nos, et sors diripientium nos.
text_pt: Ao anoitecer eis que há pavor, mas antes que amanheça já não existe; esta é a parte daqueles que nos despojam, e a sorte daqueles que nos saqueiam.
text_el: πρὸς ἑσπέραν ἔσται πένθος πρὶν ἢ πρωὶ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται αὕτη ἡ μερὶς τῶν ὑμᾶς προνομευσάντων καὶ κληρονομία τοῖς ὑμᾶς κληρονομήσασιν

text_en: Woe to the land, the winged cymbal, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia ,
text_la: Væ terræ cymbalo alarum, quæ est trans flumina Æthiopiæ,
text_pt: Ai da terra que ensombreia com as suas asas, que está além dos rios da Etiópia.
text_el: οὐαὶ γῆς πλοίων πτέρυγες ἐπέκεινα ποταμῶν Αἰθιοπίας

text_en: that sends ambassadors by the sea, and in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters. Go, you swift angels , to a nation rent and torn in pieces: to a terrible people, after which there is no other: to a nation expecting and trodden underfoot, whose land the rivers have spoiled.
text_la: qui mittit in mare legatos, et in vasis papyri super aquas. Ite, angeli veloces, ad gentem convulsam et dilaceratam; ad populum terribilem, post quem non est alius; ad gentem exspectantem et conculcatam, cujus diripuerunt flumina terram ejus.
text_pt: Que envia embaixadores por mar em navios de junco sobre as águas, dizendo: Ide, mensageiros velozes, a um povo de elevada estatura e de pele lisa; a um povo terrível desde o seu princípio; a uma nação forte e esmagadora, cuja terra os rios dividem.
text_el: ὁ ἀποστέλλων ἐν θαλάσσῃ ὅμηρα καὶ ἐπιστολὰς βυβλίνας ἐπάνω τοῦ ὕδατος πορεύσονται γὰρ ἄγγελοι κοῦφοι πρὸς ἔθνος μετέωρον καὶ ξένον λαὸν καὶ χαλεπόν τίς αὐτοῦ ἐπέκεινα ἔθνος ἀνέλπιστον καὶ καταπεπατημένον νῦν οἱ ποταμοὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: All you inhabitants of the world, who dwell on the earth, when the sign shall be lifted up on the mountains, you shall see, and you shall hear the sound of the trumpet.
text_la: Omnes habitatores orbis, qui moramini in terra, cum elevatum fuerit signum in montibus, videbitis, et clangorem tubæ audietis.
text_pt: Vós, todos os habitantes do mundo, e vós os moradores da terra, quando se arvorar a bandeira nos montes, o vereis; e quando se tocar a trombeta, o ouvireis.
text_el: πάντες ὡς χώρα κατοικουμένη κατοικηθήσεται ἡ χώρα αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ σημεῖον ἀπὸ ὄρους ἀρθῇ ὡς σάλπιγγος φωνὴ ἀκουστὸν ἔσται

text_en: For thus says the Lord to me: I will take my rest, and consider in my place, as the noon light is clear, and as a cloud of dew in the day of harvest.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus ad me : Quiescam et considerabo in loco meo, sicut meridiana lux clara est, et sicut nubes roris in die messis.
text_pt: Porque assim me disse o Senhor: Estarei quieto, olhando desde a minha morada, como o ardor do sol resplandecente depois da chuva, como a nuvem do orvalho no calor da sega.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπέν μοι κύριος ἀσφάλεια ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἐμῇ πόλει ὡς φῶς καύματος μεσημβρίας καὶ ὡς νεφέλη δρόσου ἡμέρας ἀμήτου ἔσται

text_en: For before the harvest it was all flourishing, and it shall bud without perfect ripeness, and the sprigs thereof shall be cut off with pruning hooks: and what is left shall be cut away and shaken out.
text_la: Ante messem enim totus effloruit, et immatura perfectio germinabit; et præcidentur ramusculi ejus falcibus, et quæ derelicta fuerint abscindentur et excutientur.
text_pt: Porque antes da sega, quando já o fruto está perfeito e, passada a flor, as uvas verdes amadurecerem, então, com foice podará os sarmentos e tirará os ramos e os lançará fora.
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ θερισμοῦ ὅταν συντελεσθῇ ἄνθος καὶ ὄμφαξ ἀνθήσῃ ἄνθος ὀμφακίζουσα καὶ ἀφελεῖ τὰ βοτρύδια τὰ μικρὰ τοῖς δρεπάνοις καὶ τὰς κληματίδας ἀφελεῖ καὶ κατακόψει

text_en: And they shall be left together to the birds of the mountains, and the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall be upon them all the summer, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
text_la: Et relinquentur simul avibus montium et bestiis terræ; et æstate perpetua erunt super eum volucres, et omnes bestiæ terræ super illum hiemabunt.
text_pt: Serão deixados juntos às aves dos montes e aos animais da terra; e sobre eles veranearão as aves de rapina, e todos os animais da terra invernarão sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ καταλείψει ἅμα τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ συναχθήσεται ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ θηρία τῆς γῆς ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἥξει

text_en: At that time shall a present be brought to the Lord of hosts , from a people rent and torn in pieces: from a terrible people, after which there has been no other: from a nation expecting, expecting and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the Lord of hosts , to mount Sion.
text_la: In tempore illo deferetur munus Domino exercituum a populo divulso et dilacerato, a populo terribili, post quem non fuit alius; a gente exspectante, exspectante et conculcata, cujus diripuerunt flumina terram ejus; ad locum nominis Domini exercituum, montem Sion.
text_pt: Naquele tempo trará um presente ao Senhor dos Exércitos um povo de elevada estatura e de pele lisa, e um povo terrível desde o seu princípio; uma nação forte e esmagadora, cuja terra os rios dividem; ao lugar do nome do Senhor dos Exércitos, ao monte Sião.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀνενεχθήσεται δῶρα κυρίῳ σαβαωθ ἐκ λαοῦ τεθλιμμένου καὶ τετιλμένου καὶ ἀπὸ λαοῦ μεγάλου ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον ἔθνος ἐλπίζον καὶ καταπεπατημένον ὅ ἐστιν ἐν μέρει ποταμοῦ τῆς χώρας αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν τόπον οὗ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου σαβαωθ ἐπεκλήθη ὄρος Σιων

text_en: The burden of Egypt . Behold the Lord will ascend upon a swift cloud, and will enter into Egypt , and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst thereof.
text_la: Onus Ægypti. Ecce Dominus ascendet super nubem levem, et ingredietur Ægyptum, et commovebuntur simulacra Ægypti a facie ejus, et cor Ægypti tabescet in medio ejus,
text_pt: Peso do Egito. Eis que o SENHOR vem cavalgando numa nuvem ligeira, e entrará no Egito; e os ídolos do Egito estremecerão diante dele, e o coração dos egípcios se derreterá no meio deles.
text_el: ὅρασις Αἰγύπτου ἰδοὺ κύριος κάθηται ἐπὶ νεφέλης κούφης καὶ ἥξει εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ σεισθήσεται τὰ χειροποίητα Αἰγύπτου ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ἡττηθήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And I will set the Egyptians to fight against the Egyptians : and they shall fight brother against brother, and friend against friend, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.
text_la: et concurrere faciam Ægyptios adversus Ægyptios; et pugnabit vir contra fratrem suum, et vir contra amicum suum, civitas adversus civitatem, regnum adversus regnum.
text_pt: Porque farei com que os egípcios, se levantem contra os egípcios, e cada um pelejará contra o seu irmão, e cada um contra o seu próximo, cidade contra cidade, reino contra reino.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεγερθήσονται Αἰγύπτιοι ἐπ' Αἰγυπτίους καὶ πολεμήσει ἄνθρωπος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἄνθρωπος τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ πόλις ἐπὶ πόλιν καὶ νομὸς ἐπὶ νομόν

text_en: And the spirit of Egypt shall be broken in the bowels thereof, and I will cast down their counsel: and they shall consult their idols , and their diviners , and their wizards , and soothsayers .
text_la: Et dirumpetur spiritus Ægypti in visceribus ejus, et consilium ejus præcipitabo; et interrogabunt simulacra sua, et divinos suos, et pythones, et ariolos.
text_pt: E o espírito do Egito se esvaecerá no seu interior, e destruirei o seu conselho; e eles consultarão aos seus ídolos, e encantadores, e aqueles que têm espíritos familiares e feiticeiros.
text_el: καὶ ταραχθήσεται τὸ πνεῦμα τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὴν βουλὴν αὐτῶν διασκεδάσω καὶ ἐπερωτήσουσιν τοὺς θεοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἀγάλματα αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς ἐκ τῆς γῆς φωνοῦντας καὶ τοὺς ἐγγαστριμύθους

text_en: And I will deliver Egypt into the hand of cruel masters, and a strong king shall rule over them, says the Lord the God of hosts .
text_la: Et tradam Ægyptum in manu dominorum crudelium, et rex fortis dominabitur eorum, ait Dominus Deus exercituum.
text_pt: E entregarei os egípcios nas mãos de um senhor cruel, e um rei rigoroso os dominará, diz o Senhor, o SENHOR dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσω Αἴγυπτον εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων κυρίων σκληρῶν καὶ βασιλεῖς σκληροὶ κυριεύσουσιν αὐτῶν τάδε λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ

text_en: And the water of the sea shall be dried up, and the river shall be wasted and dry.
text_la: Et arescet aqua de mari, et fluvius desolabitur atque siccabitur.
text_pt: E secarão as águas do mar, e o rio se esgotará e ressequirá.
text_el: καὶ πίονται οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ὕδωρ τὸ παρὰ θάλασσαν ὁ δὲ ποταμὸς ἐκλείψει καὶ ξηρανθήσεται

text_en: And the rivers shall fail: the streams of the banks shall be diminished, and be dried up. The reed and the bulrush shall wither away.
text_la: Et deficient flumina, attenuabuntur et siccabuntur rivi aggerum, calamus et juncus marcescet.
text_pt: Também os rios exalarão mau cheiro e se esgotarão e secarão os canais do Egito; as canas e os juncos murcharão.
text_el: καὶ ἐκλείψουσιν οἱ ποταμοὶ καὶ αἱ διώρυγες τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ ξηρανθήσεται πᾶσα συναγωγὴ ὕδατος καὶ ἐν παντὶ ἕλει καλάμου καὶ παπύρου

text_en: The channel of the river shall be laid bare from its fountain, and everything sown by the water shall be dried up, it shall wither away, and shall be no more.
text_la: Nudabitur alveus rivi a fonte suo, et omnis sementis irrigua siccabitur, arescet, et non erit.
text_pt: A relva junto ao rio, junto às ribanceiras dos rios, e tudo o que foi semeado junto ao rio, secará, será arrancado e não subsistirá.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἄχι τὸ χλωρὸν πᾶν τὸ κύκλῳ τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ πᾶν τὸ σπειρόμενον διὰ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ξηρανθήσεται ἀνεμόφθορον

text_en: The fishers also shall mourn, and all that cast a hook into the river shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish away.
text_la: Et mœrebunt piscatores, et lugebunt omnes mittentes in flumen hamum; et expandentes rete super faciem aquarum emarcescent.
text_pt: E os pescadores gemerão, e suspirarão todos os que lançam anzol ao rio, e os que estendem rede sobre as águas desfalecerão.
text_el: καὶ στενάξουσιν οἱ ἁλεεῖς καὶ στενάξουσιν πάντες οἱ βάλλοντες ἄγκιστρον εἰς τὸν ποταμόν καὶ οἱ βάλλοντες σαγήνας καὶ οἱ ἀμφιβολεῖς πενθήσουσιν

text_en: They shall be confounded that wrought in flax, combing and weaving fine linen.
text_la: Confundentur qui operabantur linum, pectentes et texentes subtilia.
text_pt: E envergonhar-se-ão os que trabalham em linho fino, e os que tecem pano branco.
text_el: καὶ αἰσχύνη λήμψεται τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὸ λίνον τὸ σχιστὸν καὶ τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν βύσσον

text_en: And its watery places shall be dry, all they shall mourn that made pools to take fishes.
text_la: Et erunt irrigua ejus flaccentia : omnes qui faciebant lacunas ad capiendos pisces.
text_pt: E os seus fundamentos serão despedaçados, e todos os que trabalham por salário ficarão com tristeza de alma.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ διαζόμενοι αὐτὰ ἐν ὀδύνῃ καὶ πάντες οἱ τὸν ζῦθον ποιοῦντες λυπηθήσονται καὶ τὰς ψυχὰς πονέσουσιν

text_en: The princes of Tanis have become fools, the wise counsellors of Pharao have given foolish counsel: how will you say to Pharao : I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
text_la: Stulti principes Taneos, sapientes consiliarii Pharaonis dederunt consilium insipiens. Quomodo dicetis Pharaoni : Filius sapientium ego, filius regum antiquorum?
text_pt: Na verdade são loucos os príncipes de Zoã; o conselho dos sábios conselheiros de Faraó se embruteceu; como, pois, a Faraó direis: Sou filho de sábios, filho de antigos reis?
text_el: καὶ μωροὶ ἔσονται οἱ ἄρχοντες Τάνεως οἱ σοφοὶ σύμβουλοι τοῦ βασιλέως ἡ βουλὴ αὐτῶν μωρανθήσεται πῶς ἐρεῖτε τῷ βασιλεῖ υἱοὶ συνετῶν ἡμεῖς υἱοὶ βασιλέων τῶν ἐξ ἀρχῆς

text_en: Where are now your wise men ? Let them tell you, and show what the Lord of hosts has purposed upon Egypt .
text_la: Ubi nunc sunt sapientes tui? annuntient tibi, et indicent quid cogitaverit Dominus exercituum super Ægyptum.
text_pt: Onde estão agora os teus sábios? Notifiquem-te agora, ou informem-te sobre o que o Senhor dos Exércitos determinou contra o Egito.
text_el: ποῦ εἰσιν νῦν οἱ σοφοί σου καὶ ἀναγγειλάτωσάν σοι καὶ εἰπάτωσαν τί βεβούλευται κύριος σαβαωθ ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον

text_en: The princes of Tanis have become fools, the princes of Memphis have gone astray, they have deceived Egypt , the stay of the people thereof.
text_la: Stulti facti sunt principes Taneos, emarcuerunt principes Mempheos; deceperunt Ægyptum, angulum populorum ejus.
text_pt: Loucos tornaram-se os príncipes de Zoã, enganados estão os príncipes de Nofe; eles fizeram errar o Egito, aqueles que são a pedra de esquina das suas tribos.
text_el: ἐξέλιπον οἱ ἄρχοντες Τάνεως καὶ ὑψώθησαν οἱ ἄρχοντες Μέμφεως καὶ πλανήσουσιν Αἴγυπτον κατὰ φυλάς

text_en: The Lord has mingled in the midst thereof the spirit of giddiness: and they have caused Egypt to err in all its works , as a drunken man staggers and vomits.
text_la: Dominus miscuit in medio ejus spiritum vertiginis; et errare fecerunt Ægyptum in omni opere suo, sicut errat ebrius et vomens.
text_pt: O Senhor derramou no meio dele um perverso espírito; e eles fizeram errar o Egito em toda a sua obra, como o bêbado quando se revolve no seu vômito.
text_el: κύριος γὰρ ἐκέρασεν αὐτοῖς πνεῦμα πλανήσεως καὶ ἐπλάνησαν Αἴγυπτον ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτῶν ὡς πλανᾶται ὁ μεθύων καὶ ὁ ἐμῶν ἅμα

text_en: And there shall be no work for Egypt , to make head or tail, him that bends down, or that holds back.
text_la: Et non erit Ægypto opus quod faciat caput et caudam, incurvantem et refrenantem.
text_pt: E não aproveitará ao Egito obra alguma que possa fazer a cabeça, a cauda, o ramo, ou o junco.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔσται τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις ἔργον ὃ ποιήσει κεφαλὴν καὶ οὐράν ἀρχὴν καὶ τέλος

text_en: In that day Egypt shall be like unto women , and they shall be amazed, and afraid , because of the moving of the hand of the Lord of hosts , which he shall move over it.
text_la: In die illa erit Ægyptus quasi mulieres; et stupebunt, et timebunt a facie commotionis manus Domini exercituum, quam ipse movebit super eam.
text_pt: Naquele tempo os egípcios serão como mulheres, e tremerão e temerão por causa do movimento da mão do Senhor dos Exércitos, que há de levantar-se contra eles.
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσονται οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ὡς γυναῖκες ἐν φόβῳ καὶ ἐν τρόμῳ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς χειρὸς κυρίου σαβαωθ ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπιβαλεῖ αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the land of Juda shall be a terror to Egypt : everyone that shall remember it shall tremble because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts , which he has determined concerning it.
text_la: Et erit terra Juda Ægypto in pavorem; omnis qui illius fuerit recordatus pavebit a facie consilii Domini exercituum, quod ipse cogitavit super eam.
text_pt: E a terra de Judá será um espanto para o Egito; todo aquele a quem isso se anunciar se assombrará, por causa do propósito do Senhor dos Exércitos, que determinou contra eles.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ χώρα τῶν Ιουδαίων τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις εἰς φόβητρον πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν ὀνομάσῃ αὐτὴν αὐτοῖς φοβηθήσονται διὰ τὴν βουλήν ἣν βεβούλευται κύριος ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: In that day there shall be five cities in the land of Egypt , speaking the language of Chanaan , and swearing by the Lord of hosts : one shall be called the city of the sun.
text_la: In die illa erunt quinque civitates in terra Ægypti loquentes lingua Chanaan, et jurantes per Dominum exercituum : Civitas solis vocabitur una.
text_pt: Naquele tempo haverá cinco cidades na terra do Egito que falarão a língua de Canaã e farão juramento ao Senhor dos Exércitos; e uma se chamará: Cidade de destruição.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσονται πέντε πόλεις ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ λαλοῦσαι τῇ γλώσσῃ τῇ Χανανίτιδι καὶ ὀμνύουσαι τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου πόλισ-ασεδεκ κληθήσεται ἡ μία πόλις

text_en: In that day there shall be an altar of the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt , and a monument of the Lord at the borders thereof:
text_la: In die illa erit altare Domini in medio terræ Ægypti, et titulus Domini juxta terminum ejus.
text_pt: Naquele tempo o Senhor terá um altar no meio da terra do Egito, e uma coluna se erigirá ao Senhor, junto da sua fronteira.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται θυσιαστήριον τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν χώρᾳ Αἰγυπτίων καὶ στήλη πρὸς τὸ ὅριον αὐτῆς τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: It shall be for a sign, and for a testimony to the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt . For they shall cry to the Lord because of the oppressor, and he shall send them a Saviour and a defender to deliver them.
text_la: Erit in signum et in testimonium Domino exercituum in terra Ægypti; clamabunt enim ad Dominum a facie tribulationis, et mittet eis salvatorem et propugnatorem qui liberet eos.
text_pt: E servirá de sinal e de testemunho ao Senhor dos Exércitos na terra do Egito, porque ao Senhor clamarão por causa dos opressores, e ele lhes enviará um salvador e um protetor, que os livrará.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται εἰς σημεῖον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κυρίῳ ἐν χώρᾳ Αἰγύπτου ὅτι κεκράξονται πρὸς κύριον διὰ τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτούς καὶ ἀποστελεῖ αὐτοῖς κύριος ἄνθρωπον ὃς σώσει αὐτούς κρίνων σώσει αὐτούς

text_en: And the Lord shall be known by Egypt , and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day, and shall worship him with sacrifices and offerings : and they shall make vows to the Lord , and perform them.
text_la: Et cognoscetur Dominus ab Ægypto, et cognoscent Ægyptii Dominum in die illa; et colent eum in hostiis et in muneribus; et vota vovebunt Domino, et solvent.
text_pt: E o Senhor se dará a conhecer ao Egito, e os egípcios conhecerão ao Senhor naquele dia, e o adorarão com sacrifícios e ofertas, e farão votos ao Senhor, e os cumprirão.
text_el: καὶ γνωστὸς ἔσται κύριος τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις καὶ γνώσονται οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι τὸν κύριον ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ποιήσουσιν θυσίας καὶ εὔξονται εὐχὰς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἀποδώσουσιν

text_en: And the Lord shall strike Egypt with a scourge, and shall heal it, and they shall return to the Lord , and he shall be pacified towards them, and heal them.
text_la: Et percutiet Dominus Ægyptum plaga, et sanabit eam; et revertentur ad Dominum, et placabitur eis, et sanabit eos.
text_pt: E ferirá o Senhor ao Egito, ferirá e o curará; e converter-se-ão ao Senhor, e mover-se-á às suas orações, e os curará;
text_el: καὶ πατάξει κύριος τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους πληγῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἰάσεται αὐτοὺς ἰάσει καὶ ἐπιστραφήσονται πρὸς κύριον καὶ εἰσακούσεται αὐτῶν καὶ ἰάσεται αὐτούς

text_en: In that day there shall be a way from Egypt to the Assyrians , and the Assyrian shall enter into Egypt , and the Egyptian to the Assyrians , and the Egyptians shall serve the Assyrian .
text_la: In die illa erit via de Ægypto in Assyrios; et intrabit Assyrius Ægyptum, et Ægyptius in Assyrios, et servient Ægyptii Assur.
text_pt: Naquele dia haverá estrada do Egito até à Assíria, e os assírios virão ao Egito, e os egípcios irão à Assíria; e os egípcios servirão com os assírios.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται ὁδὸς Αἰγύπτου πρὸς Ἀσσυρίους καὶ εἰσελεύσονται Ἀσσύριοι εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ Αἰγύπτιοι πορεύσονται πρὸς Ἀσσυρίους καὶ δουλεύσουσιν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι τοῖς Ἀσσυρίοις

text_en: In that day shall Israel be the third to the Egyptian and the Assyrian : a blessing in the midst of the land,
text_la: In die illa erit Israël tertius Ægyptio et Assyrio; benedictio in medio terræ
text_pt: Naquele dia Israel será o terceiro com os egípcios e os assírios, uma bênção no meio da terra.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται Ισραηλ τρίτος ἐν τοῖς Ἀσσυρίοις καὶ ἐν τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις εὐλογημένος ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: which the Lord of hosts has blessed , saying: Blessed be my people of Egypt , and the work of my hands to the Assyrian : but Israel is my inheritance.
text_la: cui benedixit Dominus exercituum, dicens : Benedictus populus meus Ægypti, et opus manuum mearum Assyrio; hæreditas autem mea Israël.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor dos Exércitos os abençoará, dizendo: Bendito seja o Egito, meu povo, e a Assíria, obra de minhas mãos, e Israel, minha herança.
text_el: ἣν εὐλόγησεν κύριος σαβαωθ λέγων εὐλογημένος ὁ λαός μου ὁ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ὁ ἐν Ἀσσυρίοις καὶ ἡ κληρονομία μου Ισραηλ

text_en: In the year that Tharthan entered into Azotus , when Sargon the king of the Assyrians had sent him, and he had fought against Azotus , and had taken it:
text_la: In anno quo ingressus est Thathan in Azotum, cum misisset eum Sargon, rex Assyriorum, et pugnasset contra Azotum, et cepisset eam:
text_pt: No ano em que Tartã, enviado por Sargom, rei da Assíria, veio a Asdode, e guerreou contra ela, e a tomou,
text_el: τοῦ ἔτους οὗ εἰσῆλθεν Ταναθαν εἰς Ἄζωτον ἡνίκα ἀπεστάλη ὑπὸ Αρνα βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων καὶ ἐπολέμησεν τὴν Ἄζωτον καὶ κατελάβετο αὐτήν

text_en: At that same time the Lord spoke by the hand of Isaiah the son of Amos , saying Go, and loose the sackcloth from off your loins, and take off your shoes from your feet. And he did so, and went naked, and barefoot.
text_la: in tempore illo locutus est Dominus in manu Isaiæ, filii Amos, dicens : Vade, et solve saccum de lumbis tuis, et calceamenta tua tolle de pedibus tuis. Et fecit sic, vadens nudus et discalceatus.
text_pt: Nesse mesmo tempo falou o Senhor por intermédio de Isaías, filho de Amós, dizendo: Vai, solta o cilício de teus lombos, e descalça os sapatos dos teus pés. E ele assim o fez, indo nu e descalço.
text_el: τότε ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Ησαιαν λέγων πορεύου καὶ ἄφελε τὸν σάκκον ἀπὸ τῆς ὀσφύος σου καὶ τὰ σανδάλιά σου ὑπόλυσαι ἀπὸ τῶν ποδῶν σου καὶ ἐποίησεν οὕτως πορευόμενος γυμνὸς καὶ ἀνυπόδετος

text_en: And the Lord said: As my servant Isaiah has walked, naked and barefoot, it shall be a sign and a wonder of three years upon Egypt , and upon Ethiopia ,
text_la: Et dixit Dominus : Sicut ambulavit servus meus Isaias nudus et discalceatus, trium annorum signum et portentum erit super Ægyptum et super Æthiopiam;
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor: Assim como o meu servo Isaías andou três anos nu e descalço, por sinal e prodígio sobre o Egito e sobre a Etiópia,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὃν τρόπον πεπόρευται Ησαιας ὁ παῖς μου γυμνὸς καὶ ἀνυπόδετος τρία ἔτη ἔσται σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις καὶ Αἰθίοψιν

text_en: so shall the king of the Assyrians lead away the prisoners of Egypt , and the captivity of Ethiopia , young and old, naked and barefoot, with their buttocks uncovered to the shame of Egypt .
text_la: sic minabit rex Assyriorum captivitatem Ægypti, et transmigrationem Æthiopiæ, juvenum et senum, nudam et discalceatam, discoopertis natibus, ad ignominiam Ægypti.
text_pt: Assim o rei da Assíria levará em cativeiro os presos do Egito, e os exilados da Etiópia, tanto moços como velhos, nus e descalços, e com as nádegas descobertas, para vergonha do Egito.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως ἄξει βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Αἰγύπτου καὶ Αἰθιόπων νεανίσκους καὶ πρεσβύτας γυμνοὺς καὶ ἀνυποδέτους ἀνακεκαλυμμένους τὴν αἰσχύνην Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And they shall be afraid , and ashamed of Ethiopia their hope , and of Egypt their glory .
text_la: Et timebunt, et confundentur ab Æthiopia spe sua, et ab Ægypto gloria sua.
text_pt: E assombrar-se-ão, e envergonhar-se-ão, por causa dos etíopes, sua esperança, como também dos egípcios, sua glória.
text_el: καὶ αἰσχυνθήσονται ἡττηθέντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ἐπὶ τοῖς Αἰθίοψιν ἐφ' οἷς ἦσαν πεποιθότες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτοῖς δόξα

text_en: And the inhabitants of this isle shall say in that day: Lo this was our hope , to whom we fled for help, to deliver us from the face of the king of the Assyrians : and how shall we be able to escape?
text_la: Et dicet habitator insulæ hujus in die illa : Ecce hæc erat spes nostra, ad quos confugimus in auxilium, ut liberarent nos a facie regis Assyriorum : et quomodo effugere poterimus nos?
text_pt: Então os moradores desta ilha dirão naquele dia: Vede que tal é a nossa esperança, à qual fugimos por socorro, para nos livrarmos da face do rei da Assíria! Como pois escaparemos nós?
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν τῇ νήσῳ ταύτῃ ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἦμεν πεποιθότες τοῦ φυγεῖν εἰς αὐτοὺς εἰς βοήθειαν οἳ οὐκ ἐδύναντο σωθῆναι ἀπὸ βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων καὶ πῶς ἡμεῖς σωθησόμεθα

text_en: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds come from the south, it comes from the desert from a terrible land.
text_la: Onus deserti maris. Sicut turbines ab africo veniunt, de deserto venit, de terra horribili.
text_pt: Peso do deserto do mar. Como os tufões de vento do sul, que tudo assolam, ele virá do deserto, de uma terra horrível.
text_el: τὸ ὅραμα τῆς ἐρήμου ὡς καταιγὶς δι' ἐρήμου διέλθοι ἐξ ἐρήμου ἐρχομένη ἐκ γῆς φοβερὸν

text_en: A grievous vision is told me: he that is unfaithful deals unfaithfully: and he that is a spoiler, spoils. Go up, O Elam, besiege, O Mede : I have made all the mourning thereof to cease.
text_la: Visio dura nuntiata est mihi : qui incredulus est infideliter agit; et qui depopulator est vastat. Ascende, Ælam; obside, Mede; omnem gemitum ejus cessare feci.
text_pt: Dura visão me foi anunciada: o pérfido trata perfidamente, e o destruidor anda destruindo. Sobe, ó Elão, sitia, ó Média, que já fiz cessar todo o seu gemido.
text_el: τὸ ὅραμα καὶ σκληρὸν ἀνηγγέλη μοι ὁ ἀθετῶν ἀθετεῖ ὁ ἀνομῶν ἀνομεῖ ἐπ' ἐμοὶ οἱ Αιλαμῖται καὶ οἱ πρέσβεις τῶν Περσῶν ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἔρχονται νῦν στενάξω καὶ παρακαλέσω ἐμαυτόν

text_en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain, anguish has taken hold of me, as the anguish of a woman in labour: I fell down at the hearing of it, I was troubled at the seeing of it.
text_la: Propterea repleti sunt lumbi mei dolore; angustia possedit me sicut angustia parturientis; corrui cum audirem, conturbatus sum cum viderem.
text_pt: Por isso os meus lombos estão cheios de angústia; dores se apoderam de mim como as dores daquela que dá à luz; fiquei abatido quando ouvi, e desanimado vendo isso.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐνεπλήσθη ἡ ὀσφύς μου ἐκλύσεως καὶ ὠδῖνες ἔλαβόν με ὡς τὴν τίκτουσαν ἠδίκησα τὸ μὴ ἀκοῦσαι ἐσπούδασα τὸ μὴ βλέπειν

text_en: My heart failed, darkness amazed me: Babylon my beloved has become a wonder to me.
text_la: Emarcuit cor meum; tenebræ stupefecerunt me : Babylon dilecta mea posita est mihi in miraculum.
text_pt: O meu coração se agita, o horror apavora-me; a noite que desejava, se me tornou em temor.
text_el: ἡ καρδία μου πλανᾶται καὶ ἡ ἀνομία με βαπτίζει ἡ ψυχή μου ἐφέστηκεν εἰς φόβον

text_en: Prepare the table, behold in the watchtower them that eat and drink: arise, you princes, take up the shield.
text_la: Pone mensam, contemplare in specula comedentes et bibentes : surgite, principes, arripite clypeum.
text_pt: Põem-se a mesa, estão de atalaia, comem, bebem; levantai-vos, príncipes, e untai o escudo.
text_el: ἑτοίμασον τὴν τράπεζαν πίετε φάγετε ἀναστάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες ἑτοιμάσατε θυρεούς

text_en: For thus has the Lord said to me: Go, and set a watchman: and whatsoever he shall see, let him tell.
text_la: Hæc enim dixit mihi Dominus : Vade, et pone speculatorem, et quodcumque viderit annuntiet.
text_pt: Porque assim me disse o Senhor: Vai, põe uma sentinela, e ela que diga o que vir.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος πρός με βαδίσας σεαυτῷ στῆσον σκοπὸν καὶ ὃ ἂν ἴδῃς ἀνάγγειλον

text_en: And he saw a chariot with two horsemen, a rider upon an ass, and a rider upon a camel: and he beheld them diligently with much heed.
text_la: Et vidit currum duorum equitum, ascensorem asini, et ascensorem cameli; et contemplatus est diligenter multo intuitu.
text_pt: E quando vir um carro com um par de cavaleiros, um carro com jumentos, e um carro com camelos, ela que observe atentamente com grande cuidado.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ἀναβάτας ἱππεῖς δύο ἀναβάτην ὄνου καὶ ἀναβάτην καμήλου ἀκρόασαι ἀκρόασιν πολλὴν

text_en: And a lion cried out: I am upon the watchtower of the Lord , standing continually by day: and I am upon my ward, standing whole nights.
text_la: Et clamavit leo : Super speculam Domini ego sum, stans jugiter per diem; et super custodiam meam ego sum, stans totis noctibus.
text_pt: E clamou: Um leão, meu Senhor! Sobre a torre de vigia estou em pé continuamente de dia, e de guarda me ponho noites inteiras.
text_el: καὶ κάλεσον Ουριαν εἰς τὴν σκοπιὰν κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν ἔστην διὰ παντὸς ἡμέρας καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἔστην ὅλην τὴν νύκτα

text_en: Behold this man comes, the rider upon the chariot with two horsemen, and he answered, and said: Babylon is fallen, she is fallen, and all the graven gods thereof are broken unto the ground.
text_la: Ecce iste venit ascensor vir bigæ equitum; et respondit, et dixit : Cecidit, cecidit Babylon, et omnia sculptilia deorum ejus contrita sunt in terram.
text_pt: E eis agora vem um carro com homens, e um par de cavaleiros. Então respondeu e disse: Caída é babilônia, caída é! E todas as imagens de escultura dos seus deuses quebraram-se no chão.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἔρχεται ἀναβάτης συνωρίδος καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν πέπτωκεν Βαβυλών καὶ πάντα τὰ ἀγάλματα αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ χειροποίητα αὐτῆς συνετρίβησαν εἰς τὴν γῆν

text_en: O my thrashing, and the children of my floor, that which I have heard of the Lord of hosts , the God of Israel , I have declared unto you.
text_la: Tritura mea et filii areæ meæ, quæ audivi a Domino exercituum, Deo Israël, annuntiavi vobis.
text_pt: Ah, malhada minha, e trigo da minha eira! O que ouvi do Senhor dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, isso vos anunciei.
text_el: ἀκούσατε οἱ καταλελειμμένοι καὶ οἱ ὀδυνώμενοι ἀκούσατε ἃ ἤκουσα παρὰ κυρίου σαβαωθ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ισραηλ ἀνήγγειλεν ἡμῖν

text_en: The burden of Duma . Calls to me out of Seir: Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
text_la: Onus Duma. Ad me clamat ex Seir : Custos, quid de nocte? custos, quid de nocte?
text_pt: Peso de Dumá. Gritam-me de Seir: Guarda, que houve de noite? Guarda, que houve de noite?
text_el: τὸ ὅραμα τῆς Ιδουμαίας πρὸς ἐμὲ καλεῖ παρὰ τοῦ Σηιρ φυλάσσετε ἐπάλξεις

text_en: The watchman said: The morning comes, also the night: if you seek, seek: return, come.
text_la: Dixit custos : Venit mane et nox; si quæritis, quærite; convertimini, venite.
text_pt: E disse o guarda: Vem a manhã, e também a noite; se quereis perguntar, perguntai; voltai, vinde.
text_el: φυλάσσω τὸ πρωὶ καὶ τὴν νύκτα ἐὰν ζητῇς ζήτει καὶ παρ' ἐμοὶ οἴκει

text_en: The burden in Arabia . In the forest at evening you shall sleep, in the paths of Dedanim.
text_la: Onus in Arabia. In saltu ad vesperam dormietis, in semitis Dedanim.
text_pt: Peso contra Arábia. Nos bosques da Arábia passareis a noite, ó viandantes de Dedanim.
text_el: ἐν τῷ δρυμῷ ἑσπέρας κοιμηθήσῃ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ Δαιδαν

text_en: Meeting the thirsty bring him water, you that inhabit the land of the south, meet with bread him that flees.
text_la: Occurrentes sitienti ferte aquam, qui habitatis terram austri; cum panibus occurrite fugienti.
text_pt: Saí com água ao encontro dos sedentos; moradores da terra de Tema, saí com pão ao encontro dos fugitivos.
text_el: εἰς συνάντησιν διψῶντι ὕδωρ φέρετε οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν χώρᾳ Θαιμαν ἄρτοις συναντᾶτε τοῖς φεύγουσιν

text_en: For they are fled from before the swords, from the sword that hung over them, from the bent bow, from the face of a grievous battle.
text_la: A facie enim gladiorum fugerunt, a facie gladii imminentis, a facie arcus extenti, a facie gravis prælii.
text_pt: Porque fogem de diante das espadas, de diante da espada desembainhada, e de diante do arco armado, e de diante do peso da guerra.
text_el: διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν φευγόντων καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πλανωμένων καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς μαχαίρας καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν τοξευμάτων τῶν διατεταμένων καὶ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πεπτωκότων ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ

text_en: For thus says the Lord to me: Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Cedar shall be taken away.
text_la: Quoniam hæc dicit Dominus ad me : Adhuc in uno anno, quasi in anno mercenarii, et auferetur omnis gloria Cedar.
text_pt: Porque assim me disse o Senhor: Dentro de um ano, como os anos de jornaleiro, desaparecerá toda a glória de Quedar.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως εἶπέν μοι κύριος ἔτι ἐνιαυτὸς ὡς ἐνιαυτὸς μισθωτοῦ ἐκλείψει ἡ δόξα τῶν υἱῶν Κηδαρ

text_en: And the residue of the number of strong archers of the children of Cedar shall be diminished: for the Lord the God of Israel has spoken it.
text_la: Et reliquiæ numeri sagittariorum fortium de filiis Cedar imminuentur; Dominus enim Deus Israël locutus est.
text_pt: E os restantes do número dos flecheiros, os poderosos dos filhos de Quedar, serão diminuídos, porque assim disse o Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον τῶν τοξευμάτων τῶν ἰσχυρῶν υἱῶν Κηδαρ ἔσται ὀλίγον διότι κύριος ἐλάλησεν ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you also, that you too are wholly gone up to the housetops?
text_la: Onus vallis Visionis. Quidnam quoque tibi est, quia ascendisti et tu omnis in tecta?
text_pt: Peso do vale da visão. Que tens agora, pois que com todos os teus subiste aos telhados?
text_el: τὸ ῥῆμα τῆς φάραγγος Σιων τί ἐγένετό σοι νῦν ὅτι ἀνέβητε πάντες εἰς δώματα

text_en: Full of clamour, a populous city, a joyous city: your slain are not slain by the sword, nor dead in battle.
text_la: Clamoris plena, urbs frequens, civitas exsultans; interfecti tui, non interfecti gladio, nec mortui in bello.
text_pt: Tu, cheia de clamores, cidade turbulenta, cidade alegre, os teus mortos não foram mortos à espada, nem morreram na guerra.
text_el: μάταια ἐνεπλήσθη ἡ πόλις βοώντων οἱ τραυματίαι σου οὐ τραυματίαι μαχαίρας οὐδὲ οἱ νεκροί σου νεκροὶ πολέμου

text_en: All the princes are fled together, and are bound hard: all that were found, are bound together, they are fled far off.
text_la: Cuncti principes tui fugerunt simul dureque ligati sunt; omnes qui inventi sunt vincti sunt pariter; procul fugerunt.
text_pt: Todos os teus governadores juntamente fugiram, foram atados pelos arqueiros; todos os que em ti se acharam, foram amarrados juntamente, e fugiram para longe.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντές σου πεφεύγασιν καὶ οἱ ἁλόντες σκληρῶς δεδεμένοι εἰσίν καὶ οἱ ἰσχύοντες ἐν σοὶ πόρρω πεφεύγασιν

text_en: Therefore have I said: Depart from me, I will weep bitterly: labour not to comfort me, for the devastation of the daughter of my people.
text_la: Propterea dixi : Recedite a me : amare flebo; nolite incumbere ut consolemini me super vastitate filiæ populi mei;
text_pt: Portanto digo: Desviai de mim a vista, e chorarei amargamente; não vos canseis mais em consolar-me pela destruição da filha do meu povo.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εἶπα ἄφετέ με πικρῶς κλαύσομαι μὴ κατισχύσητε παρακαλεῖν με ἐπὶ τὸ σύντριμμα τῆς θυγατρὸς τοῦ γένους μου

text_en: For it is a day of slaughter and of treading down, and of weeping to the Lord the God of hosts in the valley of vision, searching the wall, and magnificent upon the mountain.
text_la: dies enim interfectionis, et conculcationis, et fletuum, Domino Deo exercituum, in valle Visionis, scrutans murum, et magnificus super montem.
text_pt: Porque dia de alvoroço, e de atropelamento, e de confusão é este da parte do Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos, no vale da visão; dia de derrubar o muro e de clamar até aos montes.
text_el: ὅτι ἡμέρα ταραχῆς καὶ ἀπωλείας καὶ καταπατήματος καὶ πλάνησις παρὰ κυρίου σαβαωθ ἐν φάραγγι Σιων πλανῶνται ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου πλανῶνται ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη

text_en: And Elam took the quiver, the chariot of the horseman, and the shield was taken down from the wall.
text_la: Et Ælam sumpsit pharetram, currum hominis equitis, et parietem nudavit clypeus.
text_pt: Porque Elão tomou a aljava, juntamente com carros de homens e cavaleiros; e Quir descobriu os escudos.
text_el: οἱ δὲ Αιλαμῖται ἔλαβον φαρέτρας ἀναβάται ἄνθρωποι ἐφ' ἵπποις καὶ συναγωγὴ παρατάξεως

text_en: And your choice valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall place themselves in the gate.
text_la: Et erunt electæ valles tuæ plenæ quadrigarum, et equites ponent sedes suas in porta.
text_pt: E os teus mais formosos vales se encherão de carros, e os cavaleiros se colocarão em ordem às portas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται αἱ ἐκλεκταὶ φάραγγές σου πλησθήσονται ἁρμάτων οἱ δὲ ἱππεῖς ἐμφράξουσι τὰς πύλας σου

text_en: And the covering of Juda shall be discovered, and you shall see in that day the armoury of the house of the forest.
text_la: Et revelabitur operimentum Judæ, et videbis in die illa armamentarium domus saltus.
text_pt: E ele tirou a coberta de Judá, e naquele dia olhaste para as armas da casa do bosque.
text_el: καὶ ἀνακαλύψουσιν τὰς πύλας Ιουδα καὶ ἐμβλέψονται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ εἰς τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς οἴκους τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And you shall see the breaches of the city of David , that they are many: and you have gathered together the waters of the lower pool ,
text_la: Et scissuras civitatis David videbitis, quia multiplicatæ sunt; et congregastis aquas piscinæ inferioris,
text_pt: E vistes as brechas da cidade de Davi, porquanto já eram muitas, e ajuntastes as águas do tanque de baixo.
text_el: καὶ ἀνακαλύψουσιν τὰ κρυπτὰ τῶν οἴκων τῆς ἄκρας Δαυιδ καὶ εἴδοσαν ὅτι πλείους εἰσὶν καὶ ὅτι ἀπέστρεψαν τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς ἀρχαίας κολυμβήθρας εἰς τὴν πόλιν

text_en: and have numbered the houses of Jerusalem , and broken down houses to fortify the wall.
text_la: et domos Jerusalem numerastis, et destruxistis domos ad muniendum murum.
text_pt: Também contastes as casas de Jerusalém, e derrubastes as casas, para fortalecer os muros.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι καθείλοσαν τοὺς οἴκους Ιερουσαλημ εἰς ὀχύρωμα τοῦ τείχους τῇ πόλει

text_en: And you made a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool : and you have not looked up to the maker thereof, nor regarded him even at a distance, that wrought it long ago.
text_la: Et lacum fecistis inter duos muros ad aquam piscinæ veteris; et non suspexistis ad eum qui fecerat eam, et operatorem ejus de longe non vidistis.
text_pt: Fizestes também um reservatório entre os dois muros para as águas do tanque velho, porém não olhastes acima, para aquele que isto tinha feito, nem considerastes o que o formou desde a antiguidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς ὕδωρ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν δύο τειχέων ἐσώτερον τῆς κολυμβήθρας τῆς ἀρχαίας καὶ οὐκ ἐνεβλέψατε εἰς τὸν ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ποιήσαντα αὐτὴν καὶ τὸν κτίσαντα αὐτὴν οὐκ εἴδετε

text_en: And the Lord , the God of hosts , in that day shall call to weeping, and to mourning, to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth :
text_la: Et vocabit Dominus Deus exercituum in die illa ad fletum, et ad planctum, ad calvitium, et ad cingulum sacci;
text_pt: E o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos, chamou naquele dia para chorar e para prantear, e para raspar a cabeça, e cingir com o cilício.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν κύριος σαβαωθ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ κλαυθμὸν καὶ κοπετὸν καὶ ξύρησιν καὶ ζῶσιν σάκκων

text_en: And behold joy and gladness , killing calves, and slaying rams, eating flesh, and drinking wine: Let us eat and drink; for tomorrow we shall die.
text_la: et ecce gaudium et lætitia, occidere vitulos et jugulare arietes, comedere carnes, et bibere vinum : comedamus et bibamus, cras enim moriemur.
text_pt: Porém eis aqui gozo e alegria, matam-se bois e degolam-se ovelhas, come-se carne, e bebe-se vinho, e diz-se: Comamos e bebamos, porque amanhã morreremos.
text_el: αὐτοὶ δὲ ἐποιήσαντο εὐφροσύνην καὶ ἀγαλλίαμα σφάζοντες μόσχους καὶ θύοντες πρόβατα ὥστε φαγεῖν κρέα καὶ πιεῖν οἶνον λέγοντες φάγωμεν καὶ πίωμεν αὔριον γὰρ ἀποθνῄσκομεν

text_en: And the voice of the Lord of hosts was revealed in my ears: Surely this iniquity shall not be forgiven you till you die, says the Lord God of hosts .
text_la: Et revelata est in auribus meis vox Domini exercituum : Si dimittetur iniquitas hæc vobis donec moriamini, dicit Dominus Deus exercituum.
text_pt: Mas o SENHOR dos Exércitos revelou-se aos meus ouvidos, dizendo: Certamente esta maldade não vos será expiada até que morrais, diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνακεκαλυμμένα ταῦτά ἐστιν ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν κυρίου σαβαωθ ὅτι οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται ὑμῖν αὕτη ἡ ἁμαρτία ἕως ἂν ἀποθάνητε

text_en: Thus says the Lord God of hosts : Go, get you in to him that dwells in the tabernacle, to Sobna who is over the temple : and you shall say to him:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : Vade, ingredere ad eum qui habitat in tabernaculo, ad Sobnam, præpositum templi, et dices ad eum :
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos: Anda e vai ter com este tesoureiro, com Sebna, o mordomo, e dize-lhe:
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ πορεύου εἰς τὸ παστοφόριον πρὸς Σομναν τὸν ταμίαν καὶ εἰπὸν αὐτῷ

text_en: What do you here, or as if you were somebody here? For you have hewed you out a sepulchre here, you have hewed out a monument carefully in a high place, a dwelling for yourself in a rock.
text_la: Quid tu hic, aut quasi quis hic? quia excidisti tibi hic sepulchrum, excidisti in excelso memoriale diligenter, in petra tabernaculum tibi.
text_pt: Que é que tens aqui, ou a quem tens tu aqui, para que cavasses aqui uma sepultura? Cavando em lugar alto a sua sepultura, e cinzelando na rocha uma morada para ti mesmo?
text_el: τί σὺ ὧδε καὶ τί σοί ἐστιν ὧδε ὅτι ἐλατόμησας σεαυτῷ ὧδε μνημεῖον καὶ ἐποίησας σεαυτῷ ἐν ὑψηλῷ μνημεῖον καὶ ἔγραψας σεαυτῷ ἐν πέτρᾳ σκηνήν

text_en: Behold the Lord will cause you to be carried away, as a cock is carried away, and he will lift you up as a garment.
text_la: Ecce Dominus asportari te faciet, sicut asportatur gallus gallinaceus; et quasi amictum, sic sublevabit te.
text_pt: Eis que o Senhor te arrojará violentamente como um homem forte, e de todo te envolverá.
text_el: ἰδοὺ δὴ κύριος σαβαωθ ἐκβαλεῖ καὶ ἐκτρίψει ἄνδρα καὶ ἀφελεῖ τὴν στολήν σου

text_en: He will crown you with a crown of tribulation, he will toss you like a ball into a large and spacious country: there shall you die, and there shall the chariot of your glory be, the shame of the house of your Lord .
text_la: Coronas coronabit te tribulatione; quasi pilam mittet te in terram latam et spatiosam; ibi morieris, et ibi erit currus gloriæ tuæ, ignominia domus domini tui.
text_pt: Certamente com violência te fará rolar, como se faz rolar uma bola num país espaçoso; ali morrerás, e ali acabarão os carros da tua glória, ó opróbrio da casa do teu senhor.
text_el: καὶ τὸν στέφανόν σου τὸν ἔνδοξον καὶ ῥίψει σε εἰς χώραν μεγάλην καὶ ἀμέτρητον καὶ ἐκεῖ ἀποθανῇ καὶ θήσει τὸ ἅρμα σου τὸ καλὸν εἰς ἀτιμίαν καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἄρχοντός σου εἰς καταπάτημα

text_en: And I will drive you out from your station, and depose you from your ministry .
text_la: Et expellam te de statione tua, et de ministerio tuo deponam te.
text_pt: E demitir-te-ei do teu posto, e te arrancarei do teu assento.
text_el: καὶ ἀφαιρεθήσῃ ἐκ τῆς οἰκονομίας σου καὶ ἐκ τῆς στάσεώς σου

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliacim the son of Helcias,
text_la: Et erit in die illa : vocabo servum meum Eliacim, filium Helciæ,
text_pt: E será naquele dia que chamarei a meu servo Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καλέσω τὸν παῖδά μου Ελιακιμ τὸν τοῦ Χελκιου

text_en: and I will clothe him with your robe, and will strengthen him with your girdle, and will give your power into his hand: and he shall be as a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and to the house of Juda .
text_la: et induam illum tunica tua, et cingulo tuo confortabo eum, et potestatem tuam dabo in manu ejus; et erit quasi pater habitantibus Jerusalem et domui Juda.
text_pt: E vesti-lo-ei da tua túnica, e cingi-lo-ei com o teu cinto, e entregarei nas suas mãos o teu domínio, e será como pai para os moradores de Jerusalém, e para a casa de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐνδύσω αὐτὸν τὴν στολήν σου καὶ τὸν στέφανόν σου δώσω αὐτῷ καὶ τὸ κράτος καὶ τὴν οἰκονομίαν σου δώσω εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται ὡς πατὴρ τοῖς ἐνοικοῦσιν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τοῖς ἐνοικοῦσιν ἐν Ιουδα

text_en: And I will lay the key of the house of David upon his shoulder: and he shall open, and none shall shut: and he shall shut, and none shall open.
text_la: Et dabo clavem domus David super humerum ejus; et aperiet, et non erit qui claudat; et claudet, et non erit qui aperiat.
text_pt: E porei a chave da casa de Davi sobre o seu ombro, e abrirá, e ninguém fechará; e fechará, e ninguém abrirá.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὴν δόξαν Δαυιδ αὐτῷ καὶ ἄρξει καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἀντιλέγων

text_en: And I will fasten him as a peg in a sure place, and he shall be for a throne of glory to the house of his father.
text_la: Et figam illum paxillum in loco fideli, et erit in solium gloriæ domui patris ejus.
text_pt: E fixá-lo-ei como a um prego num lugar firme, e será como um trono de honra para a casa de seu pai.
text_el: καὶ στήσω αὐτὸν ἄρχοντα ἐν τόπῳ πιστῷ καὶ ἔσται εἰς θρόνον δόξης τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, divers kinds of vessels, every little vessel, from the vessels of cups even to every instrument of music.
text_la: Et suspendent super eum omnem gloriam domus patris ejus; vasorum diversa genera, omne vas parvulum, a vasis craterarum usque ad omne vas musicorum.
text_pt: E nele pendurarão toda a honra da casa de seu pai, a prole e os descendentes, como também todos os vasos menores, desde as taças até os frascos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται πεποιθὼς ἐπ' αὐτὸν πᾶς ἔνδοξος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου καὶ ἔσονται ἐπικρεμάμενοι αὐτῷ

text_en: In that day, says the Lord of hosts , shall the peg be removed, that was fastened in the sure place: and it shall be broken and shall fall: and that which hung thereon, shall perish, because the Lord has spoken it.
text_la: In die illa, dicit Dominus exercituum, auferetur paxillus qui fixus fuerat in loco fideli, et frangetur, et cadet, et peribit quod pependerat in eo, quia Dominus locutus est.
text_pt: Naquele dia, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o prego fincado em lugar firme será tirado; e será cortado, e cairá, e a carga que nele estava se desprenderá, porque o Senhor o disse.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ τάδε λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ κινηθήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ ἐστηριγμένος ἐν τόπῳ πιστῷ καὶ πεσεῖται καὶ ἀφαιρεθήσεται ἡ δόξα ἡ ἐπ' αὐτόν ὅτι κύριος ἐλάλησεν

text_en: The burden of Tyre . Howl, you ships of the sea, for the house is destroyed, from whence they were wont to come: from the land of Cethim it is revealed to them.
text_la: Onus Tyri. Ululate, naves maris, quia vastata est domus unde venire consueverant : de terra Cethim revelatum est eis.
text_pt: Peso de Tiro. Uivai, navios de Társis, porque está assolada, a ponto de não haver nela casa nenhuma, e de ninguém mais entrar nela; desde a terra de Quitim lhes foi isto revelado.
text_el: τὸ ὅραμα Τύρου ὀλολύζετε πλοῖα Καρχηδόνος ὅτι ἀπώλετο καὶ οὐκέτι ἔρχονται ἐκ γῆς Κιτιαίων ἦκται αἰχμάλωτος

text_en: Be silent, you that dwell in the island: the merchants of Sidon passing over the sea, have filled you.
text_la: Tacete, qui habitatis in insula; negotiatores Sidonis, transfretantes mare, repleverunt te.
text_pt: Calai-vos, moradores da ilha, vós a quem encheram os mercadores de Sidom, navegando pelo mar.
text_el: τίνι ὅμοιοι γεγόνασιν οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν τῇ νήσῳ μεταβόλοι Φοινίκης διαπερῶντες τὴν θάλασσαν

text_en: The seed of the Nile in many waters, the harvest of the river is her revenue: and she has become the mart of the nations .
text_la: In aquis multis semen Nili; messis fluminis fruges ejus : et facta est negotiatio gentium.
text_pt: E a sua provisão era a semente de Sior, que vinha com as muitas águas, a ceifa do Nilo, e ela era a feira das nações.
text_el: ἐν ὕδατι πολλῷ σπέρμα μεταβόλων ὡς ἀμητοῦ εἰσφερομένου οἱ μεταβόλοι τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: Be ashamed, O Sidon : for the sea speaks, even the strength of the sea, saying: I have not been in labour, nor have I brought forth, nor have I nourished up young men, nor brought up virgins .
text_la: Erubesce, Sidon; ait enim mare, fortitudo maris, dicens : Non parturivi, et non peperi, et non enutrivi juvenes, nec ad incrementum perduxi virgines.
text_pt: Envergonha-te, ó Sidom, porque o mar, a fortaleza do mar, fala, dizendo: Eu não tive dores de parto, nem dei à luz, nem ainda criei jovens, nem eduquei virgens.
text_el: αἰσχύνθητι Σιδών εἶπεν ἡ θάλασσα ἡ δὲ ἰσχὺς τῆς θαλάσσης εἶπεν οὐκ ὤδινον οὐδὲ ἔτεκον οὐδὲ ἐξέθρεψα νεανίσκους οὐδὲ ὕψωσα παρθένους

text_en: When it shall be heard in Egypt , they will be sorry when they shall hear of Tyre :
text_la: Cum auditum fuerit in Ægypto, dolebunt cum audierint de Tiro.
text_pt: Como quando se ouviram as novas do Egito, assim haverá dores quando se ouvirem as de Tiro.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ ἀκουστὸν γένηται Αἰγύπτῳ λήμψεται αὐτοὺς ὀδύνη περὶ Τύρου

text_en: Pass over the seas, howl, you inhabitants of the island.
text_la: Transite maria, ululate, qui habitatis in insula!
text_pt: Passai a Társis; clamai, moradores da ilha.
text_el: ἀπέλθατε εἰς Καρχηδόνα ὀλολύξατε οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν τῇ νήσῳ ταύτῃ

text_en: Is not this your city, which gloried from of old in her antiquity? Her feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
text_la: Numquid non vestra hæc est, quæ gloriabatur a diebus pristinis in antiquitate sua? Ducent eam pedes sui longe ad peregrinandum.
text_pt: É esta, porventura, a vossa cidade exultante, cuja origem é dos dias antigos, cujos pés a levaram para longe a peregrinar?
text_el: οὐχ αὕτη ἦν ὑμῶν ἡ ὕβρις ἡ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς πρὶν ἢ παραδοθῆναι αὐτήν

text_en: Who has taken this counsel against Tyre , that was formerly crowned, whose merchants were princes, and her traders the nobles of the earth?
text_la: Quis cogitavit hoc super Tyrum quondam coronatam, cujus negotiatores principes, institores ejus inclyti terræ?
text_pt: Quem formou este desígnio contra Tiro, distribuidora de coroas, cujos mercadores são príncipes e cujos negociantes são os mais nobres da terra?
text_el: τίς ταῦτα ἐβούλευσεν ἐπὶ Τύρον μὴ ἥσσων ἐστὶν ἢ οὐκ ἰσχύει οἱ ἔμποροι αὐτῆς ἔνδοξοι ἄρχοντες τῆς γῆς

text_en: The Lord of hosts has designed it, to pull down the pride of all glory , and bring to disgrace all the glorious ones of the earth.
text_la: Dominus exercituum cogitavit hoc, ut detraheret superbiam omnis gloriæ, et ad ignominiam deduceret universos inclytos terræ.
text_pt: O Senhor dos Exércitos formou este desígnio para denegrir a soberba de toda a glória, e envilecer os mais nobres da terra.
text_el: κύριος σαβαωθ ἐβουλεύσατο παραλῦσαι πᾶσαν τὴν ὕβριν τῶν ἐνδόξων καὶ ἀτιμάσαι πᾶν ἔνδοξον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Pass your land as a river, O daughter of the sea, you have a girdle no more.
text_la: Transi terram tuam quasi flumen, filia maris! non est cingulum ultra tibi.
text_pt: Passa como o Nilo pela tua terra, ó filha de Társis; já não há quem te restrinja.
text_el: ἐργάζου τὴν γῆν σου καὶ γὰρ πλοῖα οὐκέτι ἔρχεται ἐκ Καρχηδόνος

text_en: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he troubled kingdoms: the Lord has given a charge against Chanaan , to destroy the strong ones thereof.
text_la: Manum suam extendit super mare; conturbavit regna. Dominus mandavit adversus Chanaan, ut contereret fortes ejus;
text_pt: Ele estendeu a sua mão sobre o mar, e turbou os reinos; o Senhor deu ordens contra Canaã, para que se destruíssem as suas fortalezas.
text_el: ἡ δὲ χείρ σου οὐκέτι ἰσχύει κατὰ θάλασσαν ἡ παροξύνουσα βασιλεῖς κύριος σαβαωθ ἐνετείλατο περὶ Χανααν ἀπολέσαι αὐτῆς τὴν ἰσχύν
