text_en: And he said: You shall glory no more, O virgin daughter of Sidon , who is oppressed: arise and sail over to Cethim, there also you shall have no rest.
text_la: et dixit : Non adjicies ultra ut glorieris, calumniam sustinens virgo filia Sidonis : in Cethim consurgens transfreta : ibi quoque non erit requies tibi.
text_pt: E disse: Nunca mais exultarás de alegria, ó oprimida virgem, filha de Sidom; levanta-te, passa a Quitim, e ainda ali não terás descanso.
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν οὐκέτι μὴ προσθῆτε τοῦ ὑβρίζειν καὶ ἀδικεῖν τὴν θυγατέρα Σιδῶνος καὶ ἐὰν ἀπέλθῃς εἰς Κιτιεῖς οὐδὲ ἐκεῖ σοι ἀνάπαυσις ἔσται

text_en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans, there was not such a people, the Assyrians founded it: they have led away the strong ones thereof into captivity , they have destroyed the houses thereof, they have, brought it to ruin.
text_la: Ecce terra Chaldæorum, talis populus non fuit : Assur fundavit eam; in captivitatem traduxerunt robustos ejus, suffoderunt domos ejus, posuerunt eam in ruinam.
text_pt: Vede a terra dos caldeus, ainda este povo não era povo; a Assíria a fundou para os que moravam no deserto; levantaram as suas fortalezas, e edificaram os seus palácios; porém converteu-a em ruína.
text_el: καὶ εἰς γῆν Χαλδαίων καὶ αὕτη ἠρήμωται ἀπὸ τῶν Ἀσσυρίων οὐδὲ ἐκεῖ σοι ἀνάπαυσις ἔσται ὅτι ὁ τοῖχος αὐτῆς πέπτωκεν

text_en: Howl, O you ships of the sea, for your strength is laid waste.
text_la: Ululate, naves maris, quia devastata est fortitudo vestra.
text_pt: Uivai, navios de Társis, porque está destruída a vossa fortaleza.
text_el: ὀλολύζετε πλοῖα Καρχηδόνος ὅτι ἀπώλετο τὸ ὀχύρωμα ὑμῶν

text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day that you, O Tyre , shall be forgotten, seventy years, according to the days of one king: but after seventy years, there shall be unto Tyre as the song of a harlot.
text_la: Et erit in die illa : in oblivione eris, o Tyre! septuaginta annis, sicut dies regis unius; post septuaginta autem annos erit Tyro quasi canticum meretricis:
text_pt: Naquele dia Tiro será posta em esquecimento por setenta anos, conforme os dias de um rei; porém no fim de setenta anos Tiro cantará como uma prostituta.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καταλειφθήσεται Τύρος ἔτη ἑβδομήκοντα ὡς χρόνος βασιλέως ὡς χρόνος ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἔσται μετὰ ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη ἔσται Τύρος ὡς ᾆσμα πόρνης

text_en: Take a harp, go about the city, harlot that have been forgotten: sing well, sing many a song, that you may be remembered.
text_la: Sume citharam, circui civitatem, meretrix oblivioni tradita : bene cane, frequenta canticum, ut memoria tui sit.
text_pt: Toma a harpa, rodeia a cidade, ó prostituta entregue ao esquecimento; faça doces melodias, canta muitas canções, para que haja memória de ti.
text_el: λαβὲ κιθάραν ῥέμβευσον πόλεις πόρνη ἐπιλελησμένη καλῶς κιθάρισον πολλὰ ᾆσον ἵνα σου μνεία γένηται

text_en: And it shall come to pass after seventy years, that the Lord will visit Tyre , and will bring her back again to her traffic: and she shall commit fornication again with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
text_la: Et erit post septuaginta annos : visitabit Dominus Tyrum, et reducet eam ad mercedes suas, et rursum fornicabitur cum universis regnis terræ super faciem terræ;
text_pt: Porque será no fim de setenta anos que o Senhor visitará a Tiro, e ela tornará à sua ganância de prostituta, e prostituir-se-á com todos os reinos que há sobre a face da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται μετὰ ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη ἐπισκοπὴν ποιήσει ὁ θεὸς Τύρου καὶ πάλιν ἀποκατασταθήσεται εἰς τὸ ἀρχαῖον καὶ ἔσται ἐμπόριον πάσαις ταῖς βασιλείαις τῆς οἰκουμένης

text_en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be sanctified to the Lord : they shall not be kept in store, nor laid up: for her merchandise shall be for them that shall dwell before the Lord , that they may eat unto fullness, and be clothed for a continuance.
text_la: et erunt negotiationes ejus et mercedes ejus sanctificatæ Domino : non condentur neque reponentur, quia his qui habitaverint coram Domino erit negotiatio ejus, ut manducent in saturitatem, et vestiantur usque ad vetustatem.
text_pt: E o seu comércio e a sua ganância de prostituta serão consagrados ao Senhor; não se entesourará, nem se fechará; mas o seu comércio será para os que habitam perante o Senhor, para que comam até se saciarem, e tenham vestimenta durável.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται αὐτῆς ἡ ἐμπορία καὶ ὁ μισθὸς ἅγιον τῷ κυρίῳ οὐκ αὐτοῖς συναχθήσεται ἀλλὰ τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἔναντι κυρίου πᾶσα ἡ ἐμπορία αὐτῆς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν καὶ ἐμπλησθῆναι εἰς συμβολὴν μνημόσυνον ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: Behold the Lord shall lay waste the earth, and shall strip it, and shall afflict the face thereof, and scatter abroad the inhabitants thereof.
text_la: Ecce Dominus dissipabit terram : et nudabit eam, et affliget faciem ejus, et disperget habitatores ejus.
text_pt: Eis que o SENHOR esvazia a terra, e a desola, e transtorna a sua superfície, e dispersa os seus moradores.
text_el: ἰδοὺ κύριος καταφθείρει τὴν οἰκουμένην καὶ ἐρημώσει αὐτὴν καὶ ἀνακαλύψει τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῆς καὶ διασπερεῖ τοὺς ἐνοικοῦντας ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And it shall be as with the people, so with the priest : and as with the servant so with his master: as with the handmaid, so with her mistress: as with the buyer, so with the seller: as with the lender, so with the borrower: as with him that calls for his money, so with him that owes .
text_la: Et erit sicut populus, sic sacerdos; et sicut servus, sic dominus ejus; sicut ancilla, sic domina ejus; sicut emens, sic ille qui vendit; sicut fœnerator, sic is qui mutuum accipit; sicut qui repetit, sic qui debet.
text_pt: E o que suceder ao povo, assim sucederá ao sacerdote; ao servo, como ao seu senhor; à serva, como à sua senhora; ao comprador, como ao vendedor; ao que empresta, como ao que toma emprestado; ao que dá usura, como ao que paga usura.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὁ λαὸς ὡς ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ὁ παῖς ὡς ὁ κύριος καὶ ἡ θεράπαινα ὡς ἡ κυρία ἔσται ὁ ἀγοράζων ὡς ὁ πωλῶν καὶ ὁ δανείζων ὡς ὁ δανειζόμενος καὶ ὁ ὀφείλων ὡς ᾧ ὀφείλει

text_en: With desolation shall the earth be laid waste, and it shall be utterly spoiled: for the Lord has spoken this word.
text_la: Dissipatione dissipabitur terra, et direptione prædabitur; Dominus enim locutus est verbum hoc.
text_pt: De todo se esvaziará a terra, e de todo será saqueada, porque o Senhor pronunciou esta palavra.
text_el: φθορᾷ φθαρήσεται ἡ γῆ καὶ προνομῇ προνομευθήσεται ἡ γῆ τὸ γὰρ στόμα κυρίου ἐλάλησεν ταῦτα

text_en: The earth mourned, and faded away, and is weakened: the world faded away, the height of the people of the earth is weakened.
text_la: Luxit, et defluxit terra, et infirmata est; defluxit orbis, infirmata est altitudo populi terræ.
text_pt: A terra pranteia e se murcha; o mundo enfraquece e se murcha; enfraquecem os mais altos do povo da terra.
text_el: ἐπένθησεν ἡ γῆ καὶ ἐφθάρη ἡ οἰκουμένη ἐπένθησαν οἱ ὑψηλοὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the earth is infected by the inhabitants thereof: because they have transgressed the laws, they have changed the ordinance, they have broken the everlasting covenant.
text_la: Et terra infecta est ab habitatoribus suis, quia transgressi sunt leges, mutaverunt jus, dissipaverunt fœdus sempiternum.
text_pt: Na verdade a terra está contaminada por causa dos seus moradores; porquanto têm transgredido as leis, mudado os estatutos, e quebrado a aliança eterna.
text_el: ἡ δὲ γῆ ἠνόμησεν διὰ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας αὐτήν διότι παρέβησαν τὸν νόμον καὶ ἤλλαξαν τὰ προστάγματα διαθήκην αἰώνιον

text_en: Therefore shall a curse devour the earth, and the inhabitants thereof shall sin : and therefore they that dwell therein shall be mad , and few men shall be left.
text_la: Propter hoc maledictio vorabit terram, et peccabunt habitatores ejus; ideoque insanient cultores ejus, et relinquentur homines pauci.
text_pt: Por isso a maldição tem consumido a terra; e os que habitam nela são desolados; por isso são queimados os moradores da terra, e poucos homens restam.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀρὰ ἔδεται τὴν γῆν ὅτι ἡμάρτοσαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτήν διὰ τοῦτο πτωχοὶ ἔσονται οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ καταλειφθήσονται ἄνθρωποι ὀλίγοι

text_en: The vintage has mourned, the vine has languished away, all the merry have sighed.
text_la: Luxit vindemia, infirmata est vitis, ingemuerunt omnes qui lætabantur corde;
text_pt: Pranteia o mosto, enfraquece a vide; e suspiram todos os alegres de coração.
text_el: πενθήσει οἶνος πενθήσει ἄμπελος στενάξουσιν πάντες οἱ εὐφραινόμενοι τὴν ψυχήν

text_en: The mirth of timbrels has ceased, the noise of them that rejoice is ended, the melody of the harp is silent.
text_la: cessavit gaudium tympanorum, quievit sonitus lætantium, conticuit dulcedo citharæ.
text_pt: Cessa o folguedo dos tamboris, acaba o ruído dos que exultam, e cessa a alegria da harpa.
text_el: πέπαυται εὐφροσύνη τυμπάνων πέπαυται αὐθάδεια καὶ πλοῦτος ἀσεβῶν πέπαυται φωνὴ κιθάρας

text_en: They shall not drink wine with a song: the drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
text_la: Cum cantico non bibent vinum; amara erit potio bibentibus illam.
text_pt: Com canções não beberão vinho; a bebida forte será amarga para os que a beberem.
text_el: ᾐσχύνθησαν οὐκ ἔπιον οἶνον πικρὸν ἐγένετο τὸ σικερα τοῖς πίνουσιν

text_en: The city of vanity is broken down, every house is shut up, no man comes in.
text_la: Attrita est civitas vanitatis, clausa est omnis domus, nullo introëunte.
text_pt: Demolida está a cidade vazia, todas as casas fecharam, ninguém pode entrar.
text_el: ἠρημώθη πᾶσα πόλις κλείσει οἰκίαν τοῦ μὴ εἰσελθεῖν

text_en: There shall be a crying for wine in the streets: all mirth is forsaken: the joy of the earth has gone away.
text_la: Clamor erit super vino in plateis, deserta est omnia lætitia, translatum est gaudium terræ.
text_pt: Há lastimoso clamor nas ruas por falta do vinho; toda a alegria se escureceu, desterrou-se o gozo da terra.
text_el: ὀλολύζετε περὶ τοῦ οἴνου πανταχῇ πέπαυται πᾶσα εὐφροσύνη τῆς γῆς

text_en: Desolation is left in the city, and calamity shall oppress the gates.
text_la: Relicta est in urbe solitudo, et calamitas opprimet portas.
text_pt: Na cidade só ficou a desolação, a porta ficou reduzida a ruínas.
text_el: καὶ καταλειφθήσονται πόλεις ἔρημοι καὶ οἶκοι ἐγκαταλελειμμένοι ἀπολοῦνται

text_en: For it shall be thus in the midst of the earth, in the midst of the people, as if a few olives, that remain, should be shaken out of the olive tree: or grapes, when the vintage is ended.
text_la: Quia hæc erunt in medio terræ in medio populorum, quomodo si paucæ olivæ quæ remanserunt excutiantur ex olea et racemi, cum fuerit finita vindemia.
text_pt: Porque assim será no interior da terra, e no meio destes povos, como a sacudidura da oliveira, e como os rabiscos, quando está acabada a vindima.
text_el: ταῦτα πάντα ἔσται ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἐθνῶν ὃν τρόπον ἐάν τις καλαμήσηται ἐλαίαν οὕτως καλαμήσονται αὐτούς καὶ ἐὰν παύσηται ὁ τρύγητος

text_en: These shall lift up their voice, and shall give praise: when the Lord shall be glorified , they shall make a joyful noise from the sea.
text_la: Hi levabunt vocem suam, atque laudabunt : cum glorificatus fuerit Dominus, hinnient de mari.
text_pt: Estes alçarão a sua voz, e cantarão com alegria; e por causa da glória do Senhor exultarão desde o mar.
text_el: οὗτοι φωνῇ βοήσονται οἱ δὲ καταλειφθέντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εὐφρανθήσονται ἅμα τῇ δόξῃ κυρίου ταραχθήσεται τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς θαλάσσης

text_en: Therefore glorify the Lord in instruction: the name of the Lord God of Israel in the islands of the sea.
text_la: Propter hoc in doctrinis glorificate Dominum; in insulis maris nomen Domini Dei Israël.
text_pt: Por isso glorificai ao Senhor no oriente, e nas ilhas do mar, ao nome do Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἡ δόξα κυρίου ἐν ταῖς νήσοις ἔσται τῆς θαλάσσης τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ἔνδοξον ἔσται κύριε ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: From the ends of the earth we have heard praises, the glory of the just one. And I said: My secret to myself, my secret to myself, woe is me: the prevaricators have prevaricated, and with the prevarication of transgressors they have prevaricated.
text_la: A finibus terræ laudes audivimus, gloriam Justi. Et dixi : Secretum meum mihi, secretum meum mihi. Væ mihi! prævaricantes prævaricati sunt, et prævaricatione transgressorum prævaricati sunt.
text_pt: Dos confins da terra ouvimos cantar: Glória ao justo. Mas eu disse: Emagreço, emagreço, ai de mim! Os pérfidos têm tratado perfidamente; sim, os pérfidos têm tratado perfidamente.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν πτερύγων τῆς γῆς τέρατα ἠκούσαμεν ἐλπὶς τῷ εὐσεβεῖ καὶ ἐροῦσιν οὐαὶ τοῖς ἀθετοῦσιν οἱ ἀθετοῦντες τὸν νόμον

text_en: Fear , and the pit, and the snare are upon you, O you inhabitant of the earth.
text_la: Formido, et fovea, et laqueus super te, qui habitator es terræ.
text_pt: O temor, e a cova, e o laço vêm sobre ti, ó morador da terra.
text_el: φόβος καὶ βόθυνος καὶ παγὶς ἐφ' ὑμᾶς τοὺς ἐνοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that he that shall flee from the noise of the fear , shall fall into the pit: and he that shall rid himself out of the pit, shall be taken in the snare: for the flood-gates from on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth shall be shaken.
text_la: Et erit : qui fugerit a voce formidinis cadet in foveam; et qui se explicaverit de fovea tenebitur laqueo; quia cataractæ de excelsis apertæ sunt et concutientur fundamenta terræ.
text_pt: E será que aquele que fugir da voz de temor cairá na cova, e o que subir da cova o laço o prenderá; porque as janelas do alto estão abertas, e os fundamentos da terra tremem.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὁ φεύγων τὸν φόβον ἐμπεσεῖται εἰς τὸν βόθυνον ὁ δὲ ἐκβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ βοθύνου ἁλώσεται ὑπὸ τῆς παγίδος ὅτι θυρίδες ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἠνεῴχθησαν καὶ σεισθήσεται τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς

text_en: With breaking shall the earth be broken, with crushing shall the earth be crushed, with trembling shall the earth be moved.
text_la: Confractione confringetur terra, contritione conteretur terra, commotione commovebitur terra;
text_pt: De todo está quebrantada a terra, de todo está rompida a terra, e de todo é movida a terra.
text_el: ταραχῇ ταραχθήσεται ἡ γῆ καὶ ἀπορίᾳ ἀπορηθήσεται ἡ γῆ

text_en: With shaking shall the earth be shaken as a drunken man , and shall be removed as the tent of one night: and the iniquity thereof shall be heavy upon it, and it shall fall, and not rise again.
text_la: agitatione agitabitur terra sicut ebrius, et auferetur quasi tabernaculum unius noctis; et gravabit eam iniquitas sua, et corruet, et non adjiciet ut resurgat.
text_pt: De todo cambaleará a terra como o ébrio, e será movida e removida como a choça de noite; e a sua transgressão se agravará sobre ela, e cairá, e nunca mais se levantará.
text_el: ἔκλινεν καὶ σεισθήσεται ὡς ὀπωροφυλάκιον ἡ γῆ ὡς ὁ μεθύων καὶ κραιπαλῶν καὶ πεσεῖται καὶ οὐ μὴ δύνηται ἀναστῆναι κατίσχυσεν γὰρ ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἡ ἀνομία

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that in that day the Lord shall visit upon the host of heaven on high, and upon the kings of the earth, on the earth.
text_la: Et erit : in die illa visitabit Dominus super militiam cæli in excelso, et super reges terræ qui sunt super terram;
text_pt: E será que naquele dia o Senhor castigará os exércitos do alto nas alturas, e os reis da terra sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάξει ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ τὸν κόσμον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὴν χεῖρα καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς

text_en: And they shall be gathered together as in the gathering of one bundle into the pit, and they shall be shut up there in prison : and after many days they shall be visited.
text_la: et congregabuntur in congregatione unius fascis in lacum, et claudentur ibi in carcere, et post multos dies visitabuntur.
text_pt: E serão ajuntados como presos numa masmorra, e serão encerrados num cárcere; e outra vez serão castigados depois de muitos dias.
text_el: καὶ συνάξουσιν καὶ ἀποκλείσουσιν εἰς ὀχύρωμα καὶ εἰς δεσμωτήριον διὰ πολλῶν γενεῶν ἐπισκοπὴ ἔσται αὐτῶν

text_en: And the moon shall blush, and the sun shall be ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Sion, and in Jerusalem , and shall be glorified in the sight of his ancients.
text_la: Et erubescet luna, et confundetur sol, cum regnaverit Dominus exercituum in monte Sion et in Jerusalem et in conspectu senum suorum fuerit glorificatus.
text_pt: E a lua se envergonhará, e o sol se confundirá quando o Senhor dos Exércitos reinar no monte Sião e em Jerusalém, e perante os seus anciãos gloriosamente.
text_el: καὶ τακήσεται ἡ πλίνθος καὶ πεσεῖται τὸ τεῖχος ὅτι βασιλεύσει κύριος ἐν Σιων καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν πρεσβυτέρων δοξασθήσεται

text_en: O Lord , you are my God , I will exalt O you, and give glory to your name : for you have done wonderful things, your designs of old faithful, amen .
text_la: Domine, Deus meus es tu; exaltabo te, et confitebor nomini tuo : quoniam fecisti mirabilia, cogitationes antiquas fideles. Amen.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, tu és o meu Deus; exaltar-te-ei, e louvarei o teu nome, porque fizeste maravilhas; os teus conselhos antigos são verdade e firmeza.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεός μου δοξάσω σε ὑμνήσω τὸ ὄνομά σου ὅτι ἐποίησας θαυμαστὰ πράγματα βουλὴν ἀρχαίαν ἀληθινήν γένοιτο κύριε

text_en: For you have reduced the city to a heap, the strong city to ruin, the house of strangers, to be no city, and to be no more built up for ever.
text_la: Quia posuisti civitatem in tumulum, urbem fortem in ruinam, domum alienorum : ut non sit civitas, et in sempiternum non ædificetur.
text_pt: Porque da cidade fizeste um montão de pedras, e da cidade forte uma ruína, e do paço dos estranhos, que não seja mais cidade, e jamais se torne a edificar.
text_el: ὅτι ἔθηκας πόλεις εἰς χῶμα πόλεις ὀχυρὰς τοῦ πεσεῖν αὐτῶν τὰ θεμέλια τῶν ἀσεβῶν πόλις εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐ μὴ οἰκοδομηθῇ

text_en: Therefore shall a strong people praise you, the city of mighty nations shall fear you.
text_la: Super hoc laudabit te populus fortis; civitas gentium robustarum timebit te :
text_pt: Por isso te glorificará um povo poderoso, e a cidade das nações formidáveis te temerá.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο εὐλογήσει σε ὁ λαὸς ὁ πτωχός καὶ πόλεις ἀνθρώπων ἀδικουμένων εὐλογήσουσίν σε

text_en: Because you have been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress: a refuge from the whirlwind, a shadow from the heat. For the blast of the mighty is like a whirlwind beating against a wall.
text_la: quia factus es fortitudo pauperi, fortitudo egeno in tribulatione sua, spes a turbine, umbraculum ab æstu; spiritus enim robustorum quasi turbo impellens parietem.
text_pt: Porque foste a fortaleza do pobre, e a fortaleza do necessitado, na sua angústia; refúgio contra a tempestade, e sombra contra o calor; porque o sopro dos opressores é como a tempestade contra o muro.
text_el: ἐγένου γὰρ πάσῃ πόλει ταπεινῇ βοηθὸς καὶ τοῖς ἀθυμήσασιν διὰ ἔνδειαν σκέπη ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπων πονηρῶν ῥύσῃ αὐτούς σκέπη διψώντων καὶ πνεῦμα ἀνθρώπων ἀδικουμένων

text_en: You shall bring down the tumult of strangers, as heat in thirst: and as with heat under a burning cloud, you shall make the branch of the mighty to wither away.
text_la: Sicut æstus in siti, tumultum alienorum humiliabis; et quasi calore sub nube torrente, propaginem fortium marcescere facies.
text_pt: Como o calor em lugar seco, assim abaterás o ímpeto dos estranhos; como se abranda o calor pela sombra da espessa nuvem, assim o cântico dos tiranos será humilhado.
text_el: εὐλογήσουσίν σε ὡς ἄνθρωποι ὀλιγόψυχοι διψῶντες ἐν Σιων ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπων ἀσεβῶν οἷς ἡμᾶς παρέδωκας

text_en: And the Lord of hosts shall make unto all people in this mountain, a feast of fat things, a feast of wine, of fat things full of marrow, of wine purified from the lees.
text_la: Et faciet Dominus exercituum omnibus populis in monte hoc convivium pinguium, convivium vindemiæ, pinguium medullatorum, vindemiæ defæcatæ.
text_pt: E o Senhor dos Exércitos dará neste monte a todos os povos uma festa com animais gordos, uma festa de vinhos velhos, com tutanos gordos, e com vinhos velhos, bem purificados.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσει κύριος σαβαωθ πᾶσι τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τοῦτο πίονται εὐφροσύνην πίονται οἶνον χρίσονται μύρον

text_en: And he shall destroy in this mountain the face of the bond with which all people were tied, and the web that he began over all nations .
text_la: Et præcipitabit in monte isto faciem vinculi colligati super omnes populos, et telam quam orditus est super omnes nationes.
text_pt: E destruirá neste monte a face da cobertura, com que todos os povos andam cobertos, e o véu com que todas as nações se cobrem.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ παράδος ταῦτα πάντα τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἡ γὰρ βουλὴ αὕτη ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: He shall cast death down headlong for ever: and the Lord God shall wipe away tears from every face, and the reproach of his people he shall take away from off the whole earth: for the Lord has spoken it.
text_la: Præcipitabit mortem in sempiternum; et auferet Dominus Deus lacrimam ab omni facie, et opprobrium populi sui auferet de universa terra : quia Dominus locutus est.
text_pt: Aniquilará a morte para sempre, e assim enxugará o Senhor DEUS as lágrimas de todos os rostos, e tirará o opróbrio do seu povo de toda a terra; porque o SENHOR o disse.
text_el: κατέπιεν ὁ θάνατος ἰσχύσας καὶ πάλιν ἀφεῖλεν ὁ θεὸς πᾶν δάκρυον ἀπὸ παντὸς προσώπου τὸ ὄνειδος τοῦ λαοῦ ἀφεῖλεν ἀπὸ πάσης τῆς γῆς τὸ γὰρ στόμα κυρίου ἐλάλησεν

text_en: And they shall say in that day: Lo, this is our God , we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the Lord , we have patiently waited for him, we shall rejoice and be joyful in his salvation .
text_la: Et dicet in die illa : Ecce Deus noster iste; exspectavimus eum, et salvabit nos; iste Dominus, sustinuimus eum : exsultabimus, et lætabimur in salutari ejus.
text_pt: E naquele dia se dirá: Eis que este é o nosso Deus, a quem aguardávamos, e ele nos salvará; este é o Senhor, a quem aguardávamos; na sua salvação gozaremos e nos alegraremos.
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἰδοὺ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐφ' ᾧ ἠλπίζομεν καὶ ἠγαλλιώμεθα καὶ εὐφρανθησόμεθα ἐπὶ τῇ σωτηρίᾳ ἡμῶν

text_en: For the hand of the Lord shall rest in this mountain: and Moab shall be trodden down under him, as straw is broken in pieces with the wain.
text_la: Quia requiescet manus Domini in monte isto; et triturabitur Moab sub eo, sicuti teruntur paleæ in plaustro.
text_pt: Porque a mão do Senhor descansará neste monte; mas Moabe será trilhado debaixo dele, como se trilha a palha no monturo.
text_el: ὅτι ἀνάπαυσιν δώσει ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τοῦτο καὶ καταπατηθήσεται ἡ Μωαβῖτις ὃν τρόπον πατοῦσιν ἅλωνα ἐν ἁμάξαις

text_en: And he shall stretch forth his hands under him, as he that swims stretches forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down his glory with the dashing of his hands.
text_la: Et extendet manus suas sub eo sicut extendit natans ad natandum; et humiliabit gloriam ejus cum allisione manuum ejus.
text_pt: E estenderá as suas mãos por entre eles, como as estende o nadador para nadar; e abaterá a sua altivez com as ciladas das suas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήσει τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ὃν τρόπον καὶ αὐτὸς ἐταπείνωσεν τοῦ ἀπολέσαι καὶ ταπεινώσει τὴν ὕβριν αὐτοῦ ἐφ' ἃ τὰς χεῖρας ἐπέβαλεν

text_en: And the bulwarks of your high walls shall fall, and be brought low, and shall be pulled down to the ground, even to the dust.
text_la: Et munimenta sublimium murorum tuorum concident, et humiliabuntur, et detrahentur in terram usque ad pulverem.
text_pt: E abaixará as altas fortalezas dos teus muros, abatê-las-á e derrubá-las-á por terra até ao pó.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὕψος τῆς καταφυγῆς τοῦ τοίχου σου ταπεινώσει καὶ καταβήσεται ἕως τοῦ ἐδάφους

text_en: In that day shall this canticle be sung in the land of Juda . Sion the city of our strength a saviour, a wall and a bulwark shall be set therein.
text_la: In die illa cantabitur canticum istud in terra Juda : Urbs fortitudinis nostræ Sion; salvator ponetur in ea murus et antemurale.
text_pt: Naquele dia se entoará este cântico na terra de Judá: Temos uma cidade forte, a que Deus pôs a salvação por muros e antemuros.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ᾄσονται τὸ ᾆσμα τοῦτο ἐπὶ γῆς Ιουδα λέγοντες ἰδοὺ πόλις ὀχυρά καὶ σωτήριον ἡμῶν θήσει τεῖχος καὶ περίτειχος

text_en: Open the gates, and let the just nation, that keeps the truth , enter in.
text_la: Aperite portas, et ingrediatur gens justa, custodiens veritatem.
text_pt: Abri as portas, para que entre nelas a nação justa, que observa a verdade.
text_el: ἀνοίξατε πύλας εἰσελθάτω λαὸς φυλάσσων δικαιοσύνην καὶ φυλάσσων ἀλήθειαν

text_en: The old error is passed away: you will keep peace: peace, because we have hoped in you.
text_la: Vetus error abiit : servabis pacem; pacem, quia in te speravimus.
text_pt: Tu conservarás em paz aquele cuja mente está firme em ti; porque ele confia em ti.
text_el: ἀντιλαμβανόμενος ἀληθείας καὶ φυλάσσων εἰρήνην ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ

text_en: You have hoped in the Lord for evermore, in the Lord God mighty for ever.
text_la: Sperastis in Domino in sæculis æternis; in Domino Deo forti in perpetuum.
text_pt: Confiai no SENHOR perpetuamente; porque o SENHOR DEUS é uma rocha eterna.
text_el: ἤλπισαν κύριε ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ὁ θεὸς ὁ μέγας ὁ αἰώνιος

text_en: For he shall bring down them that dwell on high, the high city he shall lay low. He shall bring it down even to the ground, he shall pull it down even to the dust.
text_la: Quia incurvabit habitantes in excelso; civitatem sublimem humiliabit : humiliabit eam usque ad terram, detrahet eam usque ad pulverem.
text_pt: Porque ele abate os que habitam no alto, na cidade elevada; humilha-a, humilha-a até ao chão, e derruba-a até ao pó.
text_el: ὃς ταπεινώσας κατήγαγες τοὺς ἐνοικοῦντας ἐν ὑψηλοῖς πόλεις ὀχυρὰς καταβαλεῖς καὶ κατάξεις ἕως ἐδάφους

text_en: The foot shall tread it down, the feet of the poor , the steps of the needy .
text_la: Conculcabit eam pes, pedes pauperis, gressus egenorum.
text_pt: O pé pisá-la-á; os pés dos aflitos, e os passos dos pobres.
text_el: καὶ πατήσουσιν αὐτοὺς πόδες πραέων καὶ ταπεινῶν

text_en: The way of the just is right, the path of the just is right to walk in.
text_la: Semita justi recta est, rectus callis justi ad ambulandum.
text_pt: O caminho do justo é todo plano; tu retamente pesas o andar do justo.
text_el: ὁδὸς εὐσεβῶν εὐθεῖα ἐγένετο καὶ παρεσκευασμένη ἡ ὁδὸς τῶν εὐσεβῶν

text_en: And in the way of your judgments, O Lord , we have patiently waited for you: your name , and your remembrance are the desire of the soul .
text_la: Et in semita judiciorum tuorum, Domine, sustinuimus te : nomen tuum et memoriale tuum in desiderio animæ.
text_pt: Também no caminho dos teus juízos, Senhor, te esperamos; no teu nome e na tua memória está o desejo da nossa alma.
text_el: ἡ γὰρ ὁδὸς κυρίου κρίσις ἠλπίσαμεν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ μνείᾳ

text_en: My soul has desired you in the night: yea, and with my spirit within me in the morning early I will watch to you. When you shall do your judgments on the earth, the inhabitants of the world shall learn justice .
text_la: Anima mea desideravit te in nocte, sed et spiritu meo in præcordiis meis de mane vigilabo ad te. Cum feceris judicia tua in terra, justitiam discent habitatores orbis.
text_pt: Com minha alma te desejei de noite, e com o meu espírito, que está dentro de mim, madrugarei a buscar-te; porque, havendo os teus juízos na terra, os moradores do mundo aprendem justiça.
text_el: ᾗ ἐπιθυμεῖ ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν ἐκ νυκτὸς ὀρθρίζει τὸ πνεῦμά μου πρὸς σέ ὁ θεός διότι φῶς τὰ προστάγματά σου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς δικαιοσύνην μάθετε οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Let us have pity on the wicked , but he will not learn justice : in the land of the saints he has done wicked things, and he shall not see the glory of the Lord .
text_la: Misereamur impio, et non discet justitiam; in terra sanctorum iniqua gessit, et non videbit gloriam Domini.
text_pt: Ainda que se mostre favor ao ímpio, nem por isso aprende a justiça; até na terra da retidão ele pratica a iniqüidade, e não atenta para a majestade do Senhor.
text_el: πέπαυται γὰρ ὁ ἀσεβής οὐ μὴ μάθῃ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀλήθειαν οὐ μὴ ποιήσῃ ἀρθήτω ὁ ἀσεβής ἵνα μὴ ἴδῃ τὴν δόξαν κυρίου

text_en: Lord , let your hand be exalted, and let them not see: let the envious people see, and be confounded: and let fire devour your enemies.
text_la: Domine, exaltetur manus tua, et non videant; videant, et confundantur zelantes populi; et ignis hostes tuos devoret.
text_pt: Senhor, a tua mão está exaltada, mas nem por isso a vêem; vê-la-ão, porém, e confundir-se-ão por causa do zelo que tens do teu povo; e o fogo consumirá os teus adversários.
text_el: κύριε ὑψηλός σου ὁ βραχίων καὶ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν γνόντες δὲ αἰσχυνθήσονται ζῆλος λήμψεται λαὸν ἀπαίδευτον καὶ νῦν πῦρ τοὺς ὑπεναντίους ἔδεται

text_en: Lord , you will give us peace: for you have wrought all our works for us.
text_la: Domine, dabis pacem nobis : omnia enim opera nostra operatus es nobis.
text_pt: Senhor, tu nos darás a paz, porque tu és o que fizeste em nós todas as nossas obras.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἰρήνην δὸς ἡμῖν πάντα γὰρ ἀπέδωκας ἡμῖν

text_en: O Lord our God , other lords besides you have had dominion over us, only in you let us remember your name .
text_la: Domine Deus noster, possederunt nos domini absque te; tantum in te recordemur nominis tui.
text_pt: Ó Senhor Deus nosso, já outros senhores têm tido domínio sobre nós; porém, por ti só, nos lembramos de teu nome.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν κτῆσαι ἡμᾶς κύριε ἐκτὸς σοῦ ἄλλον οὐκ οἴδαμεν τὸ ὄνομά σου ὀνομάζομεν

text_en: Let not the dead live, let not the giants rise again: therefore have visited and destroyed them, and have destroyed all their memory.
text_la: Morientes non vivant, gigantes non resurgant : propterea visitasti et contrivisti eos, et perdidisti omnem memoriam eorum.
text_pt: Morrendo eles, não tornarão a viver; falecendo, não ressuscitarão; por isso os visitaste e destruíste, e apagaste toda a sua memória.
text_el: οἱ δὲ νεκροὶ ζωὴν οὐ μὴ ἴδωσιν οὐδὲ ἰατροὶ οὐ μὴ ἀναστήσωσιν διὰ τοῦτο ἐπήγαγες καὶ ἀπώλεσας καὶ ἦρας πᾶν ἄρσεν αὐτῶν

text_en: You have been favourable to the nation, O Lord , you have been favourable to the nation: are you glorified ? You have removed all the ends of the earth far off.
text_la: Indulsisti genti, Domine, indulsisti genti, numquid glorificatus es? elongasti omnes terminos terræ.
text_pt: Tu, Senhor, aumentaste a esta nação, tu aumentaste a esta nação, fizeste-te glorioso; alargaste todos os confins da terra.
text_el: πρόσθες αὐτοῖς κακά κύριε πρόσθες κακὰ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐνδόξοις τῆς γῆς

text_en: Lord , they have sought after you in distress, in the tribulation of murmuring your instruction was with them.
text_la: Domine, in angustia requisierunt te, in tribulatione murmuris doctrina tua eis.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, na angústia te buscaram; vindo sobre eles a tua correção, derramaram a sua oração secreta.
text_el: κύριε ἐν θλίψει ἐμνήσθην σου ἐν θλίψει μικρᾷ ἡ παιδεία σου ἡμῖν

text_en: As a woman with child, when she draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and cries out in her pangs: so are we become in your presence, O Lord .
text_la: Sicut quæ concipit, cum appropinquaverit ad partum, dolens clamat in doloribus suis, sic facti sumus a facie tua, Domine.
text_pt: Como a mulher grávida, quando está próxima a sua hora, tem dores de parto, e dá gritos nas suas dores, assim fomos nós diante de ti, ó Senhor!
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἡ ὠδίνουσα ἐγγίζει τοῦ τεκεῖν καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ ὠδῖνι αὐτῆς ἐκέκραξεν οὕτως ἐγενήθημεν τῷ ἀγαπητῷ σου διὰ τὸν φόβον σου κύριε

text_en: We have conceived, and been as it were in labour, and have brought forth wind: we have not wrought salvation on the earth, therefore the inhabitants of the earth have not fallen.
text_la: Concepimus, et quasi parturivimus, et peperimus spiritum. Salutes non fecimus in terra; ideo non ceciderunt habitatores terræ.
text_pt: Bem concebemos nós e tivemos dores de parto, porém demos à luz o vento; livramento não trouxemos à terra, nem caíram os moradores do mundo.
text_el: ἐν γαστρὶ ἐλάβομεν καὶ ὠδινήσαμεν καὶ ἐτέκομεν πνεῦμα σωτηρίας σου ἐποιήσαμεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀλλὰ πεσοῦνται οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Your dead men shall live, my slain shall rise again: awake, and give praise, you that dwell in the dust: for your dew is the dew of the light: and the land of the giants you shall pull down into ruin.
text_la: Vivent mortui tui, interfecti mei resurgent. Expergiscimini, et laudate, qui habitatis in pulvere, quia ros lucis ros tuus, et terram gigantum detrahes in ruinam.
text_pt: Os teus mortos e também o meu cadáver viverão e ressuscitarão; despertai e exultai, os que habitais no pó, porque o teu orvalho será como o orvalho das ervas, e a terra lançará de si os mortos.
text_el: ἀναστήσονται οἱ νεκροί καὶ ἐγερθήσονται οἱ ἐν τοῖς μνημείοις καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται οἱ ἐν τῇ γῇ ἡ γὰρ δρόσος ἡ παρὰ σοῦ ἴαμα αὐτοῖς ἐστιν ἡ δὲ γῆ τῶν ἀσεβῶν πεσεῖται

text_en: Go, my people, enter into your chambers, shut your doors upon you, hide yourself a little for a moment, until the indignation pass away.
text_la: Vade, populus meus, intra in cubicula tua; claude ostia tua super te, abscondere modicum ad momentum, donec pertranseat indignatio.
text_pt: Vai, pois, povo meu, entra nos teus quartos, e fecha as tuas portas sobre ti; esconde-te só por um momento, até que passe a ira.
text_el: βάδιζε λαός μου εἴσελθε εἰς τὰ ταμίειά σου ἀπόκλεισον τὴν θύραν σου ἀποκρύβηθι μικρὸν ὅσον ὅσον ἕως ἂν παρέλθῃ ἡ ὀργὴ κυρίου

text_en: For behold the Lord will come out of his place, to visit the iniquity of the inhabitant of the earth against him: and the earth shall disclose her blood, and shall cover her slain no more.
text_la: Ecce enim Dominus egredietur de loco suo, ut visitet iniquitatem habitatoris terræ contra eum; et revelabit terra sanguinem suum, et non operiet ultra interfectos suos.
text_pt: Porque eis que o Senhor sairá do seu lugar, para castigar os moradores da terra, por causa da sua iniqüidade, e a terra descobrirá o seu sangue, e não encobrirá mais os seu mortos.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ κύριος ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου ἐπάγει τὴν ὀργὴν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐνοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀνακαλύψει ἡ γῆ τὸ αἷμα αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ κατακαλύψει τοὺς ἀνῃρημένους

text_en: In that day the Lord with his hard, and great, and strong sword shall visit leviathan the bar serpent, and leviathan the crooked serpent, and shall slay the whale that is in the sea.
text_la: In die illa visitabit Dominus in gladio suo duro, et grandi, et forti, super Leviathan, serpentem vectem, et super Leviathan, serpentem tortuosum, et occidet cetum qui in mari est.
text_pt: Naquele dia o SENHOR castigará com a sua dura espada, grande e forte, o leviatã, serpente veloz, e o leviatã, a serpente tortuosa, e matará o dragão, que está no mar.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐπάξει ὁ θεὸς τὴν μάχαιραν τὴν ἁγίαν καὶ τὴν μεγάλην καὶ τὴν ἰσχυρὰν ἐπὶ τὸν δράκοντα ὄφιν φεύγοντα ἐπὶ τὸν δράκοντα ὄφιν σκολιὸν καὶ ἀνελεῖ τὸν δράκοντα

text_en: In that day there shall be singing to the vineyard of pure wine.
text_la: In die illa vinea meri cantabit ei.
text_pt: Naquele dia haverá uma vinha de vinho tinto; cantai-lhe.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀμπελὼν καλός ἐπιθύμημα ἐξάρχειν κατ' αὐτῆς

text_en: I am the Lord that keep it, I will suddenly give it drink: lest any hurt come to it, I keep it night and day.
text_la: Ego Dominus qui servo eam; repente propinabo ei. Ne forte visitetur contra eam, nocte et die servo eam.
text_pt: Eu, o Senhor, a guardo, e cada momento a regarei; para que ninguém lhe faça dano, de noite e de dia a guardarei.
text_el: ἐγὼ πόλις ἰσχυρά πόλις πολιορκουμένη μάτην ποτιῶ αὐτήν ἁλώσεται γὰρ νυκτός ἡμέρας δὲ πεσεῖται τὸ τεῖχος

text_en: There is no indignation in me: who shall make me a thorn and a brier in battle: shall I march against it, shall, I set it on fire together?
text_la: Indignatio non est mihi. Quis dabit me spinam et veprem in prælio? gradiar super eam, succendam eam pariter.
text_pt: Não há indignação em mim. Quem me poria sarças e espinheiros diante de mim na guerra? Eu iria contra eles e juntamente os queimaria.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν ἣ οὐκ ἐπελάβετο αὐτῆς τίς με θήσει φυλάσσειν καλάμην ἐν ἀγρῷ διὰ τὴν πολεμίαν ταύτην ἠθέτηκα αὐτήν τοίνυν διὰ τοῦτο ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς πάντα ὅσα συνέταξεν κατακέκαυμαι

text_en: Or rather shall it take hold of my strength, shall it make peace with me, shall it make peace with me?
text_la: An potius tenebit fortitudinem meam? faciet pacem mihi, pacem faciet mihi.
text_pt: Ou que se apodere da minha força, e faça paz comigo; sim, que faça paz comigo.
text_el: βοήσονται οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ποιήσωμεν εἰρήνην αὐτῷ ποιήσωμεν εἰρήνην

text_en: When they shall rush in unto Jacob , Israel shall blossom and bud, and they shall fill the face of the world with seed.
text_la: Qui ingrediuntur impetu ad Jacob, florebit et germinabit Israël, et implebunt faciem orbis semine.
text_pt: Dias virão em que Jacó lançará raízes, e florescerá e brotará Israel, e encherão de fruto a face do mundo.
text_el: οἱ ἐρχόμενοι τέκνα Ιακωβ βλαστήσει καὶ ἐξανθήσει Ισραηλ καὶ ἐμπλησθήσεται ἡ οἰκουμένη τοῦ καρποῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Hath he struck him according to the stroke of him that struck him? Or is he slain, as he killed them that were slain by him?
text_la: Numquid juxta plagam percutientis se percussit eum? aut sicut occidit interfectos ejus, sic occisus est?
text_pt: Feriu-o como feriu aos que o feriram? Ou matou-o, assim como matou aos que foram mortos por ele?
text_el: μὴ ὡς αὐτὸς ἐπάταξεν καὶ αὐτὸς οὕτως πληγήσεται καὶ ὡς αὐτὸς ἀνεῖλεν οὕτως ἀναιρεθήσεται

text_en: In measure against measure, when it shall be cast off, you shall judge it. He has meditated with his severe spirit in the day of heat.
text_la: In mensura contra mensuram, cum abjecta fuerit, judicabis eam; meditatus est in spiritu suo duro per diem æstus.
text_pt: Com medida contendeste com ela, quando a rejeitaste, quando a tirou com o seu vento forte, no tempo do vento leste.
text_el: μαχόμενος καὶ ὀνειδίζων ἐξαποστελεῖ αὐτούς οὐ σὺ ἦσθα ὁ μελετῶν τῷ πνεύματι τῷ σκληρῷ ἀνελεῖν αὐτοὺς πνεύματι θυμοῦ

text_en: Therefore upon this shall the iniquity of the house of Jacob be forgiven: and this is all the fruit, that the sin thereof should be taken away, when he shall have made all the stones of the altar , as burnt stones broken in pieces, the groves and temples shall not stand.
text_la: Idcirco super hoc dimittetur iniquitas domui Jacob; et iste omnis fructus : ut auferatur peccatum ejus, cum posuerit omnes lapides altaris sicut lapides cineris allisos : non stabunt luci et delubra.
text_pt: Por isso se expiará a iniqüidade de Jacó, e este será todo o fruto de se haver tirado seu pecado; quando ele fizer a todas as pedras do altar como pedras de cal feitas em pedaços, então os bosques e as imagens não poderão ficar em pé.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀφαιρεθήσεται ἡ ἀνομία Ιακωβ καὶ τοῦτό ἐστιν ἡ εὐλογία αὐτοῦ ὅταν ἀφέλωμαι αὐτοῦ τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ὅταν θῶσιν πάντας τοὺς λίθους τῶν βωμῶν κατακεκομμένους ὡς κονίαν λεπτήν καὶ οὐ μὴ μείνῃ τὰ δένδρα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα αὐτῶν ἐκκεκομμένα ὥσπερ δρυμὸς μακράν

text_en: For the strong city shall be desolate, the beautiful city shall be forsaken, and shall be left as a wilderness : there the calf shall feed, and there shall he lie down, and shall consume its branches.
text_la: Civitas enim munita desolata erit; speciosa relinquetur, et dimittetur quasi desertum; ibi pascetur vitulus, et ibi accubabit, et consumet summitates ejus.
text_pt: Porque a cidade fortificada ficará solitária, será uma habitação rejeitada e abandonada como um deserto; ali pastarão os bezerros, e ali se deitarão, e devorarão os seus ramos.
text_el: τὸ κατοικούμενον ποίμνιον ἀνειμένον ἔσται ὡς ποίμνιον καταλελειμμένον καὶ ἔσται πολὺν χρόνον εἰς βόσκημα καὶ ἐκεῖ ἀναπαύσονται

text_en: Its harvest shall be destroyed with drought, women shall come and teach it: for it is not a wise people, therefore he that made it, shall not have mercy on it: and he that formed it, shall not spare it.
text_la: In siccitate messes illius conterentur. Mulieres venientes, et docentes eam; non est enim populus sapiens : propterea non miserebitur ejus qui fecit eum, et qui formavit eum non parcet ei.
text_pt: Quando os seus ramos se secarem, serão quebrados, e vindo as mulheres, os acenderão, porque este povo não é povo de entendimento, assim aquele que o fez não se compadecerá dele, e aquele que o formou não lhe mostrará nenhum favor.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ χρόνον οὐκ ἔσται ἐν αὐτῇ πᾶν χλωρὸν διὰ τὸ ξηρανθῆναι γυναῖκες ἐρχόμεναι ἀπὸ θέας δεῦτε οὐ γὰρ λαός ἐστιν ἔχων σύνεσιν διὰ τοῦτο οὐ μὴ οἰκτιρήσῃ ὁ ποιήσας αὐτούς οὐδὲ ὁ πλάσας αὐτοὺς οὐ μὴ ἐλεήσῃ

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that in that day the Lord will strike from the channel of the river even to the torrent of Egypt , and you shall be gathered together one by one, O you children of Israel .
text_la: Et erit : in die illa percutiet Dominus ab alveo fluminis usque ad torrentem Ægypti; et vos congregabimini unus et unus, filii Israël.
text_pt: E será naquele dia que o Senhor debulhará seus cereais desde as correntes do rio, até ao rio do Egito; e vós, ó filhos de Israel, sereis colhidos um a um.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ συμφράξει κύριος ἀπὸ τῆς διώρυγος τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἕως Ῥινοκορούρων ὑμεῖς δὲ συναγάγετε τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ κατὰ ἕνα ἕνα

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that in that day a noise shall be made with a great trumpet, and they that were lost, shall come from the land of the Assyrians , and they that were outcasts in the land of Egypt , and they shall adore the Lord in the holy mount in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et erit : in die illa clangetur in tuba magna; et venient qui perditi fuerant de terra Assyriorum, et qui ejecti erant in terra Ægypti, et adorabunt Dominum in monte sancto in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E será naquele dia que se tocará uma grande trombeta, e os que andavam perdidos pela terra da Assíria, e os que foram desterrados para a terra do Egito, tornarão a vir, e adorarão ao Senhor no monte santo em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ σαλπιοῦσιν τῇ σάλπιγγι τῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἥξουσιν οἱ ἀπολόμενοι ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῶν Ἀσσυρίων καὶ οἱ ἀπολόμενοι ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ ἅγιον ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Woe to the crown of pride , to the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower the glory his joy , who were on the head of the fat valley, staggering with wine .
text_la: Væ coronæ superbiæ, ebriis Ephraim, et flori decidenti, gloriæ exsultationis ejus, qui erant in vertice vallis pinguissimæ, errantes a vino.
text_pt: Ai da coroa de soberba dos bêbados de Efraim, cujo glorioso ornamento é como a flor que cai, que está sobre a cabeça do fértil vale dos vencidos do vinho.
text_el: οὐαὶ τῷ στεφάνῳ τῆς ὕβρεως οἱ μισθωτοὶ Εφραιμ τὸ ἄνθος τὸ ἐκπεσὸν ἐκ τῆς δόξης ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ παχέος οἱ μεθύοντες ἄνευ οἴνου

text_en: Behold the Lord is mighty and strong, as a storm of hail: a destroying whirlwind, as the violence of many waters overflowing, and sent forth upon a spacious land.
text_la: Ecce validus et fortis Dominus sicut impetus grandinis; turbo confringens, sicut impetus aquarum multarum inundantium et emissarum super terram spatiosam.
text_pt: Eis que o Senhor tem um forte e poderoso; como tempestade de saraiva, tormenta destruidora, e como tempestade de impetuosas águas que transbordam, ele, com a mão, derrubará por terra.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἰσχυρὸν καὶ σκληρὸν ὁ θυμὸς κυρίου ὡς χάλαζα καταφερομένη οὐκ ἔχουσα σκέπην βίᾳ καταφερομένη ὡς ὕδατος πολὺ πλῆθος σῦρον χώραν τῇ γῇ ποιήσει ἀνάπαυσιν ταῖς χερσίν

text_en: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim shall be trodden under feet.
text_la: Pedibus conculcabitur corona superbiæ ebriorum Ephraim.
text_pt: A coroa de soberba dos bêbados de Efraim será pisada aos pés.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς ποσὶν καταπατηθήσεται ὁ στέφανος τῆς ὕβρεως οἱ μισθωτοὶ τοῦ Εφραιμ

text_en: And the fading tower the glory of his joy , who is on the head of the fat valley, shall be as a hasty fruit before the ripeness of autumn: which when he that sees it shall behold, as soon he takes it in his hand, he will eat it up.
text_la: Et erit flos decidens gloriæ exsultationis ejus, qui est super verticem vallis pinguium, quasi temporaneum ante maturitatem autumni, quod, cum aspexerit videns, statim ut manu tenuerit, devorabit illud.
text_pt: E a flor caída do seu glorioso ornamento, que está sobre a cabeça do fértil vale, será como o fruto temporão antes do verão, que, vendo-o alguém, e tendo-o ainda na mão, o engole.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ ἄνθος τὸ ἐκπεσὸν τῆς ἐλπίδος τῆς δόξης ἐπ' ἄκρου τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ ὑψηλοῦ ὡς πρόδρομος σύκου ὁ ἰδὼν αὐτὸ πρὶν ἢ εἰς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ λαβεῖν θελήσει αὐτὸ καταπιεῖν

text_en: In that day the Lord of hosts shall be a crown of glory , and a garland of joy to the residue of his people:
text_la: In die illa erit Dominus exercituum corona gloriæ, et sertum exsultationis residuo populi sui;
text_pt: Naquele dia o Senhor dos Exércitos será por coroa gloriosa, e por diadema formosa, para os restantes de seu povo.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἔσται κύριος σαβαωθ ὁ στέφανος τῆς ἐλπίδος ὁ πλακεὶς τῆς δόξης τῷ καταλειφθέντι μου λαῷ

text_en: And a spirit of judgment to him that sits in judgment, and strength to them that return out of the battle to the gate.
text_la: et spiritus judicii sedenti super judicium, et fortitudo revertentibus de bello ad portam.
text_pt: E por espírito de juízo, para o que se assenta a julgar, e por fortaleza para os que fazem recuar a peleja até à porta.
text_el: καταλειφθήσονται ἐπὶ πνεύματι κρίσεως ἐπὶ κρίσιν καὶ ἰσχὺν κωλύων ἀνελεῖν

text_en: But these also have been ignorant through wine, and through drunkenness have erred : the priest and the prophet have been ignorant through drunkenness , they are swallowed up with wine, they have gone astray in drunkenness , they have not known him that sees, they have been ignorant of judgment.
text_la: Verum hi quoque præ vino nescierunt, et præ ebrietate erraverunt; sacerdos et propheta nescierunt præ ebrietate; absorpti sunt a vino, erraverunt in ebrietate, nescierunt videntem, ignoraverunt judicium.
text_pt: Mas também estes erram por causa do vinho, e com a bebida forte se desencaminham; até o sacerdote e o profeta erram por causa da bebida forte; são absorvidos pelo vinho; desencaminham-se por causa da bebida forte; andam errados na visão e tropeçam no juízo.
text_el: οὗτοι γὰρ οἴνῳ πεπλανημένοι εἰσίν ἐπλανήθησαν διὰ τὸ σικερα ἱερεὺς καὶ προφήτης ἐξέστησαν διὰ τὸν οἶνον ἐσείσθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς μέθης τοῦ σικερα ἐπλανήθησαν τοῦτ' ἔστι φάσμα

text_en: For all the tables were full of vomit and filth, so that there was no more place.
text_la: Omnes enim mensæ repletæ sunt vomitu sordiumque, ita ut non esset ultra locus.
text_pt: Porque todas as suas mesas estão cheias de vômitos e imundícia, e não há lugar limpo.
text_el: ἀρὰ ἔδεται ταύτην τὴν βουλήν αὕτη γὰρ ἡ βουλὴ ἕνεκεν πλεονεξίας

text_en: Whom shall he teach knowledge ? And whom shall he make to understand the hearing? Them that are weaned from the milk, that are drawn away from the breasts.
text_la: Quem docebit scientiam? et quem intelligere faciet auditum? Ablactatos a lacte, avulsos ab uberibus.
text_pt: A quem, pois, se ensinaria o conhecimento? E a quem se daria a entender doutrina? Ao desmamado do leite, e ao arrancado dos seios?
text_el: τίνι ἀνηγγείλαμεν κακὰ καὶ τίνι ἀνηγγείλαμεν ἀγγελίαν οἱ ἀπογεγαλακτισμένοι ἀπὸ γάλακτος οἱ ἀπεσπασμένοι ἀπὸ μαστοῦ

text_en: For command, command again; command, command again; expect, expect again; a little there, a little there.
text_la: Quia manda, remanda; manda, remanda; exspecta, reexspecta; exspecta, reexspecta; modicum ibi, modicum ibi.
text_pt: Porque é mandamento sobre mandamento, mandamento sobre mandamento, regra sobre regra, regra sobre regra, um pouco aqui, um pouco ali.
text_el: θλῖψιν ἐπὶ θλῖψιν προσδέχου ἐλπίδα ἐπ' ἐλπίδι ἔτι μικρὸν ἔτι μικρὸν

text_en: For with the speech of lips, and with another tongue he will speak to this people.
text_la: In loquela enim labii, et lingua altera loquetur ad populum istum.
text_pt: Assim por lábios gaguejantes, e por outra língua, falará a este povo.
text_el: διὰ φαυλισμὸν χειλέων διὰ γλώσσης ἑτέρας ὅτι λαλήσουσιν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ

text_en: To whom he said: This is my rest, refresh the weary, and this is my refreshing: and they would not hear.
text_la: Cui dixit : Hæc est requies mea, reficite lassum; et hoc est meum refrigerium : et noluerunt audire.
text_pt: Ao qual disse: Este é o descanso, dai descanso ao cansado; e este é o refrigério; porém não quiseram ouvir.
text_el: λέγοντες αὐτῷ τοῦτο τὸ ἀνάπαυμα τῷ πεινῶντι καὶ τοῦτο τὸ σύντριμμα καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν ἀκούειν

text_en: And the word of the Lord shall be to them: Command, command again; command, command again; expect, expect again; a little there, a little there: that they may go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
text_la: Et erit eis verbum Domini : Manda, remanda; manda, remanda; exspecta, reexspecta; exspecta, reexspecta; modicum ibi, modicum ibi; ut vadant, et cadant retrorsum, et conterantur, et illaqueentur, et capiantur.
text_pt: Assim, pois, a palavra do Senhor lhes será mandamento sobre mandamento, mandamento sobre mandamento, regra sobre regra, regra sobre regra, um pouco aqui, um pouco ali; para que vão, e caiam para trás, e se quebrantem e se enlacem, e sejam presos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῖς τὸ λόγιον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ θλῖψις ἐπὶ θλῖψιν ἐλπὶς ἐπ' ἐλπίδι ἔτι μικρὸν ἔτι μικρόν ἵνα πορευθῶσιν καὶ πέσωσιν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ κινδυνεύσουσιν καὶ συντριβήσονται καὶ ἁλώσονται

text_en: Wherefore hear the word of the Lord , you scornful men , who rule over my people that is in Jerusalem .
text_la: Propter hoc audite verbum Domini, viri illusores, qui dominamini super populum meum, qui est in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Ouvi, pois, a palavra do Senhor, homens escarnecedores, que dominais este povo que está em Jerusalém.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου ἄνδρες τεθλιμμένοι καὶ ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: For you have said: We have entered into a league with death, and we have made a covenant with hell. When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come upon us: for we have placed our hope in lies , and by falsehood we are protected.
text_la: Dixistis enim : Percussimus fœdus cum morte, et cum inferno fecimus pactum : flagellum inundans cum transierit, non veniet super nos quia posuimus mendacium spem nostram, et mendacio protecti sumus.
text_pt: Porquanto dizeis: Fizemos aliança com a morte, e com o inferno fizemos acordo; quando passar o dilúvio do açoite, não chegará a nós, porque pusemos a mentira por nosso refúgio, e debaixo da falsidade nos escondemos.
text_el: ὅτι εἴπατε ἐποιήσαμεν διαθήκην μετὰ τοῦ ᾅδου καὶ μετὰ τοῦ θανάτου συνθήκας καταιγὶς φερομένη ἐὰν παρέλθῃ οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐθήκαμεν ψεῦδος τὴν ἐλπίδα ἡμῶν καὶ τῷ ψεύδει σκεπασθησόμεθα

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold I will lay a stone in the foundations of Sion , a tried stone, a corner stone , a precious stone , founded in the foundation. He that believes , let him not hasten.
text_la: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego mittam in fundamentis Sion lapidem, lapidem probatum, angularem, pretiosum, in fundamento fundatum; qui crediderit, non festinet.
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu assentei em Sião uma pedra, uma pedra já provada, pedra preciosa de esquina, que está bem firme e fundada; aquele que crer não se apresse.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐμβαλῶ εἰς τὰ θεμέλια Σιων λίθον πολυτελῆ ἐκλεκτὸν ἀκρογωνιαῖον ἔντιμον εἰς τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῆς καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ' αὐτῷ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ

text_en: And I will set judgment in weight, and justice in measure: and hail shall overturn the hope of falsehood : and waters shall overflow its protection.
text_la: Et ponam in pondere judicium, et justitiam in mensura; et subvertet grando spem mendacii, et protectionem aquæ inundabunt.
text_pt: E regrarei o juízo pela linha, e a justiça pelo prumo, e a saraiva varrerá o refúgio da mentira, e as águas cobrirão o esconderijo.
text_el: καὶ θήσω κρίσιν εἰς ἐλπίδα ἡ δὲ ἐλεημοσύνη μου εἰς σταθμούς καὶ οἱ πεποιθότες μάτην ψεύδει ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ὑμᾶς καταιγίς

text_en: And your league with death shall be abolished, and your covenant with hell shall not stand: when the overflowing scourge shall pass, you shall be trodden down by it.
text_la: Et delebitur fœdus vestrum cum morte, et pactum vestrum cum inferno non stabit : flagellum inundans cum transierit, eritis ei in conculcationem.
text_pt: E a vossa aliança com a morte se anulará; e o vosso acordo com o inferno não subsistirá; e, quando o dilúvio do açoite passar, então sereis por ele pisados.
text_el: μὴ καὶ ἀφέλῃ ὑμῶν τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ θανάτου καὶ ἡ ἐλπὶς ὑμῶν ἡ πρὸς τὸν ᾅδην οὐ μὴ ἐμμείνῃ καταιγὶς φερομένη ἐὰν ἐπέλθῃ ἔσεσθε αὐτῇ εἰς καταπάτημα

text_en: Whensoever it shall pass through, it shall take you away: because in the morning early it shall pass through, in the day and in the night, and vexation alone shall make you understand what you hear.
text_la: Quandocumque pertransierit, tollet vos, quoniam in mane diluculo pertransibit in die et in nocte; et tantummodo sola vexatio intellectum dabit auditui.
text_pt: Desde que comece a passar, vos arrebatará, porque manhã após manhã passará, de dia e de noite; e será que somente o ouvir tal notícia causará grande turbação.
text_el: ὅταν παρέλθῃ λήμψεται ὑμᾶς πρωὶ πρωὶ παρελεύσεται ἡμέρας καὶ ἐν νυκτὶ ἔσται ἐλπὶς πονηρά μάθετε ἀκούειν

text_en: For the bed is straitened, so that one must fall out, and a short covering cannot cover both.
text_la: Coangustatum est enim stratum, ita ut alter decidat; et pallium breve utrumque operire non potest.
text_pt: Porque a cama será tão curta que ninguém se poderá estender nela; e o cobertor tão estreito que ninguém se poderá cobrir com ele.
text_el: στενοχωρούμενοι οὐ δυνάμεθα μάχεσθαι αὐτοὶ δὲ ἀσθενοῦμεν τοῦ ἡμᾶς συναχθῆναι

text_en: For the Lord shall stand up as in the mountain of divisions: he shall be angry as in the valley which is in Gabaon: that he may do his work, his strange work: that he may perform his work, his work is strange to him.
text_la: Sicut enim in monte divisionum stabit Dominus; sicut in valle quæ est in Gabaon irascetur, ut faciat opus suum, alienum opus ejus : ut operetur opus suum, peregrinum est opus ejus ab eo.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor se levantará como no monte Perazim, e se irará, como no vale de Gibeão, para fazer a sua obra, a sua estranha obra, e para executar o seu ato, o seu estranho ato.
text_el: ὥσπερ ὄρος ἀσεβῶν ἀναστήσεται καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ φάραγγι Γαβαων μετὰ θυμοῦ ποιήσει τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πικρίας ἔργον ὁ δὲ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ ἀλλοτρίως χρήσεται καὶ ἡ πικρία αὐτοῦ ἀλλοτρία

text_en: And now do not mock, lest your bonds be tied strait. For I have heard of the Lord the God of hosts a consumption and a cutting short upon all the earth.
text_la: Et nunc nolite illudere, ne forte constringantur vincula vestra; consummationem enim et abbreviationem audivi a Domino Deo exercituum, super universam terram.
text_pt: Agora, pois, não mais escarneçais, para que vossos grilhões não se façam mais fortes; porque já ao Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos ouvi falar de uma destruição, e essa já está determinada sobre toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς μὴ εὐφρανθείητε μηδὲ ἰσχυσάτωσαν ὑμῶν οἱ δεσμοί διότι συντετελεσμένα καὶ συντετμημένα πράγματα ἤκουσα παρὰ κυρίου σαβαωθ ἃ ποιήσει ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: Give ear, and hear my voice, hearken, and hear my speech.
text_la: Auribus percipite, et audite vocem meam : attendite, et audite eloquium meum.
text_pt: Inclinai os ouvidos, e ouvi a minha voz; atendei bem e ouvi o meu discurso.
text_el: ἐνωτίζεσθε καὶ ἀκούετε τῆς φωνῆς μου προσέχετε καὶ ἀκούετε τοὺς λόγους μου

text_en: Shall the ploughman plough all the day to sow, shall he open and harrow his ground?
text_la: Numquid tota die arabit arans ut serat? proscindet et sarriet humum suam?
text_pt: Porventura lavra todo o dia o lavrador, para semear? Ou abre e desterroa todo o dia a sua terra?
text_el: μὴ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν μέλλει ὁ ἀροτριῶν ἀροτριᾶν ἢ σπόρον προετοιμάσει πρὶν ἐργάσασθαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: Will he not, when he has made plain the surface thereof, sow gith, and scatter cumin, and put wheat in order, and barley, and millet, and vetches in their bounds?
text_la: Nonne cum adæquaverit faciem ejus, seret gith et cyminum sparget? et ponet triticum per ordinem, et hordeum, et milium, et viciam in finibus suis?
text_pt: Não é antes assim: quando já tem nivelado a sua superfície, então espalha nela ervilhaca, e semeia cominho; ou lança nela do melhor trigo, ou cevada escolhida, ou centeio, cada qual no seu lugar?
text_el: οὐχ ὅταν ὁμαλίσῃ αὐτῆς τὸ πρόσωπον τότε σπείρει μικρὸν μελάνθιον καὶ κύμινον καὶ πάλιν σπείρει πυρὸν καὶ κριθὴν καὶ ζέαν ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις σου

text_en: For he will instruct him in judgment: his God will teach him.
text_la: Et erudiet illum in judicio; Deus suus docebit illum.
text_pt: O seu Deus o ensina, e o instrui acerca do que há de fazer.
text_el: καὶ παιδευθήσῃ κρίματι θεοῦ σου καὶ εὐφρανθήσῃ

text_en: For gith shall not be thrashed with saws, neither shall the cart wheel turn about upon cumin: but gith shall be beaten out with a rod, and cumin with a staff.
text_la: Non enim in serris triturabitur gith, nec rota plaustri super cyminum circuibit; sed in virga excutietur gith, et cyminum in baculo.
text_pt: Porque a ervilhaca não se trilha com trilho, nem sobre o cominho passa roda de carro; mas com uma vara se sacode a ervilhaca, e o cominho com um pau.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ μετὰ σκληρότητος καθαίρεται τὸ μελάνθιον οὐδὲ τροχὸς ἁμάξης περιάξει ἐπὶ τὸ κύμινον ἀλλὰ ῥάβδῳ ἐκτινάσσεται τὸ μελάνθιον τὸ δὲ κύμινον

text_en: But breadcorn shall be broken small: but the thrasher shall not thrash it for ever, neither shall the cart wheel hurt it, nor break it with its teeth.
text_la: Panis autem comminuetur; verum non in perpetuum triturans triturabit illum, neque vexabit eum rota plaustri, neque ungulis suis comminuet eum.
text_pt: O trigo é esmiuçado, mas não se trilha continuamente, nem se esmiúça com as rodas do seu carro, nem se quebra com os seus cavaleiros.
text_el: μετὰ ἄρτου βρωθήσεται οὐ γὰρ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐγὼ ὑμῖν ὀργισθήσομαι οὐδὲ φωνὴ τῆς πικρίας μου καταπατήσει ὑμᾶς

text_en: This also has come forth from the Lord God of hosts , to make his counsel wonderful, and magnify justice .
text_la: Et hoc a Domino Deo exercituum exivit, ut mirabile faceret consilium, et magnificaret justitiam.
text_pt: Até isto procede do Senhor dos Exércitos; porque é maravilhoso em conselho e grande em obra.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα παρὰ κυρίου σαβαωθ ἐξῆλθεν τὰ τέρατα βουλεύσασθε ὑψώσατε ματαίαν παράκλησιν

text_en: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel the city which David took: year is added to year the solemnities are at an end.
text_la: Væ Ariel, Ariel civitas, quam expugnavit David! additus est annus ad annum : solemnitates evolutæ sunt.
text_pt: Ai de Ariel, Ariel, a cidade onde Davi acampou! Acrescentai ano a ano, e sucedam-se as festas.
text_el: οὐαὶ πόλις Αριηλ ἣν Δαυιδ ἐπολέμησεν συναγάγετε γενήματα ἐνιαυτὸν ἐπ' ἐνιαυτόν φάγεσθε γὰρ σὺν Μωαβ

text_en: And I will make a trench about Ariel, and it shall be in sorrow and mourning, and it shall be to me as Ariel.
text_la: Et circumvallabo Ariel, et erit tristis et mœrens, et erit mihi quasi Ariel.
text_pt: Contudo porei a Ariel em aperto, e haverá pranto e tristeza; e ela será para mim como Ariel.
text_el: ἐκθλίψω γὰρ Αριηλ καὶ ἔσται αὐτῆς ἡ ἰσχὺς καὶ τὸ πλοῦτος ἐμοί

text_en: And I will make a circle round about you, and I will cast up a rampart against you, and raise up bulwarks to besiege you.
text_la: Et circumdabo quasi sphæram in circuitu tuo, et jaciam contra te aggerem, et munimenta ponam in obsidionem tuam.
text_pt: Porque te cercarei com o meu arraial, e te sitiarei com baluartes, e levantarei trincheiras contra ti.
text_el: καὶ κυκλώσω ὡς Δαυιδ ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ βαλῶ περὶ σὲ χάρακα καὶ θήσω περὶ σὲ πύργους

text_en: You shall be brought down, you shall speak out of the earth, and your speech shall be heard out of the ground: and your voice shall be from the earth like that of the python, and out of the earth your speech shall mutter.
text_la: Humiliaberis, de terra loqueris, et de humo audietur eloquium tuum; et erit quasi pythonis de terra vox tua, et de humo eloquium tuum mussitabit.
text_pt: Então serás abatida, falarás de debaixo da terra, e a tua fala desde o pó sairá fraca, e será a tua voz debaixo da terra, como a de um que tem espírito familiar, e a tua fala assobiará desde o pó.
text_el: καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται οἱ λόγοι σου εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν οἱ λόγοι σου δύσονται καὶ ἔσται ὡς οἱ φωνοῦντες ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἡ φωνή σου καὶ πρὸς τὸ ἔδαφος ἡ φωνή σου ἀσθενήσει

text_en: And the multitude of them that fan you, shall be like small dust: and as ashes passing away, the multitude of them that have prevailed against you.
text_la: Et erit sicut pulvis tenuis multitudo ventilantium te, et sicut favilla pertransiens multitudo eorum qui contra te prævaluerunt;
text_pt: E a multidão dos teus inimigos será como o pó miúdo, e a multidão dos tiranos como a pragana que passa, e num momento repentino isso acontecerá.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς κονιορτὸς ἀπὸ τροχοῦ ὁ πλοῦτος τῶν ἀσεβῶν καὶ ὡς χνοῦς φερόμενος καὶ ἔσται ὡς στιγμὴ παραχρῆμα

text_en: And it shall be at an instant suddenly. A visitation shall come from the Lord of hosts in thunder, and with earthquake, and with a great noise of whirlwind and tempest; and with the flame of devouring fire.
text_la: eritque repente confestim. A Domino exercituum visitabitur in tonitruo, et commotione terræ, et voce magna turbinis et tempestatis, et flammæ ignis devorantis.
text_pt: Do Senhor dos Exércitos serás visitada com trovões, e com terremotos, e grande ruído com tufão de vento, e tempestade, e labareda de fogo consumidor.
text_el: παρὰ κυρίου σαβαωθ ἐπισκοπὴ γὰρ ἔσται μετὰ βροντῆς καὶ σεισμοῦ καὶ φωνῆς μεγάλης καταιγὶς φερομένη καὶ φλὸξ πυρὸς κατεσθίουσα

text_en: And the multitude of all nations that have fought against Ariel, shall be as the dream of a vision by night, and all that have fought, and besieged and prevailed against it.
text_la: Et erit sicut somnium visionis nocturnæ multitudo omnium gentium quæ dimicaverunt contra Ariel, et omnes qui militaverunt, et obsederunt, et prævaluerunt adversus eam.
text_pt: E como o sonho e uma visão de noite será a multidão de todas as nações que hão de pelejar contra Ariel, como também todos os que pelejarem contra ela e contra a sua fortaleza, e a puserem em aperto.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς ὁ ἐνυπνιαζόμενος ἐν ὕπνῳ ὁ πλοῦτος τῶν ἐθνῶν πάντων ὅσοι ἐπεστράτευσαν ἐπὶ Αριηλ καὶ πάντες οἱ στρατευσάμενοι ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ πάντες οἱ συνηγμένοι ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ θλίβοντες αὐτήν

text_en: And as he that is hungry dreams, and eats, but when he is awake, his soul is empty: and as he that is thirsty dreams, and drinks and after he is awake, is yet faint with thirst, and his soul is empty: so shall be the multitude of all the Gentiles , that have fought against mount Sion.
text_la: Et sicut somniat esuriens, et comedit, cum autem fuerit expergefactus, vacua est anima ejus; et sicut somniat sitiens et bibit, et postquam fuerit expergefactus, lassus adhuc sitit, et anima ejus vacua est : sic erit multitudo omnium gentium quæ dimicaverunt contra montem Sion.
text_pt: Será também como o faminto que sonha, que está a comer, porém, acordando, sente-se vazio; ou como o sedento que sonha que está a beber, porém, acordando, eis que ainda desfalecido se acha, e a sua alma com sede; assim será toda a multidão das nações, que pelejarem contra o monte Sião.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ὡς οἱ ἐν ὕπνῳ πίνοντες καὶ ἔσθοντες καὶ ἐξαναστάντων μάταιον αὐτῶν τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ ὃν τρόπον ἐνυπνιάζεται ὁ διψῶν ὡς πίνων καὶ ἐξαναστὰς ἔτι διψᾷ ἡ δὲ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς κενὸν ἤλπισεν οὕτως ἔσται ὁ πλοῦτος πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ὅσοι ἐπεστράτευσαν ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος Σιων

text_en: Be astonished, and wonder, waver, and stagger: be drunk , and not with wine: stagger, and not with drunkenness .
text_la: Obstupescite et admiramini; fluctuate et vacillate; inebriamini, et non a vino; movemini, et non ab ebrietate.
text_pt: Tardai, e maravilhai-vos, folgai, e clamai; bêbados estão, mas não de vinho, andam titubeando, mas não de bebida forte.
text_el: ἐκλύθητε καὶ ἔκστητε καὶ κραιπαλήσατε οὐκ ἀπὸ σικερα οὐδὲ ἀπὸ οἴνου

text_en: For the Lord has mingled for you the spirit of a deep sleep, he will shut up your eyes, he will cover your prophets and princes, that see visions .
text_la: Quoniam miscuit vobis Dominus spiritum soporis; claudet oculos vestros : prophetas et principes vestros, qui vident visiones, operiet.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor derramou sobre vós um espírito de profundo sono, e fechou os vossos olhos, vendou os profetas, e os vossos principais videntes.
text_el: ὅτι πεπότικεν ὑμᾶς κύριος πνεύματι κατανύξεως καὶ καμμύσει τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν προφητῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτῶν οἱ ὁρῶντες τὰ κρυπτά

text_en: And the vision of all shall be unto you as the words of a book that is sealed which when they shall deliver to one that is learned, they shall say: Read this: and he shall answer: I cannot, for it is sealed .
text_la: Et erit vobis visio omnium sicut verba libri signati, quem cum dederint scienti litteras, dicent : Lege istum : et respondebit : Non possum, signatus est enim.
text_pt: Por isso toda a visão vos é como as palavras de um livro selado que se dá ao que sabe ler, dizendo: Lê isto, peço-te; e ele dirá: Não posso, porque está selado.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ὑμῖν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ὡς οἱ λόγοι τοῦ βιβλίου τοῦ ἐσφραγισμένου τούτου ὃ ἐὰν δῶσιν αὐτὸ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐπισταμένῳ γράμματα λέγοντες ἀνάγνωθι ταῦτα καὶ ἐρεῖ οὐ δύναμαι ἀναγνῶναι ἐσφράγισται γάρ

text_en: And the book shall be given to one that knows no letters, and it shall be said to him: Read: and he shall answer: I know no letters.
text_la: Et dabitur liber nescienti litteras, diceturque ei : Lege; et respondebit : Nescio litteras.
text_pt: Ou dá-se o livro ao que não sabe ler, dizendo: Lê isto, peço-te; e ele dirá: Não sei ler.
text_el: καὶ δοθήσεται τὸ βιβλίον τοῦτο εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπου μὴ ἐπισταμένου γράμματα καὶ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ ἀνάγνωθι τοῦτο καὶ ἐρεῖ οὐκ ἐπίσταμαι γράμματα

text_en: And the Lord said: Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips glorify me, but their heart is far from me, and they have feared me with the commandment and doctrines of men :
text_la: Et dixit Dominus : Eo quod appropinquat populus iste ore suo, et labiis suis glorificat me, cor autem ejus longe est a me, et timuerunt me mandato hominum et doctrinis,
text_pt: Porque o Senhor disse: Pois que este povo se aproxima de mim, e com a sua boca, e com os seus lábios me honra, mas o seu coração se afasta para longe de mim e o seu temor para comigo consiste só em mandamentos de homens, em que foi instruído;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἐγγίζει μοι ὁ λαὸς οὗτος τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτῶν τιμῶσίν με ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν πόρρω ἀπέχει ἀπ' ἐμοῦ μάτην δὲ σέβονταί με διδάσκοντες ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων καὶ διδασκαλίας

text_en: Therefore behold I will proceed to cause an admiration in this people, by a great and wonderful miracle : for wisdom shall perish from their wise men , and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
text_la: ideo ecce ego addam ut admirationem faciam populo huic miraculo grandi et stupendo; peribit enim sapientia a sapientibus ejus, et intellectus prudentium ejus abscondetur.
text_pt: Portanto eis que continuarei a fazer uma obra maravilhosa no meio deste povo, uma obra maravilhosa e um assombro; porque a sabedoria dos seus sábios perecerá, e o entendimento dos seus prudentes se esconderá.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ προσθήσω τοῦ μεταθεῖναι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ μεταθήσω αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν κρύψω

text_en: Woe to you that are deep of heart, to hide your counsel from the Lord : and their works are in the dark, and they say: Who sees us, and who knows us?
text_la: Væ qui profundi estis corde, ut a Domino abscondatis consilium; quorum sunt in tenebris opera, et dicunt : Quis videt nos? et quis novit nos?
text_pt: Ai dos que querem esconder profundamente o seu propósito do Senhor, e fazem as suas obras às escuras, e dizem: Quem nos vê? E quem nos conhece?
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ βαθέως βουλὴν ποιοῦντες καὶ οὐ διὰ κυρίου οὐαὶ οἱ ἐν κρυφῇ βουλὴν ποιοῦντες καὶ ἔσται ἐν σκότει τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐροῦσιν τίς ἡμᾶς ἑώρακεν καὶ τίς ἡμᾶς γνώσεται ἢ ἃ ἡμεῖς ποιοῦμεν

text_en: This thought of yours is perverse: as if the clay should think against the potter, and the work should say to the maker thereof: You made me not: or the thing framed should say to him that fashioned it: You understand not.
text_la: Perversa est hæc vestra cogitatio; quasi si lutum contra figulum cogitet, et dicat opus factori suo : Non fecisti me; et figmentum dicat fictori suo : Non intelligis.
text_pt: Vós tudo perverteis, como se o oleiro fosse igual ao barro, e a obra dissesse do seu artífice: Não me fez; e o vaso formado dissesse do seu oleiro: Nada sabe.
text_el: οὐχ ὡς ὁ πηλὸς τοῦ κεραμέως λογισθήσεσθε μὴ ἐρεῖ τὸ πλάσμα τῷ πλάσαντι οὐ σύ με ἔπλασας ἢ τὸ ποίημα τῷ ποιήσαντι οὐ συνετῶς με ἐποίησας

text_en: Is it not yet a very little while, and Libanus shall be turned into charmel, and charmel shall be esteemed as a forest?
text_la: Nonne adhuc in modico et in brevi convertetur Libanus in carmel, et carmel in saltum reputabitur?
text_pt: Porventura não se converterá o Líbano, num breve momento, em campo fértil? E o campo fértil não se reputará por um bosque?
text_el: οὐκέτι μικρὸν καὶ μετατεθήσεται ὁ Λίβανος ὡς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Χερμελ καὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Χερμελ εἰς δρυμὸν λογισθήσεται

text_en: And in that day the deaf shall hear the words of the book, and out of darkness and obscurity the eyes of the blind shall see.
text_la: Et audient in die illa surdi verba libri, et de tenebris et caligine oculi cæcorum videbunt.
text_pt: E naquele dia os surdos ouvirão as palavras do livro, e dentre a escuridão e dentre as trevas os olhos dos cegos as verão.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσονται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ κωφοὶ λόγους βιβλίου καὶ οἱ ἐν τῷ σκότει καὶ οἱ ἐν τῇ ὁμίχλῃ ὀφθαλμοὶ τυφλῶν βλέψονται

text_en: And the meek shall increase their joy in the Lord , and the poor men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Et addent mites in Domino lætitiam, et pauperes homines in Sancto Israël exsultabunt;
text_pt: E os mansos terão gozo sobre gozo no Senhor; e os necessitados entre os homens se alegrarão no Santo de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀγαλλιάσονται πτωχοὶ διὰ κύριον ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ καὶ οἱ ἀπηλπισμένοι τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐμπλησθήσονται εὐφροσύνης

text_en: For he that did prevail has failed, the scorner is consumed, and they are all cut off that watched for iniquity :
text_la: quoniam defecit qui prævalebat, consummatus est illusor, et succisi sunt omnes qui vigilabant super iniquitatem,
text_pt: Porque o tirano é reduzido a nada, e se consome o escarnecedor, e todos os que se dão à iniqüidade são desarraigados;
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν ἄνομος καὶ ἀπώλετο ὑπερήφανος καὶ ἐξωλεθρεύθησαν οἱ ἀνομοῦντες ἐπὶ κακίᾳ

text_en: That made men sin by word, and supplanted him that reproved them in the gate, and declined in vain from the just .
text_la: qui peccare faciebant homines in verbo, et arguentem in porta supplantabant, et declinaverunt frustra a justo.
text_pt: Os que fazem culpado ao homem por uma palavra, e armam laços ao que repreende na porta, e os que sem motivo põem de parte o justo.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ποιοῦντες ἁμαρτεῖν ἀνθρώπους ἐν λόγῳ πάντας δὲ τοὺς ἐλέγχοντας ἐν πύλαις πρόσκομμα θήσουσιν καὶ ἐπλαγίασαν ἐν ἀδίκοις δίκαιον

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord to the house of Jacob , he that redeemed Abraham : Jacob shall not now be confounded, neither shall his countenance now be ashamed:
text_la: Propter hoc, hæc dicit Dominus ad domum Jacob, qui redemit Abraham : Non modo confundetur Jacob, nec modo vultus ejus erubescet;
text_pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor, que remiu a Abraão, acerca da casa de Jacó: Jacó não será agora envergonhado, nem agora se descorará a sua face.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ιακωβ ὃν ἀφώρισεν ἐξ Αβρααμ οὐ νῦν αἰσχυνθήσεται Ιακωβ οὐδὲ νῦν τὸ πρόσωπον μεταβαλεῖ Ισραηλ

text_en: But when he shall see his children, the work of my hands in the midst of him sanctifying my name , and they shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob , and shall glorify the God of Israel :
text_la: sed cum viderit filios suos, opera manuum mearum in medio sui sanctificantes nomen meum, et sanctificabunt Sanctum Jacob, et Deum Israël prædicabunt;
text_pt: Mas quando ele vir seus filhos, obra das minhas mãos no meio dele, santificarão o meu nome; sim, santificarão ao Santo de Jacó, e temerão ao Deus de Israel.
text_el: ἀλλ' ὅταν ἴδωσιν τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν τὰ ἔργα μου δι' ἐμὲ ἁγιάσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ ἁγιάσουσιν τὸν ἅγιον Ιακωβ καὶ τὸν θεὸν τοῦ Ισραηλ φοβηθήσονται

text_en: And they that erred in spirit , shall know understanding, and they that murmured, shall learn the law .
text_la: et scient errantes spiritu intellectum, et mussitatores discent legem.
text_pt: E os errados de espírito virão a ter entendimento, e os murmuradores aprenderão doutrina.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται οἱ τῷ πνεύματι πλανώμενοι σύνεσιν οἱ δὲ γογγύζοντες μαθήσονται ὑπακούειν καὶ αἱ γλώσσαι αἱ ψελλίζουσαι μαθήσονται λαλεῖν εἰρήνην

text_en: Woe to you, apostate children, says the Lord , that you would take counsel, and not of me: and would begin a web, and not by my spirit, that you might add sin upon sin :
text_la: Væ filii desertores, dicit Dominus, ut faceretis consilium, et non ex me, et ordiremini telam, et non per spiritum meum, ut adderetis peccatum super peccatum;
text_pt: Ai dos filhos rebeldes, diz o SENHOR, que tomam conselho, mas não de mim; e que se cobrem, com uma cobertura, mas não do meu espírito, para acrescentarem pecado sobre pecado;
text_el: οὐαὶ τέκνα ἀποστάται τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐποιήσατε βουλὴν οὐ δι' ἐμοῦ καὶ συνθήκας οὐ διὰ τοῦ πνεύματός μου προσθεῖναι ἁμαρτίας ἐφ' ἁμαρτίαις

text_en: Who walk to go down into Egypt , and have not asked at my mouth, hoping for help in the strength of Pharao , and trusting in the shadow of Egypt .
text_la: qui ambulatis ut descendatis in Ægyptum, et os meum non interrogastis, sperantes auxilium in fortitudine Pharaonis, et habentes fiduciam in umbra Ægypti!
text_pt: Que descem ao Egito, sem pedirem o meu conselho; para se fortificarem com a força de Faraó, e para confiarem na sombra do Egito.
text_el: οἱ πορευόμενοι καταβῆναι εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐμὲ δὲ οὐκ ἐπηρώτησαν τοῦ βοηθηθῆναι ὑπὸ Φαραω καὶ σκεπασθῆναι ὑπὸ Αἰγυπτίων

text_en: And the strength of Pharao shall be to your confusion, and the confidence of the shadow of Egypt to your shame.
text_la: Et erit vobis fortitudo Pharaonis in confusionem, et fiducia umbræ Ægypti in ignominiam.
text_pt: Porque a força de Faraó se vos tornará em vergonha, e a confiança na sombra do Egito em confusão.
text_el: ἔσται γὰρ ὑμῖν ἡ σκέπη Φαραω εἰς αἰσχύνην καὶ τοῖς πεποιθόσιν ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον ὄνειδος

text_en: For your princes were in Tanis , and your messengers came even to Hanes.
text_la: Erant enim in Tani principes tui, et nuntii tui usque ad Hanes pervenerunt.
text_pt: Porque os seus príncipes já estão em Zoã, e os seus embaixadores já chegaram a Hanes.
text_el: ὅτι εἰσὶν ἐν Τάνει ἀρχηγοὶ ἄγγελοι πονηροί μάτην κοπιάσουσιν

text_en: They were all confounded at a people that could not profit them: they were no help, nor to any profit, but to confusion and to reproach.
text_la: Omnes confusi sunt super populo qui eis prodesse non potuit : non fuerunt in auxilium et in aliquam utilitatem, sed in confusionem et in opprobrium.
text_pt: Todos se envergonharão de um povo que de nada lhes servirá nem de ajuda, nem de proveito, porém de vergonha, e de opróbrio.
text_el: πρὸς λαόν ὃς οὐκ ὠφελήσει αὐτοὺς οὔτε εἰς βοήθειαν οὔτε εἰς ὠφέλειαν ἀλλὰ εἰς αἰσχύνην καὶ ὄνειδος

text_en: The burden of the beasts of the south. In a land of trouble and distress, from whence come the lioness, and the lion, the viper and the flying basilisk, they carry their riches upon the shoulders of beasts, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels to a people that shall not be able to profit them.
text_la: Onus jumentorum austri. In terra tribulationis et angustiæ leæna, et leo ex eis, vipera et regulus volans; portantes super humeros jumentorum divitias suas, et super gibbum camelorum thesauros suos, ad populum qui eis prodesse non poterit.
text_pt: Peso dos animais do sul. Para a terra de aflição e de angústia (de onde vêm a leoa e o leão, a víbora, e a serpente ardente, voadora) levarão às costas de jumentinhos as suas riquezas, e sobre as corcovas de camelos os seus tesouros, a um povo que de nada lhes aproveitará.
text_el: ἡ ὅρασις τῶν τετραπόδων τῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ τῇ στενοχωρίᾳ λέων καὶ σκύμνος λέοντος ἐκεῖθεν καὶ ἀσπίδες καὶ ἔκγονα ἀσπίδων πετομένων οἳ ἔφερον ἐπ' ὄνων καὶ καμήλων τὸν πλοῦτον αὐτῶν πρὸς ἔθνος ὃ οὐκ ὠφελήσει αὐτοὺς εἰς βοήθειαν ἀλλὰ εἰς αἰσχύνην καὶ ὄνειδος

text_en: For Egypt shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this: It is pride only, sit still.
text_la: Ægyptus enim frustra et vane auxiliabitur. Ideo clamavi super hoc : Superbia tantum est, quiesce.
text_pt: Porque o Egito os ajudará em vão, e para nenhum fim; por isso clamei acerca disto: No estarem quietos será a sua força.
text_el: Αἰγύπτιοι μάταια καὶ κενὰ ὠφελήσουσιν ὑμᾶς ἀπάγγειλον αὐτοῖς ὅτι ματαία ἡ παράκλησις ὑμῶν αὕτη

text_en: Now therefore go in and write for them upon box, and note it diligently in a book, and it shall be in the latter days for a testimony for ever.
text_la: Nunc ergo ingressus, scribe ei super buxum, et in libro diligenter exara illud, et erit in die novissimo in testimonium usque in æternum.
text_pt: Vai, pois, agora, escreve isto numa tábua perante eles e registra-o num livro; para que fique até ao último dia, para sempre e perpetuamente.
text_el: νῦν οὖν καθίσας γράψον ἐπὶ πυξίου ταῦτα καὶ εἰς βιβλίον ὅτι ἔσται εἰς ἡμέρας καιρῶν ταῦτα καὶ ἕως εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: For it is a people that provokes to wrath , and lying children that will not hear the law of God .
text_la: Populus enim ad iracundiam provocans est : et filii mendaces, filii nolentes audire legem Dei;
text_pt: Porque este é um povo rebelde, filhos mentirosos, filhos que não querem ouvir a lei do Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι λαὸς ἀπειθής ἐστιν υἱοὶ ψευδεῖς οἳ οὐκ ἠβούλοντο ἀκούειν τὸν νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: Who say to the seers: See not: and to them that behold: Behold not for us those things that are right: speak unto us pleasant things, see errors for us.
text_la: qui dicunt videntibus : Nolite videre, et aspicientibus : Nolite aspicere nobis ea quæ recta sunt; loquimini nobis placentia : videte nobis errores.
text_pt: Que dizem aos videntes: Não vejais; e aos profetas: Não profetizeis para nós o que é reto; dizei-nos coisas aprazíveis, e vede para nós enganos.
text_el: οἱ λέγοντες τοῖς προφήταις μὴ ἀναγγέλλετε ἡμῖν καὶ τοῖς τὰ ὁράματα ὁρῶσιν μὴ λαλεῖτε ἡμῖν ἀλλὰ ἡμῖν λαλεῖτε καὶ ἀναγγέλλετε ἡμῖν ἑτέραν πλάνησιν

text_en: Take away from me the way, turn away the path from me, let the Holy One of Israel cease from before us.
text_la: Auferte a me viam; declinate a me semitam; cesset a facie nostra Sanctus Israël.
text_pt: Desviai-vos do caminho, apartai-vos da vereda; fazei que o Santo de Israel cesse de estar perante nós.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψατε ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ ταύτης ἀφέλετε ἀφ' ἡμῶν τὸν τρίβον τοῦτον καὶ ἀφέλετε ἀφ' ἡμῶν τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel : Because you have rejected this word, and have trusted in oppression and tumult, and have leaned upon it:
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Sanctus Israël : Pro eo quod reprobastis verbum hoc, et sperastis in calumnia et in tumultu, et innixi estis super eo;
text_pt: Por isso, assim diz o Santo de Israel: porquanto rejeitais esta palavra, e confiais na opressão e perversidade, e sobre isso vos estribais,
