text_en: Where is the king of Emath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Ana, and of Ava?
text_la: Ubi est rex Emath, et rex Arphad, et rex urbis Sepharvaim, Ana, et Ava?
text_pt: Onde está o rei de Hamate, e o rei de Arpade, e o rei da cidade de Sefarvaim, Hena e Iva?
text_el: ποῦ εἰσιν οἱ βασιλεῖς Αιμαθ καὶ Αρφαθ καὶ πόλεως Σεπφαριμ Αναγ Ουγαυα

text_en: And Ezechias took the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it, and went up to the house of the Lord , and Ezechias spread it before the Lord .
text_la: Et tulit Ezechias libros de manu nuntiorum, et legit eos, et ascendit in domum Domini, et expandit eos Ezechias coram Domino:
text_pt: Recebendo, pois, Ezequias as cartas das mãos dos mensageiros, e lendo-as, subiu à casa do Senhor; e Ezequias as estendeu perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Εζεκιας τὸ βιβλίον παρὰ τῶν ἀγγέλων καὶ ἤνοιξεν αὐτὸ ἐναντίον κυρίου

text_en: And Ezechias prayed to the Lord , saying:
text_la: et oravit Ezechias ad Dominum, dicens:
text_pt: E orou Ezequias ao Senhor, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ προσεύξατο Εζεκιας πρὸς κύριον λέγων

text_en: Lord of hosts , God of Israel who sits upon the cherubims , you alone are the God of all the kingdoms of the earth, you have made heaven and earth.
text_la: Domine exercituum, Deus Israël, qui sedes super cherubim, tu es Deus solus omnium regnorum terræ : tu fecisti cælum et terram.
text_pt: Ó Senhor dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, que habitas entre os querubins; tu mesmo, só tu és Deus de todos os reinos da terra; tu fizeste os céus e a terra.
text_el: κύριε σαβαωθ ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβιν σὺ θεὸς μόνος εἶ πάσης βασιλείας τῆς οἰκουμένης σὺ ἐποίησας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: Incline, O Lord , your ear, and hear: open, O Lord , your eyes, and see, and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to blaspheme the living God .
text_la: Inclina, Domine, aurem tuam, et audi; aperi, Domine, oculos tuos, et vide : et audi omnia verba Sennacherib, quæ misit ad blasphemandum Deum viventem.
text_pt: Inclina, ó Senhor, o teu ouvido, e ouve; abre, Senhor, os teus olhos, e vê; e ouve todas as palavras de Senaqueribe, as quais ele enviou para afrontar o Deus vivo.
text_el: εἰσάκουσον κύριε εἴσβλεψον κύριε καὶ ἰδὲ τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἀπέστειλεν Σενναχηριμ ὀνειδίζειν θεὸν ζῶντα

text_en: For of a truth , O Lord , the kings of the Assyrians have laid waste lands, and their countries.
text_la: Vere enim, Domine, desertas fecerunt reges Assyriorum terras, et regiones earum,
text_pt: Verdade é, Senhor, que os reis da Assíria assolaram todas as nações e suas terras.
text_el: ἐπ' ἀληθείας γὰρ ἠρήμωσαν βασιλεῖς Ἀσσυρίων τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅλην καὶ τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they have cast their gods into the fire, for they were not gods, but the works of men's hands, of wood and stone: and they broke them in pieces.
text_la: et dederunt deos earum igni : non enim erant dii, sed opera manuum hominum, lignum et lapis, et comminuerunt eos.
text_pt: E lançaram no fogo os seus deuses; porque deuses não eram, senão obra de mãos de homens, madeira e pedra; por isso os destruíram.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέβαλον τὰ εἴδωλα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ πῦρ οὐ γὰρ θεοὶ ἦσαν ἀλλὰ ἔργα χειρῶν ἀνθρώπων ξύλα καὶ λίθοι καὶ ἀπώλεσαν αὐτούς

text_en: And now, O Lord our God , save us out of his hand: and let all the kingdoms of the earth know , that you only are the Lord .
text_la: Et nunc, Domine Deus noster, salva nos de manu ejus, et cognoscant omnia regna terræ quia tu es Dominus solus.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó Senhor nosso Deus, livra-nos da sua mão; e assim saberão todos os reinos da terra, que só tu és o Senhor.
text_el: σὺ δέ κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν σῶσον ἡμᾶς ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτῶν ἵνα γνῷ πᾶσα βασιλεία τῆς γῆς ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς μόνος

text_en: And Isaiah the son of Amos sent to Ezechias , saying: Thus says the Lord the God of Israel : For the prayer you have made to me concerning Sennacherib the king of the Assyrians :
text_la: Et misit Isaias, filius Amos, ad Ezechiam, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Pro quibus rogasti me de Sennacherib, rege Assyriorum,
text_pt: Então Isaías, filho de Amós, mandou dizer a Ezequias: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Quanto ao que pediste acerca de Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria,
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστάλη Ησαιας υἱὸς Αμως πρὸς Εζεκιαν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἤκουσα ἃ προσηύξω πρός με περὶ Σενναχηριμ βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων

text_en: This is the word which the Lord has spoken of him: The virgin the daughter of Sion has despised you, and laughed you to scorn: the daughter of Jerusalem has wagged the head after you.
text_la: hoc est verbum quod locutus est Dominus super eum : Despexit te et subsannavit te, virgo filia Sion; post te caput movit, filia Jerusalem.
text_pt: Esta é a palavra que o Senhor falou a respeito dele: A virgem, a filha de Sião, te despreza, de ti zomba; a filha de Jerusalém meneia a cabeça por detrás de ti.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐλάλησεν περὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ θεός ἐφαύλισέν σε καὶ ἐμυκτήρισέν σε παρθένος θυγάτηρ Σιων ἐπὶ σοὶ κεφαλὴν ἐκίνησεν θυγάτηρ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Whom have you reproached, and whom have you blasphemed , and against whom have you exalted your voice, and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Cui exprobrasti? et quem blasphemasti? et super quem exaltasti vocem, et levasti altitudinem oculorum tuorum? ad Sanctum Israël.
text_pt: A quem afrontaste e blasfemaste? E contra quem alçaste a voz, e ergueste os teus olhos ao alto? Contra o Santo de Israel.
text_el: τίνα ὠνείδισας καὶ παρώξυνας ἢ πρὸς τίνα ὕψωσας τὴν φωνήν σου καὶ οὐκ ἦρας εἰς ὕψος τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου εἰς τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: By the hand of your servants you have reproached the Lord : and have said: With the multitude of my chariots I have gone up to the height of the mountains, to the top of Libanus : and I will cut down its tall cedars , and its choice fir trees, and will enter to the top of its height, to the forest of its Carmel .
text_la: In manu servorum tuorum exprobrasti Domino, et dixisti : In multitudine quadrigarum mearum ego ascendi altitudinem montium juga Libani; et succidam excelsa cedrorum ejus, et electas abietes illius, et introibo altitudinem summitatis ejus, saltum Carmeli ejus.
text_pt: Por meio de teus servos afrontaste o Senhor, e disseste: Com a multidão dos meus carros subi eu aos cumes dos montes, aos últimos recessos do Líbano; e cortarei os seus altos cedros e as suas faias escolhidas, e entrarei na altura do seu cume, ao bosque do seu campo fértil.
text_el: ὅτι δι' ἀγγέλων ὠνείδισας κύριον σὺ γὰρ εἶπας τῷ πλήθει τῶν ἁρμάτων ἐγὼ ἀνέβην εἰς ὕψος ὀρέων καὶ εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ Λιβάνου καὶ ἔκοψα τὸ ὕψος τῆς κέδρου αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ κάλλος τῆς κυπαρίσσου καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς ὕψος μέρους τοῦ δρυμοῦ

text_en: I have digged, and drunk water, and have dried up with the sole of my foot, all the rivers shut up in banks.
text_la: Ego fodi, et bibi aquam, et exsiccavi vestigio pedis mei omnes rivos aggerum.
text_pt: Eu cavei, e bebi as águas; e com as plantas de meus pés sequei todos os rios dos lugares sitiados.
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκα γέφυραν καὶ ἠρήμωσα ὕδατα καὶ πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν ὕδατος

text_en: Have you not heard what I have done to him of old? From the days of old I have formed it: and now I have brought it to effect: and it has come to pass that hills fighting together, and fenced cities should be destroyed.
text_la: Numquid non audisti quæ olim fecerim ei? Ex diebus antiquis ego plasmavi illud; et nunc adduxi, et factum est in eradicationem collium compugnantium, et civitatum munitarum.
text_pt: Porventura não ouviste que já há muito tempo eu fiz isto, e já desde os dias antigos o tinha formado? Agora porém o fiz vir, para que tu fosses o que destruísse as cidades fortificadas, e as reduzisse a montões de ruínas.
text_el: οὐ ταῦτα ἤκουσας πάλαι ἃ ἐγὼ ἐποίησα ἐξ ἀρχαίων ἡμερῶν συνέταξα νῦν δὲ ἐπέδειξα ἐξερημῶσαι ἔθνη ἐν ὀχυροῖς καὶ ἐνοικοῦντας ἐν πόλεσιν ὀχυραῖς

text_en: The inhabitants of them were weak of hand, they trembled, and were confounded: they became like the grass of the field, and the herb of the pasture, and like the grass of the housetops, which withered before it was ripe.
text_la: Habitatores earum breviata manu contremuerunt, et confusi sunt. Facti sunt sicut fœnum agri, et gramen pascuæ, et herba tectorum, quæ exaruit antequam maturesceret.
text_pt: Por isso os seus moradores, dispondo de pouca força, andaram atemorizados e envergonhados; tornaram-se como a erva do campo, e a relva verde, e o feno dos telhados, e o trigo queimado antes da seara.
text_el: ἀνῆκα τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἐξηράνθησαν καὶ ἐγένοντο ὡς χόρτος ξηρὸς ἐπὶ δωμάτων καὶ ὡς ἄγρωστις

text_en: I know your dwelling, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against me.
text_la: Habitationem tuam, et egressum tuum, et introitum tuum cognovi, et insaniam tuam contra me.
text_pt: Porém eu conheço o teu assentar, e o teu sair, e o teu entrar, e o teu furor contra mim.
text_el: νῦν δὲ τὴν ἀνάπαυσίν σου καὶ τὴν ἔξοδόν σου καὶ τὴν εἴσοδόν σου ἐγὼ ἐπίσταμαι

text_en: When you were mad against me, your pride came up to my ears: therefore I will put a ring in your nose, and a bit between your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
text_la: Cum fureres adversum me, superbia tua ascendit in aures meas. Ponam ergo circulum in naribus tuis, et frenum in labiis tuis, et reducam te in viam per quem venisti.
text_pt: Por causa do teu furor contra mim, e porque a tua arrogância subiu até aos meus ouvidos, portanto porei o meu anzol no teu nariz e o meu freio nos teus lábios, e te farei voltar pelo caminho por onde vieste.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θυμός σου ὃν ἐθυμώθης καὶ ἡ πικρία σου ἀνέβη πρός με καὶ ἐμβαλῶ φιμὸν εἰς τὴν ῥῖνά σου καὶ χαλινὸν εἰς τὰ χείλη σου καὶ ἀποστρέψω σε τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἦλθες ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: But to you this shall be a sign: Eat this year the things that spring of themselves, and in the second year eat fruits: but in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
text_la: Tibi autem hoc erit signum : comede hoc anno quæ sponte nascuntur, et in anno secundo pomis vescere; in anno autem tertio seminate et metite, et plantate vineas, et comedite fructum earum.
text_pt: E isto te será por sinal: Este ano se comerá o que espontaneamente nascer, e no segundo ano o que daí proceder; porém no terceiro ano semeai e segai, e plantai vinhas, e comei os frutos delas.
text_el: τοῦτο δέ σοι τὸ σημεῖον φάγε τοῦτον τὸν ἐνιαυτὸν ἃ ἔσπαρκας τῷ δὲ ἐνιαυτῷ τῷ δευτέρῳ τὸ κατάλειμμα τῷ δὲ τρίτῳ σπείραντες ἀμήσατε καὶ φυτεύσατε ἀμπελῶνας καὶ φάγεσθε τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: And that which shall be saved of the house of Juda , and which is left, shall take root downward, and shall bear fruit upward:
text_la: Et mittet id quod salvatum fuerit de domo Juda, et quod reliquum est, radicem deorsum, et faciet fructum sursum:
text_pt: Porque o que escapou da casa de Judá, e restou, tornará a lançar raízes para baixo, e dará fruto para cima.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ καταλελειμμένοι ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ φυήσουσιν ῥίζαν κάτω καὶ ποιήσουσιν σπέρμα ἄνω

text_en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and salvation from mount Sion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
text_la: quia de Jerusalem exibunt reliquiæ, et salvatio de monte Sion : zelus Domini exercituum faciet istud.
text_pt: Porque de Jerusalém sairá o restante, e do monte de Sião os que escaparem; o zelo do Senhor dos Exércitos fará isto.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ ἐξελεύσονται οἱ καταλελειμμένοι καὶ οἱ σῳζόμενοι ἐξ ὄρους Σιων ὁ ζῆλος κυρίου σαβαωθ ποιήσει ταῦτα

text_en: Wherefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of the Assyrians : He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow into it, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a trench about it.
text_la: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus de rege Assyriorum : Non intrabit civitatem hanc, et non jaciet ibi sagittam, et non occupabit eam clypeus, et non mittet in circuitu ejus aggerem.
text_pt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor acerca do rei da Assíria: Não entrará nesta cidade, nem lançará nela flecha alguma; tampouco virá perante ela com escudo, ou levantará trincheira contra ela.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως λέγει κύριος ἐπὶ βασιλέα Ἀσσυρίων οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς τὴν πόλιν ταύτην οὐδὲ μὴ βάλῃ ἐπ' αὐτὴν βέλος οὐδὲ μὴ ἐπιβάλῃ ἐπ' αὐτὴν θυρεὸν οὐδὲ μὴ κυκλώσῃ ἐπ' αὐτὴν χάρακα

text_en: By the way that he came, he shall return, and into this city he shall not come, says the Lord .
text_la: In via qua venit, per eam revertetur, et civitatem hanc non ingredietur, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Pelo caminho por onde vier, por esse voltará; porém nesta cidade não entrará, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἀλλὰ τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἦλθεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἀποστραφήσεται τάδε λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will protect this city, and will save it for my own sake, and for the sake of David my servant.
text_la: Et protegam civitatem istam, ut salvem eam propter me, et propter David, servum meum.
text_pt: Porque eu ampararei esta cidade, para livrá-la, por amor de mim e por amor do meu servo Davi.
text_el: ὑπερασπιῶ ὑπὲρ τῆς πόλεως ταύτης τοῦ σῶσαι αὐτὴν δι' ἐμὲ καὶ διὰ Δαυιδ τὸν παῖδά μου

text_en: And the angel of the Lord went out and slew in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand. And they arose in the morning, and behold they were all dead corpses.
text_la: Egressus est autem angelus Domini, et percussit in castris Assyriorum centum octoginta quinque millia. Et surrexerunt mane, et ecce omnes cadavera mortuorum.
text_pt: Então saiu o anjo do Senhor, e feriu no arraial dos assírios a cento e oitenta e cinco mil deles; e, quando se levantaram pela manhã cedo, eis que todos estes eram corpos mortos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ ἀνεῖλεν ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς τῶν Ἀσσυρίων ἑκατὸν ὀγδοήκοντα πέντε χιλιάδας καὶ ἐξαναστάντες τὸ πρωὶ εὗρον πάντα τὰ σώματα νεκρά

text_en: And Sennacherib the king of the Assyrians went out and departed, and returned, and dwelt in Ninive.
text_la: Et egressus est, et abiit, et reversus est Sennacherib, rex Assyriorum, et habitavit in Ninive.
text_pt: Assim Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, se retirou, e se foi, e voltou, e habitou em Nínive.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστραφεὶς ἀπῆλθεν βασιλεὺς Ἀσσυρίων καὶ ᾤκησεν ἐν Νινευη

text_en: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the temple of Nesroch his god, that Adramelech and Sarasar his sons slew him with the sword: and they fled into the land of Ararat, and Asarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
text_la: Et factum est, cum adoraret in templo Nesroch deum suum, Adramelech et Sarasar, filii ejus, percusserunt eum gladio, fugeruntque in terram Ararat; et regnavit Asarhaddon, filius ejus, pro eo.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, estando ele prostrado na casa de Nisroque, seu deus, Adrameleque e Sarezer, seus filhos, o feriram à espada; escaparam para a terra de Ararate; e Esar-Hadom, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν προσκυνεῖν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Νασαραχ τὸν παταχρον αὐτοῦ Αδραμελεχ καὶ Σαρασαρ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπάταξαν αὐτὸν μαχαίραις αὐτοὶ δὲ διεσώθησαν εἰς Ἀρμενίαν καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ασορδαν ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: In those days Ezechias was sick even to death, and Isaiah the son of Amos the prophet came unto him, and said to him: Thus says the Lord : Take order with your house, for you shall die, and not live.
text_la: In diebus illis ægrotavit Ezechias usque ad mortem; et introivit ad eum Isaias, filius Amos, propheta, et dixit ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Dispone domui tuæ, quia morieris tu, et non vives.
text_pt: Naqueles dias Ezequias adoeceu de uma enfermidade mortal; e veio a ele o profeta Isaías, filho de Amós, e lhe disse: Assim diz o SENHOR: Põe em ordem a tua casa, porque morrerás, e não viverás.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἐμαλακίσθη Εζεκιας ἕως θανάτου καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ησαιας υἱὸς Αμως ὁ προφήτης καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος τάξαι περὶ τοῦ οἴκου σου ἀποθνῄσκεις γὰρ σὺ καὶ οὐ ζήσῃ

text_en: And Ezechias turned his face toward the wall, and prayed to the Lord ,
text_la: Et convertit Ezechias faciem suam ad parietem, et oravit ad Dominum,
text_pt: Então virou Ezequias o seu rosto para a parede, e orou ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Εζεκιας τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν τοῖχον καὶ προσηύξατο πρὸς κύριον

text_en: and said: I beseech you, O Lord , remember how I have walked before you in truth , and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight. And Ezechias wept with great weeping.
text_la: et dixit : Obsecro, Domine, memento, quæso, quomodo ambulaverim coram te in veritate et in corde perfecto, et quod bonum est in oculis tuis fecerim. Et flevit Ezechias fletu magno.
text_pt: E disse: Ah! Senhor, peço-te, lembra-te agora, de que andei diante de ti em verdade, e com coração perfeito, e fiz o que era reto aos teus olhos. E chorou Ezequias muitíssimo.
text_el: λέγων μνήσθητι κύριε ὡς ἐπορεύθην ἐνώπιόν σου μετὰ ἀληθείας ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀληθινῇ καὶ τὰ ἀρεστὰ ἐνώπιόν σου ἐποίησα καὶ ἔκλαυσεν Εζεκιας κλαυθμῷ μεγάλῳ

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Isaiah , saying:
text_la: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Isaiam, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a palavra do Senhor a Isaías, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ησαιαν λέγων

text_en: Go and say to Ezechias : Thus says the Lord the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer , and I have seen your tears: behold I will add to your days fifteen years:
text_la: Vade, et dic Ezechiæ : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus David patris tui : Audivi orationem tuam, et vidi lacrimas tuas; ecce ego adjiciam super dies tuos quindecim annos,
text_pt: Vai, e dize a Ezequias: Assim diz o Senhor, o Deus de Davi teu pai: Ouvi a tua oração, e vi as tuas lágrimas; eis que acrescentarei aos teus dias quinze anos.
text_el: πορεύθητι καὶ εἰπὸν Εζεκια τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρός σου ἤκουσα τῆς φωνῆς τῆς προσευχῆς σου καὶ εἶδον τὰ δάκρυά σου ἰδοὺ προστίθημι πρὸς τὸν χρόνον σου ἔτη δέκα πέντε

text_en: And I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians , and I will protect it.
text_la: et de manu regis Assyriorum eruam te, et civitatem istam, et protegam eam.
text_pt: E livrar-te-ei das mãos do rei da Assíria, a ti, e a esta cidade, e defenderei esta cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων σώσω σε καὶ ὑπὲρ τῆς πόλεως ταύτης ὑπερασπιῶ

text_en: And this shall be a sign to you from the Lord , that the Lord will do this word which he has spoken:
text_la: Hoc autem tibi erit signum a Domino, quia faciet Dominus verbum hoc quod locutus est:
text_pt: E isto te será da parte do Senhor como sinal de que o Senhor cumprirá esta palavra que falou.
text_el: τοῦτο δέ σοι τὸ σημεῖον παρὰ κυρίου ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ποιήσει τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: Behold I will bring again the shadow of the lines, by which it is now gone down in the sun dial of Achaz with the sun, ten lines backward. And the sun returned ten lines by the degrees by which it had gone down.
text_la: ecce ego reverti faciam umbram linearum per quas descenderat in horologio Achaz in sole, retrorsum decem lineis. Et reversus est sol decem lineis per gradus quos descenderat.
text_pt: Eis que farei retroceder dez graus a sombra lançada pelo sol declinante no relógio de Acaz. Assim retrocedeu o sol os dez graus que já tinha declinado.
text_el: τὴν σκιὰν τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν οὓς κατέβη ὁ ἥλιος τοὺς δέκα ἀναβαθμοὺς τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός σου ἀποστρέψω τὸν ἥλιον τοὺς δέκα ἀναβαθμούς καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ ἥλιος τοὺς δέκα ἀναβαθμούς οὓς κατέβη ἡ σκιά

text_en: The writing of Ezechias king of Juda , when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness.
text_la: Scriptura Ezechiæ, regis Juda, cum ægrotasset et convaluisset de infirmitate sua.
text_pt: O escrito de Ezequias, rei de Judá, de quando adoeceu e sarou de sua enfermidade:
text_el: προσευχὴ Εζεκιου βασιλέως τῆς Ιουδαίας ἡνίκα ἐμαλακίσθη καὶ ἀνέστη ἐκ τῆς μαλακίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: I said: In the midst of my days I shall go to the gates of hell: I sought for the residue of my years.
text_la: Ego dixi in dimidio dierum meorum : Vadam ad portas inferi; quæsivi residuum annorum meorum.
text_pt: Eu disse: No cessar de meus dias ir-me-ei às portas da sepultura; já estou privado do restante de meus anos.
text_el: ἐγὼ εἶπα ἐν τῷ ὕψει τῶν ἡμερῶν μου ἐν πύλαις ᾅδου καταλείψω τὰ ἔτη τὰ ἐπίλοιπα

text_en: I said: I shall not see the Lord God in the land of the living. I shall behold man no more, nor the inhabitant of rest.
text_la: Dixi : Non videbo Dominum Deum in terra viventium; non aspiciam hominem ultra, et habitatorem quietis.
text_pt: Disse: Não verei ao Senhor, o Senhor na terra dos viventes; jamais verei o homem com os moradores do mundo.
text_el: εἶπα οὐκέτι μὴ ἴδω τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐκέτι μὴ ἴδω ἄνθρωπον

text_en: My generation is at an end, and it is rolled away from me, as a shepherd's tent. My life is cut off, as by a weaver: whilst I was yet but beginning, he cut me off: from morning even to night you will make an end of me.
text_la: Generatio mea ablata est, et convoluta est a me, quasi tabernaculum pastorum. Præcisa est velut a texente vita mea; dum adhuc ordirer, succidit me : de mane usque ad vesperam finies me.
text_pt: Já o tempo da minha vida se foi, e foi arrebatada de mim, como tenda de pastor; cortei a minha vida como tecelão; ele me cortará do tear; desde a manhã até à noite me acabarás.
text_el: ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας μου κατέλιπον τὸ λοιπὸν τῆς ζωῆς μου ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ὥσπερ ὁ καταλύων σκηνὴν πήξας τὸ πνεῦμά μου παρ' ἐμοὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἱστὸς ἐρίθου ἐγγιζούσης ἐκτεμεῖν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ παρεδόθην

text_en: I hoped till morning, as a lion so has he broken all my bones: from morning even to night you will make an end of me.
text_la: Sperabam usque ad mane; quasi leo, sic contrivit omnia ossa mea : de mane usque ad vesperam finies me.
text_pt: Esperei com paciência até à madrugada; como um leão quebrou todos os meus ossos; desde a manhã até à noite me acabarás.
text_el: ἕως πρωὶ ὡς λέοντι οὕτως τὰ ὀστᾶ μου συνέτριψεν ἀπὸ γὰρ τῆς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς νυκτὸς παρεδόθην

text_en: I will cry like a young swallow, I will meditate like a dove : my eyes are weakened looking upward: Lord , I suffer violence ; answer for me.
text_la: Sicut pullus hirundinis, sic clamabo; meditabor ut columba. Attenuati sunt oculi mei, suspicientes in excelsum. Domine, vim patior : responde pro me.
text_pt: Como o grou, ou a andorinha, assim eu chilreava, e gemia como a pomba; alçava os meus olhos ao alto; ó Senhor, ando oprimido, fica por meu fiador.
text_el: ὡς χελιδών οὕτως φωνήσω καὶ ὡς περιστερά οὕτως μελετήσω ἐξέλιπον γάρ μου οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ τοῦ βλέπειν εἰς τὸ ὕψος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πρὸς τὸν κύριον ὃς ἐξείλατό με

text_en: What shall I say, or what shall he answer for me, whereas he himself has done it? I will recount to you all my years in the bitterness of my soul .
text_la: Quid dicam, aut quid respondebit mihi, cum ipse fecerit? Recogitabo tibi omnes annos meos in amaritudine animæ meæ.
text_pt: Que direi? Como me prometeu, assim o fez; assim passarei mansamente por todos os meus anos, por causa da amargura da minha alma.
text_el: καὶ ἀφείλατό μου τὴν ὀδύνην τῆς ψυχῆς

text_en: O Lord , if man's life be such, and the life of my spirit be in such things as these, you shall correct me, and make me to live.
text_la: Domine, si sic vivitur, et in talibus vita spiritus mei, corripies me, et vivificabis me.
text_pt: Senhor, por estas coisas se vive, e em todas elas está a vida do meu espírito, portanto cura-me e faze-me viver.
text_el: κύριε περὶ αὐτῆς γὰρ ἀνηγγέλη σοι καὶ ἐξήγειράς μου τὴν πνοήν καὶ παρακληθεὶς ἔζησα

text_en: Behold in peace is my bitterness most bitter: but you have delivered my soul that it should not perish, you have cast all my sins behind your back.
text_la: Ecce in pace amaritudo mea amarissima. Tu autem eruisti animam meam ut non periret; projecisti post tergum tuum omnia peccata mea.
text_pt: Eis que foi para a minha paz que tive grande amargura, mas a ti agradou livrar a minha alma da cova da corrupção; porque lançaste para trás das tuas costas todos os meus pecados.
text_el: εἵλου γάρ μου τὴν ψυχήν ἵνα μὴ ἀπόληται καὶ ἀπέρριψας ὀπίσω μου πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας μου

text_en: For hell shall not confess to you, neither shall death praise you: nor shall they that go down into the pit, look for your truth .
text_la: Quia non infernus confitebitur tibi, neque mors laudabit te : non exspectabunt qui descendunt in lacum veritatem tuam.
text_pt: Porque não te louvará a sepultura, nem a morte te glorificará; nem esperarão em tua verdade os que descem à cova.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ οἱ ἐν ᾅδου αἰνέσουσίν σε οὐδὲ οἱ ἀποθανόντες εὐλογήσουσίν σε οὐδὲ ἐλπιοῦσιν οἱ ἐν ᾅδου τὴν ἐλεημοσύνην σου

text_en: The living, the living, he shall give praise to you, as I do this day: the father shall make the truth known to the children.
text_la: Vivens, vivens ipse confitebitur tibi, sicut et ego hodie; pater filiis notam faciet veritatem tuam.
text_pt: O vivente, o vivente, esse te louvará, como eu hoje o faço; o pai aos filhos fará notória a tua verdade.
text_el: οἱ ζῶντως εὐλογήσουσίν σε ὃν τρόπον κἀγώ ἀπὸ γὰρ τῆς σήμερον παιδία ποιήσω ἃ ἀναγγελοῦσιν τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου

text_en: O Lord , save me, and we will sing our psalms all the days of our life in the house of the Lord .
text_la: Domine, salvum me fac! et psalmos nostros cantabimus cunctis diebus vitæ nostræ in domo Domini.
text_pt: O Senhor veio salvar-me; por isso, tangendo em meus instrumentos, nós o louvaremos todos os dias de nossa vida na casa do Senhor.
text_el: κύριε τῆς σωτηρίας μου καὶ οὐ παύσομαι εὐλογῶν σε μετὰ ψαλτηρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου κατέναντι τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: Now Isaiah had ordered that they should take a lump of figs, and lay it as a plaster upon the wound, and that he should be healed.
text_la: Et jussit Isaias ut tollerent massam de ficis, et cataplasmarent super vulnus, et sanaretur.
text_pt: E dissera Isaías: Tomem uma pasta de figos, e a ponham como emplastro sobre a chaga; e sarará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ησαιας πρὸς Εζεκιαν λαβὲ παλάθην ἐκ σύκων καὶ τρῖψον καὶ κατάπλασαι καὶ ὑγιὴς ἔσῃ

text_en: And Ezechias had said: What shall be the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord ?
text_la: Et dixit Ezechias : Quod erit signum quia ascendam in domum Domini?
text_pt: Também dissera Ezequias: Qual será o sinal de que hei de subir à casa do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας τοῦτο τὸ σημεῖον ὅτι ἀναβήσομαι εἰς τὸν οἶκον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: At that time Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan king of Babylon , sent letters and presents to Ezechias : for he had heard that he had been sick and was recovered.
text_la: In tempore illo misit Merodach Baladan, filius Baladan, rex Babylonis, libros et munera ad Ezechiam : audierat enim quod ægrotasset et convaluisset.
text_pt: Naquele tempo enviou Merodaque-Baladã, filho de Baladã, rei de babilônia, cartas e um presente a Ezequias, porque tinha ouvido dizer que havia estado doente e que já tinha convalescido.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀπέστειλεν Μαρωδαχ υἱὸς τοῦ Λααδαν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς Βαβυλωνίας ἐπιστολὰς καὶ πρέσβεις καὶ δῶρα Εζεκια ἤκουσεν γὰρ ὅτι ἐμαλακίσθη ἕως θανάτου καὶ ἀνέστη

text_en: And Ezechias rejoiced at their coming, and he showed them the storehouses of his aromatical spices, and of the silver, and of the gold, and of the sweet odours, and of the precious ointment , and all the storehouses of his furniture, and all things that were found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion that Ezechias showed them not.
text_la: Lætatus est autem super eis Ezechias, et ostendit eis cellam aromatum, et argenti, et auri, et odoramentorum, et unguenti optimi, et omnes apothecas supellectilis suæ, et universa quæ inventa sunt in thesauris ejus. Non fuit verbum quod non ostenderet eis Ezechias in domo sua, et in omni potestate sua.
text_pt: E Ezequias se alegrou com eles, e lhes mostrou a casa do seu tesouro, a prata, e o ouro, e as especiarias, e os melhores ungüentos, e toda a sua casa de armas, e tudo quanto se achava nos seus tesouros; coisa nenhuma houve, nem em sua casa, nem em todo o seu domínio, que Ezequias não lhes mostrasse.
text_el: καὶ ἐχάρη ἐπ' αὐτοῖς Εζεκιας χαρὰν μεγάλην καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ νεχωθα καὶ τῆς στακτῆς καὶ τῶν θυμιαμάτων καὶ τοῦ μύρου καὶ τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ τοῦ χρυσίου καὶ πάντας τοὺς οἴκους τῶν σκευῶν τῆς γάζης καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἦν ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἦν οὐθέν ὃ οὐκ ἔδειξεν Εζεκιας ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Ezechias , and said to him: What said these men , and from whence came they to you? And Ezechias said: From a far country they came to me, from Babylon .
text_la: Introivit autem Isaias propheta ad Ezechiam regem, et dixit ei : Quid dixerunt viri isti, et unde venerunt ad te? Et dixit Ezechias : De terra longinqua venerunt ad me, de Babylone.
text_pt: Então o profeta Isaías veio ao rei Ezequias, e lhe disse: Que foi que aqueles homens disseram, e de onde vieram a ti? E disse Ezequias: De uma terra remota vieram a mim, de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ησαιας ὁ προφήτης πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Εζεκιαν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν τί λέγουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι οὗτοι καὶ πόθεν ἥκασιν πρὸς σέ καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας ἐκ γῆς πόρρωθεν ἥκασιν πρός με ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And he said: What saw they in your house? And Ezechias said: All things that are in my house have they seen, there was not anything which I have not shown them in my treasures.
text_la: Et dixit : Quid viderunt in domo tua? Et dixit Ezechias : Omnia quæ in domo mea sunt viderunt; non fuit res quam non ostenderim eis in thesauris meis.
text_pt: E disse ele: Que foi que viram em tua casa? E disse Ezequias: Viram tudo quanto há em minha casa; coisa nenhuma há nos meus tesouros que eu deixasse de lhes mostrar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ησαιας τί εἴδοσαν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας πάντα τὰ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου εἴδοσαν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου ὃ οὐκ εἴδοσαν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς μου

text_en: And Isaiah said to Ezechias : Hear the word of the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Et dixit Isaias ad Ezechiam : Audi verbum Domini exercituum.
text_pt: Então disse Isaías a Ezequias: Ouve a palavra do Senhor dos Exércitos:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ησαιας ἄκουσον τὸν λόγον κυρίου σαβαωθ

text_en: Behold the days shall come that all that is in your house, and that your fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried away into Babylon : there shall not anything be left, says the Lord .
text_la: Ecce dies venient, et auferentur omnia quæ in domo tua sunt, et quæ thesaurizaverunt patres tui usque ad diem hanc, in Babylonem; non relinquetur quidquam, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Eis que virão dias em que tudo quanto houver em tua casa, e o que entesouraram teus pais até ao dia de hoje, será levado para babilônia; não ficará coisa alguma, disse o SENHOR.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται λέγει κύριος καὶ λήμψονται πάντα τὰ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου καὶ ὅσα συνήγαγον οἱ πατέρες σου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἥξει καὶ οὐδὲν οὐ μὴ καταλίπωσιν εἶπεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς

text_en: And of your children, that shall issue from you, whom you shall beget, they shall take away, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
text_la: Et de filiis tuis, qui exibunt de te, quos genueris, tollent, et erunt eunuchi in palatio regis Babylonis.
text_pt: E até de teus filhos, que procederem de ti, e tu gerares, tomarão, para que sejam eunucos no palácio do rei de babilônia.
text_el: ὅτι καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν τέκνων σου ὧν ἐγέννησας λήμψονται καὶ ποιήσουσιν σπάδοντας ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ βασιλέως τῶν Βαβυλωνίων

text_en: And Ezechias said to Isaiah : The word of the Lord , which he has spoken, is good . And he said: Only let peace and truth be in my days.
text_la: Et dixit Ezechias ad Isaiam : Bonum verbum Domini, quod locutus est. Et dixit : Fiat tantum pax et veritas in diebus meis!
text_pt: Então disse Ezequias a Isaías: Boa é a palavra do Senhor que disseste. Disse mais: Pois haverá paz e verdade em meus dias.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εζεκιας πρὸς Ησαιαν ἀγαθὸς ὁ λόγος κυρίου ὃν ἐλάλησεν γενέσθω δὴ εἰρήνη καὶ δικαιοσύνη ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις μου

text_en: Be comforted, be comforted, my people, says your God .
text_la: Consolamini, consolamini, popule meus, dicit Deus vester.
text_pt: Consolai, consolai o meu povo, diz o vosso Deus.
text_el: παρακαλεῖτε παρακαλεῖτε τὸν λαόν μου λέγει ὁ θεός

text_en: Speak to the heart of Jerusalem , and call to her: for her evil has come to an end, her iniquity is forgiven: she has received of the hand of the Lord double for all her sins .
text_la: Loquimini ad cor Jerusalem, et advocate eam, quoniam completa est malitia ejus, dimissa est iniquitas illius : suscepit de manu Domini duplicia pro omnibus peccatis suis.
text_pt: Falai benignamente a Jerusalém, e bradai-lhe que já a sua milícia é acabada, que a sua iniqüidade está expiada e que já recebeu em dobro da mão do Senhor, por todos os seus pecados.
text_el: ἱερεῖς λαλήσατε εἰς τὴν καρδίαν Ιερουσαλημ παρακαλέσατε αὐτήν ὅτι ἐπλήσθη ἡ ταπείνωσις αὐτῆς λέλυται αὐτῆς ἡ ἁμαρτία ὅτι ἐδέξατο ἐκ χειρὸς κυρίου διπλᾶ τὰ ἁμαρτήματα αὐτῆς

text_en: The voice of one crying in the desert : Prepare the way of the Lord , make straight in the wilderness the paths of our God .
text_la: Vox clamantis in deserto : Parate viam Domini, rectas facite in solitudine semitas Dei nostri.
text_pt: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor; endireitai no ermo vereda a nosso Deus.
text_el: φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low, and the crooked shall become straight, and the rough ways plain.
text_la: Omnis vallis exaltabitur, et omnis mons et collis humiliabitur, et erunt prava in directa, et aspera in vias planas :
text_pt: Todo o vale será exaltado, e todo o monte e todo o outeiro será abatido; e o que é torcido se endireitará, e o que é áspero se aplainará.
text_el: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς ταπεινωθήσεται καὶ ἔσται πάντα τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς εὐθεῖαν καὶ ἡ τραχεῖα εἰς πεδία

text_en: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh together shall see, that the mouth of the Lord has spoken.
text_la: et revelabitur gloria Domini, et videbit omnis caro pariter quod os Domini locutum est.
text_pt: E a glória do Senhor se manifestará, e toda a carne juntamente a verá, pois a boca do Senhor o disse.
text_el: καὶ ὀφθήσεται ἡ δόξα κυρίου καὶ ὄψεται πᾶσα σὰρξ τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ὅτι κύριος ἐλάλησεν

text_en: The voice of one, saying: Cry. And I said: What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the glory thereof as the flower of the field.
text_la: Vox dicentis : Clama. Et dixi : Quid clamabo? Omnis caro fœnum, et omnis gloria ejus quasi flos agri.
text_pt: Uma voz diz: Clama; e alguém disse: Que hei de clamar? Toda a carne é erva e toda a sua beleza como a flor do campo.
text_el: φωνὴ λέγοντος βόησον καὶ εἶπα τί βοήσω πᾶσα σὰρξ χόρτος καὶ πᾶσα δόξα ἀνθρώπου ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου

text_en: The grass is withered, and the flower is fallen, because the spirit of the Lord has blown upon it. Indeed the people is grass:
text_la: Exsiccatum est fœnum, et cecidit flos, quia spiritus Domini sufflavit in eo. Vere fœnum est populus :
text_pt: Seca-se a erva, e cai a flor, soprando nela o Espírito do Senhor. Na verdade o povo é erva.
text_el: ἐξηράνθη ὁ χόρτος καὶ τὸ ἄνθος ἐξέπεσεν

text_en: The grass is withered, and the flower is fallen: but the word of our Lord endures for ever.
text_la: exsiccatum est fœnum, et cecidit flos; verbum autem Domini nostri manet in æternum.
text_pt: Seca-se a erva, e cai a flor, porém a palavra de nosso Deus subsiste eternamente.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Get you up upon a high mountain, you that bring good tidings to Sion : lift up your voice with strength, you that bring good tidings to Jerusalem : lift it up, fear not. Say to the cities of Juda : Behold your God :
text_la: Super montem excelsum ascende, tu qui evangelizas Sion; exalta in fortitudine vocem tuam, qui evangelizas Jerusalem : exalta, noli timere. Dic civitatibus Juda : Ecce Deus vester :
text_pt: Tu, ó Sião, que anuncias boas novas, sobe a um monte alto. Tu, ó Jerusalém, que anuncias boas novas, levanta a tua voz fortemente; levanta-a, não temas, e dize às cidades de Judá: Eis aqui está o vosso Deus.
text_el: ἐπ' ὄρος ὑψηλὸν ἀνάβηθι ὁ εὐαγγελιζόμενος Σιων ὕψωσον τῇ ἰσχύι τὴν φωνήν σου ὁ εὐαγγελιζόμενος Ιερουσαλημ ὑψώσατε μὴ φοβεῖσθε εἰπὸν ταῖς πόλεσιν Ιουδα ἰδοὺ ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: Behold the Lord God shall come with strength, and his arm shall rule: Behold his reward is with him and his work is before him.
text_la: ecce Dominus Deus in fortitudine veniet, et brachium ejus dominabitur : ecce merces ejus cum eo, et opus illius coram illo.
text_pt: Eis que o Senhor DEUS virá com poder e seu braço dominará por ele; eis que o seu galardão está com ele, e o seu salário diante da sua face.
text_el: ἰδοὺ κύριος μετὰ ἰσχύος ἔρχεται καὶ ὁ βραχίων μετὰ κυριείας ἰδοὺ ὁ μισθὸς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ἔργον ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather together the lambs with his arm, and shall take them up in his bosom, and he himself shall carry them that are with young.
text_la: Sicut pastor gregem suum pascet, in brachio suo congregabit agnos, et in sinu suo levabit; fœtas ipse portabit.
text_pt: Como pastor apascentará o seu rebanho; entre os seus braços recolherá os cordeirinhos, e os levará no seu regaço; as que amamentam guiará suavemente.
text_el: ὡς ποιμὴν ποιμανεῖ τὸ ποίμνιον αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ βραχίονι αὐτοῦ συνάξει ἄρνας καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσας παρακαλέσει

text_en: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and weighed the heavens with his palm? Who has poised with three fingers the bulk of the earth, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
text_la: Quis mensus est pugillo aquas, et cælos palmo ponderavit? quis appendit tribus digitis molem terræ, et liberavit in pondere montes, et colles in statera?
text_pt: Quem mediu na concha da sua mão as águas, e tomou a medida dos céus aos palmos, e recolheu numa medida o pó da terra e pesou os montes com peso e os outeiros em balanças?
text_el: τίς ἐμέτρησεν τῇ χειρὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ τὸν οὐρανὸν σπιθαμῇ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν δρακί τίς ἔστησεν τὰ ὄρη σταθμῷ καὶ τὰς νάπας ζυγῷ

text_en: Who has forwarded the spirit of the Lord ? Or who has been his counsellor, and has taught him?
text_la: Quis adjuvit spiritum Domini? aut quis consiliarius ejus fuit, et ostendit illi?
text_pt: Quem guiou o Espírito do Senhor, ou como seu conselheiro o ensinou?
text_el: τίς ἔγνω νοῦν κυρίου καὶ τίς αὐτοῦ σύμβουλος ἐγένετο ὃς συμβιβᾷ αὐτόν

text_en: With whom has he consulted, and who has instructed him, and taught him the path of justice , and taught him knowledge , and showed him the way of understanding?
text_la: cum quo iniit consilium, et instruxit eum, et docuit eum semitam justitiæ, et erudivit eum scientiam, et viam prudentiæ ostendit illi?
text_pt: Com quem tomou ele conselho, que lhe desse entendimento, e lhe ensinasse o caminho do juízo, e lhe ensinasse conhecimento, e lhe mostrasse o caminho do entendimento?
text_el: ἢ πρὸς τίνα συνεβουλεύσατο καὶ συνεβίβασεν αὐτόν ἢ τίς ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ κρίσιν ἢ ὁδὸν συνέσεως τίς ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ

text_en: Behold the Gentiles are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the smallest grain of a balance: behold the islands are as a little dust.
text_la: Ecce gentes quasi stilla situlæ, et quasi momentum stateræ reputatæ sunt; ecce insulæ quasi pulvis exiguus.
text_pt: Eis que as nações são consideradas por ele como a gota de um balde, e como o pó miúdo das balanças; eis que ele levanta as ilhas como a uma coisa pequeníssima.
text_el: εἰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὡς σταγὼν ἀπὸ κάδου καὶ ὡς ῥοπὴ ζυγοῦ ἐλογίσθησαν καὶ ὡς σίελος λογισθήσονται

text_en: And Libanus shall not be enough to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering .
text_la: Et Libanus non sufficiet ad succendendum, et animalia ejus non sufficient ad holocaustum.
text_pt: Nem todo o Líbano basta para o fogo, nem os seus animais bastam para holocaustos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Λίβανος οὐχ ἱκανὸς εἰς καῦσιν καὶ πάντα τὰ τετράποδα οὐχ ἱκανὰ εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν

text_en: All nations are before him as if they had no being at all, and are counted to him as nothing, and vanity.
text_la: Omnes gentes quasi non sint, sic sunt coram eo, et quasi nihilum et inane reputatæ sunt ei.
text_pt: Todas as nações são como nada perante ele; ele as considera menos do que nada e como uma coisa vã.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὡς οὐδέν εἰσι καὶ εἰς οὐθὲν ἐλογίσθησαν

text_en: To whom then have you likened God ? Or what image will you make for him?
text_la: Cui ergo similem fecisti Deum? aut quam imaginem ponetis ei?
text_pt: A quem, pois, fareis semelhante a Deus, ou com que o comparareis?
text_el: τίνι ὡμοιώσατε κύριον καὶ τίνι ὁμοιώματι ὡμοιώσατε αὐτόν

text_en: Hath the workman cast a graven statue? Or has the goldsmith formed it with gold, or the silversmith with plates of silver?
text_la: Numquid sculptile conflavit faber? aut aurifex auro figuravit illud, et laminis argenteis argentarius?
text_pt: O artífice funde a imagem, e o ourives a cobre de ouro, e forja para ela cadeias de prata.
text_el: μὴ εἰκόνα ἐποίησεν τέκτων ἢ χρυσοχόος χωνεύσας χρυσίον περιεχρύσωσεν αὐτόν ὁμοίωμα κατεσκεύασεν αὐτόν

text_en: He has chosen strong wood, and that will not rot: the skilful workman seeks how he may set up an idol that may not be moved.
text_la: Forte lignum et imputribile elegit; artifex sapiens quærit quomodo statuat simulacrum, quod non moveatur.
text_pt: O empobrecido, que não pode oferecer tanto, escolhe madeira que não se apodrece; artífice sábio busca, para gravar uma imagem que não se pode mover.
text_el: ξύλον γὰρ ἄσηπτον ἐκλέγεται τέκτων καὶ σοφῶς ζητεῖ πῶς στήσει αὐτοῦ εἰκόνα καὶ ἵνα μὴ σαλεύηται

text_en: Do you not know ? Has it not been heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood the foundations of the earth?
text_la: Numquid non scitis? numquid non audistis? numquid non annuntiatum est vobis ab initio? numquid non intellexistis fundamenta terræ?
text_pt: Porventura não sabeis? Porventura não ouvis, ou desde o princípio não se vos notificou, ou não atentastes para os fundamentos da terra?
text_el: οὐ γνώσεσθε οὐκ ἀκούσεσθε οὐκ ἀνηγγέλη ἐξ ἀρχῆς ὑμῖν οὐκ ἔγνωτε τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς

text_en: It is he that sits upon the globe of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as locusts: he that stretches out the heavens as nothing, and spreads them out as a tent to dwell in.
text_la: Qui sedet super gyrum terræ, et habitatores ejus sunt quasi locustæ; qui extendit velut nihilum cælos, et expandit eos sicut tabernaculum ad inhabitandum;
text_pt: Ele é o que está assentado sobre o círculo da terra, cujos moradores são para ele como gafanhotos; é ele o que estende os céus como cortina, e os desenrola como tenda, para neles habitar;
text_el: ὁ κατέχων τὸν γῦρον τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ ὡς ἀκρίδες ὁ στήσας ὡς καμάραν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ διατείνας ὡς σκηνὴν κατοικεῖν

text_en: He that brings the searchers of secrets to nothing, that has made the judges of the earth as vanity.
text_la: qui dat secretorum scrutatores quasi non sint, judices terræ velut inane fecit.
text_pt: O que reduz a nada os príncipes, e torna em coisa vã os juízes da terra.
text_el: ὁ διδοὺς ἄρχοντας εἰς οὐδὲν ἄρχειν τὴν δὲ γῆν ὡς οὐδὲν ἐποίησεν

text_en: And surely their stock was neither planted, nor sown, nor rooted in the earth: suddenly he has blown upon them, and they are withered, and a whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
text_la: Et quidem neque plantatus, neque satus, neque radicatus in terra truncus eorum; repente flavit in eos, et aruerunt, et turbo quasi stipulam auferet eos.
text_pt: E mal se tem plantado, mal se tem semeado, e mal se tem arraigado na terra o seu tronco, já se secam, quando ele sopra sobre eles, e um tufão os leva como a pragana.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ μὴ σπείρωσιν οὐδὲ μὴ φυτεύσωσιν οὐδὲ μὴ ῥιζωθῇ εἰς τὴν γῆν ἡ ῥίζα αὐτῶν ἔπνευσεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐξηράνθησαν καὶ καταιγὶς ὡς φρύγανα ἀναλήμψεται αὐτούς

text_en: And to whom have you likened me, or made me equal, says the Holy One?
text_la: Et cui assimilastis me, et adæquastis? dicit Sanctus.
text_pt: A quem, pois, me fareis semelhante, para que eu lhe seja igual? diz o Santo.
text_el: νῦν οὖν τίνι με ὡμοιώσατε καὶ ὑψωθήσομαι εἶπεν ὁ ἅγιος

text_en: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these things: who brings out their host by number, and calls them all by their names : by the greatness of his might, and strength, and power, not one of them was missing.
text_la: Levate in excelsum oculos vestros, et videte quis creavit hæc : qui educit in numero militiam eorum, et omnes ex nomine vocat; præ multitudine fortitudinis et roboris, virtutisque ejus, neque unum reliquum fuit.
text_pt: Levantai ao alto os vossos olhos, e vede quem criou estas coisas; foi aquele que faz sair o exército delas segundo o seu número; ele as chama a todas pelos seus nomes; por causa da grandeza das suas forças, e porquanto é forte em poder, nenhuma delas faltará.
text_el: ἀναβλέψατε εἰς ὕψος τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ ἴδετε τίς κατέδειξεν πάντα ταῦτα ὁ ἐκφέρων κατὰ ἀριθμὸν τὸν κόσμον αὐτοῦ πάντας ἐπ' ὀνόματι καλέσει ἀπὸ πολλῆς δόξης καὶ ἐν κράτει ἰσχύος οὐδέν σε ἔλαθεν

text_en: Why do you say, O Jacob , and speak, O Israel : My way is hid from the Lord , and my judgment is passed over from my God ?
text_la: Quare dicis, Jacob, et loqueris, Israël : Abscondita est via mea a Domino, et a Deo meo judicium meum transivit?
text_pt: Por que dizes, ó Jacó, e tu falas, ó Israel: O meu caminho está encoberto ao Senhor, e o meu juízo passa despercebido ao meu Deus?
text_el: μὴ γὰρ εἴπῃς Ιακωβ καὶ τί ἐλάλησας Ισραηλ ἀπεκρύβη ἡ ὁδός μου ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ὁ θεός μου τὴν κρίσιν ἀφεῖλεν καὶ ἀπέστη

text_en: Do you not know, or have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God , who has created the ends of the earth: he shall not faint, nor labour, neither is there any searching out of his wisdom.
text_la: Numquid nescis, aut non audisti? Deus sempiternus Dominus, qui creavit terminos terræ : non deficiet, neque laborabit, nec est investigatio sapientiæ ejus.
text_pt: Não sabes, não ouviste que o eterno Deus, o Senhor, o Criador dos fins da terra, nem se cansa nem se fatiga? É inescrutável o seu entendimento.
text_el: καὶ νῦν οὐκ ἔγνως εἰ μὴ ἤκουσας θεὸς αἰώνιος ὁ θεὸς ὁ κατασκευάσας τὰ ἄκρα τῆς γῆς οὐ πεινάσει οὐδὲ κοπιάσει οὐδὲ ἔστιν ἐξεύρεσις τῆς φρονήσεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: It is he that gives strength to the weary, and increases force and might to them that are not.
text_la: Qui dat lasso virtutem, et his qui non sunt, fortitudinem et robur multiplicat.
text_pt: Dá força ao cansado, e multiplica as forças ao que não tem nenhum vigor.
text_el: διδοὺς τοῖς πεινῶσιν ἰσχὺν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὀδυνωμένοις λύπην

text_en: You shall faint, and labour, and young men shall fall by infirmity.
text_la: Deficient pueri, et laborabunt, et juvenes in infirmitate cadent;
text_pt: Os jovens se cansarão e se fatigarão, e os moços certamente cairão;
text_el: πεινάσουσιν γὰρ νεώτεροι καὶ κοπιάσουσιν νεανίσκοι καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ ἀνίσχυες ἔσονται

text_en: But they that hope in the Lord shall renew their strength, they shall take wings as eagles, they shall run and not be weary, they shall walk and not faint.
text_la: qui autem sperant in Domino mutabunt fortitudinem, assument pennas sicut aquilæ : current et non laborabunt, ambulabunt et non deficient.
text_pt: Mas os que esperam no Senhor renovarão as forças, subirão com asas como águias; correrão, e não se cansarão; caminharão, e não se fatigarão.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὑπομένοντες τὸν θεὸν ἀλλάξουσιν ἰσχύν πτεροφυήσουσιν ὡς ἀετοί δραμοῦνται καὶ οὐ κοπιάσουσιν βαδιοῦνται καὶ οὐ πεινάσουσιν

text_en: Let the islands keep silence before me, and the nations take new strength: let them come near, and then speak, let us come near to judgment together.
text_la: Taceant ad me insulæ, et gentes mutent fortitudinem : accedant, et tunc loquantur; simul ad judicium propinquemus.
text_pt: Calai-vos perante mim, ó ilhas, e os povos renovem as forças; cheguem-se, e então falem; cheguemo-nos juntos a juízo.
text_el: ἐγκαινίζεσθε πρός με νῆσοι οἱ γὰρ ἄρχοντες ἀλλάξουσιν ἰσχύν ἐγγισάτωσαν καὶ λαλησάτωσαν ἅμα τότε κρίσιν ἀναγγειλάτωσαν

text_en: Who has raised up the just one from the east, has called him to follow him? He shall give the nations in his sight, and he shall rule over kings: he shall give them as the dust to his sword, as stubble driven by the wind, to his bow.
text_la: Quis suscitavit ab oriente Justum, vocavit eum ut sequeretur se? Dabit in conspectu ejus gentes, et reges obtinebit : dabit quasi pulverem gladio ejus, sicut stipulam vento raptam arcui ejus.
text_pt: Quem suscitou do oriente o justo e o chamou para o seu pé? Quem deu as nações à sua face e o fez dominar sobre reis? Ele os entregou à sua espada como o pó e como pragana arrebatada pelo vento ao seu arco.
text_el: τίς ἐξήγειρεν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν δικαιοσύνην ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὴν κατὰ πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ πορεύσεται δώσει ἐναντίον ἐθνῶν καὶ βασιλεῖς ἐκστήσει καὶ δώσει εἰς γῆν τὰς μαχαίρας αὐτῶν καὶ ὡς φρύγανα ἐξωσμένα τὰ τόξα αὐτῶν

text_en: He shall pursue them, he shall pass in peace, no path shall appear after his feet.
text_la: Persequetur eos, transibit in pace : semita in pedibus ejus non apparebit.
text_pt: Ele os persegue e passa em paz, por uma vereda por onde os seus pés nunca tinham caminhado.
text_el: καὶ διώξεται αὐτοὺς καὶ διελεύσεται ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἡ ὁδὸς τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who has wrought and done these things, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord , I am the first and the last .
text_la: Quis hæc operatus est, et fecit, vocans generationes ab exordio? Ego Dominus : primus et novissimus ego sum.
text_pt: Quem operou e fez isto, chamando as gerações desde o princípio? Eu o Senhor, o primeiro, e com os últimos eu mesmo.
text_el: τίς ἐνήργησεν καὶ ἐποίησεν ταῦτα ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὴν ὁ καλῶν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ γενεῶν ἀρχῆς ἐγὼ θεὸς πρῶτος καὶ εἰς τὰ ἐπερχόμενα ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: The islands saw it, and feared, the ends of the earth were astonished, they drew near, and came.
text_la: Viderunt insulæ, et timuerunt; extrema terræ obstupuerunt : appropinquaverunt, et accesserunt.
text_pt: As ilhas o viram, e temeram; os fins da terra tremeram; aproximaram-se, e vieram.
text_el: εἴδοσαν ἔθνη καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν τὰ ἄκρα τῆς γῆς ἤγγισαν καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἅμα

text_en: Every one shall help his neighbour, and shall say to his brother: Be of good courage .
text_la: Unusquisque proximo suo auxiliabitur, et fratri suo dicet : Confortare.
text_pt: Um ao outro ajudou, e ao seu irmão disse: Esforça-te.
text_el: κρίνων ἕκαστος τῷ πλησίον καὶ τῷ ἀδελφῷ βοηθῆσαι καὶ ἐρεῖ

text_en: The coppersmith striking with the hammer encouraged him that forged at that time, saying: It is ready for soldering: and he strengthened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
text_la: Confortavit faber ærarius percutiens malleo eum, qui cudebat tunc temporis, dicens : Glutino bonum est; et confortavit eum clavis, ut non moveretur.
text_pt: E o artífice animou ao ourives, e o que alisa com o martelo ao que bate na bigorna, dizendo da coisa soldada: Boa é. Então com pregos a firma, para que não venha a mover-se.
text_el: ἴσχυσεν ἀνὴρ τέκτων καὶ χαλκεὺς τύπτων σφύρῃ ἅμα ἐλαύνων ποτὲ μὲν ἐρεῖ σύμβλημα καλόν ἐστιν ἰσχύρωσαν αὐτὰ ἐν ἥλοις θήσουσιν αὐτὰ καὶ οὐ κινηθήσονται

text_en: But you Israel , are my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend:
text_la: Et tu, Israël, serve meus, Jacob quem elegi, semen Abraham amici mei :
text_pt: Porém tu, ó Israel, servo meu, tu Jacó, a quem elegi descendência de Abraão, meu amigo;
text_el: σὺ δέ Ισραηλ παῖς μου Ιακωβ ὃν ἐξελεξάμην σπέρμα Αβρααμ ὃν ἠγάπησα

text_en: In whom I have taken you from the ends of the earth, and from the remote parts thereof have called you, and said to you: You are my servant, I have chosen you, and have not cast you away.
text_la: in quo apprehendi te ab extremis terræ, et a longinquis ejus vocavi te, et dixi tibi : Servus meus es tu : elegi te, et non abjeci te.
text_pt: Tu a quem tomei desde os fins da terra, e te chamei dentre os seus mais excelentes, e te disse: Tu és o meu servo, a ti escolhi e nunca te rejeitei.
text_el: οὗ ἀντελαβόμην ἀπ' ἄκρων τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκ τῶν σκοπιῶν αὐτῆς ἐκάλεσά σε καὶ εἶπά σοι παῖς μου εἶ ἐξελεξάμην σε καὶ οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπόν σε

text_en: Fear not, for I am with you: turn not aside, for I am your God : I have strengthened you, and have helped you, and the right hand of my just one has upheld you.
text_la: Ne timeas, quia ego tecum sum; ne declines, quia ego Deus tuus : confortavi te, et auxiliatus sum tibi, et suscepit te dextera Justi mei.
text_pt: Não temas, porque eu sou contigo; não te assombres, porque eu sou teu Deus; eu te fortaleço, e te ajudo, e te sustento com a destra da minha justiça.
text_el: μὴ φοβοῦ μετὰ σοῦ γάρ εἰμι μὴ πλανῶ ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι ὁ θεός σου ὁ ἐνισχύσας σε καὶ ἐβοήθησά σοι καὶ ἠσφαλισάμην σε τῇ δεξιᾷ τῇ δικαίᾳ μου

text_en: Behold all that fight against you shall be confounded and ashamed, they shall be as nothing, and the men shall perish that strive against you.
text_la: Ecce confundentur et erubescent omnes qui pugnant adversum te; erunt quasi non sint, et peribunt viri qui contradicunt tibi.
text_pt: Eis que, envergonhados e confundidos serão todos os que se indignaram contra ti; tornar-se-ão em nada, e os que contenderem contigo, perecerão.
text_el: ἰδοὺ αἰσχυνθήσονται καὶ ἐντραπήσονται πάντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοί σοι ἔσονται γὰρ ὡς οὐκ ὄντες καὶ ἀπολοῦνται πάντες οἱ ἀντίδικοί σου

text_en: You shall seek them, and shall not find the men that resist you: they shall be as nothing: and as a thing consumed the men that war against you.
text_la: Quæres eos, et non invenies, viros rebelles tuos; erunt quasi non sint, et veluti consumptio homines bellantes adversum te.
text_pt: Buscá-los-ás, porém não os acharás; os que pelejarem contigo, tornar-se-ão em nada, e como coisa que não é nada, os que guerrearem contigo.
text_el: ζητήσεις αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ μὴ εὕρῃς τοὺς ἀνθρώπους οἳ παροινήσουσιν εἰς σέ ἔσονται γὰρ ὡς οὐκ ὄντες καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται οἱ ἀντιπολεμοῦντές σε

text_en: For I am the Lord your God , who take you by the hand, and say to you: Fear not, I have helped you.
text_la: Quia ego Dominus Deus tuus, apprehendens manum tuam, dicensque tibi : Ne timeas : ego adjuvi te.
text_pt: Porque eu, o Senhor teu Deus, te tomo pela tua mão direita; e te digo: Não temas, eu te ajudo.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ ὁ θεός σου ὁ κρατῶν τῆς δεξιᾶς σου ὁ λέγων σοι μὴ φοβοῦ

text_en: Fear not, you worm of Jacob , you that are dead of Israel : I have helped you, says the Lord : and your Redeemer the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Noli timere, vermis Jacob, qui mortui estis ex Israël : ego auxiliatus sum tibi, dicit Dominus, et redemptor tuus Sanctus Israël.
text_pt: Não temas, tu verme de Jacó, povozinho de Israel; eu te ajudo, diz o Senhor, e o teu redentor é o Santo de Israel.
text_el: Ιακωβ ὀλιγοστὸς Ισραηλ ἐγὼ ἐβοήθησά σοι λέγει ὁ θεὸς ὁ λυτρούμενός σε Ισραηλ

text_en: I have made you as a new thrashing wain, with teeth like a saw: you shall thrash the mountains, and break them in pieces: and shall make the hills as chaff.
text_la: Ego posui te quasi plaustrum triturans novum, habens rostra serrantia; triturabis montes, et comminues, et colles quasi pulverem pones.
text_pt: Eis que farei de ti um trilho novo, que tem dentes agudos; os montes trilharás e moerás; e os outeiros tornarás como a pragana.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐποίησά σε ὡς τροχοὺς ἁμάξης ἀλοῶντας καινοὺς πριστηροειδεῖς καὶ ἀλοήσεις ὄρη καὶ λεπτυνεῖς βουνοὺς καὶ ὡς χνοῦν θήσεις

text_en: You shall fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and you shall rejoice in the Lord , in the Holy One of Israel you shall be joyful.
text_la: Ventilabis eos, et ventus tollet, et turbo disperget eos; et tu exsultabis in Domino, in Sancto Israël lætaberis.
text_pt: Tu os padejarás e o vento os levará, e o redemoinho os espalhará; mas tu te alegrarás no Senhor e te gloriarás no Santo de Israel.
text_el: καὶ λικμήσεις καὶ ἄνεμος λήμψεται αὐτούς καὶ καταιγὶς διασπερεῖ αὐτούς σὺ δὲ εὐφρανθήσῃ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις Ισραηλ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσονται

text_en: The needy and the poor seek for waters, and there are none: their tongue has been dry with thirst. I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
text_la: Egeni et pauperes quærunt aquas, et non sunt; lingua eorum siti aruit. Ego Dominus exaudiam eos, Deus Israël, non derelinquam eos.
text_pt: Os aflitos e necessitados buscam águas, e não há, e a sua língua se seca de sede; eu o Senhor os ouvirei, eu, o Deus de Israel não os desampararei.
text_el: οἱ πτωχοὶ καὶ οἱ ἐνδεεῖς ζητήσουσιν γὰρ ὕδωρ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς δίψης ἐξηράνθη ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεός ἐγὼ ἐπακούσομαι ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψω αὐτούς

text_en: I will open rivers in the high hills, and fountains in the midst of the plains: I will turn the desert into pools of waters, and the impassable land into streams of waters.
text_la: Aperiam in supinis collibus flumina, et in medio camporum fontes : ponam desertum in stagna aquarum, et terram inviam in rivos aquarum.
text_pt: Abrirei rios em lugares altos, e fontes no meio dos vales; tornarei o deserto em lagos de águas, e a terra seca em mananciais de água.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἀνοίξω ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ποταμοὺς καὶ ἐν μέσῳ πεδίων πηγάς ποιήσω τὴν ἔρημον εἰς ἕλη καὶ τὴν διψῶσαν γῆν ἐν ὑδραγωγοῖς

text_en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar , and the thorn, and the myrtle, and the olive tree: I will set in the desert the fir tree, the elm, and the box tree together:
text_la: Dabo in solitudinem cedrum, et spinam, et myrtum, et lignum olivæ; ponam in deserto abietem, ulmum, et buxum simul :
text_pt: Plantarei no deserto o cedro, a acácia, e a murta, e a oliveira; porei no ermo juntamente a faia, o pinheiro e o álamo.
text_el: θήσω εἰς τὴν ἄνυδρον γῆν κέδρον καὶ πύξον καὶ μυρσίνην καὶ κυπάρισσον καὶ λεύκην

text_en: That they may see and know , and consider, and understand together that the hand of the Lord has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
text_la: ut videant, et sciant, et recogitent, et intelligant pariter, quia manus Domini fecit hoc, et Sanctus Israël creavit illud.
text_pt: Para que todos vejam, e saibam, e considerem, e juntamente entendam que a mão do Senhor fez isto, e o Santo de Israel o criou.
text_el: ἵνα ἴδωσιν καὶ γνῶσιν καὶ ἐννοηθῶσιν καὶ ἐπιστῶνται ἅμα ὅτι χεὶρ κυρίου ἐποίησεν ταῦτα πάντα καὶ ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ Ισραηλ κατέδειξεν

text_en: Bring your cause near, says the Lord : bring hither, if you have anything to allege, says the King of Jacob.
text_la: Prope facite judicium vestrum, dicit Dominus; Afferte, si quid forte habetis, dicit rex Jacob.
text_pt: Apresentai a vossa demanda, diz o Senhor; trazei as vossas firmes razões, diz o Rei de Jacó.
text_el: ἐγγίζει ἡ κρίσις ὑμῶν λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός ἤγγισαν αἱ βουλαὶ ὑμῶν λέγει ὁ βασιλεὺς Ιακωβ

text_en: Let them come, and tell us all things that are to come: tell us the former things what they were: and we will set our heart upon them and shall know the latter end of them, and tell us the things that are to come.
text_la: Accedant, et nuntient nobis quæcumque ventura sunt; priora quæ fuerunt, nuntiate, et ponemus cor nostrum, et sciemus novissima eorum; et quæ ventura sunt, indicate nobis.
text_pt: Tragam e anunciem-nos as coisas que hão de acontecer; anunciai-nos as coisas passadas, para que atentemos para elas, e saibamos o fim delas; ou fazei-nos ouvir as coisas futuras.
text_el: ἐγγισάτωσαν καὶ ἀναγγειλάτωσαν ὑμῖν ἃ συμβήσεται ἢ τὰ πρότερα τίνα ἦν εἴπατε καὶ ἐπιστήσομεν τὸν νοῦν καὶ γνωσόμεθα τί τὰ ἔσχατα καὶ τὰ ἐπερχόμενα εἴπατε ἡμῖν

text_en: Show the things that are to come hereafter, and we shall know that you are gods. Do also good or evil , if you can: and let us speak, and see together.
text_la: Annuntiate quæ ventura sunt in futurum, et sciemus quia dii estis vos; bene quoque aut male, si potestis, facite, et loquamur et videamus simul.
text_pt: Anunciai-nos as coisas que ainda hão de vir, para que saibamos que sois deuses; ou fazei bem, ou fazei mal, para que nos assombremos, e juntamente o vejamos.
text_el: ἀναγγείλατε ἡμῖν τὰ ἐπερχόμενα ἐπ' ἐσχάτου καὶ γνωσόμεθα ὅτι θεοί ἐστε εὖ ποιήσατε καὶ κακώσατε καὶ θαυμασόμεθα καὶ ὀψόμεθα ἅμα

text_en: Behold, you are of nothing, and your work of that which has no being: he that has chosen you is an abomination.
text_la: Ecce vos estis ex nihilo, et opus vestrum ex eo quod non est : abominatio est qui elegit vos.
text_pt: Eis que sois menos do que nada e a vossa obra é menos do que nada; abominação é quem vos escolhe.
text_el: ὅτι πόθεν ἐστὲ ὑμεῖς καὶ πόθεν ἡ ἐργασία ὑμῶν ἐκ γῆς βδέλυγμα ἐξελέξαντο ὑμᾶς

text_en: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come from the rising of the sun: he shall call upon my name , and he shall make princes to be as dirt, and as the potter treading clay.
text_la: Suscitavi ab aquilone, et veniet ab ortu solis : vocabit nomen meum, et adducet magistratus quasi lutum, et velut plastes conculcans humum.
text_pt: Suscitei a um do norte, e ele há de vir; desde o nascimento do sol invocará o meu nome; e virá sobre os príncipes, como sobre o lodo e, como o oleiro pisa o barro, os pisará.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἤγειρα τὸν ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ τὸν ἀφ' ἡλίου ἀνατολῶν κληθήσονται τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐρχέσθωσαν ἄρχοντες καὶ ὡς πηλὸς κεραμέως καὶ ὡς κεραμεὺς καταπατῶν τὸν πηλόν οὕτως καταπατηθήσεσθε

text_en: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know : and from time of old, that we may say: You are just . There is none that shows, nor that foretells, nor that hears your words.
text_la: Quis annuntiavit ab exordio ut sciamus, et a principio ut dicamus : Justus es? Non est neque annuntians, neque prædicens, neque audiens sermones vestros.
text_pt: Quem anunciou isto desde o princípio, para que o possamos saber, ou desde antes, para que digamos: Justo é? Porém não há quem anuncie, nem tampouco quem manifeste, nem tampouco quem ouça as vossas palavras.
text_el: τίς γὰρ ἀναγγελεῖ τὰ ἐξ ἀρχῆς ἵνα γνῶμεν καὶ τὰ ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ἐροῦμεν ὅτι ἀληθῆ ἐστιν οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ προλέγων οὐδὲ ὁ ἀκούων ὑμῶν τοὺς λόγους

text_en: The first shall say to Sion: Behold they are here, and to Jerusalem I will give an evangelist.
text_la: Primus ad Sion dicet : Ecce adsunt, et Jerusalem evangelistam dabo.
text_pt: Eu sou o que primeiro direi a Sião: Eis que ali estão; e a Jerusalém darei um anunciador de boas novas.
text_el: ἀρχὴν Σιων δώσω καὶ Ιερουσαλημ παρακαλέσω εἰς ὁδόν

text_en: And I saw, and there was no one even among them to consult, or who, when I asked, could answer a word.
text_la: Et vidi, et non erat neque ex istis quisquam qui iniret consilium, et interrogatus responderet verbum.
text_pt: E quando olhei, não havia ninguém; nem mesmo entre estes, conselheiro algum havia a quem perguntasse ou que me respondesse palavra.
text_el: ἀπὸ γὰρ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἰδοὺ οὐδείς καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων αὐτῶν οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀναγγέλλων καὶ ἐὰν ἐρωτήσω αὐτούς πόθεν ἐστέ οὐ μὴ ἀποκριθῶσίν μοι

text_en: Behold they are all in the wrong, and their works are vain: their idols are wind and vanity.
text_la: Ecce omnes injusti, et vana opera eorum; ventus et inane simulacra eorum.
text_pt: Eis que todos são vaidade; as suas obras não são coisa alguma; as suas imagens de fundição são vento e confusão.
text_el: εἰσὶν γὰρ οἱ ποιοῦντες ὑμᾶς καὶ μάτην οἱ πλανῶντες ὑμᾶς

text_en: Behold my servant , I will uphold him: my elect , my soul delights in him: I have given my spirit upon him, he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .
text_la: Ecce servus meus, suscipiam eum; electus meus, complacuit sibi in illo anima mea : dedi spiritum meum super eum : judicium gentibus proferet.
text_pt: Eis aqui o meu servo, a quem sustenho, o meu eleito, em quem se apraz a minha alma; pus o meu espírito sobre ele; ele trará justiça aos gentios.
text_el: Ιακωβ ὁ παῖς μου ἀντιλήμψομαι αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ ὁ ἐκλεκτός μου προσεδέξατο αὐτὸν ἡ ψυχή μου ἔδωκα τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπ' αὐτόν κρίσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐξοίσει

text_en: He shall not cry, nor have respect to person, neither shall his voice be heard abroad.
text_la: Non clamabit, neque accipiet personam, nec audietur vox ejus foris.
text_pt: Não clamará, não se exaltará, nem fará ouvir a sua voz na praça.
text_el: οὐ κεκράξεται οὐδὲ ἀνήσει οὐδὲ ἀκουσθήσεται ἔξω ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The bruised reed he shall not break, and smoking flax he shall not quench, he shall bring forth judgment unto truth .
text_la: Calamum quassatum non conteret, et linum fumigans non extinguet : in veritate educet judicium.
text_pt: A cana trilhada não quebrará, nem apagará o pavio que fumega; com verdade trará justiça.
text_el: κάλαμον τεθλασμένον οὐ συντρίψει καὶ λίνον καπνιζόμενον οὐ σβέσει ἀλλὰ εἰς ἀλήθειαν ἐξοίσει κρίσιν

text_en: He shall not be sad, nor troublesome, till he set judgment in the earth, and the islands shall wait for his law.
text_la: Non erit tristis, neque turbulentus, donec ponat in terra judicium; et legem ejus insulæ exspectabunt.
text_pt: Não faltará, nem será quebrantado, até que ponha na terra a justiça; e as ilhas aguardarão a sua lei.
text_el: ἀναλάμψει καὶ οὐ θραυσθήσεται ἕως ἂν θῇ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κρίσιν καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν

text_en: Thus says the Lord God that created the heavens , and stretched them out: that established the earth, and the things that spring out of it: that gives breath to the people upon it, and spirit to them that tread thereon.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus, creans cælos, et extendens eos; formans terram, et quæ germinant ex ea; dans flatum populo qui est super eam, et spiritum calcantibus eam :
text_pt: Assim diz Deus, o Senhor, que criou os céus, e os estendeu, e espraiou a terra, e a tudo quanto produz; que dá a respiração ao povo que nela está, e o espírito aos que andam nela.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ πήξας αὐτόν ὁ στερεώσας τὴν γῆν καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ διδοὺς πνοὴν τῷ λαῷ τῷ ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ πνεῦμα τοῖς πατοῦσιν αὐτήν

text_en: I the Lord have called you in justice , and taken you by the hand, and preserved you. And I have given you for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles :
text_la: Ego Dominus vocavi te in justitia, et apprehendi manum tuam, et servavi te : et dedi te in fœdus populi, in lucem gentium,
text_pt: Eu, o Senhor, te chamei em justiça, e te tomarei pela mão, e te guardarei, e te darei por aliança do povo, e para luz dos gentios.
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐκάλεσά σε ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ κρατήσω τῆς χειρός σου καὶ ἐνισχύσω σε καὶ ἔδωκά σε εἰς διαθήκην γένους εἰς φῶς ἐθνῶν

text_en: That you might open the eyes of the blind, and bring forth the prisoner out of prison , and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
text_la: ut aperires oculos cæcorum, et educeres de conclusione vinctum, de domo carceris sedentes in tenebris.
text_pt: Para abrir os olhos dos cegos, para tirar da prisão os presos, e do cárcere os que jazem em trevas.
text_el: ἀνοῖξαι ὀφθαλμοὺς τυφλῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν ἐκ δεσμῶν δεδεμένους καὶ ἐξ οἴκου φυλακῆς καθημένους ἐν σκότει

text_en: I the Lord , this is my name : I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to graven things.
text_la: Ego Dominus, hoc est nomen meum; gloriam meam alteri non dabo, et laudem meam sculptilibus.
text_pt: Eu sou o Senhor; este é o meu nome; a minha glória, pois, a outrem não darei, nem o meu louvor às imagens de escultura.
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεός τοῦτό μού ἐστιν τὸ ὄνομα τὴν δόξαν μου ἑτέρῳ οὐ δώσω οὐδὲ τὰς ἀρετάς μου τοῖς γλυπτοῖς

text_en: The things that were first, behold they have come: and new things do I declare: before they spring forth, I will make you hear them.
text_la: Quæ prima fuerunt, ecce venerunt; nova quoque ego annuntio : antequam oriantur, audita vobis faciam.
text_pt: Eis que as primeiras coisas já se cumpriram, e as novas eu vos anuncio, e, antes que venham à luz, vo-las faço ouvir.
text_el: τὰ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἰδοὺ ἥκασιν καὶ καινὰ ἃ ἐγὼ ἀναγγελῶ καὶ πρὸ τοῦ ἀνατεῖλαι ἐδηλώθη ὑμῖν

text_en: Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise is from the ends of the earth: you that go down to the sea, and all that are therein: you islands, and you inhabitants of them.
text_la: Cantate Domino canticum novum, laus ejus ab extremis terræ, qui descenditis in mare, et plenitudo ejus; insulæ, et habitatores earum.
text_pt: Cantai ao Senhor um cântico novo, e o seu louvor desde a extremidade da terra; vós os que navegais pelo mar, e tudo quanto há nele; vós, ilhas, e seus habitantes.
text_el: ὑμνήσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ὕμνον καινόν ἡ ἀρχὴ αὐτοῦ δοξάζετε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἀπ' ἄκρου τῆς γῆς οἱ καταβαίνοντες εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πλέοντες αὐτήν αἱ νῆσοι καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτάς

text_en: Let the desert and the cities thereof be exalted: Cedar shall dwell in houses: you inhabitants of Petra, give praise, they shall cry from the top of the mountains.
text_la: Sublevetur desertum et civitates ejus. In domibus habitabit Cedar : laudate, habitatores petræ; de vertice montium clamabunt.
text_pt: Alcem a voz o deserto e as suas cidades, com as aldeias que Quedar habita; exultem os que habitam nas rochas, e clamem do cume dos montes.
text_el: εὐφράνθητι ἔρημος καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς ἐπαύλεις καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Κηδαρ εὐφρανθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες Πέτραν ἀπ' ἄκρων τῶν ὀρέων βοήσουσιν

text_en: They shall give glory to the Lord , and shall declare his praise in the islands.
text_la: Ponent Domino gloriam, et laudem ejus in insulis nuntiabunt.
text_pt: Dêem a glória ao Senhor, e anunciem o seu louvor nas ilhas.
text_el: δώσουσιν τῷ θεῷ δόξαν τὰς ἀρετὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν ταῖς νήσοις ἀναγγελοῦσιν

text_en: The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man , as a man of war shall he stir up zeal : he shall shout and cry: he shall prevail against his enemies.
text_la: Dominus sicut fortis egredietur, sicut vir præliator suscitabit zelum; vociferabitur, et clamabit : super inimicos suos confortabitur.
text_pt: O Senhor sairá como poderoso, como homem de guerra despertará o zelo; clamará, e fará grande ruído, e prevalecerá contra seus inimigos.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων ἐξελεύσεται καὶ συντρίψει πόλεμον ἐπεγερεῖ ζῆλον καὶ βοήσεται ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ μετὰ ἰσχύος

text_en: I have always held my peace, I have kept silence, I have been patient, I will speak now as a woman in labour: I will destroy, and swallow up at once.
text_la: Tacui semper, silui, patiens fui : sicut parturiens loquar; dissipabo, et absorbebo simul.
text_pt: Por muito tempo me calei; estive em silêncio, e me contive; mas agora darei gritos como a que está de parto, e a todos os assolarei e juntamente devorarei.
text_el: ἐσιώπησα μὴ καὶ ἀεὶ σιωπήσομαι καὶ ἀνέξομαι ἐκαρτέρησα ὡς ἡ τίκτουσα ἐκστήσω καὶ ξηρανῶ ἅμα

text_en: I will lay waste the mountains and hills, and will make all their grass to wither: and I will turn rivers into islands, and will dry up the standing pools .
text_la: Desertos faciam montes et colles, et omne gramen eorum exsiccabo; et ponam flumina in insulas, et stagna arefaciam.
text_pt: Os montes e outeiros tornarei em deserto, e toda a sua erva farei secar, e tornarei os rios em ilhas, e as lagoas secarei.
text_el: καὶ θήσω ποταμοὺς εἰς νήσους καὶ ἕλη ξηρανῶ

text_en: And I will lead the blind into the way which they know not: and in the paths which they were ignorant of I will make them walk: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight: these things have I done to them, and have not forsaken them.
text_la: Et ducam cæcos in viam quam nesciunt, et in semitis quas ignoraverunt ambulare eos faciam; ponam tenebras coram eis in lucem, et prava in recta; hæc verba feci eis, et non dereliqui eos.
text_pt: E guiarei os cegos pelo caminho que nunca conheceram, fá-los-ei caminhar pelas veredas que não conheceram; tornarei as trevas em luz perante eles, e as coisas tortas farei direitas. Estas coisas lhes farei, e nunca os desampararei.
text_el: καὶ ἄξω τυφλοὺς ἐν ὁδῷ ᾗ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν καὶ τρίβους οὓς οὐκ ᾔδεισαν πατῆσαι ποιήσω αὐτούς ποιήσω αὐτοῖς τὸ σκότος εἰς φῶς καὶ τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς εὐθεῖαν ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ποιήσω καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψω αὐτούς

text_en: They are turned back: let them be greatly confounded, that trust in a graven thing, that say to a molten thing: You are our god.
text_la: Conversi sunt retrorsum, confundantur confusione, qui confidunt in sculptili; qui dicunt conflatili : Vos dii nostri.
text_pt: Tornarão atrás e confundir-se-ão de vergonha os que confiam em imagens de escultura, e dizem às imagens de fundição: Vós sois nossos deuses.
text_el: αὐτοὶ δὲ ἀπεστράφησαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω αἰσχύνθητε αἰσχύνην οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπὶ τοῖς γλυπτοῖς οἱ λέγοντες τοῖς χωνευτοῖς ὑμεῖς ἐστε θεοὶ ἡμῶν

text_en: Hear, you deaf, and, you blind, behold that you may see.
text_la: Surdi, audite, et cæci, intuemini ad videndum.
text_pt: Surdos, ouvi, e vós, cegos, olhai, para que possais ver.
text_el: οἱ κωφοί ἀκούσατε καὶ οἱ τυφλοί ἀναβλέψατε ἰδεῖν

text_en: Who is blind, but my servant? Or deaf, but he to whom I have sent my messengers? Who is blind, but he that is sold? Or who is blind, but the servant of the Lord ?
text_la: Quis cæcus, nisi servus meus; et surdus, nisi ad quem nuntios meos misi? quis cæcus, nisi qui venundatus est? et quis cæcus, nisi servus Domini?
text_pt: Quem é cego, senão o meu servo, ou surdo como o meu mensageiro, a quem envio? E quem é cego como o que é perfeito, e cego como o servo do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ τίς τυφλὸς ἀλλ' ἢ οἱ παῖδές μου καὶ κωφοὶ ἀλλ' ἢ οἱ κυριεύοντες αὐτῶν καὶ ἐτυφλώθησαν οἱ δοῦλοι τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: You that see many things, will you not observe them? You that have ears open, will you not hear?
text_la: Qui vides multa, nonne custodies? qui apertas habes aures, nonne audies?
text_pt: Tu vês muitas coisas, mas não as guardas; ainda que tenhas os ouvidos abertos, nada ouves.
text_el: εἴδετε πλεονάκις καὶ οὐκ ἐφυλάξασθε ἠνοιγμένα τὰ ὦτα καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατε

text_en: And the Lord was willing to sanctify him, and to magnify the law, and exalt it.
text_la: Et Dominus voluit ut sanctificaret eum, et magnificaret legem, et extolleret.
text_pt: O Senhor se agradava dele por amor da sua justiça; engrandeceu-o pela lei, e o fez glorioso.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐβούλετο ἵνα δικαιωθῇ καὶ μεγαλύνῃ αἴνεσιν καὶ εἶδον

text_en: But this is a people that is robbed and wasted: they are all the snare of young men, and they are hid in the houses of prisons: they are made a prey, and there is none to deliver them: a spoil, and there is none that says: Restore.
text_la: Ipse autem populus direptus, et vastatus; laqueus juvenum omnes, et in domibus carcerum absconditi sunt; facti sunt in rapinam, nec est qui eruat; in direptionem, nec est qui dicat : Redde.
text_pt: Mas este é um povo roubado e saqueado; todos estão enlaçados em cavernas, e escondidos em cárceres; são postos por presa, e ninguém há que os livre; por despojo, e ninguém diz: Restitui.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ λαὸς πεπρονομευμένος καὶ διηρπασμένος ἡ γὰρ παγὶς ἐν τοῖς ταμιείοις πανταχοῦ καὶ ἐν οἴκοις ἅμα ὅπου ἔκρυψαν αὐτούς ἐγένοντο εἰς προνομήν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐξαιρούμενος ἅρπαγμα καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ λέγων ἀπόδος

text_en: Who is there among you that will give ear to this, that will attend and hearken for times to come?
text_la: Quis est in vobis qui audiat hoc, attendat, et auscultet futura?
text_pt: Quem há entre vós que ouça isto, que atenda e ouça o que há de ser depois?
text_el: τίς ἐν ὑμῖν ὃς ἐνωτιεῖται ταῦτα εἰσακούσεται εἰς τὰ ἐπερχόμενα

text_en: Who has given Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to robbers? Has not the Lord himself, against whom we have sinned ? And they would not walk in his ways, and they have not hearkened to his law.
text_la: Quis dedit in direptionem Jacob, et Israël vastantibus? nonne Dominus ipse, cui peccavimus? Et noluerunt in viis ejus ambulare, et non audierunt legem ejus.
text_pt: Quem entregou a Jacó por despojo, e a Israel aos roubadores? Porventura não foi o Senhor, aquele contra quem pecamos, e nos caminhos do qual não queriam andar, não dando ouvidos à sua lei?
text_el: τίς ἔδωκεν εἰς διαρπαγὴν Ιακωβ καὶ Ισραηλ τοῖς προνομεύουσιν αὐτόν οὐχὶ ὁ θεός ᾧ ἡμάρτοσαν αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ ἐβούλοντο ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ πορεύεσθαι οὐδὲ ἀκούειν τοῦ νόμου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he has poured out upon him the indignation of his fury, and a strong battle, and has burnt him round about, and he knew not: and set him on fire, and he understood not.
text_la: Et effudit super eum indignationem furoris sui, et forte bellum; et combussit eum in circuitu, et non cognovit; et succendit eum, et non intellexit.
text_pt: Por isso derramou sobre eles a indignação da sua ira, e a força da guerra, e lhes pôs labaredas em redor; porém nisso não atentaram; e os queimou, mas não puseram nisso o coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐπήγαγεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ὀργὴν θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ κατίσχυσεν αὐτοὺς πόλεμος καὶ οἱ συμφλέγοντες αὐτοὺς κύκλῳ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ἕκαστος αὐτῶν οὐδὲ ἔθεντο ἐπὶ ψυχήν

text_en: And now thus says the Lord that created you, O Jacob , and formed you, O Israel : Fear not, for I have redeemed you, and called you by your name : you are mine.
text_la: Et nunc hæc dicit Dominus creans te, Jacob, et formans te, Israël : Noli timere, quia redemi te, et vocavi te nomine tuo : meus es tu.
text_pt: Mas agora, assim diz o SENHOR que te criou, ó Jacó, e que te formou, ó Israel: Não temas, porque eu te remi; chamei-te pelo teu nome, tu és meu.
text_el: καὶ νῦν οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ποιήσας σε Ιακωβ ὁ πλάσας σε Ισραηλ μὴ φοβοῦ ὅτι ἐλυτρωσάμην σε ἐκάλεσά σε τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐμὸς εἶ σύ

text_en: When you shall pass through the waters, I will be with you, and the rivers shall not cover you: when you shall walk in the fire, you shall not be burnt, and the flames shall not burn in you:
text_la: Cum transieris per aquas, tecum ero, et flumina non operient te; cum ambulaveris in igne, non combureris, et flamma non ardebit in te.
text_pt: Quando passares pelas águas estarei contigo, e quando pelos rios, eles não te submergirão; quando passares pelo fogo, não te queimarás, nem a chama arderá em ti.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν διαβαίνῃς δι' ὕδατος μετὰ σοῦ εἰμι καὶ ποταμοὶ οὐ συγκλύσουσίν σε καὶ ἐὰν διέλθῃς διὰ πυρός οὐ μὴ κατακαυθῇς φλὸξ οὐ κατακαύσει σε

text_en: For I am the Lord your God , the Holy One of Israel , your Saviour: I have given Egypt for your atonement , Ethiopia and Saba for you.
text_la: Quia ego Dominus Deus tuus, Sanctus Israël, salvator tuus, dedi propitiationem tuam Ægyptum, Æthopiam, et Saba, pro te.
text_pt: Porque eu sou o Senhor teu Deus, o Santo de Israel, o teu Salvador; dei o Egito por teu resgate, a Etiópia e a Seba em teu lugar.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὁ ἅγιος Ισραηλ ὁ σῴζων σε ἐποίησά σου ἄλλαγμα Αἴγυπτον καὶ Αἰθιοπίαν καὶ Σοήνην ὑπὲρ σοῦ

text_en: Since you became honourable in my eyes, you are glorious : I have loved you, and I will give men for you, and people for your life.
text_la: Ex quo honorabilis factus es in oculis meis, et gloriosus, ego dilexi te, et dabo homines pro te, et populos pro anima tua.
text_pt: Visto que foste precioso aos meus olhos, também foste honrado, e eu te amei, assim dei os homens por ti, e os povos pela tua vida.
text_el: ἀφ' οὗ ἔντιμος ἐγένου ἐναντίον μου ἐδοξάσθης κἀγώ σε ἠγάπησα καὶ δώσω ἀνθρώπους πολλοὺς ὑπὲρ σοῦ καὶ ἄρχοντας ὑπὲρ τῆς κεφαλῆς σου

text_en: Fear not, for I am with you: I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west.
text_la: Noli timere, quia ego tecum sum; ab oriente adducam semen tuum, et ab occidente congregabo te.
text_pt: Não temas, pois, porque estou contigo; trarei a tua descendência desde o oriente, e te ajuntarei desde o ocidente.
text_el: μὴ φοβοῦ ὅτι μετὰ σοῦ εἰμι ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἄξω τὸ σπέρμα σου καὶ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν συνάξω σε
