text_en: I will say to the north: Give up: and to the south: Keep not back: bring my sons from afar, and my daughters from the ends of the earth.
text_la: Dicam aquiloni : Da; et austro : Noli prohibere : affer filios meos de longinquo, et filias meas ab extremis terræ.
text_pt: Direi ao norte: Dá; e ao sul: Não retenhas; trazei meus filhos de longe e minhas filhas das extremidades da terra,
text_el: ἐρῶ τῷ βορρᾷ ἄγε καὶ τῷ λιβί μὴ κώλυε ἄγε τοὺς υἱούς μου ἀπὸ γῆς πόρρωθεν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας μου ἀπ' ἄκρων τῆς γῆς

text_en: And every one that calls upon my name , I have created him for my glory . I have formed him, and made him.
text_la: Et omnem qui invocat nomen meum, in gloriam meam creavi eum, formavi eum, et feci eum.
text_pt: A todos os que são chamados pelo meu nome, e os que criei para a minha glória: eu os formei, e também eu os fiz.
text_el: πάντας ὅσοι ἐπικέκληνται τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐν γὰρ τῇ δόξῃ μου κατεσκεύασα αὐτὸν καὶ ἔπλασα καὶ ἐποίησα αὐτόν

text_en: Bring forth the people that are blind, and have eyes: that are deaf, and have ears.
text_la: Educ foras populum cæcum, et oculos habentem; surdum, et aures ei sunt.
text_pt: Trazei o povo cego, que tem olhos; e os surdos, que têm ouvidos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγον λαὸν τυφλόν καὶ ὀφθαλμοί εἰσιν ὡσαύτως τυφλοί καὶ κωφοὶ τὰ ὦτα ἔχοντες

text_en: All the nations are assembled together, and the tribes are gathered: who among you can declare this, and shall make us hear the former things? Let them bring forth their witnesses , let them be justified, and hear, and say: It is truth .
text_la: Omnes gentes congregatæ sunt simul, et collectæ sunt tribus. Quis in vobis annuntiet istud, et quæ prima sunt audire nos faciet? Dent testes eorum, justificentur, et audiant, et dicant : Vere.
text_pt: Todas as nações se congreguem, e os povos se reúnam; quem dentre eles pode anunciar isto, e fazer-nos ouvir as coisas antigas? Apresentem as suas testemunhas, para que se justifiquem, e se ouça, e se diga: Verdade é.
text_el: πάντα τὰ ἔθνη συνήχθησαν ἅμα καὶ συναχθήσονται ἄρχοντες ἐξ αὐτῶν τίς ἀναγγελεῖ ταῦτα ἢ τὰ ἐξ ἀρχῆς τίς ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν ἀγαγέτωσαν τοὺς μάρτυρας αὐτῶν καὶ δικαιωθήτωσαν καὶ εἰπάτωσαν ἀληθῆ

text_en: You are my witnesses , says the Lord , and my servant whom I have chosen: that you may know , and believe me, and understand that I myself am. Before me there was no God formed, and after me there shall be none.
text_la: Vos testes mei, dicit Dominus, et servus meus quem elegi : ut sciatis, et credatis mihi, et intelligatis quia ego ipse sum; ante me non est formatus Deus, et post me non erit.
text_pt: Vós sois as minhas testemunhas, diz o Senhor, e meu servo, a quem escolhi; para que o saibais, e me creiais, e entendais que eu sou o mesmo, e que antes de mim deus nenhum se formou, e depois de mim nenhum haverá.
text_el: γένεσθέ μοι μάρτυρες κἀγὼ μάρτυς λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός καὶ ὁ παῖς ὃν ἐξελεξάμην ἵνα γνῶτε καὶ πιστεύσητε καὶ συνῆτε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ἔμπροσθέν μου οὐκ ἐγένετο ἄλλος θεὸς καὶ μετ' ἐμὲ οὐκ ἔσται

text_en: I am, I am the Lord : and there is no saviour besides me.
text_la: Ego sum, ego sum Dominus, et non est absque me salvator.
text_pt: Eu, eu sou o Senhor, e fora de mim não há Salvador.
text_el: ἐγὼ ὁ θεός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν πάρεξ ἐμοῦ σῴζων

text_en: I have declared, and have saved. I have made it heard, and there was no strange one among you. You are my witnesses , says the Lord , and I am God .
text_la: Ego annuntiavi, et salvavi; auditum feci, et non fuit in vobis alienus : vos testes mei, dicit Dominus, et ego Deus.
text_pt: Eu anunciei, e eu salvei, e eu o fiz ouvir, e deus estranho não houve entre vós, pois vós sois as minhas testemunhas, diz o Senhor; eu sou Deus.
text_el: ἀνήγγειλα καὶ ἔσωσα ὠνείδισα καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἐν ὑμῖν ἀλλότριος ὑμεῖς ἐμοὶ μάρτυρες κἀγὼ μάρτυς λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός

text_en: And from the beginning I am the same, and there is none that can deliver out of my hind: I will work, and who shall turn it away?
text_la: Et ab initio ego ipse, et non est qui de manu mea eruat. Operabor, et quis avertet illud?
text_pt: Ainda antes que houvesse dia, eu sou; e ninguém há que possa fazer escapar das minhas mãos; agindo eu, quem o impedirá?
text_el: ἔτι ἀπ' ἀρχῆς καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν μου ἐξαιρούμενος ποιήσω καὶ τίς ἀποστρέψει αὐτό

text_en: Thus says the Lord your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel : For your sake I sent to Babylon , and have brought down all their bars, and the Chaldeans glorying in their ships.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus, redemptor vester, Sanctus Israël : Propter vos misi in Babylonem, et detraxi vectes universos, et Chaldæos in navibus suis gloriantes.
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR, vosso Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Por amor de vós enviei a babilônia, e a todos fiz descer como fugitivos, os caldeus, nos navios com que se vangloriavam.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ λυτρούμενος ὑμᾶς ὁ ἅγιος Ισραηλ ἕνεκεν ὑμῶν ἀποστελῶ εἰς Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ἐπεγερῶ πάντας φεύγοντας καὶ Χαλδαῖοι ἐν πλοίοις δεθήσονται

text_en: I am the Lord your Holy One, the Creator of Israel , your King.
text_la: Ego Dominus, Sanctus vester, creans Israël, rex vester.
text_pt: Eu sou o Senhor, vosso Santo, o Criador de Israel, vosso Rei.
text_el: ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἅγιος ὑμῶν ὁ καταδείξας Ισραηλ βασιλέα ὑμῶν

text_en: Thus says the Lord , who made a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus, qui dedit in mari viam, et in aquis torrentibus semitam;
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, o que preparou no mar um caminho, e nas águas impetuosas uma vereda;
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ διδοὺς ὁδὸν ἐν θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐν ὕδατι ἰσχυρῷ τρίβον

text_en: Who brought forth the chariot and the horse, the army and the strong: they lay down to sleep together, and they shall not rise again: they are broken as flax, and are extinct.
text_la: qui eduxit quadrigam et equum, agmen et robustum : simul obdormierunt, nec resurgent; contriti sunt quasi linum, et extincti sunt.
text_pt: O que fez sair o carro e o cavalo, o exército e a força; eles juntamente se deitaram, e nunca se levantarão; estão extintos; como um pavio se apagaram.
text_el: ὁ ἐξαγαγὼν ἅρματα καὶ ἵππον καὶ ὄχλον ἰσχυρόν ἀλλὰ ἐκοιμήθησαν καὶ οὐκ ἀναστήσονται ἐσβέσθησαν ὡς λίνον ἐσβεσμένον

text_en: Remember not former things, and look not on things of old.
text_la: Ne memineritis priorum, et antiqua ne intueamini.
text_pt: Não vos lembreis das coisas passadas, nem considereis as antigas.
text_el: μὴ μνημονεύετε τὰ πρῶτα καὶ τὰ ἀρχαῖα μὴ συλλογίζεσθε

text_en: Behold I do new things, and now they shall spring forth, verily you shall know them: I will make a way in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert .
text_la: Ecce ego facio nova, et nunc orientur, utique cognoscetis ea : ponam in deserto viam, et in invio flumina.
text_pt: Eis que faço uma coisa nova, agora sairá à luz; porventura não a percebeis? Eis que porei um caminho no deserto, e rios no ermo.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ποιῶ καινὰ ἃ νῦν ἀνατελεῖ καὶ γνώσεσθε αὐτά καὶ ποιήσω ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὁδὸν καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀνύδρῳ ποταμούς

text_en: The beast of the field shall glorify me, the dragons and the ostriches: because I have given waters in the wilderness , rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people, to my chosen.
text_la: Glorificabit me bestia agri, dracones, et struthiones : quia dedi in deserto aquas, flumina in invio, ut darem potum populo meo, electo meo.
text_pt: Os animais do campo me honrarão, os chacais, e os avestruzes; porque porei águas no deserto, e rios no ermo, para dar de beber ao meu povo, ao meu eleito.
text_el: εὐλογήσει με τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ σειρῆνες καὶ θυγατέρες στρουθῶν ὅτι ἔδωκα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὕδωρ καὶ ποταμοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀνύδρῳ ποτίσαι τὸ γένος μου τὸ ἐκλεκτόν

text_en: This people have I formed for myself, they shall show forth my praise.
text_la: Populum istum formavi mihi : laudem meam narrabit.
text_pt: A esse povo que formei para mim; o meu louvor relatarão.
text_el: λαόν μου ὃν περιεποιησάμην τὰς ἀρετάς μου διηγεῖσθαι

text_en: But you have not called upon me, O Jacob , neither have you laboured about me, O Israel .
text_la: Non me invocasti, Jacob, nec laborasti in me, Israël.
text_pt: Contudo tu não me invocaste a mim, ó Jacó, mas te cansaste de mim, ó Israel.
text_el: οὐ νῦν ἐκάλεσά σε Ιακωβ οὐδὲ κοπιᾶσαί σε ἐποίησα Ισραηλ

text_en: You have not offered me the ram of your holocaust , nor have you glorified me with your victims: I have not caused you to serve with oblations , nor wearied you with incense .
text_la: Non obtulisti mihi arietem holocausti tui, et victimis tuis non glorificasti me; non te servire feci in oblatione, nec laborem tibi præbui in thure.
text_pt: Não me trouxeste o gado miúdo dos teus holocaustos, nem me honraste com os teus sacrifícios; não te fiz servir com ofertas, nem te fatiguei com incenso.
text_el: οὐκ ἐμοὶ πρόβατα τῆς ὁλοκαρπώσεώς σου οὐδὲ ἐν ταῖς θυσίαις σου ἐδόξασάς με οὐδὲ ἔγκοπον ἐποίησά σε ἐν λιβάνῳ

text_en: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, neither have you filled me with the fat of your victims. But you have made me to serve with your sins , you have wearied me with your iniquities .
text_la: Non emisti mihi argento calamum, et adipe victimarum tuarum non inebriasti me : verumtamen servire me fecisti in peccatis tuis; præbuisti mihi laborem in iniquitatibus tuis.
text_pt: Não me compraste por dinheiro cana aromática, nem com a gordura dos teus sacrifícios me satisfizeste, mas me deste trabalho com os teus pecados, e me cansaste com as tuas iniqüidades.
text_el: οὐδὲ ἐκτήσω μοι ἀργυρίου θυμίαμα οὐδὲ τὸ στέαρ τῶν θυσιῶν σου ἐπεθύμησα ἀλλὰ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις σου καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις σου προέστην σου

text_en: I am, I am he that blot out your iniquities for my own sake, and I will not remember your sins .
text_la: Ego sum, ego sum ipse qui deleo iniquitates tuas propter me, et peccatorum tuorum non recordabor.
text_pt: Eu, eu mesmo, sou o que apago as tuas transgressões por amor de mim, e dos teus pecados não me lembro.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἐξαλείφων τὰς ἀνομίας σου καὶ οὐ μὴ μνησθήσομαι

text_en: Put me in remembrance, and let us plead together: tell if you have anything to justify yourself.
text_la: Reduc me in memoriam, et judicemur simul : narra si quid habes ut justificeris.
text_pt: Faze-me lembrar; entremos juntos em juízo; conta tu as tuas razões, para que te possas justificar.
text_el: σὺ δὲ μνήσθητι καὶ κριθῶμεν λέγε σὺ τὰς ἀνομίας σου πρῶτος ἵνα δικαιωθῇς

text_en: Your first father sinned , and your teachers have transgressed against me.
text_la: Pater tuus primus peccavit, et interpretes tui prævaricati sunt in me :
text_pt: Teu primeiro pai pecou, e os teus intérpretes prevaricaram contra mim.
text_el: οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν πρῶτοι καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν ἠνόμησαν εἰς ἐμέ

text_en: And I have profaned the holy princes, I have given Jacob to slaughter, and Israel to reproach.
text_la: et contaminavi principes sanctos; dedi ad internecionem Jacob, et Israël in blasphemiam.
text_pt: Por isso profanei os príncipes do santuário; e entreguei Jacó ao anátema, e Israel ao opróbrio.
text_el: καὶ ἐμίαναν οἱ ἄρχοντες τὰ ἅγιά μου καὶ ἔδωκα ἀπολέσαι Ιακωβ καὶ Ισραηλ εἰς ὀνειδισμόν

text_en: And now hear, O Jacob , my servant, and Israel whom I have chosen.
text_la: Et nunc audi, Jacob, serve meus, et Israël, quem elegi.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ouve, ó Jacó, servo meu, e tu, ó Israel, a quem escolhi.
text_el: νῦν δὲ ἄκουσον παῖς μου Ιακωβ καὶ Ισραηλ ὃν ἐξελεξάμην

text_en: Thus says the Lord that made and formed you, your helper from the womb: Fear not, O my servant Jacob , and you most righteous whom I have chosen.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus faciens et formans te, ab utero auxiliator tuus : Noli timere, serve meus Jacob, et rectissime, quem elegi.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor que te criou e te formou desde o ventre, e que te ajudará: Não temas, ó Jacó, servo meu, e tu, Jesurum, a quem escolhi.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ποιήσας σε καὶ ὁ πλάσας σε ἐκ κοιλίας ἔτι βοηθηθήσῃ μὴ φοβοῦ παῖς μου Ιακωβ καὶ ὁ ἠγαπημένος Ισραηλ ὃν ἐξελεξάμην

text_en: For I will pour out waters upon the thirsty ground, and streams upon the dry land: I will pour out my spirit upon your seed, and my blessing upon your stock.
text_la: Effundam enim aquas super sitientem, et fluenta super aridam; effundam spiritum meum super semen tuum, et benedictionem meam super stirpem tuam :
text_pt: Porque derramarei água sobre o sedento, e rios sobre a terra seca; derramarei o meu Espírito sobre a tua posteridade, e a minha bênção sobre os teus descendentes.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ δώσω ὕδωρ ἐν δίψει τοῖς πορευομένοις ἐν ἀνύδρῳ ἐπιθήσω τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου καὶ τὰς εὐλογίας μου ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα σου

text_en: And they shall spring up among the herbs, as willows beside the running waters.
text_la: et germinabunt inter herbas, quasi salices juxta præterfluentes aquas.
text_pt: E brotarão como a erva, como salgueiros junto aos ribeiros das águas.
text_el: καὶ ἀνατελοῦσιν ὡσεὶ χόρτος ἀνὰ μέσον ὕδατος καὶ ὡς ἰτέα ἐπὶ παραρρέον ὕδωρ

text_en: One shall say: I am the Lord's , and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob , and another shall subscribe with his hand, To the Lord , and surname himself by the name of Israel .
text_la: Iste dicet : Domini ego sum; et ille vocabit in nomine Jacob; et hic scribet manu sua : Domino, et in nomine Israël assimilabitur.
text_pt: Este dirá: Eu sou do Senhor; e aquele se chamará do nome de Jacó; e aquele outro escreverá com a sua mão ao Senhor, e por sobrenome tomará o nome de Israel.
text_el: οὗτος ἐρεῖ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰμι καὶ οὗτος βοήσεται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Ιακωβ καὶ ἕτερος ἐπιγράψει τοῦ θεοῦ εἰμι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Ισραηλ

text_en: Thus says the Lord the king of Israel , and his redeemer the Lord of hosts : I am the first , and I am the last , and besides me there is no God .
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus, rex Israël, et redemptor ejus, Dominus exercituum : Ego primus, et ego novissimus, et absque me non est deus.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, Rei de Israel, e seu Redentor, o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eu sou o primeiro, e eu sou o último, e fora de mim não há Deus.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει ὁ θεὸς ὁ βασιλεὺς τοῦ Ισραηλ ὁ ῥυσάμενος αὐτὸν θεὸς σαβαωθ ἐγὼ πρῶτος καὶ ἐγὼ μετὰ ταῦτα πλὴν ἐμοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν θεός

text_en: Who is like to me? Let him call and declare: and let him set before me the order, since I appointed the ancient people: and the things to come, and that shall be hereafter, let them show unto them.
text_la: Quis similis mei? vocet, et annuntiet : et ordinem exponat mihi, ex quo constitui populum antiquum; ventura et quæ futura sunt annuntient eis.
text_pt: E quem proclamará como eu, e anunciará isto, e o porá em ordem perante mim, desde que ordenei um povo eterno? E anuncie-lhes as coisas vindouras, e as que ainda hão de vir.
text_el: τίς ὥσπερ ἐγώ στήτω καλεσάτω καὶ ἑτοιμασάτω μοι ἀφ' οὗ ἐποίησα ἄνθρωπον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ τὰ ἐπερχόμενα πρὸ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν ἀναγγειλάτωσαν ὑμῖν

text_en: Fear not, neither be troubled from that time I have made you to hear, and have declared: you are my witnesses . Is there a God besides me, a maker, whom I have not known ?
text_la: Nolite timere, neque conturbemini : ex tunc audire te feci, et annuntiavi; vos estis testes mei. Numquid est Deus absque me, et formator quem ego non noverim?
text_pt: Não vos assombreis, nem temais; porventura desde então não vo-lo fiz ouvir, e não vo-lo anunciei? Porque vós sois as minhas testemunhas. Porventura há outro Deus fora de mim? Não, não há outra Rocha que eu conheça.
text_el: μὴ παρακαλύπτεσθε οὐκ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἠνωτίσασθε καὶ ἀπήγγειλα ὑμῖν μάρτυρες ὑμεῖς ἐστε εἰ ἔστιν θεὸς πλὴν ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν τότε

text_en: The makers of idols are all of them nothing, and their best beloved things shall not profit them. They are their witnesses , that they do not see, nor understand, that they may be ashamed.
text_la: Plastæ idoli omnes nihil sunt, et amantissima eorum non proderunt eis. Ipsi sunt testes eorum, quia non vident, neque intelligunt, ut confundantur.
text_pt: Todos os artífices de imagens de escultura são vaidade, e as suas coisas mais desejáveis são de nenhum préstimo; e suas próprias testemunhas, nada vêem nem entendem para que sejam envergonhados.
text_el: οἱ πλάσσοντες καὶ γλύφοντες πάντες μάταιοι οἱ ποιοῦντες τὰ καταθύμια αὐτῶν ἃ οὐκ ὠφελήσει αὐτούς ἀλλὰ αἰσχυνθήσονται

text_en: Who has formed a god, and made a graven thing that is profitable for nothing?
text_la: Quis formavit deum, et sculptile conflavit ad nihil utile?
text_pt: Quem forma um deus, e funde uma imagem de escultura, que é de nenhum préstimo?
text_el: πάντες οἱ πλάσσοντες θεὸν καὶ γλύφοντες ἀνωφελῆ

text_en: Behold, all the partakers thereof shall be confounded: for the makers are men : they shall all assemble together, they shall stand and fear, and shall be confounded together.
text_la: Ecce omnes participes ejus confundentur, fabri enim sunt ex hominibus; convenient omnes, stabunt et pavebunt, et confundentur simul.
text_pt: Eis que todos os seus companheiros ficarão confundidos, pois os mesmos artífices não passam de homens; ajuntem-se todos, e levantem-se; assombrar-se-ão, e serão juntamente confundidos.
text_el: καὶ πάντες ὅθεν ἐγένοντο ἐξηράνθησαν καὶ κωφοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπων συναχθήτωσαν πάντες καὶ στήτωσαν ἅμα ἐντραπήτωσαν καὶ αἰσχυνθήτωσαν ἅμα

text_en: The smith has wrought with his file, with coals, and with hammers he has formed it, and has wrought with the strength of his arm: he shall hunger and faint, he shall drink no water, and shall be weary.
text_la: Faber ferrarius lima operatus est, in prunis et in malleis formavit illud, et operatus est in brachio fortitudinis suæ; esuriet et deficiet, non bibet aquam et lassescet.
text_pt: O ferreiro, com a tenaz, trabalha nas brasas, e o forma com martelos, e o lavra com a força do seu braço; ele tem fome e a sua força enfraquece, e não bebe água, e desfalece.
text_el: ὅτι ὤξυνεν τέκτων σίδηρον σκεπάρνῳ εἰργάσατο αὐτὸ καὶ ἐν τερέτρῳ ἔτρησεν αὐτό εἰργάσατο αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ βραχίονι τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ καὶ πεινάσει καὶ ἀσθενήσει καὶ οὐ μὴ πίῃ ὕδωρ ἐκλεξάμενος

text_en: The carpenter has stretched out his rule, he has formed it with a plane: he has made it with corners, and has fashioned it round with the compass: and he has made the image of a man as it were a beautiful man dwelling in a house.
text_la: Artifex lignarius extendit normam, formavit illud in runcina, fecit illud in angularibus, et in circino tornavit illud, et fecit imaginem viri quasi speciosum hominem habitantem in domo;
text_pt: O carpinteiro estende a régua, desenha-o com uma linha, aplaina-o com a plaina, e traça-o com o compasso; e o faz à semelhança de um homem, segundo a forma de um homem, para ficar em casa.
text_el: τέκτων ξύλον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν μέτρῳ καὶ ἐν κόλλῃ ἐρρύθμισεν αὐτό ἐποίησεν αὐτὸ ὡς μορφὴν ἀνδρὸς καὶ ὡς ὡραιότητα ἀνθρώπου στῆσαι αὐτὸ ἐν οἴκῳ

text_en: He has cut down cedars , taken the holm, and the oak that stood among the trees of the forest: he has planted the pine tree, which the rain has nourished.
text_la: succidit cedros, tulit ilicem, et quercum, quæ steterat inter ligna saltus; plantavit pinum, quam pluvia nutrivit :
text_pt: Quando corta para si cedros, toma, também, o cipreste e o carvalho; assim escolhe dentre as árvores do bosque; planta um olmeiro, e a chuva o faz crescer.
text_el: ὃ ἔκοψεν ξύλον ἐκ τοῦ δρυμοῦ ὃ ἐφύτευσεν κύριος καὶ ὑετὸς ἐμήκυνεν

text_en: And it has served men for fuel: he took thereof, and warmed himself: and he kindled it, and baked bread: but of the rest he made a god, and adored it: he made a graven thing, and bowed down before it.
text_la: et facta est hominibus in focum; sumpsit ex eis, et calefactus est; et succendit et coxit panes; de reliquo autem operatus est deum et adoravit; fecit sculptile, et curvatus est ante illud.
text_pt: Então serve ao homem para queimar; e toma deles, e se aquenta, e os acende, e coze o pão; também faz um deus, e se prostra diante dele; também fabrica uma imagem de escultura, e ajoelha-se diante dela.
text_el: ἵνα ᾖ ἀνθρώποις εἰς καῦσιν καὶ λαβὼν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἐθερμάνθη καὶ καύσαντες ἔπεψαν ἄρτους ἐπ' αὐτῶν τὸ δὲ λοιπὸν εἰργάσαντο εἰς θεούς καὶ προσκυνοῦσιν αὐτούς

text_en: Part of it he burnt with fire, and with part of it he dressed his meat: he boiled pottage, and was filled, and was warmed, and said: Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire.
text_la: Medium ejus combussit igni, et de medio ejus carnes comedit; coxit pulmentum, et saturatus est, et calefactus est, et dixit : Vah! calefactus sum, vidi focum;
text_pt: Metade dele queima no fogo, com a outra metade prepara a carne para comer, assa-a e farta-se dela; também se aquenta, e diz: Ora já me aquentei, já vi o fogo.
text_el: οὗ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ κατέκαυσαν ἐν πυρὶ καὶ καύσαντες ἔπεψαν ἄρτους ἐπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπ' αὐτοῦ κρέας ὀπτήσας ἔφαγεν καὶ ἐνεπλήσθη καὶ θερμανθεὶς εἶπεν ἡδύ μοι ὅτι ἐθερμάνθην καὶ εἶδον πῦρ

text_en: But the residue thereof he made a god, and a graven thing for himself: he bows down before it, and adores it, and prays unto it, saying: Deliver me, for you are my God .
text_la: reliquum autem ejus deum fecit et sculptile sibi; curvatur ante illud, et adorat illud, et obsecrat, dicens : Libera me, quia deus meus es tu!
text_pt: Então do resto faz um deus, uma imagem de escultura; ajoelha-se diante dela, e se inclina, e roga-lhe, e diz: Livra-me, porquanto tu és o meu deus.
text_el: τὸ δὲ λοιπὸν ἐποίησεν εἰς θεὸν γλυπτὸν καὶ προσκυνεῖ αὐτῷ καὶ προσεύχεται λέγων ἐξελοῦ με ὅτι θεός μου εἶ σύ

text_en: They have not known , nor understood: for their eyes are covered that they may not see, and that they may not understand with their heart.
text_la: Nescierunt, neque intellexerunt; obliti enim sunt ne videant oculi eorum, et ne intelligant corde suo.
text_pt: Nada sabem, nem entendem; porque tapou os olhos para que não vejam, e os seus corações para que não entendam.
text_el: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν φρονῆσαι ὅτι ἀπημαυρώθησαν τοῦ βλέπειν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ τοῦ νοῆσαι τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν

text_en: They do not consider in their mind, nor know , nor have the thought to say: I have burnt part of it in the fire, and I have baked bread upon the coals thereof: I have broiled flesh and have eaten, and of the residue thereof shall I make an idol ? Shall I fall down before the stock of a tree?
text_la: Non recogitant in mente sua, neque cognoscunt, neque sentiunt, ut dicant : Medietatem ejus combussi igni, et coxi super carbones ejus panes; coxi carnes et comedi, et de reliquo ejus idolum faciam? ante truncum ligni procidam?
text_pt: E nenhum deles cai em si, e já não têm conhecimento nem entendimento para dizer: Metade queimei no fogo, e cozi pão sobre as suas brasas, assei sobre elas carne, e a comi; e faria eu do resto uma abominação? Ajoelhar-me-ei ao que saiu de uma árvore?
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐλογίσατο τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἀνελογίσατο ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἔγνω τῇ φρονήσει ὅτι τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ κατέκαυσεν ἐν πυρὶ καὶ ἔπεψεν ἐπὶ τῶν ἀνθράκων αὐτοῦ ἄρτους καὶ ὀπτήσας κρέας ἔφαγεν καὶ τὸ λοιπὸν αὐτοῦ εἰς βδέλυγμα ἐποίησεν καὶ προσκυνοῦσιν αὐτῷ

text_en: Part thereof is ashes: his foolish heart adores it, and he will not save his soul , nor say: Perhaps there is a lie in my right hand.
text_la: Pars ejus cinis est; cor insipiens adoravit illud, et non liberabit animam suam : neque dicet : Forte mendacium est in dextera mea.
text_pt: Apascenta-se de cinza; o seu coração enganado o desviou, de maneira que já não pode livrar a sua alma, nem dizer: Porventura não há uma mentira na minha mão direita?
text_el: γνῶτε ὅτι σποδὸς ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν καὶ πλανῶνται καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐξελέσθαι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἴδετε οὐκ ἐρεῖτε ὅτι ψεῦδος ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ μου

text_en: Remember these things, O Jacob , and Israel , for you are my servant. I have formed you, you are my servant, O Israel , forget me not.
text_la: Memento horum Jacob, et Israël, quoniam servus meus es tu. Formavi te; servus meus es tu, Israël, ne obliviscaris mei.
text_pt: Lembra-te destas coisas, ó Jacó, e Israel, porquanto és meu servo; eu te formei, meu servo és, ó Israel, não me esquecerei de ti.
text_el: μνήσθητι ταῦτα Ιακωβ καὶ Ισραηλ ὅτι παῖς μου εἶ σύ ἔπλασά σε παῖδά μου καὶ σύ Ισραηλ μὴ ἐπιλανθάνου μου

text_en: I have blotted out your iniquities as a cloud, and your sins as a mist: return to me, for I have redeemed you.
text_la: Delevi ut nubem iniquitates tuas, et quasi nebulam peccata tua : revertere ad me, quoniam redemi te.
text_pt: Apaguei as tuas transgressões como a névoa, e os teus pecados como a nuvem; torna-te para mim, porque eu te remi.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀπήλειψα ὡς νεφέλην τὰς ἀνομίας σου καὶ ὡς γνόφον τὰς ἁμαρτίας σου ἐπιστράφητι πρός με καὶ λυτρώσομαί σε

text_en: Give praise, O you heavens , for the Lord has shown mercy: shout with joy , you ends of the earth: you mountains, resound with praise, you, O forest, and every tree therein: for the Lord has redeemed Jacob , and Israel shall be glorified .
text_la: Laudate, cæli, quoniam misericordiam fecit Dominus; jubilate, extrema terræ; resonate, montes, laudationem, saltus et omne lignum ejus, quoniam redemit Dominus Jacob, et Israël gloriabitur.
text_pt: Cantai alegres, vós, ó céus, porque o Senhor o fez; exultai vós, as partes mais baixas da terra; vós, montes, retumbai com júbilo; também vós, bosques, e todas as suas árvores; porque o Senhor remiu a Jacó, e glorificou-se em Israel.
text_el: εὐφράνθητε οὐρανοί ὅτι ἠλέησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν Ισραηλ σαλπίσατε θεμέλια τῆς γῆς βοήσατε ὄρη εὐφροσύνην οἱ βουνοὶ καὶ πάντα τὰ ξύλα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἐλυτρώσατο ὁ θεὸς τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ Ισραηλ δοξασθήσεται

text_en: Thus says the Lord your redeemer , and your maker, from the womb: I am the Lord , that make all things, that alone stretch out the heavens , that established the earth, and there is none with me.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus, redemptor tuus, et formator tuus ex utero : Ego sum Dominus, faciens omnia, extendens cælos solus, stabiliens terram, et nullus mecum;
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, teu redentor, e que te formou desde o ventre: Eu sou o Senhor que faço tudo, que sozinho estendo os céus, e espraio a terra por mim mesmo;
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ λυτρούμενός σε καὶ ὁ πλάσσων σε ἐκ κοιλίας ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ συντελῶν πάντα ἐξέτεινα τὸν οὐρανὸν μόνος καὶ ἐστερέωσα τὴν γῆν τίς ἕτερος

text_en: That make void the tokens of diviners , and make the soothsayers mad. That turn the wise backward, and that make their knowledge foolish.
text_la: irrita faciens signa divinorum, et ariolos in furorem vertens; convertens sapientes retrorsum, et scientiam eorum stultam faciens;
text_pt: Que desfaço os sinais dos inventores de mentiras, e enlouqueço os adivinhos; que faço tornar atrás os sábios, e converto em loucura o conhecimento deles;
text_el: διασκεδάσει σημεῖα ἐγγαστριμύθων καὶ μαντείας ἀπὸ καρδίας ἀποστρέφων φρονίμους εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ τὴν βουλὴν αὐτῶν μωρεύων

text_en: That raise up the word of my servant and perform the counsel of my messengers, who say to Jerusalem : You shall be inhabited: and to the cities of Juda : You shall be built, and I will raise up the wastes thereof.
text_la: suscitans verbum servi sui, et consilium nuntiorum suorum complens; qui dico Jerusalem : Habitaberis, et civitatibus Juda : Ædificabimini, et deserta ejus suscitabo;
text_pt: Que confirmo a palavra do seu servo, e cumpro o conselho dos seus mensageiros; que digo a Jerusalém: Tu serás habitada, e às cidades de Judá: Sereis edificadas, e eu levantarei as suas ruínas;
text_el: καὶ ἱστῶν ῥήματα παιδὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν βουλὴν τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ ἀληθεύων ὁ λέγων Ιερουσαλημ κατοικηθήσῃ καὶ ταῖς πόλεσιν τῆς Ιουδαίας οἰκοδομηθήσεσθε καὶ τὰ ἔρημα αὐτῆς ἀνατελεῖ

text_en: Who say to the deep: Be desolate, and I will dry up your rivers.
text_la: qui dico profundo : Desolare, et flumina tua arefaciam;
text_pt: Que digo à profundeza: Seca-te, e eu secarei os teus rios.
text_el: ὁ λέγων τῇ ἀβύσσῳ ἐρημωθήσῃ καὶ τοὺς ποταμούς σου ξηρανῶ

text_en: Who say to Cyrus: You are my shepherd, and you shall perform all my pleasure. Who say to Jerusalem : You shall be built: and to the temple : Your foundations shall be laid.
text_la: qui dico Cyro : Pastor meus es, et omnem voluntatem meam complebis; qui dico Jerusalem : Ædificaberis, et templo : Fundaberis.
text_pt: Que digo de Ciro: É meu pastor, e cumprirá tudo o que me apraz, dizendo também a Jerusalém: Tu serás edificada; e ao templo: Tu serás fundado.
text_el: ὁ λέγων Κύρῳ φρονεῖν καὶ πάντα τὰ θελήματά μου ποιήσει ὁ λέγων Ιερουσαλημ οἰκοδομηθήσῃ καὶ τὸν οἶκον τὸν ἅγιόν μου θεμελιώσω

text_en: Thus says the Lord to my anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I have taken hold of, to subdue nations before his face, and to turn the backs of kings, and to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus christo meo Cyro, cujus apprehendi dexteram, ut subjiciam ante faciem ejus gentes, et dorsa regum vertam, et aperiam coram eo januas, et portæ non claudentur :
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR ao seu ungido, a Ciro, a quem tomo pela mão direita, para abater as nações diante de sua face, e descingir os lombos dos reis, para abrir diante dele as portas, e as portas não se fecharão.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῷ χριστῷ μου Κύρῳ οὗ ἐκράτησα τῆς δεξιᾶς ἐπακοῦσαι ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ ἔθνη καὶ ἰσχὺν βασιλέων διαρρήξω ἀνοίξω ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ θύρας καὶ πόλεις οὐ συγκλεισθήσονται

text_en: I will go before you, and will humble the great ones of the earth: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and will burst the bars of iron.
text_la: Ego ante te ibo, et gloriosos terræ humiliabo; portas æreas conteram, et vectes ferreos confringam :
text_pt: Eu irei adiante de ti, e endireitarei os caminhos tortuosos; quebrarei as portas de bronze, e despedaçarei os ferrolhos de ferro.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἔμπροσθέν σου πορεύσομαι καὶ ὄρη ὁμαλιῶ θύρας χαλκᾶς συντρίψω καὶ μοχλοὺς σιδηροῦς συγκλάσω

text_en: And I will give you hidden treasures, and the concealed riches of secret places: that you may know that I am the Lord who call you by your name , the God of Israel .
text_la: et dabo tibi thesauros absconditos, et arcana secretorum, ut scias quia ego Dominus, qui voco nomen tuum, Deus Israël,
text_pt: Dar-te-ei os tesouros escondidos, e as riquezas encobertas, para que saibas que eu sou o Senhor, o Deus de Israel, que te chama pelo teu nome.
text_el: καὶ δώσω σοι θησαυροὺς σκοτεινούς ἀποκρύφους ἀοράτους ἀνοίξω σοι ἵνα γνῷς ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ καλῶν τὸ ὄνομά σου θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: For the sake of my servant Jacob , and Israel my elect , I have even called you by your name : I have made a likeness of you, and you have not known me.
text_la: propter servum meum Jacob, et Israël, electum meum; et vocavi te nomine tuo : assimilavi te, et non cognovisti me.
text_pt: Por amor de meu servo Jacó, e de Israel, meu eleito, eu te chamei pelo teu nome, pus o teu sobrenome, ainda que não me conhecesses.
text_el: ἕνεκεν Ιακωβ τοῦ παιδός μου καὶ Ισραηλ τοῦ ἐκλεκτοῦ μου ἐγὼ καλέσω σε τῷ ὀνόματί σου καὶ προσδέξομαί σε σὺ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνως με

text_en: I am the Lord , and there is none else: there is no God besides me: I girded you, and you have not known me:
text_la: Ego Dominus, et non est amplius; extra me non est deus; accinxi te, et non cognovisti me :
text_pt: Eu sou o Senhor, e não há outro; fora de mim não há Deus; eu te cingirei, ainda que tu não me conheças;
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι πλὴν ἐμοῦ θεός καὶ οὐκ ᾔδεις με

text_en: That they may know who are from the rising of the sun, and they who are from the west, that there is none besides me. I am the Lord , and there is none else:
text_la: ut sciant hi qui ab ortu solis et qui ab occidente, quoniam absque me non est : ego Dominus, et non est alter :
text_pt: Para que se saiba desde o nascente do sol, e desde o poente, que fora de mim não há outro; eu sou o Senhor, e não há outro.
text_el: ἵνα γνῶσιν οἱ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου καὶ οἱ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν πλὴν ἐμοῦ ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι

text_en: I form the light, and create darkness, I make peace, and create evil : I the Lord that do all these things.
text_la: formans lucem et creans tenebras, faciens pacem et creans malum : ego Dominus faciens omnia hæc.
text_pt: Eu formo a luz, e crio as trevas; eu faço a paz, e crio o mal; eu, o Senhor, faço todas estas coisas.
text_el: ἐγὼ ὁ κατασκευάσας φῶς καὶ ποιήσας σκότος ὁ ποιῶν εἰρήνην καὶ κτίζων κακά ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ποιῶν ταῦτα πάντα

text_en: Drop down dew, you heavens , from above, and let the clouds rain the just : let the earth be opened, and bud forth a saviour: and let justice spring up together: I the Lord have created him.
text_la: Rorate, cæli, desuper, et nubes pluant justum; aperiatur terra, et germinet Salvatorem, et justitia oriatur simul : ego Dominus creavi eum.
text_pt: Destilai, ó céus, dessas alturas, e as nuvens chovam justiça; abra-se a terra, e produza a salvação, e ao mesmo tempo frutifique a justiça; eu, o Senhor, as criei.
text_el: εὐφρανθήτω ὁ οὐρανὸς ἄνωθεν καὶ αἱ νεφέλαι ῥανάτωσαν δικαιοσύνην ἀνατειλάτω ἡ γῆ ἔλεος καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἀνατειλάτω ἅμα ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ κτίσας σε

text_en: Woe to him that gainsays his maker, a sherd of the earthen pots: shall the clay say to him that fashions it: What are you making, and your work is without hands?
text_la: Væ qui contradicit fictori suo, testa de samiis terræ! Numquid dicet lutum figulo suo : Quid facis, et opus tuum absque manibus est?
text_pt: Ai daquele que contende com o seu Criador! o caco entre outros cacos de barro! Porventura dirá o barro ao que o formou: Que fazes? ou a tua obra: Não tens mãos?
text_el: ποῖον βέλτιον κατεσκεύασα ὡς πηλὸν κεραμέως μὴ ὁ ἀροτριῶν ἀροτριάσει τὴν γῆν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν μὴ ἐρεῖ ὁ πηλὸς τῷ κεραμεῖ τί ποιεῖς ὅτι οὐκ ἐργάζῃ οὐδὲ ἔχεις χεῖρας

text_en: Woe to him that says to his father: Why do you beget? And to the woman : Why do you bring forth?
text_la: Væ qui dicit patri : Quid generas? et mulieri : Quid parturis?
text_pt: Ai daquele que diz ao pai: Que é o que geras? E à mulher: Que dás tu à luz?
text_el: ὁ λέγων τῷ πατρί τί γεννήσεις καὶ τῇ μητρί τί ὠδινήσεις

text_en: Thus says the Lord the Holy One of Israel , his maker: Ask me of things to come, concerning my children, and concerning the work of my hands give charge to me.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus, Sanctus Israël, plastes ejus : Ventura interrogate me; super filios meos et super opus manuum mearum mandate mihi.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, o Santo de Israel, aquele que o formou: Perguntai-me as coisas futuras; demandai-me acerca de meus filhos, e acerca da obra das minhas mãos.
text_el: ὅτι οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἅγιος Ισραηλ ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἐπερχόμενα ἐρωτήσατέ με περὶ τῶν υἱῶν μου καὶ περὶ τῶν θυγατέρων μου καὶ περὶ τῶν ἔργων τῶν χειρῶν μου ἐντείλασθέ μοι

text_en: I made the earth: and I created man upon it: my hand stretched forth the heavens , and I have commanded all their host.
text_la: Ego feci terram, et hominem super eam creavi ego : manus meæ tetenderunt cælos, et omni militiæ eorum mandavi.
text_pt: Eu fiz a terra, e criei nela o homem; eu o fiz; as minhas mãos estenderam os céus, e a todos os seus exércitos dei as minhas ordens.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐποίησα γῆν καὶ ἄνθρωπον ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἐγὼ τῇ χειρί μου ἐστερέωσα τὸν οὐρανόν ἐγὼ πᾶσι τοῖς ἄστροις ἐνετειλάμην

text_en: I have raised him up to justice , and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and let go my captives, not for ransom, nor for presents, says the Lord the God of hosts .
text_la: Ego suscitavi eum ad justitiam, et omnes vias ejus dirigam; ipse ædificabit civitatem meam, et captivitatem meam dimittet, non in pretio neque in muneribus, dicit Dominus Deus exercituum.
text_pt: Eu o despertei em justiça, e todos os seus caminhos endireitarei; ele edificará a minha cidade, e soltará os meus cativos, não por preço nem por presente, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἤγειρα αὐτὸν μετὰ δικαιοσύνης βασιλέα καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ εὐθεῖαι οὗτος οἰκοδομήσει τὴν πόλιν μου καὶ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἐπιστρέψει οὐ μετὰ λύτρων οὐδὲ μετὰ δώρων εἶπεν κύριος σαβαωθ

text_en: Thus says the Lord : The labour of Egypt , and the merchandise of Ethiopia , and of Sabaim, men of stature shall come over to you, and shall be yours: they shall walk after you, they shall go bound with manacles: and they shall worship you, and shall make supplication to you: only in you is God , and there is no God besides you.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Labor Ægypti, et negotiatio Æthiopiæ, et Sabaim viri sublimes ad te transibunt, et tui erunt; post te ambulabunt, vincti manicis pergent, et te adorabunt, teque deprecabuntur. Tantum in te est Deus, et non est absque te deus.
text_pt: Assim diz o SENHOR: O trabalho do Egito, e o comércio dos etíopes e dos sabeus, homens de alta estatura, passarão para ti, e serão teus; irão atrás de ti, virão em grilhões, e diante de ti se prostrarão; far-te-ão as suas súplicas, dizendo: Deveras Deus está em ti, e não há nenhum outro deus.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος σαβαωθ ἐκοπίασεν Αἴγυπτος καὶ ἐμπορία Αἰθιόπων καὶ οἱ Σεβωιν ἄνδρες ὑψηλοὶ ἐπὶ σὲ διαβήσονται καὶ σοὶ ἔσονται δοῦλοι καὶ ὀπίσω σου ἀκολουθήσουσιν δεδεμένοι χειροπέδαις καὶ προσκυνήσουσίν σοι καὶ ἐν σοὶ προσεύξονται ὅτι ἐν σοὶ ὁ θεός ἐστιν καὶ ἐροῦσιν οὐκ ἔστιν θεὸς πλὴν σοῦ

text_en: Verily you are a hidden God , the God of Israel the saviour.
text_la: Vere tu es Deus absconditus, Deus Israël, salvator.
text_pt: Verdadeiramente tu és o Deus que te ocultas, o Deus de Israel, o Salvador.
text_el: σὺ γὰρ εἶ θεός καὶ οὐκ ᾔδειμεν ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ισραηλ σωτήρ

text_en: They are all confounded and ashamed: the forgers of errors have gone together into confusion.
text_la: Confusi sunt, et erubuerunt omnes : simul abierunt in confusionem fabricatores errorum.
text_pt: Envergonhar-se-ão, e também se confundirão todos; cairão juntamente na afronta os que fabricam imagens.
text_el: αἰσχυνθήσονται καὶ ἐντραπήσονται πάντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι αὐτῷ καὶ πορεύσονται ἐν αἰσχύνῃ ἐγκαινίζεσθε πρός με νῆσοι

text_en: Israel is saved in the Lord with an eternal salvation : you shall not be confounded, and you shall not be ashamed for ever and ever.
text_la: Israël salvatus est in Domino salute æterna; non confundemini, et non erubescetis usque in sæculum sæculi.
text_pt: Porém Israel é salvo pelo Senhor, com uma eterna salvação; por isso não sereis envergonhados nem confundidos em toda a eternidade.
text_el: Ισραηλ σῴζεται ὑπὸ κυρίου σωτηρίαν αἰώνιον οὐκ αἰσχυνθήσονται οὐδὲ μὴ ἐντραπῶσιν ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: For thus says the Lord that created the heavens , God himself that formed the earth, and made it, the very maker thereof: he did not create it in vain: he formed it to be inhabited. I am the Lord , and there is no other.
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Dominus creans cælos, ipse Deus formans terram et faciens eam, ipse plastes ejus; non in vanum creavit eam : ut habitaretur formavit eam : Ego Dominus, et non est alius.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor que tem criado os céus, o Deus que formou a terra, e a fez; ele a confirmou, não a criou vazia, mas a formou para que fosse habitada: Eu sou o Senhor e não há outro.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανόν οὗτος ὁ θεὸς ὁ καταδείξας τὴν γῆν καὶ ποιήσας αὐτήν αὐτὸς διώρισεν αὐτήν οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἐποίησεν αὐτὴν ἀλλὰ κατοικεῖσθαι ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι

text_en: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I have not said to the seed of Jacob : Seek me in vain. I am the Lord that speak justice , that declare right things.
text_la: Non in abscondito locutus sum, in loco terræ tenebroso; non dixi semini Jacob frustra : Quærite me : ego Dominus loquens justitiam, annuntians recta.
text_pt: Não falei em segredo, nem em lugar algum escuro da terra; não disse à descendência de Jacó: Buscai-me em vão; eu sou o Senhor, que falo a justiça, e anuncio coisas retas.
text_el: οὐκ ἐν κρυφῇ λελάληκα οὐδὲ ἐν τόπῳ γῆς σκοτεινῷ οὐκ εἶπα τῷ σπέρματι Ιακωβ μάταιον ζητήσατε ἐγώ εἰμι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος λαλῶν δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἀναγγέλλων ἀλήθειαν

text_en: Assemble yourselves, and come, and draw near together, you that are saved of the Gentiles : they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven work, and pray to a god that cannot save.
text_la: Congregamini, et venite, et accedite simul qui salvati estis ex gentibus : nescierunt qui levant lignum sculpturæ suæ, et rogant deum non salvantem.
text_pt: Congregai-vos, e vinde; chegai-vos juntos, os que escapastes das nações; nada sabem os que conduzem em procissão as suas imagens de escultura, feitas de madeira, e rogam a um deus que não pode salvar.
text_el: συνάχθητε καὶ ἥκετε βουλεύσασθε ἅμα οἱ σῳζόμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οἱ αἴροντες τὸ ξύλον γλύμμα αὐτῶν καὶ προσευχόμενοι ὡς πρὸς θεούς οἳ οὐ σῴζουσιν

text_en: Tell, and come, and consult together: who has declared this from the beginning, who has foretold this from that time? Have not I the Lord , and there is no God else besides me? A just God and a saviour, there is none besides me.
text_la: Annuntiate, et venite, et consiliamini simul. Quis auditum fecit hoc ab initio, ex tunc prædixit illud? numquid non ego Dominus, et non est ultra deus absque me? Deus justus, et salvans non est præter me.
text_pt: Anunciai, e chegai-vos, e tomai conselho todos juntos; quem fez ouvir isto desde a antiguidade? Quem desde então o anunciou? Porventura não sou eu, o Senhor? Pois não há outro Deus senão eu; Deus justo e Salvador não há além de mim.
text_el: εἰ ἀναγγελοῦσιν ἐγγισάτωσαν ἵνα γνῶσιν ἅμα τίς ἀκουστὰ ἐποίησεν ταῦτα ἀπ' ἀρχῆς τότε ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν ἐγὼ ὁ θεός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλος πλὴν ἐμοῦ δίκαιος καὶ σωτὴρ οὐκ ἔστιν πάρεξ ἐμοῦ

text_en: Be converted to me, and you shall be saved, all you ends of the earth: for I am God , and there is no other.
text_la: Convertimini ad me, et salvi eritis, omnes fines terræ, quia ego Deus, et non est alius.
text_pt: Olhai para mim, e sereis salvos, vós, todos os termos da terra; porque eu sou Deus, e não há outro.
text_el: ἐπιστράφητε πρός με καὶ σωθήσεσθε οἱ ἀπ' ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλος

text_en: I have sworn by myself, the word of justice shall go out of my mouth, and shall not return:
text_la: In memetipso juravi; egredietur de ore meo justitiæ verbum, et non revertetur :
text_pt: Por mim mesmo tenho jurado, já saiu da minha boca a palavra de justiça, e não tornará atrás; que diante de mim se dobrará todo o joelho, e por mim jurará toda a língua.
text_el: κατ' ἐμαυτοῦ ὀμνύω ἦ μὴν ἐξελεύσεται ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου δικαιοσύνη οἱ λόγοι μου οὐκ ἀποστραφήσονται

text_en: For every knee shall be bowed to me, and every tongue shall swear .
text_la: quia mihi curvabitur omne genu, et jurabit omnis lingua.
text_pt: De mim se dirá: Deveras no Senhor há justiça e força; até ele virão, mas serão envergonhados todos os que se indignarem contra ele.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμοὶ κάμψει πᾶν γόνυ καὶ ἐξομολογήσεται πᾶσα γλῶσσα τῷ θεῷ

text_en: Therefore shall he say: In the Lord are my justices and empire: they shall come to him, and all that resist him shall be confounded.
text_la: Ergo in Domino, dicet, meæ sunt justitiæ et imperium; ad eum venient, et confundentur omnes qui repugnant ei.
text_pt: Mas no Senhor será justificada, e se gloriará toda a descendência de Israel.
text_el: λέγων δικαιοσύνη καὶ δόξα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἥξουσιν καὶ αἰσχυνθήσονται πάντες οἱ ἀφορίζοντες ἑαυτούς

text_en: In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.
text_la: In Domino justificabitur, et laudabitur omne semen Israël.
text_el: ἀπὸ κυρίου δικαιωθήσονται καὶ ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἐνδοξασθήσονται πᾶν τὸ σπέρμα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: Bel is broken, Nebo is destroyed: their idols are put upon beasts and cattle, your burdens of heavy weight even unto weariness.
text_la: Confractus est Bel, contritus est Nabo; facta sunt simulacra eorum bestiis et jumentis, onera vestra gravi pondere usque ad lassitudinem.
text_pt: Bel está abatido, Nebo se encurvou, os seus ídolos são postos sobre os animais e sobre as feras; as cargas dos vossos fardos são canseiras para as feras já cansadas.
text_el: ἔπεσε Βηλ συνετρίβη Δαγων ἐγένετο τὰ γλυπτὰ αὐτῶν εἰς θηρία καὶ κτήνη αἴρετε αὐτὰ καταδεδεμένα ὡς φορτίον κοπιῶντι

text_en: They are consumed, and are broken together: they could not save him that carried them, and they themselves shall go into captivity.
text_la: Contabuerunt, et contrita sunt simul; non potuerunt salvare portantem, et anima eorum in captivitatem ibit.
text_pt: Juntamente se encurvaram e se abateram; não puderam livrar-se da carga, mas a sua alma entrou em cativeiro.
text_el: καὶ πεινῶντι καὶ ἐκλελυμένῳ οὐκ ἰσχύοντι ἅμα οἳ οὐ δυνήσονται σωθῆναι ἀπὸ πολέμου αὐτοὶ δὲ αἰχμάλωτοι ἤχθησαν

text_en: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob , all the remnant of the house of Israel who are carried by my bowels, are borne up by my womb.
text_la: Audite me, domus Jacob, et omne residuum domus Israël; qui portamini a meo utero, qui gestamini a mea vulva.
text_pt: Ouvi-me, ó casa de Jacó, e todo o restante da casa de Israel; vós a quem trouxe nos braços desde o ventre, e sois levados desde a madre.
text_el: ἀκούσατέ μου οἶκος τοῦ Ιακωβ καὶ πᾶν τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ Ισραηλ οἱ αἰρόμενοι ἐκ κοιλίας καὶ παιδευόμενοι ἐκ παιδίου

text_en: Even to your old age I am the same, and to your grey hairs I will carry you: I have made you, and I will bear: I will carry and will save.
text_la: Usque ad senectam ego ipse, et usque ad canos ego portabo; ego feci, et ego feram; ego portabo, et salvabo.
text_pt: E até à velhice eu serei o mesmo, e ainda até às cãs eu vos carregarei; eu vos fiz, e eu vos levarei, e eu vos trarei, e vos livrarei.
text_el: ἕως γήρους ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ ἕως ἂν καταγηράσητε ἐγώ εἰμι ἐγὼ ἀνέχομαι ὑμῶν ἐγὼ ἐποίησα καὶ ἐγὼ ἀνήσω ἐγὼ ἀναλήμψομαι καὶ σώσω ὑμᾶς

text_en: To whom have you likened me, and made me equal, and compared me, and made me like?
text_la: Cui assimilastis me, et adæquastis, et comparastis me, et fecistis similem?
text_pt: A quem me assemelhareis, e com quem me igualareis, e me comparareis, para que sejamos semelhantes?
text_el: τίνι με ὡμοιώσατε ἴδετε τεχνάσασθε οἱ πλανώμενοι

text_en: You that contribute gold out of the bag, and weigh out silver in the scales: and hire a goldsmith to make a god: and they fall down and worship.
text_la: Qui confertis aurum de sacculo, et argentum statera ponderatis, conducentes aurificem ut faciat deum, et procidunt, et adorant.
text_pt: Gastam o ouro da bolsa, e pesam a prata nas balanças; assalariam o ourives, e ele faz um deus, e diante dele se prostram e se inclinam.
text_el: οἱ συμβαλλόμενοι χρυσίον ἐκ μαρσιππίου καὶ ἀργύριον ἐν ζυγῷ στήσουσιν ἐν σταθμῷ καὶ μισθωσάμενοι χρυσοχόον ἐποίησαν χειροποίητα καὶ κύψαντες προσκυνοῦσιν αὐτοῖς

text_en: They bear him on their shoulders and carry him, and set him in his place, and he shall stand, and shall not stir out of his place. Yea, when they shall cry also unto him, he shall not hear: he shall not save them from tribulation.
text_la: Portant illum in humeris gestantes, et ponentes in loco suo, et stabit, ac de loco suo non movebitur : sed et cum clamaverint ad eum, non audiet; de tribulatione non salvabit eos.
text_pt: Sobre os ombros o tomam, o levam, e o põem no seu lugar; ali fica em pé, do seu lugar não se move; e, se alguém clama a ele, resposta nenhuma dá, nem livra alguém da sua tribulação.
text_el: αἴρουσιν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τῶν ὤμων καὶ πορεύονται ἐὰν δὲ θῶσιν αὐτό ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ μένει οὐ μὴ κινηθῇ καὶ ὃς ἂν βοήσῃ πρὸς αὐτόν οὐ μὴ εἰσακούσῃ ἀπὸ κακῶν οὐ μὴ σώσῃ αὐτόν

text_en: Remember this, and be ashamed: return, you transgressors, to the heart.
text_la: Mementote istud, et confundamini; redite, prævaricatores, ad cor.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos disto, e considerai; trazei-o à memória, ó prevaricadores.
text_el: μνήσθητε ταῦτα καὶ στενάξατε μετανοήσατε οἱ πεπλανημένοι ἐπιστρέψατε τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: Remember the former age, for I am God , and there is no God beside, neither is there the like to me:
text_la: Recordamini prioris sæculi, quoniam ego sum Deus, et non est ultra deus, nec est similis mei.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos das coisas passadas desde a antiguidade; que eu sou Deus, e não há outro Deus, não há outro semelhante a mim.
text_el: καὶ μνήσθητε τὰ πρότερα ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι πλὴν ἐμοῦ

text_en: Who show from the beginning the things that shall be at last, and from ancient times the things that as yet are not done, saying: My counsel shall stand, and all my will shall be done:
text_la: Annuntians ab exordio novissimum, et ab initio quæ necdum facta sunt, dicens : Consilium meum stabit, et omnis voluntas mea fiet.
text_pt: Que anuncio o fim desde o princípio, e desde a antiguidade as coisas que ainda não sucederam; que digo: O meu conselho será firme, e farei toda a minha vontade.
text_el: ἀναγγέλλων πρότερον τὰ ἔσχατα πρὶν αὐτὰ γενέσθαι καὶ ἅμα συνετελέσθη καὶ εἶπα πᾶσά μου ἡ βουλὴ στήσεται καὶ πάντα ὅσα βεβούλευμαι ποιήσω

text_en: Who call a bird from the east, and from a far country the man of my own will , and I have spoken, and will bring it to pass: I have created , and I will do it.
text_la: Vocans ab oriente avem, et de terra longinqua virum voluntatis meæ : et locutus sum, et adducam illud; creavi et faciam illud.
text_pt: Que chamo a ave de rapina desde o oriente, e de uma terra remota o homem do meu conselho; porque assim o disse, e assim o farei vir; eu o formei, e também o farei.
text_el: καλῶν ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν πετεινὸν καὶ ἀπὸ γῆς πόρρωθεν περὶ ὧν βεβούλευμαι ἐλάλησα καὶ ἤγαγον ἔκτισα καὶ ἐποίησα ἤγαγον αὐτὸν καὶ εὐόδωσα τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Hear me, O you hardhearted, who are far from justice .
text_la: Audite me, duro corde, qui longe estis a justitia.
text_pt: Ouvi-me, ó duros de coração, os que estais longe da justiça.
text_el: ἀκούσατέ μου οἱ ἀπολωλεκότες τὴν καρδίαν οἱ μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς δικαιοσύνης

text_en: I have brought my justice near, it shall not be afar off: and my salvation shall not tarry. I will give salvation in Sion, and my glory in Israel .
text_la: Prope feci justitiam meam, non elongabitur, et salus mea non morabitur. Dabo in Sion salutem, et in Israël gloriam meam.
text_pt: Faço chegar a minha justiça, e não estará ao longe, e a minha salvação não tardará; mas estabelecerei em Sião a salvação, e em Israel a minha glória.
text_el: ἤγγισα τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου καὶ τὴν σωτηρίαν τὴν παρ' ἐμοῦ οὐ βραδυνῶ δέδωκα ἐν Σιων σωτηρίαν τῷ Ισραηλ εἰς δόξασμα

text_en: Come down, sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground: there is no throne for the daughter of the Chaldeans, for you shall no more be called delicate and tender.
text_la: Descende, sede in pulvere, virgo filia Babylon : sede in terra; non est solium filiæ Chaldæorum, quia ultra non vocaberis mollis et tenera.
text_pt: Desce, e assenta-te no pó, ó virgem filha de babilônia; assenta-te no chão; já não há trono, ó filha dos caldeus, porque nunca mais serás chamada a tenra nem a delicada.
text_el: κατάβηθι κάθισον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν παρθένος θυγάτηρ Βαβυλῶνος εἴσελθε εἰς τὸ σκότος θυγάτηρ Χαλδαίων ὅτι οὐκέτι προστεθήσῃ κληθῆναι ἁπαλὴ καὶ τρυφερά

text_en: Take a millstone and grind meal: uncover your shame, strip your shoulder, make bare your legs, pass over the rivers.
text_la: Tolle molam, et mole farinam; denuda turpitudinem tuam; discooperi humerum, revela crura, transi flumina.
text_pt: Toma a mó, e mói a farinha; remove o teu véu, descalça os pés, descobre as pernas e passa os rios.
text_el: λαβὲ μύλον ἄλεσον ἄλευρον ἀποκάλυψαι τὸ κατακάλυμμά σου ἀνακάλυψαι τὰς πολιάς ἀνάσυραι τὰς κνήμας διάβηθι ποταμούς

text_en: Your nakedness shall be discovered, and your shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and no man shall resist me.
text_la: Revelabitur ignominia tua, et videbitur opprobrium tuum; ultionem capiam, et non resistet mihi homo.
text_pt: A tua vergonha se descobrirá, e ver-se-á o teu opróbrio; tomarei vingança, e não pouparei a homem algum.
text_el: ἀνακαλυφθήσεται ἡ αἰσχύνη σου φανήσονται οἱ ὀνειδισμοί σου τὸ δίκαιον ἐκ σοῦ λήμψομαι οὐκέτι μὴ παραδῶ ἀνθρώποις

text_en: Our redeemer , the Lord of hosts is his name , the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Redemptor noster, Dominus exercituum nomen illius, Sanctus Israël.
text_pt: O nosso redentor cujo nome é o Senhor dos Exércitos, é o Santo de Israel.
text_el: εἶπεν ὁ ῥυσάμενός σε κύριος σαβαωθ ὄνομα αὐτῷ ἅγιος Ισραηλ

text_en: Sit silent, and get into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called the lady of kingdoms.
text_la: Sede tacens, et intra in tenebras, filia Chaldæorum, quia non vocaberis ultra domina regnorum.
text_pt: Assenta-te calada, e entra nas trevas, ó filha dos caldeus, porque nunca mais serás chamada senhora de reinos.
text_el: κάθισον κατανενυγμένη εἴσελθε εἰς τὸ σκότος θυγάτηρ Χαλδαίων οὐκέτι μὴ κληθῇς ἰσχὺς βασιλείας

text_en: I was angry with my people, I have polluted my inheritance, and have given them into your hand: you have shown no mercy to them: upon the ancient you have laid your yoke exceeding heavy.
text_la: Iratus sum super populum meum : contaminavi hæreditatem meam, et dedi eos in manu tua : non posuisti eis misericordias; super senem aggravasti jugum tuum valde.
text_pt: Muito me agastei contra o meu povo, profanei a minha herança, e os entreguei na tua mão; porém não usaste com eles de misericórdia, e até sobre os velhos fizeste muito pesado o teu jugo.
text_el: παρωξύνθην ἐπὶ τῷ λαῷ μου ἐμίανας τὴν κληρονομίαν μου ἐγὼ ἔδωκα εἰς τὴν χεῖρά σου σὺ δὲ οὐκ ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς ἔλεος τοῦ πρεσβυτέρου ἐβάρυνας τὸν ζυγὸν σφόδρα

text_en: And you have said: I shall be a lady for ever: you have not laid these things to your heart, neither have you remembered your latter end.
text_la: Et dixisti : In sempiternum ero domina. Non posuisti hæc super cor tuum, neque recordata es novissimi tui.
text_pt: E disseste: Eu serei senhora para sempre; até agora não te importaste com estas coisas, nem te lembraste do fim delas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔσομαι ἄρχουσα οὐκ ἐνόησας ταῦτα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου οὐδὲ ἐμνήσθης τὰ ἔσχατα

text_en: And now hear these things, you that are delicate, and dwellest confidently, that say in your heart: I am, and there is none else besides me: I shall not sit as a widow , and I shall not know barrenness.
text_la: Et nunc audi hæc delicata, et habitans confidenter, quæ dicis in corde tuo : Ego sum, et non est præter me amplius; non sedebo vidua, et ignorabo sterilitatem.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ouve isto, tu que és dada a prazeres, que habitas tão segura, que dizes no teu coração: Eu o sou, e fora de mim não há outra; não ficarei viúva, nem conhecerei a perda de filhos.
text_el: νῦν δὲ ἄκουσον ταῦτα ἡ τρυφερὰ ἡ καθημένη πεποιθυῖα ἡ λέγουσα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἑτέρα οὐ καθιῶ χήρα οὐδὲ γνώσομαι ὀρφανείαν

text_en: These two things shall come upon you suddenly in one day, barrenness and widowhood. All things have come upon you, because of the multitude of your sorceries, and for the great hardness of your enchanters.
text_la: Venient tibi duo hæc subito in die una, sterilitas et viduitas : universa venerunt super te, propter multitudinem maleficiorum tuorum, et propter duritiam incantatorum tuorum vehementem.
text_pt: Porém ambas estas coisas virão sobre ti num momento, no mesmo dia, perda de filhos e viuvez; em toda a sua plenitude virão sobre ti, por causa da multidão das tuas feitiçarias, e da grande abundância dos teus muitos encantamentos.
text_el: νῦν δὲ ἥξει ἐξαίφνης ἐπὶ σὲ τὰ δύο ταῦτα ἐν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ χηρεία καὶ ἀτεκνία ἥξει ἐξαίφνης ἐπὶ σὲ ἐν τῇ φαρμακείᾳ σου ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι τῶν ἐπαοιδῶν σου σφόδρα

text_en: And you have trusted in your wickedness , and have said: There is none that sees me. Your wisdom, and, your knowledge , this has deceived you. And you have said in your heart: I am, and besides me there is no other.
text_la: Et fiduciam habuisti in malitia tua, et dixisti : Non est qui videat me. Sapientia tua et scientia tua, hæc decepit te. Et dixisti in corde tuo : Ego sum, et præter me non est altera.
text_pt: Porque confiaste na tua maldade e disseste: Ninguém me pode ver; a tua sabedoria e o teu conhecimento, isso te fez desviar, e disseste no teu coração: Eu sou, e fora de mim não há outra.
text_el: τῇ ἐλπίδι τῆς πονηρίας σου σὺ γὰρ εἶπας ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἑτέρα γνῶθι ὅτι ἡ σύνεσις τούτων καὶ ἡ πορνεία σου ἔσται σοι αἰσχύνη καὶ εἶπας τῇ καρδίᾳ σου ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἑτέρα

text_en: Evil shall come upon you, and you shall not know the rising thereof: and calamity shall fall violently upon you, which you can not keep off: misery shall come upon you suddenly, which you shall not know .
text_la: Veniet super te malum, et nescies ortum ejus; et irruet super te calamitas quam non poteris expiare; veniet super te repente miseria quam nescies.
text_pt: Portanto sobre ti virá o mal, sem que saibas a sua origem, e tal destruição cairá sobre ti, sem que a possas evitar; e virá sobre ti de repente desolação que não poderás conhecer.
text_el: καὶ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ ἀπώλεια καὶ οὐ μὴ γνῷς βόθυνος καὶ ἐμπεσῇ εἰς αὐτόν καὶ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ ταλαιπωρία καὶ οὐ μὴ δυνήσῃ καθαρὰ γενέσθαι καὶ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ ἐξαπίνης ἀπώλεια καὶ οὐ μὴ γνῷς

text_en: Stand now with your enchanters, and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have laboured from your youth, if so be it may profit you anything, or if you may become stronger.
text_la: Sta cum incantatoribus tuis et cum multitudine maleficiorum tuorum, in quibus laborasti ab adolescentia tua, si forte quod prosit tibi, aut si possis fieri fortior.
text_pt: Deixa-te estar com os teus encantamentos, e com a multidão das tuas feitiçarias, em que trabalhaste desde a tua mocidade, a ver se podes tirar proveito, ou se porventura te podes fortalecer.
text_el: στῆθι νῦν ἐν ταῖς ἐπαοιδαῖς σου καὶ τῇ πολλῇ φαρμακείᾳ σου ἃ ἐμάνθανες ἐκ νεότητός σου εἰ δυνήσῃ ὠφεληθῆναι

text_en: You have failed in the multitude of your counsels: let now the astrologers stand and save you, they that gazed at the stars, and counted the months, that from them they might tell the things that shall come to you.
text_la: Defecisti in multitudine consiliorum tuorum. Stent, et salvent te augures cæli, qui contemplabantur sidera, et supputabant menses, ut ex eis annuntiarent ventura tibi.
text_pt: Cansaste-te na multidão dos teus conselhos; levantem-se pois agora os agoureiros dos céus, os que contemplavam os astros, os prognosticadores das luas novas, e salvem-te do que há de vir sobre ti.
text_el: κεκοπίακας ἐν ταῖς βουλαῖς σου στήτωσαν καὶ σωσάτωσάν σε οἱ ἀστρολόγοι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οἱ ὁρῶντες τοὺς ἀστέρας ἀναγγειλάτωσάν σοι τί μέλλει ἐπὶ σὲ ἔρχεσθαι

text_en: Behold they are as stubble, fire has burnt them, they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flames: there are no coals wherewith they may be warmed, nor fire, that they may sit thereat.
text_la: Ecce facti sunt quasi stipula, ignis combussit eos; non liberabunt animam suam de manu flammæ; non sunt prunæ quibus calefiant, nec focus ut sedeant ad eum.
text_pt: Eis que serão como a pragana, o fogo os queimará; não poderão salvar a sua vida do poder das chamas; não haverá brasas, para se aquentar, nem fogo para se assentar junto dele.
text_el: ἰδοὺ πάντες ὡς φρύγανα ἐπὶ πυρὶ κατακαήσονται καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξέλωνται τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτῶν ἐκ φλογός ὅτι ἔχεις ἄνθρακας πυρός κάθισαι ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: Such are all the things become to you, in which you have laboured: your merchants from your youth, every one has erred in his own way, there is none that can save you.
text_la: Sic facta sunt tibi in quibuscumque laboraveras : negotiatores tui ab adolescentia tua, unusquisque in via sua erraverunt; non est qui salvet te.
text_pt: Assim serão para contigo aqueles com quem trabalhaste, os teus negociantes desde a tua mocidade; cada qual irá vagueando pelo seu caminho; ninguém te salvará.
text_el: οὗτοι ἔσονταί σοι βοήθεια ἐκοπίασας ἐν τῇ μεταβολῇ σου ἐκ νεότητος ἄνθρωπος καθ' ἑαυτὸν ἐπλανήθη σοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔσται σωτηρία

text_en: Hear these things, O house of Jacob , you that are called by the name of Israel , and have come forth out of the waters of Juda , you who swear by the name of the Lord , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in justice .
text_la: Audite hæc, domus Jacob, qui vocamini nomine Israël, et de aquis Juda existis; qui juratis in nomine Domini, et Dei Israël recordamini non in veritate neque in justitia.
text_pt: Ouvi isto, casa de Jacó, que vos chamais do nome de Israel, e saístes das águas de Judá, que jurais pelo nome do SENHOR, e fazeis menção do Deus de Israel, mas não em verdade nem em justiça.
text_el: ἀκούσατε ταῦτα οἶκος Ιακωβ οἱ κεκλημένοι τῷ ὀνόματι Ισραηλ καὶ οἱ ἐξ Ιουδα ἐξελθόντες οἱ ὀμνύοντες τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου θεοῦ Ισραηλ μιμνῃσκόμενοι οὐ μετὰ ἀληθείας οὐδὲ μετὰ δικαιοσύνης

text_en: For they are called of the holy city , and are established upon the God of Israel : the Lord of hosts is his name .
text_la: De civitate enim sancta vocati sunt, et super Deum Israël constabiliti sunt : Dominus exercituum nomen ejus.
text_pt: E até da santa cidade tomam o nome e se firmam sobre o Deus de Israel; o Senhor dos Exércitos é o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἀντεχόμενοι τῷ ὀνόματι τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἁγίας καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τοῦ Ισραηλ ἀντιστηριζόμενοι κύριος σαβαωθ ὄνομα αὐτῷ

text_en: The former things of old, I have declared, and they went forth out of my mouth, and I have made them to be heard: I did them suddenly and they came to pass.
text_la: Priora ex tunc annuntiavi, et ex ore meo exierunt, et audita feci ea : repente operatus sum, et venerunt.
text_pt: As primeiras coisas desde a antiguidade as anunciei; da minha boca saíram, e eu as fiz ouvir; apressuradamente as fiz, e aconteceram.
text_el: τὰ πρότερα ἔτι ἀνήγγειλα καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀκουστὸν ἐγένετο ἐξάπινα ἐποίησα καὶ ἐπῆλθεν

text_en: For I knew that you are stubborn, and your neck is as an iron sinew, and your forehead as brass.
text_la: Scivi enim quia durus es tu, et nervus ferreus cervix tua, et frons tua ærea.
text_pt: Porque eu sabia que eras duro, e a tua cerviz um nervo de ferro, e a tua testa de bronze.
text_el: γινώσκω ἐγὼ ὅτι σκληρὸς εἶ καὶ νεῦρον σιδηροῦν ὁ τράχηλός σου καὶ τὸ μέτωπόν σου χαλκοῦν

text_en: I foretold you of old, before they came to pass I told you, lest you should say: My idols have done these things, and my graven and molten things have commanded them.
text_la: Prædixi tibi ex tunc; antequam venirent, indicavi tibi, ne forte diceres : Idola mea fecerunt hæc, et sculptilia mea et conflatilia mandaverunt ista.
text_pt: Por isso te anunciei desde então, e te fiz ouvir antes que acontecesse, para que não dissesses: O meu ídolo fez estas coisas, e a minha imagem de escultura, e a minha imagem de fundição as mandou.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλά σοι πάλαι πρὶν ἐλθεῖν ἐπὶ σὲ ἀκουστόν σοι ἐποίησα μὴ εἴπῃς ὅτι τὰ εἴδωλά μου ἐποίησαν καὶ μὴ εἴπῃς ὅτι τὰ γλυπτὰ καὶ τὰ χωνευτὰ ἐνετείλατό μοι

text_en: See now all the things which you have heard: but have you declared them? I have shown you new things from that time, and things are kept which you know not:
text_la: Quæ audisti, vide omnia; vos autem, num annuntiastis? Audita feci tibi nova ex tunc, et conservata sunt quæ nescis.
text_pt: Já o tens ouvido; olha bem para tudo isto; porventura não o anunciareis? Desde agora te faço ouvir coisas novas e ocultas, e que nunca conheceste.
text_el: ἠκούσατε πάντα καὶ ὑμεῖς οὐκ ἔγνωτε ἀλλὰ καὶ ἀκουστά σοι ἐποίησα τὰ καινὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἃ μέλλει γίνεσθαι καὶ οὐκ εἶπας

text_en: They are created now, and not of old: and before the day, when you heard them not, lest you should say: Behold I knew them.
text_la: Nunc creata sunt et non ex tunc; et ante diem, et non audisti ea, ne forte dicas : Ecce ego cognovi ea.
text_pt: Agora são criadas, e não de há muito, e antes deste dia não as ouviste, para que porventura não digas: Eis que eu já as sabia.
text_el: νῦν γίνεται καὶ οὐ πάλαι καὶ οὐ προτέραις ἡμέραις ἤκουσας αὐτά μὴ εἴπῃς ὅτι ναί γινώσκω αὐτά

text_en: You have neither heard, nor known , neither was your ear opened of old. For I know that transgressing you will transgress, and I have called you a transgressor from the womb.
text_la: Neque audisti, neque cognovisti, neque ex tunc aperta est auris tua : scio enim quia prævaricans prævaricaberis, et transgressorem ex utero vocavi te.
text_pt: Nem tu as ouviste, nem tu as conheceste, nem tampouco há muito foi aberto o teu ouvido, porque eu sabia que procederias muito perfidamente, e que eras chamado transgressor desde o ventre.
text_el: οὔτε ἔγνως οὔτε ἠπίστω οὔτε ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἤνοιξά σου τὰ ὦτα ἔγνων γὰρ ὅτι ἀθετῶν ἀθετήσεις καὶ ἄνομος ἔτι ἐκ κοιλίας κληθήσῃ

text_en: For my name's sake I will remove my wrath far off: and for my praise I will bridle you, lest you should perish.
text_la: Propter nomen meum longe faciam furorem meum, et laude mea infrenabo te, ne intereas.
text_pt: Por amor do meu nome retardarei a minha ira, e por amor do meu louvor me refrearei para contigo, para que te não venha a cortar.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τοῦ ἐμοῦ ὀνόματος δείξω σοι τὸν θυμόν μου καὶ τὰ ἔνδοξά μου ἐπάξω ἐπὶ σοί ἵνα μὴ ἐξολεθρεύσω σε

text_en: Behold I have refined you, but not as silver, I have chosen you in the furnace of poverty.
text_la: Ecce excoxi te, sed non quasi argentum; elegi te in camino paupertatis.
text_pt: Eis que já te purifiquei, mas não como a prata; escolhi-te na fornalha da aflição.
text_el: ἰδοὺ πέπρακά σε οὐχ ἕνεκεν ἀργυρίου ἐξειλάμην δέ σε ἐκ καμίνου πτωχείας

text_en: For my own sake, for my own sake will I do it, that I may not be blasphemed : and I will not give my glory to another.
text_la: Propter me, propter me faciam, ut non blasphemer; et gloriam meam alteri non dabo.
text_pt: Por amor de mim, por amor de mim o farei, porque, como seria profanado o meu nome? E a minha glória não a darei a outrem.
text_el: ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ ποιήσω σοι ὅτι τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα βεβηλοῦται καὶ τὴν δόξαν μου ἑτέρῳ οὐ δώσω

text_en: Hearken to me, O Jacob , and you Israel whom I call: I am he, I am the first, and I am the last.
text_la: Audi me, Jacob, et Israël, quem ego voco : ego ipse, ego primus, et ego novissimus.
text_pt: Dá-me ouvidos, ó Jacó, e tu, ó Israel, a quem chamei; eu sou o mesmo, eu o primeiro, eu também o último.
text_el: ἄκουέ μου Ιακωβ καὶ Ισραηλ ὃν ἐγὼ καλῶ ἐγώ εἰμι πρῶτος καὶ ἐγώ εἰμι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: My hand also has founded the earth, and my right hand has measured the heavens : I shall call them, and they shall stand together.
text_la: Manus quoque mea fundavit terram, et dextera mea mensa est cælos; ego vocabo eos, et stabunt simul.
text_pt: Também a minha mão fundou a terra, e a minha destra mediu os céus a palmos; eu os chamarei, e aparecerão juntos.
text_el: καὶ ἡ χείρ μου ἐθεμελίωσεν τὴν γῆν καὶ ἡ δεξιά μου ἐστερέωσεν τὸν οὐρανόν καλέσω αὐτούς καὶ στήσονται ἅμα

text_en: Assemble yourselves together, all you, and hear: who among them has declared these things? The Lord has loved him, he will do his pleasure in Babylon , and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
text_la: Congregamini, omnes vos, et audite : quis de eis annuntiavit hæc? Dominus dilexit eum, faciet voluntatem suam in Babylone, et brachium suum in Chaldæis.
text_pt: Ajuntai-vos todos vós, e ouvi: Quem, dentre eles, tem anunciado estas coisas? O SENHOR o amou, e executará a sua vontade contra babilônia, e o seu braço será contra os caldeus.
text_el: καὶ συναχθήσονται πάντες καὶ ἀκούσονται τίς αὐτοῖς ἀνήγγειλεν ταῦτα ἀγαπῶν σε ἐποίησα τὸ θέλημά σου ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα τοῦ ἆραι σπέρμα Χαλδαίων

text_en: I, even I have spoken and called him: I have brought him, and his way is made prosperous.
text_la: Ego, ego locutus sum, et vocavi eum; adduxi eum, et directa est via ejus.
text_pt: Eu, eu o tenho falado; também já o chamei, e o trarei, e farei próspero o seu caminho.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐλάλησα ἐγὼ ἐκάλεσα ἤγαγον αὐτὸν καὶ εὐόδωσα τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Come near unto me, and hear this: I have not spoken in secret from the beginning: from the time before it was done, I was there, and now the Lord God has sent me, and his spirit.
text_la: Accedite ad me et audite hoc : non a principio in abscondito locutus sum : ex tempore antequam fieret, ibi eram : et nunc Dominus Deus misit me, et spiritus ejus.
text_pt: Chegai-vos a mim, ouvi isto: Não falei em segredo desde o princípio; desde o tempo em que aquilo se fez eu estava ali, e agora o Senhor DEUS me enviou a mim, e o seu Espírito.
text_el: προσαγάγετε πρός με καὶ ἀκούσατε ταῦτα οὐκ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ἐν κρυφῇ ἐλάλησα οὐδὲ ἐν τόπῳ γῆς σκοτεινῷ ἡνίκα ἐγένετο ἐκεῖ ἤμην καὶ νῦν κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Thus says the Lord your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel : I am the Lord your God that teach you profitable things, that govern you in the way that you walk.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus, redemptor tuus, Sanctus Israël : Ego Dominus Deus tuus, docens te utilia, gubernans te in via qua ambulas.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, o teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Eu sou o Senhor teu Deus, que te ensina o que é útil, e te guia pelo caminho em que deves andar.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ ῥυσάμενός σε ὁ ἅγιος Ισραηλ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεός σου δέδειχά σοι τοῦ εὑρεῖν σε τὴν ὁδόν ἐν ᾗ πορεύσῃ ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: O that you had hearkened to my commandments: your peace had been as a river, and your justice as the waves of the sea,
text_la: Utinam attendisses mandata mea : facta fuisset sicut flumen pax tua, et justitia tua sicut gurgites maris :
text_pt: Ah! se tivesses dado ouvidos aos meus mandamentos, então seria a tua paz como o rio, e a tua justiça como as ondas do mar!
text_el: καὶ εἰ ἤκουσας τῶν ἐντολῶν μου ἐγένετο ἂν ὡσεὶ ποταμὸς ἡ εἰρήνη σου καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου ὡς κῦμα θαλάσσης

text_en: and your seed had been as the sand, and the offspring of your bowels like the gravel thereof: his name should not have perished, nor have been destroyed from before my face.
text_la: et fuisset quasi arena semen tuum, et stirps uteri tui ut lapilli ejus; non interisset et non fuisset attritum nomen ejus a facie mea.
text_pt: Também a tua descendência seria como a areia, e os que procedem das tuas entranhas como os seus grãos; o seu nome nunca seria cortado nem destruído de diante de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἂν ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τὸ σπέρμα σου καὶ τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου ὡς ὁ χοῦς τῆς γῆς οὐδὲ νῦν οὐ μὴ ἐξολεθρευθῇς οὐδὲ ἀπολεῖται τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐνώπιόν μου

text_en: Come forth out of Babylon , flee from the Chaldeans, declare it with the voice of joy : make this to be heard, and speak it out even to the ends of the earth. Say: The Lord has redeemed his servant Jacob .
text_la: Egredimini de Babylone, fugite a Chaldæis, in voce exsultationis annuntiate : auditum facite hoc, et efferte illud usque ad extrema terræ. Dicite : Redemit Dominus servum suum Jacob.
text_pt: Saí de babilônia, fugi de entre os caldeus. E anunciai com voz de júbilo, fazei ouvir isso, e levai-o até ao fim da terra; dizei: O SENHOR remiu a seu servo Jacó.
text_el: ἔξελθε ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος φεύγων ἀπὸ τῶν Χαλδαίων φωνὴν εὐφροσύνης ἀναγγείλατε καὶ ἀκουστὸν γενέσθω τοῦτο ἀπαγγείλατε ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς λέγετε ἐρρύσατο κύριος τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ Ιακωβ

text_en: They thirsted not in the desert , when he led them out: he brought forth water out of the rock for them, and he clove the rock, and the waters gushed out.
text_la: Non sitierunt in deserto, cum educeret eos : aquam de petra produxit eis, et scidit petram, et fluxerunt aquæ.
text_pt: E não tinham sede, quando os levava pelos desertos; fez-lhes correr água da rocha; fendeu a rocha, e as águas correram.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν διψήσωσιν δι' ἐρήμου ἄξει αὐτούς ὕδωρ ἐκ πέτρας ἐξάξει αὐτοῖς σχισθήσεται πέτρα καὶ ῥυήσεται ὕδωρ καὶ πίεται ὁ λαός μου

text_en: There is no peace to the wicked , says the Lord .
text_la: Non est pax impiis, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Mas os ímpios não têm paz, diz o Senhor.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν χαίρειν τοῖς ἀσεβέσιν λέγει κύριος

text_en: Give ear, you islands, and hearken, you people from afar. The Lord has called me from the womb, from the bowels of my mother he has been mindful of my name .
text_la: Audite, insulæ, et attendite, populi de longe : Dominus ab utero vocavit me; de ventre matris meæ recordatus est nominis mei.
text_pt: Ouvi-me, ilhas, e escutai vós, povos de longe: O SENHOR me chamou desde o ventre, desde as entranhas de minha mãe fez menção do meu nome.
text_el: ἀκούσατέ μου νῆσοι καὶ προσέχετε ἔθνη διὰ χρόνου πολλοῦ στήσεται λέγει κύριος ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομά μου

text_en: And he has made my mouth like a sharp sword: in the shadow of his hand he has protected me, and has made me as a chosen arrow: in his quiver he has hidden me.
text_la: Et posuit os meum quasi gladium acutum, in umbra manus suæ protexit me, et posuit me sicut sagittam electam : in pharetra sua abscondit me.
text_pt: E fez a minha boca como uma espada aguda, com a sombra da sua mão me cobriu; e me pôs como uma flecha limpa, e me escondeu na sua aljava;
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸ στόμα μου ὡσεὶ μάχαιραν ὀξεῖαν καὶ ὑπὸ τὴν σκέπην τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ ἔκρυψέν με ἔθηκέν με ὡς βέλος ἐκλεκτὸν καὶ ἐν τῇ φαρέτρᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐσκέπασέν με

text_en: And he said to me: You are my servant Israel , for in you will I glory .
text_la: Et dixit mihi : Servus meus es tu Israël, quia in te gloriabor.
text_pt: E me disse: Tu és meu servo; és Israel, aquele por quem hei de ser glorificado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι δοῦλός μου εἶ σύ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐν σοὶ δοξασθήσομαι

text_en: And I said: I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength without cause and in vain: therefore my judgment is with the Lord , and my work with my God .
text_la: Et ego dixi : In vacuum laboravi; sine causa et vane fortitudinem meam consumpsi : ergo judicium meum cum Domino, et opus meum cum Deo meo.
text_pt: Porém eu disse: Debalde tenho trabalhado, inútil e vãmente gastei as minhas forças; todavia o meu direito está perante o Senhor, e o meu galardão perante o meu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἶπα κενῶς ἐκοπίασα καὶ εἰς μάταιον καὶ εἰς οὐδὲν ἔδωκα τὴν ἰσχύν μου διὰ τοῦτο ἡ κρίσις μου παρὰ κυρίῳ καὶ ὁ πόνος μου ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ μου

text_en: And now says the Lord , that formed me from the womb to be his servant, that I may bring back Jacob unto him, and Israel will not be gathered together: and I am glorified in the eyes of the Lord , and my God is made my strength.
text_la: Et nunc dicit Dominus, formans me ex utero servum sibi, ut reducam Jacob ad eum, et Israël non congregabitur; et glorificatus sum in oculis Domini, et Deus meus factus est fortitudo mea.
text_pt: E agora diz o Senhor, que me formou desde o ventre para ser seu servo, para que torne a trazer Jacó; porém Israel não se deixará ajuntar; contudo aos olhos do Senhor serei glorificado, e o meu Deus será a minha força.
text_el: καὶ νῦν οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ πλάσας με ἐκ κοιλίας δοῦλον ἑαυτῷ τοῦ συναγαγεῖν τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς αὐτόν συναχθήσομαι καὶ δοξασθήσομαι ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ὁ θεός μου ἔσται μου ἰσχύς

text_en: And he said: It is a small thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to convert the dregs of Israel . Behold, I have given you to be the light of the Gentiles , that you may be my salvation even to the farthest part of the earth.
text_la: Et dixit : Parum est ut sis mihi servus ad suscitandas tribus Jacob, et fæces Israël convertendas : ecce dedi te in lucem gentium, ut sis salus mea usque ad extremum terræ.
text_pt: Disse mais: Pouco é que sejas o meu servo, para restaurares as tribos de Jacó, e tornares a trazer os preservados de Israel; também te dei para luz dos gentios, para seres a minha salvação até à extremidade da terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι μέγα σοί ἐστιν τοῦ κληθῆναί σε παῖδά μου τοῦ στῆσαι τὰς φυλὰς Ιακωβ καὶ τὴν διασπορὰν τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπιστρέψαι ἰδοὺ τέθεικά σε εἰς διαθήκην γένους εἰς φῶς ἐθνῶν τοῦ εἶναί σε εἰς σωτηρίαν ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς

text_en: Thus says the Lord the redeemer of Israel , his Holy One, to the soul that is despised, to the nation that is abhorred, to the servant of rulers: Kings shall see, and princes shall rise up, and adore for the Lord's sake, because he is faithful, and for the Holy One of Israel , who has chosen you.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus, redemptor Israël, Sanctus ejus, ad contemptibilem animam, ad abominatam gentem, ad servum dominorum : Reges videbunt, et consurgent principes, et adorabunt propter Dominum, quia fidelis est, et Sanctum Israël qui elegit te.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor, o Redentor de Israel, o seu Santo, à alma desprezada, ao que a nação abomina, ao servo dos que dominam: Os reis o verão, e se levantarão, como também os príncipes, e eles diante de ti se inclinarão, por amor do Senhor, que é fiel, e do Santo de Israel, que te escolheu.
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὁ ῥυσάμενός σε ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἁγιάσατε τὸν φαυλίζοντα τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ τὸν βδελυσσόμενον ὑπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν δούλων τῶν ἀρχόντων βασιλεῖς ὄψονται αὐτὸν καὶ ἀναστήσονται ἄρχοντες καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν αὐτῷ ἕνεκεν κυρίου ὅτι πιστός ἐστιν ὁ ἅγιος Ισραηλ καὶ ἐξελεξάμην σε

text_en: Thus says the Lord : In an acceptable time I have heard you, and in the day of salvation I have helped you: and I have preserved you, and given you to be a covenant of the people, that you might raise up the earth, and possess the inheritances that were destroyed:
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : In tempore placito exaudivi te, et in die salutis auxiliatus sum tui : et servavi te, et dedi te in fœdus populi, ut suscitares terram, et possideres hæreditates dissipatas;
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: No tempo aceitável te ouvi e no dia da salvação te ajudei, e te guardarei, e te darei por aliança do povo, para restaurares a terra, e dar-lhes em herança as herdades assoladas;
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος καιρῷ δεκτῷ ἐπήκουσά σου καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σωτηρίας ἐβοήθησά σοι καὶ ἔδωκά σε εἰς διαθήκην ἐθνῶν τοῦ καταστῆσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ κληρονομῆσαι κληρονομίαν ἐρήμου

text_en: That you might say to them that are bound: Come forth: and to them that are in darkness: Show yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in every plain.
text_la: ut diceres his qui vincti sunt : Exite, et his qui in tenebris : Revelamini. Super vias pascentur, et in omnibus planis pascua eorum.
text_pt: Para dizeres aos presos: Saí; e aos que estão em trevas: Aparecei. Eles pastarão nos caminhos, e em todos os lugares altos haverá o seu pasto.
text_el: λέγοντα τοῖς ἐν δεσμοῖς ἐξέλθατε καὶ τοῖς ἐν τῷ σκότει ἀνακαλυφθῆναι καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν βοσκηθήσονται καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς τρίβοις ἡ νομὴ αὐτῶν

text_en: They shall not hunger, nor thirst, neither shall the heat nor the sun strike them: for he that is merciful to them, shall be their shepherd, and at the fountains of waters he shall give them drink.
text_la: Non esurient neque sitient, et non percutiet eos æstus et sol, quia miserator eorum reget eos, et ad fontes aquarum potabit eos.
text_pt: Nunca terão fome, nem sede, nem o calor, nem o sol os afligirá; porque o que se compadece deles os guiará e os levará mansamente aos mananciais das águas.
text_el: οὐ πεινάσουσιν οὐδὲ διψήσουσιν οὐδὲ πατάξει αὐτοὺς καύσων οὐδὲ ὁ ἥλιος ἀλλὰ ὁ ἐλεῶν αὐτοὺς παρακαλέσει καὶ διὰ πηγῶν ὑδάτων ἄξει αὐτούς

text_en: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my paths shall be exalted.
text_la: Et ponam omnes montes meos in viam, et semitæ meæ exaltabuntur.
text_pt: E farei de todos os meus montes um caminho; e as minhas estradas serão levantadas.
text_el: καὶ θήσω πᾶν ὄρος εἰς ὁδὸν καὶ πᾶσαν τρίβον εἰς βόσκημα αὐτοῖς

text_en: Behold these shall come from afar, and behold these from the north and from the sea, and these from the south country.
text_la: Ecce isti de longe venient, et ecce illi ab aquilone et mari, et isti de terra australi.
text_pt: Eis que estes virão de longe, e eis que aqueles do norte, e do ocidente, e aqueles outros da terra de Sinim.
text_el: ἰδοὺ οὗτοι πόρρωθεν ἔρχονται οὗτοι ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ οὗτοι ἀπὸ θαλάσσης ἄλλοι δὲ ἐκ γῆς Περσῶν

text_en: Give praise, O you heavens , and rejoice, O earth, you mountains, give praise with jubilation: because the Lord has comforted his people, and will have mercy on his poor ones.
