text_el: ὅταν ἀναβοήσῃς ἐξελέσθωσάν σε ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου τούτους γὰρ πάντας ἄνεμος λήμψεται καὶ ἀποίσει καταιγίς οἱ δὲ ἀντεχόμενοί μου κτήσονται γῆν καὶ κληρονομήσουσιν τὸ ὄρος τὸ ἅγιόν μου

text_en: And I will say: Make a way: give free passage, turn out of the path, take away the stumbling blocks out of the way of my people.
text_la: Et dicam : Viam facite, præbete iter; declinate de semita, auferte offendicula de via populi mei.
text_pt: E dir-se-á: Aplanai, aplanai a estrada, preparai o caminho; tirai os tropeços do caminho do meu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν καθαρίσατε ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ὁδοὺς καὶ ἄρατε σκῶλα ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ τοῦ λαοῦ μου

text_en: For thus says the High and the Eminent that inhabits eternity : and his name is Holy, who dwells in the high and holy place, and with a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble , and to revive the heart of the contrite .
text_la: Quia hæc dicit Excelsus, et Sublimis, habitans æternitatem, et sanctum nomen ejus : in excelso et in sancto habitans, et cum contrito et humili spiritu : ut vivificet spiritum humilium, et vivificet cor contritorum.
text_pt: Porque assim diz o Alto e o Sublime, que habita na eternidade, e cujo nome é Santo: Num alto e santo lugar habito; como também com o contrito e abatido de espírito, para vivificar o espírito dos abatidos, e para vivificar o coração dos contritos.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ ὕψιστος ὁ ἐν ὑψηλοῖς κατοικῶν τὸν αἰῶνα ἅγιος ἐν ἁγίοις ὄνομα αὐτῷ κύριος ὕψιστος ἐν ἁγίοις ἀναπαυόμενος καὶ ὀλιγοψύχοις διδοὺς μακροθυμίαν καὶ διδοὺς ζωὴν τοῖς συντετριμμένοις τὴν καρδίαν

text_en: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be angry unto the end: because the spirit shall go forth from my face, and breathings I will make.
text_la: Non enim in sempiternum litigabo, neque usque ad finem irascar, quia spiritus a facie mea egredietur, et flatus ego faciam.
text_pt: Porque não contenderei para sempre, nem continuamente me indignarei; porque o espírito perante a minha face se desfaleceria, e as almas que eu fiz.
text_el: οὐκ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐκδικήσω ὑμᾶς οὐδὲ διὰ παντὸς ὀργισθήσομαι ὑμῖν πνεῦμα γὰρ παρ' ἐμοῦ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ πνοὴν πᾶσαν ἐγὼ ἐποίησα

text_en: For the iniquity of his covetousness I was angry , and I struck him: I hid my face from you, and was angry : and he went away wandering in his own heart.
text_la: Propter iniquitatem avaritiæ ejus iratus sum, et percussi eum. Abscondi a te faciem meam, et indignatus sum; et abiit vagus in via cordis sui.
text_pt: Pela iniqüidade da sua avareza me indignei, e o feri; escondi-me, e indignei-me; contudo, rebelde, seguiu o caminho do seu coração.
text_el: δι' ἁμαρτίαν βραχύ τι ἐλύπησα αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπάταξα αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέστρεψα τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλυπήθη καὶ ἐπορεύθη στυγνὸς ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: I saw his ways, and I healed him, and brought him back, and restored comforts to him, and to them that mourn for him.
text_la: Vias ejus vidi, et sanavi eum; et reduxi eum, et reddidi consolationes ipsi, et lugentibus ejus.
text_pt: Eu vejo os seus caminhos, e o sararei, e o guiarei, e lhe tornarei a dar consolação, a saber, aos seus pranteadores.
text_el: τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ ἑώρακα καὶ ἰασάμην αὐτὸν καὶ παρεκάλεσα αὐτὸν καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῷ παράκλησιν ἀληθινήν

text_en: I created the fruit of the lips, peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, said the Lord , and I healed him.
text_la: Creavi fructum labiorum pacem; pacem ei qui longe est et qui prope, dixit Dominus, et sanavi eum.
text_pt: Eu crio os frutos dos lábios: paz, paz, para o que está longe; e para o que está perto, diz o Senhor, e eu o sararei.
text_el: εἰρήνην ἐπ' εἰρήνην τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ τοῖς ἐγγὺς οὖσιν καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἰάσομαι αὐτούς

text_en: But the wicked are like the raging sea, which cannot rest, and the waves thereof cast up dirt and mire.
text_la: Impii autem quasi mare fervens, quod quiescere non potest, et redundant fluctus ejus in conculcationem et lutum.
text_pt: Mas os ímpios são como o mar bravo, porque não se pode aquietar, e as suas águas lançam de si lama e lodo.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἄδικοι οὕτως κλυδωνισθήσονται καὶ ἀναπαύσασθαι οὐ δυνήσονται

text_en: There is no peace to the wicked , says the Lord God .
text_la: Non est pax impiis, dicit Dominus Deus.
text_pt: Não há paz para os ímpios, diz o meu Deus.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν χαίρειν τοῖς ἀσεβέσιν εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεός

text_en: Cry, cease not, lift up your voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins .
text_la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exalta vocem tuam, et annuntia populo meo scelera eorum, et domui Jacob peccata eorum.
text_pt: Clama em alta voz, não te detenhas, levanta a tua voz como a trombeta e anuncia ao meu povo a sua transgressão, e à casa de Jacó os seus pecados.
text_el: ἀναβόησον ἐν ἰσχύι καὶ μὴ φείσῃ ὡς σάλπιγγα ὕψωσον τὴν φωνήν σου καὶ ἀνάγγειλον τῷ λαῷ μου τὰ ἁμαρτήματα αὐτῶν καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ Ιακωβ τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῶν

text_en: For they seek me from day to day, and desire to know my ways, as a nation that has done justice , and has not forsaken the judgment of their God : they ask of me the judgments of justice : they are willing to approach to God .
text_la: Me etenim de die in diem quærunt, et scire vias meas volunt, quasi gens quæ justitiam fecerit, et judicium Dei sui non dereliquerit. Rogant me judicia justitiæ; appropinquare Deo volunt.
text_pt: Todavia me procuram cada dia, tomam prazer em saber os meus caminhos, como um povo que pratica justiça, e não deixa o direito do seu Deus; perguntam-me pelos direitos da justiça, e têm prazer em se chegarem a Deus,
text_el: ἐμὲ ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ζητοῦσιν καὶ γνῶναί μου τὰς ὁδοὺς ἐπιθυμοῦσιν ὡς λαὸς δικαιοσύνην πεποιηκὼς καὶ κρίσιν θεοῦ αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐγκαταλελοιπὼς αἰτοῦσίν με νῦν κρίσιν δικαίαν καὶ ἐγγίζειν θεῷ ἐπιθυμοῦσιν

text_en: Why have we fasted , and you have not regarded: have we humbled our souls , and you have not taken notice? Behold in the day of your fast your own will is found, and you exact of all your debtors.
text_la: Quare jejunavimus, et non aspexisti; humiliavimus animas nostras, et nescisti? Ecce in die jejunii vestri invenitur voluntas vestra, et omnes debitores vestros repetitis.
text_pt: Dizendo: Por que jejuamos nós, e tu não atentas para isso? Por que afligimos as nossas almas, e tu não o sabes? Eis que no dia em que jejuais achais o vosso próprio contentamento, e requereis todo o vosso trabalho.
text_el: λέγοντες τί ὅτι ἐνηστεύσαμεν καὶ οὐκ εἶδες ἐταπεινώσαμεν τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔγνως ἐν γὰρ ταῖς ἡμέραις τῶν νηστειῶν ὑμῶν εὑρίσκετε τὰ θελήματα ὑμῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ὑποχειρίους ὑμῶν ὑπονύσσετε

text_en: Behold you fast for debates and strife, and strike with the fist wickedly . Do not fast as you have done until this day, to make your cry to be heard on high.
text_la: Ecce ad lites et contentiones jejunatis, et percutitis pugno impie. Nolite jejunare sicut usque ad hanc diem, ut audiatur in excelso clamor vester.
text_pt: Eis que para contendas e debates jejuais, e para ferirdes com punho iníquo; não jejueis como hoje, para fazer ouvir a vossa voz no alto.
text_el: εἰ εἰς κρίσεις καὶ μάχας νηστεύετε καὶ τύπτετε πυγμαῖς ταπεινόν ἵνα τί μοι νηστεύετε ὡς σήμερον ἀκουσθῆναι ἐν κραυγῇ τὴν φωνὴν ὑμῶν

text_en: Is this such a fast as I have chosen: for a man to afflict his soul for a day? Is this it, to wind his head about like a circle, and to spread sackcloth and ashes? Will you call this a fast , and a day acceptable to the Lord ?
text_la: Numquid tale est jejunium quod elegi, per diem affligere hominem animam suam? numquid contorquere quasi circulum caput suum, et saccum et cinerem sternere? numquid istud vocabis jejunium, et diem acceptabilem Domino?
text_pt: Seria este o jejum que eu escolheria, que o homem um dia aflija a sua alma, que incline a sua cabeça como o junco, e estenda debaixo de si saco e cinza? Chamarias tu a isto jejum e dia aprazível ao Senhor?
text_el: οὐ ταύτην τὴν νηστείαν ἐξελεξάμην καὶ ἡμέραν ταπεινοῦν ἄνθρωπον τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ οὐδ' ἂν κάμψῃς ὡς κρίκον τὸν τράχηλόν σου καὶ σάκκον καὶ σποδὸν ὑποστρώσῃ οὐδ' οὕτως καλέσετε νηστείαν δεκτήν

text_en: Is not this rather the fast that I have chosen? Loose the bands of wickedness , undo the bundles that oppress, let them that are broken go free, and break asunder every burden.
text_la: Nonne hoc est magis jejunium quod elegi? Dissolve colligationes impietatis, solve fasciculos deprimentes, dimitte eos qui confracti sunt liberos, et omne onus dirumpe;
text_pt: Porventura não é este o jejum que escolhi, que soltes as ligaduras da impiedade, que desfaças as ataduras do jugo e que deixes livres os oprimidos, e despedaces todo o jugo?
text_el: οὐχὶ τοιαύτην νηστείαν ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην λέγει κύριος ἀλλὰ λῦε πάντα σύνδεσμον ἀδικίας διάλυε στραγγαλιὰς βιαίων συναλλαγμάτων ἀπόστελλε τεθραυσμένους ἐν ἀφέσει καὶ πᾶσαν συγγραφὴν ἄδικον διάσπα

text_en: Deal your bread to the hungry, and bring the needy and the harbourless into your house: when you shall see one naked, cover him, and despise not your own flesh.
text_la: frange esurienti panem tuum, et egenos vagosque induc in domum tuam; cum videris nudum, operi eum, et carnem tuam ne despexeris.
text_pt: Porventura não é também que repartas o teu pão com o faminto, e recolhas em casa os pobres abandonados; e, quando vires o nu, o cubras, e não te escondas da tua carne?
text_el: διάθρυπτε πεινῶντι τὸν ἄρτον σου καὶ πτωχοὺς ἀστέγους εἴσαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου ἐὰν ἴδῃς γυμνόν περίβαλε καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν οἰκείων τοῦ σπέρματός σου οὐχ ὑπερόψῃ

text_en: Then shall your light break forth as the morning, and your health shall speedily arise, and your justice shall go before your face, and the glory of the Lord shall gather you up.
text_la: Tunc erumpet quasi mane lumen tuum; et sanitas tua citius orietur, et anteibit faciem tuam justitia tua, et gloria Domini colliget te.
text_pt: Então romperá a tua luz como a alva, e a tua cura apressadamente brotará, e a tua justiça irá adiante de ti, e a glória do Senhor será a tua retaguarda.
text_el: τότε ῥαγήσεται πρόιμον τὸ φῶς σου καὶ τὰ ἰάματά σου ταχὺ ἀνατελεῖ καὶ προπορεύσεται ἔμπροσθέν σου ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου καὶ ἡ δόξα τοῦ θεοῦ περιστελεῖ σε

text_en: Then shall you call, and the Lord shall hear: you shall cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If you will take away the chain out of the midst of you, and cease to stretch out the finger, and to speak that which profits not.
text_la: Tunc invocabis, et Dominus exaudiet; clamabis, et dicet : Ecce adsum. Si abstuleris de medio tui catenam, et desieris extendere digitum et loqui quod non prodest;
text_pt: Então clamarás, e o Senhor te responderá; gritarás, e ele dirá: Eis-me aqui. Se tirares do meio de ti o jugo, o estender do dedo, e o falar iniquamente;
text_el: τότε βοήσῃ καὶ ὁ θεὸς εἰσακούσεταί σου ἔτι λαλοῦντός σου ἐρεῖ ἰδοὺ πάρειμι ἐὰν ἀφέλῃς ἀπὸ σοῦ σύνδεσμον καὶ χειροτονίαν καὶ ῥῆμα γογγυσμοῦ

text_en: When you shall pour out your soul to the hungry, and shall satisfy the afflicted soul , then shall your light rise up in darkness, and your darkness shall be as the noonday.
text_la: cum effuderis esurienti animam tuam, et animam afflictam repleveris, orietur in tenebris lux tua, et tenebræ tuæ erunt sicut meridies.
text_pt: E se abrires a tua alma ao faminto, e fartares a alma aflita; então a tua luz nascerá nas trevas, e a tua escuridão será como o meio-dia.
text_el: καὶ δῷς πεινῶντι τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ ψυχῆς σου καὶ ψυχὴν τεταπεινωμένην ἐμπλήσῃς τότε ἀνατελεῖ ἐν τῷ σκότει τὸ φῶς σου καὶ τὸ σκότος σου ὡς μεσημβρία

text_en: And the Lord will give you rest continually, and will fill your soul with brightness, and deliver your bones, and you shall be like a watered garden, and like a fountain of water whose waters shall not fail.
text_la: Et requiem tibi dabit Dominus semper, et implebit splendoribus animam tuam, et ossa tua liberabit; et eris quasi hortus irriguus, et sicut fons aquarum cujus non deficient aquæ.
text_pt: E o Senhor te guiará continuamente, e fartará a tua alma em lugares áridos, e fortificará os teus ossos; e serás como um jardim regado, e como um manancial, cujas águas nunca faltam.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὁ θεός σου μετὰ σοῦ διὰ παντός καὶ ἐμπλησθήσῃ καθάπερ ἐπιθυμεῖ ἡ ψυχή σου καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ σου πιανθήσεται καὶ ἔσῃ ὡς κῆπος μεθύων καὶ ὡς πηγὴ ἣν μὴ ἐξέλιπεν ὕδωρ καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ σου ὡς βοτάνη ἀνατελεῖ καὶ πιανθήσεται καὶ κληρονομήσουσι γενεὰς γενεῶν

text_en: And the places that have been desolate for ages shall be built in you: you shall raise up the foundation of generation and generation : and you shall be called the repairer of the fences, turning the paths into rest.
text_la: Et ædificabuntur in te deserta sæculorum, fundamenta generationis et generationis suscitabis; et vocaberis ædificator sepium, avertens semitas in quietem.
text_pt: E os que de ti procederem edificarão as antigas ruínas; e levantarás os fundamentos de geração em geração; e chamar-te-ão reparador das roturas, e restaurador de veredas para morar.
text_el: καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσονταί σου αἱ ἔρημοι αἰώνιοι καὶ ἔσται σου τὰ θεμέλια αἰώνια γενεῶν γενεαῖς καὶ κληθήσῃ οἰκοδόμος φραγμῶν καὶ τοὺς τρίβους τοὺς ἀνὰ μέσον παύσεις

text_en: If you turn away your foot from the sabbath , from doing your own will in my holy day, and call the sabbath delightful, and the holy of the Lord glorious , and glorify him, while you do not your own ways, and your own will is not found, to speak a word:
text_la: Si averteris a sabbato pedem tuum facere voluntatem tuam in die sancto meo, et vocaveris sabbatum delicatum, et sanctum Domini gloriosum, et glorificaveris eum dum non facis vias tuas, et non invenitur voluntas tua, ut loquaris sermonem :
text_pt: Se desviares o teu pé do sábado, de fazeres a tua vontade no meu santo dia, e chamares ao sábado deleitoso, e o santo dia do Senhor, digno de honra, e o honrares não seguindo os teus caminhos, nem pretendendo fazer a tua própria vontade, nem falares as tuas próprias palavras,
text_el: ἐὰν ἀποστρέψῃς τὸν πόδα σου ἀπὸ τῶν σαββάτων τοῦ μὴ ποιεῖν τὰ θελήματά σου ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἁγίᾳ καὶ καλέσεις τὰ σάββατα τρυφερά ἅγια τῷ θεῷ σου οὐκ ἀρεῖς τὸν πόδα σου ἐπ' ἔργῳ οὐδὲ λαλήσεις λόγον ἐν ὀργῇ ἐκ τοῦ στόματός σου

text_en: Then shall you be delighted in the Lord , and I will lift you up above the high places of the earth, and will feed you with the inheritance of Jacob your father. For the mouth of the Lord has spoken it.
text_la: tunc delectaberis super Domino, et sustollam te super altitudines terræ, et cibabo te hæreditate Jacob patris tui : os enim Domini locutum est.
text_pt: Então te deleitarás no Senhor, e te farei cavalgar sobre as alturas da terra, e te sustentarei com a herança de teu pai Jacó; porque a boca do Senhor o disse.
text_el: καὶ ἔσῃ πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ κύριον καὶ ἀναβιβάσει σε ἐπὶ τὰ ἀγαθὰ τῆς γῆς καὶ ψωμιεῖ σε τὴν κληρονομίαν Ιακωβ τοῦ πατρός σου τὸ γὰρ στόμα κυρίου ἐλάλησεν ταῦτα

text_en: Behold the hand of the Lord is not shortened that it cannot save, neither is his ear heavy that it cannot hear.
text_la: Ecce non est abbreviata manus Domini, ut salvare nequeat, neque aggravata est auris ejus, ut non exaudiat.
text_pt: Eis que a mão do SENHOR não está encolhida, para que não possa salvar; nem agravado o seu ouvido, para não poder ouvir.
text_el: μὴ οὐκ ἰσχύει ἡ χεὶρ κυρίου τοῦ σῶσαι ἢ ἐβάρυνεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ τοῦ μὴ εἰσακοῦσαι

text_en: But your iniquities have divided between you and your God , and your sins have hid his face from you that he should not hear.
text_la: Sed iniquitates vestræ diviserunt inter vos et Deum vestrum; et peccata vestra absconderunt faciem ejus a vobis, ne exaudiret.
text_pt: Mas as vossas iniqüidades fazem separação entre vós e o vosso Deus; e os vossos pecados encobrem o seu rosto de vós, para que não vos ouça.
text_el: ἀλλὰ τὰ ἁμαρτήματα ὑμῶν διιστῶσιν ἀνὰ μέσον ὑμῶν καὶ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀφ' ὑμῶν τοῦ μὴ ἐλεῆσαι

text_en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity : your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue utters iniquity .
text_la: Manus enim vestræ pollutæ sunt sanguine, et digiti vestri iniquitate; labia vestra locuta sunt mendacium, et lingua vestra iniquitatem fatur.
text_pt: Porque as vossas mãos estão contaminadas de sangue, e os vossos dedos de iniqüidade; os vossos lábios falam falsidade, a vossa língua pronuncia perversidade.
text_el: αἱ γὰρ χεῖρες ὑμῶν μεμολυμμέναι αἵματι καὶ οἱ δάκτυλοι ὑμῶν ἐν ἁμαρτίαις τὰ δὲ χείλη ὑμῶν ἐλάλησεν ἀνομίαν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα ὑμῶν ἀδικίαν μελετᾷ

text_en: There is none that calls upon justice , neither is there any one that judges truly : but they trust in a mere nothing, and speak vanities: they have conceived labour, and brought forth iniquity .
text_la: Non est qui invocet justitiam, neque est qui judicet vere : sed confidunt in nihilo, et loquuntur vanitates; conceperunt laborem, et pepererunt iniquitatem.
text_pt: Ninguém há que clame pela justiça, nem ninguém que compareça em juízo pela verdade; confiam na vaidade, e falam mentiras; concebem o mal, e dão à luz a iniqüidade.
text_el: οὐδεὶς λαλεῖ δίκαια οὐδὲ ἔστιν κρίσις ἀληθινή πεποίθασιν ἐπὶ ματαίοις καὶ λαλοῦσιν κενά ὅτι κύουσιν πόνον καὶ τίκτουσιν ἀνομίαν

text_en: They have broken the eggs of asps, and have woven the webs of spiders: he that shall eat of their eggs, shall die: and that which is brought out, shall be hatched into a basilisk.
text_la: Ova aspidum ruperunt, et telas araneæ texuerunt. Qui comederit de ovis eorum, morietur; et quod confotum est, erumpet in regulum.
text_pt: Chocam ovos de basilisco, e tecem teias de aranha; o que comer dos ovos deles, morrerá; e, quebrando-os, sairá uma víbora.
text_el: ᾠὰ ἀσπίδων ἔρρηξαν καὶ ἱστὸν ἀράχνης ὑφαίνουσιν καὶ ὁ μέλλων τῶν ᾠῶν αὐτῶν φαγεῖν συντρίψας οὔριον εὗρεν καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ βασιλίσκος

text_en: Their webs shall not be for clothing, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are unprofitable works, and the work of iniquity is in their hands.
text_la: Telæ eorum non erunt in vestimentum, neque operientur operibus suis; opera eorum opera inutilia, et opus iniquitatis in manibus eorum.
text_pt: As suas teias não prestam para vestes nem se poderão cobrir com as suas obras; as suas obras são obras de iniqüidade, e obra de violência há nas suas mãos.
text_el: ὁ ἱστὸς αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔσται εἰς ἱμάτιον οὐδὲ μὴ περιβάλωνται ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν τὰ γὰρ ἔργα αὐτῶν ἔργα ἀνομίας

text_en: Their feet run to evil , and make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are unprofitable thoughts: wasting and destruction are in their ways.
text_la: Pedes eorum ad malum currunt, et festinant ut effundant sanguinem innocentem; cogitationes eorum cogitationes inutiles : vastitas et contritio in viis eorum.
text_pt: Os seus pés correm para o mal, e se apressam para derramarem o sangue inocente; os seus pensamentos são pensamentos de iniqüidade; destruição e quebrantamento há nas suas estradas.
text_el: οἱ δὲ πόδες αὐτῶν ἐπὶ πονηρίαν τρέχουσιν ταχινοὶ ἐκχέαι αἷμα καὶ οἱ διαλογισμοὶ αὐτῶν διαλογισμοὶ ἀφρόνων σύντριμμα καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: They have not known the way of peace, and there is no judgment in their steps: their paths have become crooked to them, every one that treads in them knows no peace.
text_la: Viam pacis nescierunt, et non est judicium in gressibus eorum; semitæ eorum incurvatæ sunt eis : omnis qui calcat in eis, ignorat pacem.
text_pt: Não conhecem o caminho da paz, nem há justiça nos seus passos; fizeram para si veredas tortuosas; todo aquele que anda por elas não tem conhecimento da paz.
text_el: καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ οἴδασιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κρίσις ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν αἱ γὰρ τρίβοι αὐτῶν διεστραμμέναι ἃς διοδεύουσιν καὶ οὐκ οἴδασιν εἰρήνην

text_en: Therefore is judgment far from us, and justice shall not overtake us. We looked for light, and behold darkness: brightness, and we have walked in the dark.
text_la: Propter hoc elongatum est judicium a nobis, et non apprehendet nos justitia. Exspectavimus lucem, et ecce tenebræ; splendorem, et in tenebris ambulavimus.
text_pt: Por isso o juízo está longe de nós, e a justiça não nos alcança; esperamos pela luz, e eis que só há trevas; pelo resplendor, mas andamos em escuridão.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀπέστη ἡ κρίσις ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ μὴ καταλάβῃ αὐτοὺς δικαιοσύνη ὑπομεινάντων αὐτῶν φῶς ἐγένετο αὐτοῖς σκότος μείναντες αὐγὴν ἐν ἀωρίᾳ περιεπάτησαν

text_en: We have groped for the wall, and like the blind we have groped as if we had no eyes: we have stumbled at noonday as in darkness, we are in dark places, as dead men .
text_la: Palpavimus sicut cæci parietem, et quasi absque oculis attrectavimus : impegimus meridie quasi in tenebris; in caliginosis quasi mortui.
text_pt: Apalpamos as paredes como cegos, e como os que não têm olhos andamos apalpando; tropeçamos ao meio-dia como nas trevas, e nos lugares escuros como mortos.
text_el: ψηλαφήσουσιν ὡς τυφλοὶ τοῖχον καὶ ὡς οὐχ ὑπαρχόντων ὀφθαλμῶν ψηλαφήσουσιν καὶ πεσοῦνται ἐν μεσημβρίᾳ ὡς ἐν μεσονυκτίῳ ὡς ἀποθνῄσκοντες στενάξουσιν

text_en: We shall roar all of us like bears, and shall lament as mournful doves. We have looked for judgment, and there is none: for salvation , and it is far from us.
text_la: Rugiemus quasi ursi omnes, et quasi columbæ meditantes gememus : exspectavimus judicium, et non est; salutem, et elongata est a nobis.
text_pt: Todos nós bramamos como ursos, e continuamente gememos como pombas; esperamos pelo juízo, e não o há; pela salvação, e está longe de nós.
text_el: ὡς ἄρκος καὶ ὡς περιστερὰ ἅμα πορεύσονται ἀνεμείναμεν κρίσιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν σωτηρία μακρὰν ἀφέστηκεν ἀφ' ἡμῶν

text_en: For our iniquities are multiplied before you, and our sins have testified against us: for our wicked doings are with us, and have known our iniquities :
text_la: Multiplicatæ sunt enim iniquitates nostræ coram te, et peccata nostra responderunt nobis, quia scelera nostra nobiscum et iniquitates nostras cognovimus.
text_pt: Porque as nossas transgressões se multiplicaram perante ti, e os nossos pecados testificam contra nós; porque as nossas transgressões estão conosco, e conhecemos as nossas iniqüidades;
text_el: πολλὴ γὰρ ἡμῶν ἡ ἀνομία ἐναντίον σου καὶ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ἡμῶν ἀντέστησαν ἡμῖν αἱ γὰρ ἀνομίαι ἡμῶν ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ τὰ ἀδικήματα ἡμῶν ἔγνωμεν

text_en: In sinning and lying against the Lord : and we have turned away so that we went not after our God , but spoke calumny and transgression: we have conceived, and uttered from the heart, words of falsehood.
text_la: Peccare et mentiri contra Dominum, et aversi sumus ne iremus post tergum Dei nostri, ut loqueremur calumniam et transgressionem; concepimus et locuti sumus de corde verba mendacii.
text_pt: Como o prevaricar, e mentir contra o Senhor, e o desviarmo-nos do nosso Deus, o falar de opressão e rebelião, o conceber e proferir do coração palavras de falsidade.
text_el: ἠσεβήσαμεν καὶ ἐψευσάμεθα καὶ ἀπέστημεν ἀπὸ ὄπισθεν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐλαλήσαμεν ἄδικα καὶ ἠπειθήσαμεν ἐκύομεν καὶ ἐμελετήσαμεν ἀπὸ καρδίας ἡμῶν λόγους ἀδίκους

text_en: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice has stood far off: because truth has fallen down in the street, and equity could not come in.
text_la: Et conversum est retrorsum judicium, et justitia longe stetit, quia corruit in platea veritas, et æquitas non potuit ingredi.
text_pt: Por isso o direito se tornou atrás, e a justiça se pôs de longe; porque a verdade anda tropeçando pelas ruas, e a eqüidade não pode entrar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστήσαμεν ὀπίσω τὴν κρίσιν καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη μακρὰν ἀφέστηκεν ὅτι καταναλώθη ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ δι' εὐθείας οὐκ ἠδύναντο διελθεῖν

text_en: And truth has been forgotten: and he that departed from evil , lay open to be a prey: and the Lord saw, and it appeared evil in his eyes, because there is no judgment.
text_la: Et facta est veritas in oblivionem, et qui recessit a malo, prædæ patuit. Et vidit Dominus, et malum apparuit in oculis ejus, quia non est judicium.
text_pt: Sim, a verdade desfalece, e quem se desvia do mal arrisca-se a ser despojado; e o Senhor viu, e pareceu mal aos seus olhos que não houvesse justiça.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἦρται καὶ μετέστησαν τὴν διάνοιαν τοῦ συνιέναι καὶ εἶδεν κύριος καὶ οὐκ ἤρεσεν αὐτῷ ὅτι οὐκ ἦν κρίσις

text_en: And he saw that there is not a man : and he stood astonished, because there is none to oppose himself: and his own arm brought salvation to him, and his own justice supported him.
text_la: Et vidit quia non est vir, et aporiatus est, quia non est qui occurrat; et salvavit sibi brachium suum, et justitia ejus ipsa confirmavit eum.
text_pt: E vendo que ninguém havia, maravilhou-se de que não houvesse um intercessor; por isso o seu próprio braço lhe trouxe a salvação, e a sua própria justiça o susteve.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἀνήρ καὶ κατενόησεν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀντιλημψόμενος καὶ ἠμύνατο αὐτοὺς τῷ βραχίονι αὐτοῦ καὶ τῇ ἐλεημοσύνῃ ἐστηρίσατο

text_en: He put on justice as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation upon his head: he put on the garments of vengeance, and was clad with zeal as with a cloak.
text_la: Indutus est justitia ut lorica, et galea salutis in capite ejus; indutus est vestimentis ultionis, et opertus est quasi pallio zeli :
text_pt: Pois vestiu-se de justiça, como de uma couraça, e pôs o capacete da salvação na sua cabeça, e por vestidura pôs sobre si vestes de vingança, e cobriu-se de zelo, como de um manto.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεδύσατο δικαιοσύνην ὡς θώρακα καὶ περιέθετο περικεφαλαίαν σωτηρίου ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς καὶ περιεβάλετο ἱμάτιον ἐκδικήσεως καὶ τὸ περιβόλαιον

text_en: As unto revenge, as it were to repay wrath to his adversaries, and a reward to his enemies: he will repay the like to the islands.
text_la: sicut ad vindictam quasi ad retributionem indignationis hostibus suis, et vicissitudinem inimicis suis; insulis vicem reddet.
text_pt: Conforme forem as obras deles, assim será a sua retribuição, furor aos seus adversários, e recompensa aos seus inimigos; às ilhas dará ele a sua recompensa.
text_el: ὡς ἀνταποδώσων ἀνταπόδοσιν ὄνειδος τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις

text_en: And they from the west, shall fear the name of the Lord : and they from the rising of the sun, his glory when he shall come as a violent stream, which the spirit of the Lord drives on:
text_la: Et timebunt qui ab occidente nomen Domini, et qui ab ortu solis gloriam ejus, cum venerit quasi fluvius violentus quem spiritus Domini cogit;
text_pt: Então temerão o nome do Senhor desde o poente, e a sua glória desde o nascente do sol; vindo o inimigo como uma corrente de águas, o Espírito do Senhor arvorará contra ele a sua bandeira.
text_el: καὶ φοβηθήσονται οἱ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου καὶ οἱ ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἔνδοξον ἥξει γὰρ ὡς ποταμὸς βίαιος ἡ ὀργὴ παρὰ κυρίου ἥξει μετὰ θυμοῦ

text_en: And there shall come a redeemer to Sion, and to them that return from iniquity in Jacob , says the Lord .
text_la: et venerit Sion redemptor, et eis qui redeunt ab iniquitate in Jacob, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: E virá um Redentor a Sião e aos que em Jacó se converterem da transgressão, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἥξει ἕνεκεν Σιων ὁ ῥυόμενος καὶ ἀποστρέψει ἀσεβείας ἀπὸ Ιακωβ

text_en: This is my covenant with them, says the Lord : My spirit that is in you, and my words that I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your seed, nor out of the mouth of your seed's seed, says the Lord , from henceforth and for ever.
text_la: Hoc fœdus meum cum eis, dicit Dominus : spiritus meus qui est in te, et verba mea quæ posui in ore tuo, non recedent de ore tuo, et de ore seminis tui, et de ore seminis seminis tui, dicit Dominus, amodo et usque in sempiternum.
text_pt: Quanto a mim, esta é a minha aliança com eles, diz o Senhor: o meu espírito, que está sobre ti, e as minhas palavras, que pus na tua boca, não se desviarão da tua boca nem da boca da tua descendência, nem da boca da descendência da tua descendência, diz o Senhor, desde agora e para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη αὐτοῖς ἡ παρ' ἐμοῦ διαθήκη εἶπεν κύριος τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἐμόν ὅ ἐστιν ἐπὶ σοί καὶ τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκα εἰς τὸ στόμα σου οὐ μὴ ἐκλίπῃ ἐκ τοῦ στόματός σου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ σπέρματός σου εἶπεν γὰρ κύριος ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Arise, be enlightened, O Jerusalem : for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon you.
text_la: Surge, illuminare, Jerusalem, quia venit lumen tuum, et gloria Domini super te orta est.
text_pt: Levanta-te, resplandece, porque vem a tua luz, e a glória do SENHOR vai nascendo sobre ti;
text_el: φωτίζου φωτίζου Ιερουσαλημ ἥκει γάρ σου τὸ φῶς καὶ ἡ δόξα κυρίου ἐπὶ σὲ ἀνατέταλκεν

text_en: For behold darkness shall cover the earth, and a mist the people: but the Lord shall arise upon you, and his glory shall be seen upon you.
text_la: Quia ecce tenebræ operient terram, et caligo populos; super te autem orietur Dominus, et gloria ejus in te videbitur.
text_pt: Porque eis que as trevas cobriram a terra, e a escuridão os povos; mas sobre ti o Senhor virá surgindo, e a sua glória se verá sobre ti.
text_el: ἰδοὺ σκότος καὶ γνόφος καλύψει γῆν ἐπ' ἔθνη ἐπὶ δὲ σὲ φανήσεται κύριος καὶ ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ σὲ ὀφθήσεται

text_en: And the Gentiles shall walk in your light, and kings in the brightness of your rising.
text_la: Et ambulabunt gentes in lumine tuo, et reges in splendore ortus tui.
text_pt: E os gentios caminharão à tua luz, e os reis ao resplendor que te nasceu.
text_el: καὶ πορεύσονται βασιλεῖς τῷ φωτί σου καὶ ἔθνη τῇ λαμπρότητί σου

text_en: Lift up your eyes round about, and see: all these are gathered together, they have come to you: your sons shall come from afar, and your daughters shall rise up at your side.
text_la: Leva in circuitu oculos tuos, et vide : omnes isti congregati sunt, venerunt tibi; filii tui de longe venient et filiæ tuæ de latere surgent.
text_pt: Levanta em redor os teus olhos, e vê; todos estes já se ajuntaram, e vêm a ti; teus filhos virão de longe, e tuas filhas serão criadas ao teu lado.
text_el: ἆρον κύκλῳ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου καὶ ἰδὲ συνηγμένα τὰ τέκνα σου ἰδοὺ ἥκασιν πάντες οἱ υἱοί σου μακρόθεν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες σου ἐπ' ὤμων ἀρθήσονται

text_en: Then shall you see, and abound, and your heart shall wonder and be enlarged, when the multitude of the sea shall be converted to you, the strength of the Gentiles shall come to you.
text_la: Tunc videbis, et afflues; mirabitur et dilatabitur cor tuum : quando conversa fuerit ad te multitudo maris; fortitudo gentium venerit tibi.
text_pt: Então o verás, e serás iluminado, e o teu coração estremecerá e se alargará; porque a abundância do mar se tornará a ti, e as riquezas dos gentios virão a ti.
text_el: τότε ὄψῃ καὶ φοβηθήσῃ καὶ ἐκστήσῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ ὅτι μεταβαλεῖ εἰς σὲ πλοῦτος θαλάσσης καὶ ἐθνῶν καὶ λαῶν καὶ ἥξουσίν σοι

text_en: The multitude of camels shall cover you, the dromedaries of Madian and Epha: all they from Saba shall come, bringing gold and frankincense: and showing forth praise to the Lord .
text_la: Inundatio camelorum operiet te, dromedarii Madian et Epha; omnes de Saba venient, aurum et thus deferentes, et laudem Domino annuntiantes.
text_pt: A multidão de camelos te cobrirá, os dromedários de Midiã e Efá; todos virão de Sabá; ouro e incenso trarão, e publicarão os louvores do Senhor.
text_el: ἀγέλαι καμήλων καὶ καλύψουσίν σε κάμηλοι Μαδιαμ καὶ Γαιφα πάντες ἐκ Σαβα ἥξουσιν φέροντες χρυσίον καὶ λίβανον οἴσουσιν καὶ τὸ σωτήριον κυρίου εὐαγγελιοῦνται

text_en: All the flocks of Cedar shall be gathered together unto you, the rams of Nabaioth shall minister to you: they shall be offered upon my acceptable altar , and I will glorify the house of my majesty.
text_la: Omne pecus Cedar congregabitur tibi; arietes Nabaioth ministrabunt tibi : offerentur super placabili altari meo, et domum majestatis meæ glorificabo.
text_pt: Todas as ovelhas de Quedar se congregarão a ti; os carneiros de Nebaiote te servirão; com agrado subirão ao meu altar, e eu glorificarei a casa da minha glória.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ πρόβατα Κηδαρ συναχθήσονταί σοι καὶ κριοὶ Ναβαιωθ ἥξουσίν σοι καὶ ἀνενεχθήσεται δεκτὰ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριόν μου καὶ ὁ οἶκος τῆς προσευχῆς μου δοξασθήσεται

text_en: Who are these, that fly as clouds, and as doves to their windows?
text_la: Qui sunt isti qui ut nubes volant, et quasi columbæ ad fenestras suas?
text_pt: Quem são estes que vêm voando como nuvens, e como pombas às suas janelas?
text_el: τίνες οἵδε ὡς νεφέλαι πέτανται καὶ ὡς περιστεραὶ σὺν νεοσσοῖς

text_en: For, the islands wait for me, and the ships of the sea in the beginning: that I may bring your sons from afar: their silver, and their gold with them, to the name of the Lord your God , and to the Holy One of Israel , because he has glorified you.
text_la: Me enim insulæ exspectant, et naves maris in principio, ut adducam filios tuos de longe; argentum eorum, et aurum eorum cum eis, nomini Domini Dei tui, et Sancto Israël, quia glorificavit te.
text_pt: Certamente as ilhas me aguardarão, e primeiro os navios de Társis, para trazer teus filhos de longe, e com eles a sua prata e o seu ouro, para o nome do Senhor teu Deus, e para o Santo de Israel, porquanto ele te glorificou.
text_el: ἐμὲ νῆσοι ὑπέμειναν καὶ πλοῖα Θαρσις ἐν πρώτοις ἀγαγεῖν τὰ τέκνα σου μακρόθεν καὶ τὸν ἄργυρον καὶ τὸν χρυσὸν μετ' αὐτῶν διὰ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τὸ ἅγιον καὶ διὰ τὸ τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ισραηλ ἔνδοξον εἶναι

text_en: And the children of strangers shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister to you: for in my wrath have I struck you, and in my reconciliation have I had mercy upon you.
text_la: Et ædificabunt filii peregrinorum muros tuos, et reges eorum ministrabunt tibi; in indignatione enim mea percussi te, et in reconciliatione mea misertus sum tui.
text_pt: E os filhos dos estrangeiros edificarão os teus muros, e os seus reis te servirão; porque no meu furor te feri, mas na minha benignidade tive misericórdia de ti.
text_el: καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν ἀλλογενεῖς τὰ τείχη σου καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν παραστήσονταί σοι διὰ γὰρ ὀργήν μου ἐπάταξά σε καὶ διὰ ἔλεον ἠγάπησά σε

text_en: And your gates shall be open continually: they shall not be shut day nor night, that the strength of the Gentiles may be brought to you, and their kings may be brought.
text_la: Et aperientur portæ tuæ jugiter; die ac nocte non claudentur, ut afferatur ad te fortitudo gentium, et reges earum adducantur.
text_pt: E as tuas portas estarão abertas de contínuo, nem de dia nem de noite se fecharão; para que tragam a ti as riquezas dos gentios, e, conduzidos com elas, os seus reis.
text_el: καὶ ἀνοιχθήσονται αἱ πύλαι σου διὰ παντός ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς οὐ κλεισθήσονται εἰσαγαγεῖν πρὸς σὲ δύναμιν ἐθνῶν καὶ βασιλεῖς ἀγομένους

text_en: For the nation and the kingdom that will not serve you, shall perish: and the Gentiles shall be wasted with desolation.
text_la: Gens enim et regnum quod non servierit tibi peribit, et gentes solitudine vastabuntur.
text_pt: Porque a nação e o reino que não te servirem perecerão; sim, essas nações serão de todo assoladas.
text_el: τὰ γὰρ ἔθνη καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς οἵτινες οὐ δουλεύσουσίν σοι ἀπολοῦνται καὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἐρημίᾳ ἐρημωθήσονται

text_en: The glory of Libanus shall come to you, the fir tree, and the box tree, and the pine tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary: and I will glorify the place of my feet.
text_la: Gloria Libani ad te veniet, abies, et buxus, et pinus simul ad ornandum locum sanctificationis meæ; et locum pedum meorum glorificabo.
text_pt: A glória do Líbano virá a ti; a faia, o pinheiro, e o álamo conjuntamente, para ornarem o lugar do meu santuário, e glorificarei o lugar dos meus pés.
text_el: καὶ ἡ δόξα τοῦ Λιβάνου πρὸς σὲ ἥξει ἐν κυπαρίσσῳ καὶ πεύκῃ καὶ κέδρῳ ἅμα δοξάσαι τὸν τόπον τὸν ἅγιόν μου

text_en: And the children of them that afflict you, shall come bowing down to you, and all that slandered you shall worship the steps of your feet, and shall call you the city of the Lord , the Sion of the Holy One of Israel .
text_la: Et venient ad te curvi filii eorum qui humiliaverunt te, et adorabunt vestigia pedum tuorum omnes qui detrahebant tibi : et vocabunt te civitatem Domini, Sion Sancti Israël.
text_pt: Também virão a ti, inclinando-se, os filhos dos que te oprimiram; e prostrar-se-ão às plantas dos teus pés todos os que te desprezaram; e chamar-te-ão a cidade do Senhor, a Sião do Santo de Israel.
text_el: καὶ πορεύσονται πρὸς σὲ δεδοικότες υἱοὶ ταπεινωσάντων σε καὶ παροξυνάντων σε καὶ κληθήσῃ πόλις κυρίου Σιων ἁγίου Ισραηλ

text_en: Because you were forsaken, and hated , and there was none that passed through you, I will make you to be an everlasting glory , a joy unto generation and generation :
text_la: Pro eo quod fuisti derelicta et odio habita, et non erat qui per te transiret : ponam te in superbiam sæculorum, gaudium in generationem et generationem :
text_pt: Em lugar de seres deixada, e odiada, de modo que ninguém passava por ti, far-te-ei uma excelência perpétua, um gozo de geração em geração.
text_el: διὰ τὸ γεγενῆσθαί σε ἐγκαταλελειμμένην καὶ μεμισημένην καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ βοηθῶν καὶ θήσω σε ἀγαλλίαμα αἰώνιον εὐφροσύνην γενεῶν γενεαῖς

text_en: And you shall suck the milk of the Gentiles , and you shall be nursed with the breasts of kings: and you shall know that I am the Lord your Saviour, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob .
text_la: et suges lac gentium, et mamilla regum lactaberis; et scies quia ego Dominus salvans te, et redemptor tuus, Fortis Jacob.
text_pt: E mamarás o leite dos gentios, e alimentar-te-ás ao peito dos reis; e saberás que eu sou o Senhor, o teu Salvador, e o teu Redentor, o Poderoso de Jacó.
text_el: καὶ θηλάσεις γάλα ἐθνῶν καὶ πλοῦτον βασιλέων φάγεσαι καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ σῴζων σε καὶ ἐξαιρούμενός σε θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver: and for wood brass, and for stones iron: and I will make your visitation peace, and your overseers justice .
text_la: Pro ære afferam aurum, et pro ferro afferam argentum, et pro lignis æs, et pro lapidibus ferrum : et ponam visitationem tuam pacem, et præpositos tuos justitiam.
text_pt: Por cobre trarei ouro, e por ferro trarei prata, e por madeira, bronze, e por pedras, ferro; e farei pacíficos os teus oficiais e justos os teus exatores.
text_el: καὶ ἀντὶ χαλκοῦ οἴσω σοι χρυσίον ἀντὶ δὲ σιδήρου οἴσω σοι ἀργύριον ἀντὶ δὲ ξύλων οἴσω σοι χαλκόν ἀντὶ δὲ λίθων σίδηρον καὶ δώσω τοὺς ἄρχοντάς σου ἐν εἰρήνῃ καὶ τοὺς ἐπισκόπους σου ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ

text_en: Iniquity shall no more be heard in your land, wasting nor destruction in your borders, and salvation shall possess your walls, and praise your gates.
text_la: Non audietur ultra iniquitas in terra tua; vastitas et contritio in terminis tuis : et occupabit salus muros tuos, et portas tuas laudatio.
text_pt: Nunca mais se ouvirá de violência na tua terra, desolação nem destruição nos teus termos; mas aos teus muros chamarás Salvação, e às tuas portas Louvor.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀκουσθήσεται ἔτι ἀδικία ἐν τῇ γῇ σου οὐδὲ σύντριμμα οὐδὲ ταλαιπωρία ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις σου ἀλλὰ κληθήσεται σωτήριον τὰ τείχη σου καὶ αἱ πύλαι σου γλύμμα

text_en: You shall no more have the sun for your light by day, neither shall the brightness of the moon enlighten you: but the Lord shall be unto you for an everlasting light, and your God for your glory .
text_la: Non erit tibi amplius sol ad lucendum per diem, nec splendor lunæ illuminabit te : sed erit tibi Dominus in lucem sempiternam, et Deus tuus in gloriam tuam.
text_pt: Nunca mais te servirá o sol para luz do dia nem com o seu resplendor a lua te iluminará; mas o Senhor será a tua luz perpétua, e o teu Deus a tua glória.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔσται σοι ὁ ἥλιος εἰς φῶς ἡμέρας οὐδὲ ἀνατολὴ σελήνης φωτιεῖ σοι τὴν νύκτα ἀλλ' ἔσται σοι κύριος φῶς αἰώνιον καὶ ὁ θεὸς δόξα σου

text_en: Your sun shall go down no more, and your moon shall not decrease: for the Lord shall be unto you for an everlasting light, and the days of your mourning shall be ended.
text_la: Non occidet ultra sol tuus, et luna tua non minuetur, quia erit tibi Dominus in lucem sempiternam, et complebuntur dies luctus tui.
text_pt: Nunca mais se porá o teu sol, nem a tua lua minguará; porque o Senhor será a tua luz perpétua, e os dias do teu luto findarão.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ δύσεται ὁ ἥλιός σοι καὶ ἡ σελήνη σοι οὐκ ἐκλείψει ἔσται γὰρ κύριός σοι φῶς αἰώνιον καὶ ἀναπληρωθήσονται αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ πένθους σου

text_en: And your people shall be all just , they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hand to glorify me.
text_la: Populus autem tuus omnes justi; in perpetuum hæreditabunt terram : germen plantationis meæ, opus manus meæ ad glorificandum.
text_pt: E todos os do teu povo serão justos, para sempre herdarão a terra; serão renovos por mim plantados, obra das minhas mãos, para que eu seja glorificado.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λαός σου πᾶς δίκαιος καὶ δι' αἰῶνος κληρονομήσουσιν τὴν γῆν φυλάσσων τὸ φύτευμα ἔργα χειρῶν αὐτοῦ εἰς δόξαν

text_en: The least shall become a thousand, and a little one a most strong nation: I the Lord will suddenly do this thing in its time.
text_la: Minimus erit in mille, et parvulus in gentem fortissimam. Ego Dominus in tempore ejus subito faciam istud.
text_pt: O menor virá a ser mil, e o mínimo uma nação forte; eu, o Senhor, ao seu tempo o farei prontamente.
text_el: ὁ ὀλιγοστὸς ἔσται εἰς χιλιάδας καὶ ὁ ἐλάχιστος εἰς ἔθνος μέγα ἐγὼ κύριος κατὰ καιρὸν συνάξω αὐτούς

text_en: The spirit of the Lord is upon me, because the Lord has anointed me: he has sent me to preach to the meek, to heal the contrite of heart, and to preach a release to the captives, and deliverance to them that are shut up.
text_la: Spiritus Domini super me, eo quod unxerit Dominus me; ad annuntiandum mansuetis misit me, ut mederer contritis corde, et prædicarem captivis indulgentiam, et clausis apertionem;
text_pt: O espírito do Senhor DEUS está sobre mim; porque o SENHOR me ungiu, para pregar boas novas aos mansos; enviou-me a restaurar os contritos de coração, a proclamar liberdade aos cativos, e a abertura de prisão aos presos;
text_el: πνεῦμα κυρίου ἐπ' ἐμέ οὗ εἵνεκεν ἔχρισέν με εὐαγγελίσασθαι πτωχοῖς ἀπέσταλκέν με ἰάσασθαι τοὺς συντετριμμένους τῇ καρδίᾳ κηρύξαι αἰχμαλώτοις ἄφεσιν καὶ τυφλοῖς ἀνάβλεψιν

text_en: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord , and the day of vengeance of our God : to comfort all that mourn:
text_la: ut prædicarem annum placabilem Domino, et diem ultionis Deo nostro; ut consolarer omnes lugentes,
text_pt: A apregoar o ano aceitável do Senhor e o dia da vingança do nosso Deus; a consolar todos os tristes;
text_el: καλέσαι ἐνιαυτὸν κυρίου δεκτὸν καὶ ἡμέραν ἀνταποδόσεως παρακαλέσαι πάντας τοὺς πενθοῦντας

text_en: To appoint to the mourners of Sion, and to give them a crown for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, a garment of praise for the spirit of grief: and they shall be called in it the mighty ones of justice , the planting of the Lord to glorify him.
text_la: ut ponerem lugentibus Sion, et darem eis coronam pro cinere, oleum gaudii pro luctu, pallium laudis pro spiritu mœroris; et vocabuntur in ea fortes justitiæ, plantatio Domini ad glorificandum.
text_pt: A ordenar acerca dos tristes de Sião que se lhes dê glória em vez de cinza, óleo de gozo em vez de tristeza, vestes de louvor em vez de espírito angustiado; a fim de que se chamem árvores de justiça, plantações do Senhor, para que ele seja glorificado.
text_el: δοθῆναι τοῖς πενθοῦσιν Σιων δόξαν ἀντὶ σποδοῦ ἄλειμμα εὐφροσύνης τοῖς πενθοῦσιν καταστολὴν δόξης ἀντὶ πνεύματος ἀκηδίας καὶ κληθήσονται γενεαὶ δικαιοσύνης φύτευμα κυρίου εἰς δόξαν

text_en: And they shall build the places that have been waste from of old, and shall raise up ancient ruins, and shall repair the desolate cities, that were destroyed for generation and generation .
text_la: Et ædificabunt deserta a sæculo, et ruinas antiquas erigent, et instaurabunt civitates desertas, dissipatas in generationem et generationem.
text_pt: E edificarão os lugares antigamente assolados, e restaurarão os anteriormente destruídos, e renovarão as cidades assoladas, destruídas de geração em geração.
text_el: καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν ἐρήμους αἰωνίας ἐξηρημωμένας πρότερον ἐξαναστήσουσιν καὶ καινιοῦσιν πόλεις ἐρήμους ἐξηρημωμένας εἰς γενεάς

text_en: And strangers shall stand and shall feed your flocks: and the sons of strangers shall be your husbandman, and the dressers of your vines.
text_la: Et stabunt alieni, et pascent pecora vestra, et filii peregrinorum agricolæ et vinitores vestri erunt.
text_pt: E haverá estrangeiros, que apascentarão os vossos rebanhos; e estranhos serão os vossos lavradores e os vossos vinhateiros.
text_el: καὶ ἥξουσιν ἀλλογενεῖς ποιμαίνοντες τὰ πρόβατά σου καὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ἀροτῆρες καὶ ἀμπελουργοί

text_en: But you shall be called the priests of the Lord : to you it shall be said: You ministers of our God : you shall eat the riches of the Gentiles , and you shall pride yourselves in their glory .
text_la: Vos autem sacerdotes Domini vocabimini : Ministri Dei nostri, dicetur vobis, fortitudinem gentium comedetis, et in gloria earum superbietis.
text_pt: Porém vós sereis chamados sacerdotes do Senhor, e vos chamarão ministros de nosso Deus; comereis a riqueza dos gentios, e na sua glória vos gloriareis.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἱερεῖς κυρίου κληθήσεσθε λειτουργοὶ θεοῦ ἰσχὺν ἐθνῶν κατέδεσθε καὶ ἐν τῷ πλούτῳ αὐτῶν θαυμασθήσεσθε

text_en: For your double confusion and shame, they shall praise their part: therefore shall they receive double in their land, everlasting joy shall be unto them.
text_la: Pro confusione vestra duplici et rubore, laudabunt partem suam; propter hoc in terra sua duplicia possidebunt, lætitia sempiterna erit eis.
text_pt: Em lugar da vossa vergonha tereis dupla honra; e em lugar da afronta exultareis na vossa parte; por isso na sua terra possuirão o dobro, e terão perpétua alegria.
text_el: οὕτως ἐκ δευτέρας κληρονομήσουσιν τὴν γῆν καὶ εὐφροσύνη αἰώνιος ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: For I am the Lord that love judgment, and hate robbery in a holocaust : and I will make their work in truth , and I will make a perpetual covenant with them.
text_la: Quia ego Dominus diligens judicium, et odio habens rapinam in holocausto; et dabo opus eorum in veritate, et fœdus perpetuum feriam eis.
text_pt: Porque eu, o Senhor, amo o juízo, odeio o que foi roubado oferecido em holocausto; portanto, firmarei em verdade a sua obra; e farei uma aliança eterna com eles.
text_el: ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι κύριος ὁ ἀγαπῶν δικαιοσύνην καὶ μισῶν ἁρπάγματα ἐξ ἀδικίας καὶ δώσω τὸν μόχθον αὐτῶν δικαίοις καὶ διαθήκην αἰώνιον διαθήσομαι αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they shall know their seed among the Gentiles , and their offspring in the midst of peoples: all that shall see them, shall know them, that these are the seed which the Lord has blessed .
text_la: Et scient in gentibus semen eorum, et germen eorum in medio populorum; omnes qui viderint eos cognoscent illos, quia isti sunt semen cui benedixit Dominus.
text_pt: E a sua posteridade será conhecida entre os gentios, e os seus descendentes no meio dos povos; todos quantos os virem os conhecerão, como descendência bendita do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ γνωσθήσεται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἔκγονα αὐτῶν πᾶς ὁ ὁρῶν αὐτοὺς ἐπιγνώσεται αὐτούς ὅτι οὗτοί εἰσιν σπέρμα ηὐλογημένον ὑπὸ θεοῦ

text_en: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord , and my soul shall be joyful in my God : for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation : and with the robe of justice he has covered me, as a bridegroom decked with a crown, and as a bride adorned with her jewels .
text_la: Gaudens gaudebo in Domino, et exsultabit anima mea in Deo meo, quia induit me vestimentis salutis, et indumento justitiæ circumdedit me, quasi sponsum decoratum corona, et quasi sponsam ornatam monilibus suis.
text_pt: Regozijar-me-ei muito no Senhor, a minha alma se alegrará no meu Deus; porque me vestiu de roupas de salvação, cobriu-me com o manto de justiça, como um noivo se adorna com turbante sacerdotal, e como a noiva que se enfeita com as suas jóias.
text_el: καὶ εὐφροσύνῃ εὐφρανθήσονται ἐπὶ κύριον ἀγαλλιάσθω ἡ ψυχή μου ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ ἐνέδυσεν γάρ με ἱμάτιον σωτηρίου καὶ χιτῶνα εὐφροσύνης ὡς νυμφίῳ περιέθηκέν μοι μίτραν καὶ ὡς νύμφην κατεκόσμησέν με κόσμῳ

text_en: For as the earth brings forth her bud, and as the garden causes her seed to shoot forth: so shall the Lord God make justice to spring forth, and praise before all the nations.
text_la: Sicut enim terra profert germen suum, et sicut hortus semen suum germinat, sic Dominus Deus germinabit justitiam et laudem coram universis gentibus.
text_pt: Porque, como a terra produz os seus renovos, e como o jardim faz brotar o que nele se semeia, assim o Senhor DEUS fará brotar a justiça e o louvor para todas as nações.
text_el: καὶ ὡς γῆν αὔξουσαν τὸ ἄνθος αὐτῆς καὶ ὡς κῆπος τὰ σπέρματα αὐτοῦ οὕτως ἀνατελεῖ κύριος δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἀγαλλίαμα ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: For Sion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for the sake of Jerusalem , I will not rest till her just one come forth as brightness, and her saviour be lighted as a lamp.
text_la: Propter Sion non tacebo, et propter Jerusalem non quiescam, donec egrediatur ut splendor justus ejus, et salvator ejus ut lampas accendatur.
text_pt: Por amor de Sião não me calarei, e por amor de Jerusalém não me aquietarei, até que saia a sua justiça como um resplendor, e a sua salvação como uma tocha acesa.
text_el: διὰ Σιων οὐ σιωπήσομαι καὶ διὰ Ιερουσαλημ οὐκ ἀνήσω ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθῃ ὡς φῶς ἡ δικαιοσύνη μου τὸ δὲ σωτήριόν μου ὡς λαμπὰς καυθήσεται

text_en: And the Gentiles shall see your just one, and all kings your glorious one: and you shall be called by a new name , which the mouth of the Lord shall name .
text_la: Et videbunt gentes justum tuum, et cuncti reges inclytum tuum; et vocabitur tibi nomen novum, quod os Domini nominabit.
text_pt: E os gentios verão a tua justiça, e todos os reis a tua glória; e chamar-te-ão por um nome novo, que a boca do Senhor designará.
text_el: καὶ ὄψονται ἔθνη τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου καὶ βασιλεῖς τὴν δόξαν σου καὶ καλέσει σε τὸ ὄνομά σου τὸ καινόν ὃ ὁ κύριος ὀνομάσει αὐτό

text_en: And you shall be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord , and a royal diadem in the hand of your God .
text_la: Et eris corona gloriæ in manu Domini, et diadema regni in manu Dei tui.
text_pt: E serás uma coroa de glória na mão do Senhor, e um diadema real na mão do teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔσῃ στέφανος κάλλους ἐν χειρὶ κυρίου καὶ διάδημα βασιλείας ἐν χειρὶ θεοῦ σου

text_en: You shall no more be called Forsaken: and your land shall no more be called Desolate: but you shall be called My pleasure in her, and your land inhabited. Because the Lord has been well pleased with you: and your land shall be inhabited.
text_la: Non vocaberis ultra Derelicta, et terra tua non vocabitur amplius Desolata; sed vocaberis, Voluntas mea in ea, et terra tua Inhabitata, quia complacuit Domino in te, et terra tua inhabitabitur.
text_pt: Nunca mais te chamarão: Desamparada, nem a tua terra se denominará jamais: Assolada; mas chamar-te-ão: O meu prazer está nela, e à tua terra: A casada; porque o Senhor se agrada de ti, e a tua terra se casará.
text_el: καὶ οὐκέτι κληθήσῃ καταλελειμμένη καὶ ἡ γῆ σου οὐ κληθήσεται ἔρημος σοὶ γὰρ κληθήσεται θέλημα ἐμόν καὶ τῇ γῇ σου οἰκουμένη

text_en: For the young man shall dwell with the virgin , and your children shall dwell in you. And the bridegroom shall rejoice over the bride, and your God shall rejoice over you.
text_la: Habitabit enim juvenis cum virgine, et habitabunt in te filii tui; et gaudebit sponsus super sponsam, et gaudebit super te Deus tuus.
text_pt: Porque, como o jovem se casa com a virgem, assim teus filhos se casarão contigo; e como o noivo se alegra da noiva, assim se alegrará de ti o teu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ὡς συνοικῶν νεανίσκος παρθένῳ οὕτως κατοικήσουσιν οἱ υἱοί σου μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον εὐφρανθήσεται νυμφίος ἐπὶ νύμφῃ οὕτως εὐφρανθήσεται κύριος ἐπὶ σοί

text_en: Upon your walls, O Jerusalem , I have appointed watchmen all the day, and all the night, they shall never hold their peace. You that are mindful of the Lord , hold not your peace,
text_la: Super muros tuos, Jerusalem, constitui custodes; tota die et tota nocte in perpetuum non tacebunt. Qui reminiscimini Domini, ne taceatis,
text_pt: Ó Jerusalém, sobre os teus muros pus guardas, que todo o dia e toda a noite jamais se calarão; ó vós, os que fazeis lembrar ao Senhor, não haja descanso em vós,
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν τειχέων σου Ιερουσαλημ κατέστησα φύλακας ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα οἳ διὰ τέλους οὐ σιωπήσονται μιμνῃσκόμενοι κυρίου

text_en: and give him no silence till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
text_la: et ne detis silentium ei, donec stabiliat et donec ponat Jerusalem laudem in terra.
text_pt: Nem deis a ele descanso, até que confirme, e até que ponha a Jerusalém por louvor na terra.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅμοιος ἐὰν διορθώσῃ καὶ ποιήσῃ Ιερουσαλημ ἀγαυρίαμα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: The Lord has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength: Surely I will no more give your corn to be meat for your enemies: and the sons of the strangers shall not drink your wine, for which you have laboured.
text_la: Juravit Dominus in dextera sua, et in brachio fortitudinis suæ : Si dedero triticum tuum ultra cibum inimicis tuis; et si biberint filii alieni vinum tuum in quo laborasti.
text_pt: Jurou o Senhor pela sua mão direita, e pelo braço da sua força: Nunca mais darei o teu trigo por comida aos teus inimigos, nem os estrangeiros beberão o teu mosto, em que trabalhaste.
text_el: ὤμοσεν κύριος κατὰ τῆς δεξιᾶς αὐτοῦ καὶ κατὰ τῆς ἰσχύος τοῦ βραχίονος αὐτοῦ εἰ ἔτι δώσω τὸν σῖτόν σου καὶ τὰ βρώματά σου τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου καὶ εἰ ἔτι πίονται υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι τὸν οἶνόν σου ἐφ' ᾧ ἐμόχθησας

text_en: For they that gather it, shall eat it, and shall praise the Lord : and they that bring it together, shall drink it in my holy courts .
text_la: Quia qui congregant illud, comedent, et laudabunt Dominum; et qui comportant illud, bibent in atriis sanctis meis.
text_pt: Mas os que o ajuntarem o comerão, e louvarão ao Senhor; e os que o colherem beberão nos átrios do meu santuário.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ οἱ συνάγοντες φάγονται αὐτὰ καὶ αἰνέσουσιν κύριον καὶ οἱ συνάγοντες πίονται αὐτὰ ἐν ταῖς ἐπαύλεσιν ταῖς ἁγίαις μου

text_en: Go through, go through the gates, prepare the way for the people, make the road plain, pick out the stones, and lift up the standard to the people.
text_la: Transite, transite per portas, præparate viam populo : planum facite iter, eligite lapides, et elevate signum ad populos.
text_pt: Passai, passai pelas portas; preparai o caminho ao povo; aplanai, aplanai a estrada, limpai-a das pedras; arvorai a bandeira aos povos.
text_el: πορεύεσθε διὰ τῶν πυλῶν μου καὶ ὁδοποιήσατε τῷ λαῷ μου καὶ τοὺς λίθους τοὺς ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ διαρρίψατε ἐξάρατε σύσσημον εἰς τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: Behold the Lord has made it to be heard in the ends of the earth, tell the daughter of Sion: Behold your Saviour comes: behold his reward is with him, and his work before him.
text_la: Ecce Dominus auditum fecit in extremis terræ : Dicite filiæ Sion : Ecce Salvator tuus venit; ecce merces ejus cum eo, et opus ejus coram illo.
text_pt: Eis que o Senhor fez ouvir até às extremidades da terra: Dizei à filha de Sião: Eis que vem a tua salvação; eis que com ele vem o seu galardão, e a sua obra diante dele.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ κύριος ἐποίησεν ἀκουστὸν ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς εἴπατε τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιων ἰδού σοι ὁ σωτὴρ παραγίνεται ἔχων τὸν ἑαυτοῦ μισθὸν καὶ τὸ ἔργον πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they shall call them, The holy people, the redeemed of the Lord . But you shall be called: A city sought after, and not forsaken.
text_la: Et vocabunt eos, Populus sanctus, redempti a Domino; tu autem vocaberis, Quæsita civitas, et non Derelicta.
text_pt: E chamar-lhes-ão: Povo santo, remidos do Senhor; e tu serás chamada: Procurada, a cidade não desamparada.
text_el: καὶ καλέσει αὐτὸν λαὸν ἅγιον λελυτρωμένον ὑπὸ κυρίου σὺ δὲ κληθήσῃ ἐπιζητουμένη πόλις καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλελειμμένη

text_en: Who is this that comes from Edom , with dyed garments from Bosra, this beautiful one in his robe, walking in the greatness of his strength. I, that speak justice , and am a defender to save.
text_la: Quis est iste, qui venit de Edom, tinctis vestibus de Bosra? iste formosus in stola sua, gradiens in multitudine fortitudinis suæ? Ego qui loquor justitiam, et propugnator sum ad salvandum.
text_pt: Quem é este, que vem de Edom, de Bozra, com vestes tintas; este que é glorioso em sua vestidura, que marcha com a sua grande força? Eu, que falo em justiça, poderoso para salvar.
text_el: τίς οὗτος ὁ παραγινόμενος ἐξ Εδωμ ἐρύθημα ἱματίων ἐκ Βοσορ οὕτως ὡραῖος ἐν στολῇ βίᾳ μετὰ ἰσχύος ἐγὼ διαλέγομαι δικαιοσύνην καὶ κρίσιν σωτηρίου

text_en: Why then is your apparel red, and your garments like theirs that tread in the winepress?
text_la: Quare ergo rubrum est indumentum tuum, et vestimenta tua sicut calcantium in torculari?
text_pt: Por que está vermelha a tua vestidura, e as tuas roupas como as daquele que pisa no lagar?
text_el: διὰ τί σου ἐρυθρὰ τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ τὰ ἐνδύματά σου ὡς ἀπὸ πατητοῦ ληνοῦ

text_en: I have trodden the winepress alone, and of the Gentiles there is not a man with me: I have trampled on them in my indignation, and have trodden them down in my wrath , and their blood is sprinkled upon my garments, and I have stained all my apparel.
text_la: Torcular calcavi solus, et de gentibus non est vir mecum; calcavi eos in furore meo, et conculcavi eos in ira mea : et aspersus est sanguis eorum super vestimenta mea, et omnia indumenta mea inquinavi.
text_pt: Eu sozinho pisei no lagar, e dos povos ninguém houve comigo; e os pisei na minha ira, e os esmaguei no meu furor; e o seu sangue salpicou as minhas vestes, e manchei toda a minha vestidura.
text_el: πλήρης καταπεπατημένης καὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀνὴρ μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ κατεπάτησα αὐτοὺς ἐν θυμῷ καὶ κατέθλασα αὐτοὺς ὡς γῆν καὶ κατήγαγον τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν εἰς γῆν

text_en: For the day of vengeance is in my heart, the year of my redemption has come.
text_la: Dies enim ultionis in corde meo; annus redemptionis meæ venit.
text_pt: Porque o dia da vingança estava no meu coração; e o ano dos meus remidos é chegado.
text_el: ἡμέρα γὰρ ἀνταποδόσεως ἐπῆλθεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐνιαυτὸς λυτρώσεως πάρεστιν

text_en: I looked about, and there was none to help: I sought, and there was none to give aid: and my own arm has saved for me, and my indignation itself has helped me.
text_la: Circumspexi, et non erat auxiliator; quæsivi, et non fuit qui adjuvaret : et salvavit mihi brachium meum, et indignatio mea ipsa auxiliata est mihi.
text_pt: E olhei, e não havia quem me ajudasse; e admirei-me de não haver quem me sustivesse, por isso o meu braço me trouxe a salvação, e o meu furor me susteve.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβλεψα καὶ οὐδεὶς βοηθός καὶ προσενόησα καὶ οὐθεὶς ἀντελαμβάνετο καὶ ἐρρύσατο αὐτοὺς ὁ βραχίων μου καὶ ὁ θυμός μου ἐπέστη

text_en: And I have trodden down the people in my wrath , and have made them drunk in my indignation, and have brought down their strength to the earth.
text_la: Et conculcavi populos in furore meo, et inebriavi eos in indignatione mea, et detraxi in terram virtutem eorum.
text_pt: E atropelei os povos na minha ira, e os embriaguei no meu furor; e a sua força derrubei por terra.
text_el: καὶ κατεπάτησα αὐτοὺς τῇ ὀργῇ μου καὶ κατήγαγον τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν εἰς γῆν

text_en: I will remember the tender mercies of the Lord , the praise of the Lord for all the things that the Lord has bestowed upon us, and for the multitude of his good things to the house of Israel , which he has given them according to his kindness, and according to the multitude of his mercies.
text_la: Miserationum Domini recordabor; laudem Domini super omnibus quæ reddidit nobis Dominus, et super multitudinem bonorum domui Israël, quæ largitus est eis secundum indulgentiam suam, et secundum multitudinem misericordiarum suarum.
text_pt: As benignidades do Senhor mencionarei, e os muitos louvores do Senhor, conforme tudo quanto o Senhor nos concedeu; e grande bondade para com a casa de Israel, que usou com eles segundo as suas misericórdias, e segundo a multidão das suas benignidades.
text_el: τὸν ἔλεον κυρίου ἐμνήσθην τὰς ἀρετὰς κυρίου ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ὁ κύριος ἡμῖν ἀνταποδίδωσιν κύριος κριτὴς ἀγαθὸς τῷ οἴκῳ Ισραηλ ἐπάγει ἡμῖν κατὰ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ καὶ κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said: Surely they are my people, children that will not deny: so he became their saviour.
text_la: Et dixit : Verumtamen populus meus est, filii non negantes; et factus est eis salvator.
text_pt: Porque dizia: Certamente eles são meu povo, filhos que não mentirão; assim ele se fez o seu Salvador.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν οὐχ ὁ λαός μου τέκνα οὐ μὴ ἀθετήσωσιν καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῖς εἰς σωτηρίαν

text_en: In all their affliction he was not troubled, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love , and in his mercy he redeemed them, and he carried them and lifted them up all the days of old.
text_la: In omni tribulatione eorum non est tribulatus, et angelus faciei ejus salvavit eos : in dilectione sua et in indulgentia sua ipse redemit eos, et portavit eos, et elevavit eos cunctis diebus sæculi.
text_pt: Em toda a angústia deles ele foi angustiado, e o anjo da sua presença os salvou; pelo seu amor, e pela sua compaixão ele os remiu; e os tomou, e os conduziu todos os dias da antiguidade.
text_el: ἐκ πάσης θλίψεως οὐ πρέσβυς οὐδὲ ἄγγελος ἀλλ' αὐτὸς κύριος ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς διὰ τὸ ἀγαπᾶν αὐτοὺς καὶ φείδεσθαι αὐτῶν αὐτὸς ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀνέλαβεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ὕψωσεν αὐτοὺς πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: But they provoked to wrath , and afflicted the spirit of his Holy One: and he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
text_la: Ipsi autem ad iracundiam provocaverunt, et afflixerunt spiritum Sancti ejus : et conversus est eis in inimicum, et ipse debellavit eos.
text_pt: Mas eles foram rebeldes, e contristaram o seu Espírito Santo; por isso se lhes tornou em inimigo, e ele mesmo pelejou contra eles.
text_el: αὐτοὶ δὲ ἠπείθησαν καὶ παρώξυναν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐστράφη αὐτοῖς εἰς ἔχθραν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπολέμησεν αὐτούς

text_en: And he remembered the days of old of Moses , and of his people: Where is he that brought them up out of the sea, with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he that put in the midst of them the spirit of his Holy One?
text_la: Et recordatus est dierum sæculi Moysi, et populi sui. Ubi est qui eduxit eos de mari cum pastoribus gregis sui? Ubi est qui posuit in medio ejus spiritum Sancti sui;
text_pt: Todavia se lembrou dos dias da antiguidade, de Moisés, e do seu povo, dizendo: Onde está agora o que os fez subir do mar com os pastores do seu rebanho? Onde está o que pôs no meio deles o seu Espírito Santo?
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθη ἡμερῶν αἰωνίων ὁ ἀναβιβάσας ἐκ τῆς γῆς τὸν ποιμένα τῶν προβάτων ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὶς ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον

text_en: He that brought out Moses by the right hand, by the arm of his majesty: that divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name .
text_la: qui eduxit ad dexteram Moysen, brachio majestatis suæ; qui scidit aquas ante eos, ut faceret sibi nomen sempiternum;
text_pt: Aquele cujo braço glorioso ele fez andar à mão direita de Moisés, que fendeu as águas diante deles, para fazer para si um nome eterno?
text_el: ὁ ἀγαγὼν τῇ δεξιᾷ Μωυσῆν ὁ βραχίων τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ κατίσχυσεν ὕδωρ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτῷ ὄνομα αἰώνιον

text_en: He that led them out through the deep , as a horse in the wilderness that stumbles not.
text_la: qui eduxit eos per abyssos, quasi equum in deserto non impingentem?
text_pt: Aquele que os guiou pelos abismos, como o cavalo no deserto, de modo que nunca tropeçaram?
text_el: ἤγαγεν αὐτοὺς διὰ τῆς ἀβύσσου ὡς ἵππον δι' ἐρήμου καὶ οὐκ ἐκοπίασαν

text_en: As a beast that goes down in the field, the spirit of the Lord was their leader: so did you lead your people to make yourself a glorious name .
text_la: Quasi animal in campo descendens, spiritus Domini ductor ejus fuit. Sic adduxisti populum tuum, ut faceres tibi nomen gloriæ.
text_pt: Como o animal que desce ao vale, o Espírito do Senhor lhes deu descanso; assim guiaste ao teu povo, para te fazeres um nome glorioso.
text_el: καὶ ὡς κτήνη διὰ πεδίου κατέβη πνεῦμα παρὰ κυρίου καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτούς οὕτως ἤγαγες τὸν λαόν σου ποιῆσαι σεαυτῷ ὄνομα δόξης

text_en: Look down from heaven , and behold from your holy habitation and the place of your glory : where is your zeal , and your strength, the multitude of your bowels, and of your mercies? They have held back themselves from me.
text_la: Attende de cælo, et vide de habitaculo sancto tuo, et gloriæ tuæ. Ubi est zelus tuus, et fortitudo tua, multitudo viscerum tuorum et miserationum tuarum? Super me continuerunt se.
text_pt: Atenta desde os céus, e olha desde a tua santa e gloriosa habitação. Onde estão o teu zelo e as tuas obras poderosas? A comoção das tuas entranhas, e das tuas misericórdias, detém-se para comigo?
text_el: ἐπίστρεψον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἰδὲ ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ἁγίου σου καὶ δόξης ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ ζῆλός σου καὶ ἡ ἰσχύς σου ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους σου καὶ τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν σου ὅτι ἀνέσχου ἡμῶν

text_en: For you are our father, and Abraham has not known us, and Israel has been ignorant of us: you, O Lord , are our father, our redeemer , from everlasting is your name .
text_la: Tu enim pater noster : et Abraham nescivit nos, et Israël ignoravit nos : tu, Domine, pater noster, redemptor noster, a sæculo nomen tuum.
text_pt: Mas tu és nosso Pai, ainda que Abraão não nos conhece, e Israel não nos reconhece; tu, ó Senhor, és nosso Pai; nosso Redentor desde a antiguidade é o teu nome.
text_el: σὺ γὰρ ἡμῶν εἶ πατήρ ὅτι Αβρααμ οὐκ ἔγνω ἡμᾶς καὶ Ισραηλ οὐκ ἐπέγνω ἡμᾶς ἀλλὰ σύ κύριε πατὴρ ἡμῶν ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπ' ἀρχῆς τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐστιν

text_en: Why have you made us to err , O Lord , from your ways: why have you hardened our heart, that we should not fear you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes of your inheritance.
text_la: Quare errare nos fecisti, Domine, de viis tuis; indurasti cor nostrum ne timeremus te? Convertere propter servos tuos, tribus hæreditatis tuæ.
text_pt: Por que, ó Senhor, nos fazes errar dos teus caminhos? Por que endureces o nosso coração, para que não te temamos? Volta, por amor dos teus servos, às tribos da tua herança.
text_el: τί ἐπλάνησας ἡμᾶς κύριε ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ σου ἐσκλήρυνας ἡμῶν τὰς καρδίας τοῦ μὴ φοβεῖσθαί σε ἐπίστρεψον διὰ τοὺς δούλους σου διὰ τὰς φυλὰς τῆς κληρονομίας σου

text_en: They have possessed your holy people as nothing: our enemies have trodden down your sanctuary.
text_la: Quasi nihilum possederunt populum sanctum tuum : hostes nostri conculcaverunt sanctificationem tuam.
text_pt: Só por um pouco de tempo o teu santo povo a possuiu; nossos adversários pisaram o teu santuário.
text_el: ἵνα μικρὸν κληρονομήσωμεν τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ ἁγίου σου οἱ ὑπεναντίοι ἡμῶν κατεπάτησαν τὸ ἁγίασμά σου

text_en: We have become as in the beginning, when you did not rule over us, and when we were not called by your name .
text_la: Facti sumus quasi in principio, cum non dominareris nostri, neque invocaretur nomen tuum super nos.
text_pt: Somos feitos como aqueles sobre quem tu nunca dominaste, e como os que nunca se chamaram pelo teu nome.
text_el: ἐγενόμεθα ὡς τὸ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς ὅτε οὐκ ἦρξας ἡμῶν οὐδὲ ἐπεκλήθη τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐὰν ἀνοίξῃς τὸν οὐρανόν τρόμος λήμψεται ἀπὸ σοῦ ὄρη καὶ τακήσονται

text_en: O that you would rend the heavens , and would come down: the mountains would melt away at your presence.
text_la: Utinam dirumperes cælos, et descenderes; a facie tua montes defluerent;
text_pt: Oh! se fendesses os céus, e descesses, e os montes se escoassem de diante da tua face,
text_el: ὡς κηρὸς ἀπὸ πυρὸς τήκεται καὶ κατακαύσει πῦρ τοὺς ὑπεναντίους καὶ φανερὸν ἔσται τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου ἐν τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ἔθνη ταραχθήσονται

text_en: They would melt as at the burning of fire, the waters would burn with fire, that your name might be made known to your enemies: that the nations might tremble at your presence.
text_la: sicut exustio ignis tabescerent, aquæ arderent igni : ut notum fieret nomen tuum inimicis tuis; a facie tua gentes turbarentur.
text_pt: Como o fogo abrasador de fundição, fogo que faz ferver as águas, para fazeres notório o teu nome aos teus adversários, e assim as nações tremessem da tua presença!

text_en: When you shall do wonderful things, we shall not bear them: you came down, and at your presence the mountains melted away.
text_la: Cum feceris mirabilia, non sustinebimus; descendisti, et a facie tua montes defluxerunt.
text_pt: Quando fazias coisas terríveis, que nunca esperávamos, descias, e os montes se escoavam diante da tua face.
text_el: ὅταν ποιῇς τὰ ἔνδοξα τρόμος λήμψεται ἀπὸ σοῦ ὄρη

text_en: From the beginning of the world they have not heard, nor perceived with the ears: the eye has not seen, O God , besides you, what things you have prepared for them that wait for you.
text_la: A sæculo non audierunt, neque auribus perceperunt; oculus non vidit, Deus, absque te, quæ præparasti exspectantibus te.
text_pt: Porque desde a antiguidade não se ouviu, nem com ouvidos se percebeu, nem com os olhos se viu um Deus além de ti que trabalha para aquele que nele espera.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐκ ἠκούσαμεν οὐδὲ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν εἶδον θεὸν πλὴν σοῦ καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου ἃ ποιήσεις τοῖς ὑπομένουσιν ἔλεον

text_en: You have met him that rejoices, and does justice : in your ways they shall remember you: behold you are angry , and we have sinned : in them we have been always, and we shall be saved.
text_la: Occurristi lætanti, et facienti justitiam; in viis tuis recordabuntur tui. Ecce tu iratus es, et peccavimus; in ipsis fuimus semper, et salvabimur.
text_pt: Saíste ao encontro daquele que se alegrava e praticava justiça e dos que se lembram de ti nos teus caminhos; eis que te iraste, porque pecamos; neles há eternidade, para que sejamos salvos?
text_el: συναντήσεται γὰρ τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τῶν ὁδῶν σου μνησθήσονται ἰδοὺ σὺ ὠργίσθης καὶ ἡμεῖς ἡμάρτομεν διὰ τοῦτο ἐπλανήθημεν

text_en: And we are all become as one unclean , and all our justices as the rag of a menstruous woman : and we have all fallen as a leaf, and our iniquities , like the wind, have taken us away.
text_la: Et facti sumus ut immundus omnes nos, et quasi pannus menstruatæ universæ justitiæ nostræ; et cecidimus quasi folium universi, et iniquitates nostræ quasi ventus abstulerunt nos.
text_pt: Mas todos nós somos como o imundo, e todas as nossas justiças como trapo da imundícia; e todos nós murchamos como a folha, e as nossas iniqüidades como um vento nos arrebatam.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθημεν ὡς ἀκάθαρτοι πάντες ἡμεῖς ὡς ῥάκος ἀποκαθημένης πᾶσα ἡ δικαιοσύνη ἡμῶν καὶ ἐξερρύημεν ὡς φύλλα διὰ τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν οὕτως ἄνεμος οἴσει ἡμᾶς

text_en: There is none that calls upon your name : that rises up, and takes hold of you: you have hid your face from us, and have crushed us in the hand of our iniquity .
text_la: Non est qui invocet nomen tuum; qui consurgat, et teneat te. Abscondisti faciem tuam a nobis, et allisisti nos in manu iniquitatis nostræ.
text_pt: E já ninguém há que invoque o teu nome, que se desperte, e te detenhas; porque escondes de nós o teu rosto, e nos fazes derreter, por causa das nossas iniqüidades.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐπικαλούμενος τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ ὁ μνησθεὶς ἀντιλαβέσθαι σου ὅτι ἀπέστρεψας τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀφ' ἡμῶν καὶ παρέδωκας ἡμᾶς διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν

text_en: And now, O Lord , you are our father, and we are clay: and you are our maker, and we all are the works of your hands.
text_la: Et nunc, Domine, pater noster es tu, nos vero lutum; et fictor noster tu, et opera manuum tuarum omnes nos.
text_pt: Mas agora, ó Senhor, tu és nosso Pai; nós o barro e tu o nosso oleiro; e todos nós a obra das tuas mãos.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε πατὴρ ἡμῶν σύ ἡμεῖς δὲ πηλὸς ἔργον τῶν χειρῶν σου πάντες

text_en: Be not very angry , O Lord , and remember no longer our iniquity : behold, see we are all your people.
text_la: Ne irascaris, Domine, satis, et ne ultra memineris iniquitatis nostræ; ecce, respice, populus tuus omnes nos.
text_pt: Não te enfureças tanto, ó Senhor, nem perpetuamente te lembres da iniqüidade; olha, pois, nós te pedimos, todos nós somos o teu povo.
text_el: μὴ ὀργίζου ἡμῖν σφόδρα καὶ μὴ ἐν καιρῷ μνησθῇς ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν καὶ νῦν ἐπίβλεψον ὅτι λαός σου πάντες ἡμεῖς

text_en: The city of your sanctuary has become a desert , Sion is made a desert , Jerusalem is desolate.
text_la: Civitas Sancti tui facta est deserta, Sion deserta facta est, Jerusalem desolata est.
text_pt: As tuas santas cidades tornaram-se um deserto; Sião está feita um deserto, Jerusalém está assolada.
text_el: πόλις τοῦ ἁγίου σου ἐγενήθη ἔρημος Σιων ὡς ἔρημος ἐγενήθη Ιερουσαλημ εἰς κατάραν

text_en: The house of our holiness , and of our glory , where our fathers praised you, is burnt with fire, and all our lovely things are turned into ruins.
text_la: Domus sanctificationis nostræ et gloriæ nostræ, ubi laudaverunt te patres nostri, facta est in exustionem ignis, et omnia desiderabilia nostra versa sunt in ruinas.
text_pt: A nossa santa e gloriosa casa, em que te louvavam nossos pais, foi queimada a fogo; e todas as nossas coisas preciosas se tornaram em assolação.
text_el: ὁ οἶκος τὸ ἅγιον ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ δόξα ἣν ηὐλόγησαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐγενήθη πυρίκαυστος καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔνδοξα συνέπεσεν

text_en: Will you refrain yourself, O Lord , upon these things, will you hold your peace, and afflict us vehemently?
text_la: Numquid super his continebis te, Domine; tacebis, et affliges nos vehementer?
text_pt: Conter-te-ias tu ainda sobre estas coisas, ó Senhor? Ficarias calado, e nos afligirias tanto?
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσι τούτοις ἀνέσχου κύριε καὶ ἐσιώπησας καὶ ἐταπείνωσας ἡμᾶς σφόδρα

text_en: They have sought me that before asked not for me, they have found me that sought me not. I said: Behold me, behold me, to a nation that did not call upon my name .
text_la: Quæsierunt me qui ante non interrogabant; invenerunt qui non quæsierunt me. Dixi : Ecce ego, ecce ego, ad gentem quæ non invocabat nomen meum.
text_pt: Fui buscado dos que não perguntavam por mim, fui achado daqueles que não me buscavam; a uma nação que não se chamava do meu nome eu disse: Eis-me aqui. Eis-me aqui.
text_el: ἐμφανὴς ἐγενόμην τοῖς ἐμὲ μὴ ζητοῦσιν εὑρέθην τοῖς ἐμὲ μὴ ἐπερωτῶσιν εἶπα ἰδού εἰμι τῷ ἔθνει οἳ οὐκ ἐκάλεσάν μου τὸ ὄνομα

text_en: I have spread forth my hands all the day to an unbelieving people, who walk in a way that is not good after their own thoughts.
text_la: Expandi manus meas tota die ad populum incredulum, qui graditur in via non bona post cogitationes suas.
text_pt: Estendi as minhas mãos o dia todo a um povo rebelde, que anda por caminho, que não é bom, após os seus pensamentos;
text_el: ἐξεπέτασα τὰς χεῖράς μου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν πρὸς λαὸν ἀπειθοῦντα καὶ ἀντιλέγοντα οἳ οὐκ ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδῷ ἀληθινῇ ἀλλ' ὀπίσω τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: A people that continually provoke me to anger before my face, that immolate in gardens, and sacrifice upon bricks.
text_la: Populus qui ad iracundiam provocat me ante faciem meam semper; qui immolant in hortis, et sacrificant super lateres;
text_pt: Povo que de contínuo me irrita diante da minha face, sacrificando em jardins e queimando incenso sobre altares de tijolos;
text_el: ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ὁ παροξύνων με ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ διὰ παντός αὐτοὶ θυσιάζουσιν ἐν τοῖς κήποις καὶ θυμιῶσιν ἐπὶ ταῖς πλίνθοις τοῖς δαιμονίοις ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν

text_en: That dwell in sepulchres, and sleep in the temple of idols : that eat swine's flesh, and profane broth is in their vessels.
text_la: qui habitant in sepulchris, et in delubris idolorum dormiunt; qui comedunt carnem suillam, et jus profanum in vasis eorum;
text_pt: Que habita entre as sepulturas, e passa as noites junto aos lugares secretos; come carne de porco e tem caldo de coisas abomináveis nos seus vasos;
text_el: καὶ ἐν τοῖς μνήμασιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς σπηλαίοις κοιμῶνται δι' ἐνύπνια οἱ ἔσθοντες κρέα ὕεια καὶ ζωμὸν θυσιῶν μεμολυμμένα πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῶν

text_en: That say: Depart from me, come not near me, because you are unclean : these shall be smoke in my anger , a fire burning all the day.
text_la: qui dicunt : Recede a me, non appropinques mihi, quia immundus es. Isti fumus erunt in furore meo, ignis ardens tota die.
text_pt: Que dizem: Fica onde estás, e não te chegues a mim, porque sou mais santo do que tu. Estes são fumaça no meu nariz, um fogo que arde todo o dia.
text_el: οἱ λέγοντες πόρρω ἀπ' ἐμοῦ μὴ ἐγγίσῃς μου ὅτι καθαρός εἰμι οὗτος καπνὸς τοῦ θυμοῦ μου πῦρ καίεται ἐν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: Behold it is written before me: I will not be silent, but I will render and repay into their bosom.
text_la: Ecce scriptum est coram me : Non tacebo, sed reddam, et retribuam in sinum eorum.
text_pt: Eis que está escrito diante de mim: não me calarei; mas eu pagarei, sim, pagarei no seu seio,
text_el: ἰδοὺ γέγραπται ἐνώπιόν μου οὐ σιωπήσω ἕως ἂν ἀποδῶ εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτῶν

text_en: Your iniquities , and the iniquities of your fathers together, says the Lord , who have sacrificed upon the mountains, and have reproached me upon the hills; and I will measure back their first work in their bosom.
text_la: Iniquitates vestras, et iniquitates patrum vestrorum simul, dicit Dominus; qui sacrificaverunt super montes, et super colles exprobraverunt mihi; et remetiar opus eorum primum in sinu eorum.
text_pt: As vossas iniqüidades, e juntamente as iniqüidades de vossos pais, diz o Senhor, que queimaram incenso nos montes, e me afrontaram nos outeiros; assim lhes tornarei a medir as suas obras antigas no seu seio.
text_el: τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν λέγει κύριος οἳ ἐθυμίασαν ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν βουνῶν ὠνείδισάν με ἀποδώσω τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτῶν

text_en: Thus says the Lord : As if a grain be found in a cluster, and it be said: Destroy it not, because it is a blessing : so will I do for the sake of my servants, that I may not destroy the whole.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Quomodo si inveniatur granum in botro, et dicatur : Ne dissipes illud, quoniam benedictio est : sic faciam propter servos meos, ut non disperdam totum.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Como quando se acha mosto num cacho de uvas, dizem: Não o desperdices, pois há bênção nele, assim farei por amor de meus servos, que não os destrua a todos,
text_el: οὕτως λέγει κύριος ὃν τρόπον εὑρεθήσεται ὁ ῥὼξ ἐν τῷ βότρυι καὶ ἐροῦσιν μὴ λυμήνῃ αὐτὸν ὅτι εὐλογία κυρίου ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῷ οὕτως ποιήσω ἕνεκεν τοῦ δουλεύοντός μοι τούτου ἕνεκεν οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσω πάντας

text_en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob , and out of Juda a possessor of my mountains: and my elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
text_la: Et educam de Jacob semen, et de Juda possidentem montes meos; et hæreditabunt eam electi mei, et servi mei habitabunt ibi.
text_pt: E produzirei descendência a Jacó, e a Judá um herdeiro que possua os meus montes; e os meus eleitos herdarão a terra e os meus servos habitarão ali.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάξω τὸ ἐξ Ιακωβ σπέρμα καὶ τὸ ἐξ Ιουδα καὶ κληρονομήσει τὸ ὄρος τὸ ἅγιόν μου καὶ κληρονομήσουσιν οἱ ἐκλεκτοί μου καὶ οἱ δοῦλοί μου καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And the plains shall be turned to folds of flocks, and the valley of Achor into a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
text_la: Et erunt campestria in caulas gregum, et vallis Achor in cubile armentorum, populo meo qui requisierunt me.
text_pt: E Sarom servirá de curral de rebanhos, e o vale de Acor lugar de repouso de gados, para o meu povo, que me buscou.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ἐν τῷ δρυμῷ ἐπαύλεις ποιμνίων καὶ φάραγξ Αχωρ εἰς ἀνάπαυσιν βουκολίων τῷ λαῷ μου οἳ ἐζήτησάν με

text_en: And you, that have forsaken the Lord , that have forgotten my holy mount, that set a table for fortune , and offer libations upon it,
